abstract: The present invention relates to a robot and a method for controlling the robot, and an embodiment of the present invention may comprise: a robot body within which a battery is accommodated; two wheels which are disposed under the robot body; two leg parts which are connected between the robot body and the wheels respectively; an arm which has a one-piece structure and includes a pair of rotary coupling portions rotatably coupled to the robot body and disposed at left and right sides respectively and a connection portion connecting the pair of rotary coupling portions to each other; and a sensor part which senses an obstacle located on a travel path of the wheels and obstructing the travel of the wheels, wherein a predetermined countermotion is performed when the sensor part senses the obstacle, and the countermotion includes a rotational motion of the arm.
title: ROBOT AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING ROBOT

abstract: The invention relates to a lower limb exoskeleton based on load bearing support and self-weight balance. The lower limb exoskeleton comprises two symmetrically-distributed mechanical legs, a fixed connecting plate arranged at the top ends of the mechanical legs and connected with the two mechanical legs and a protective tool connected with the mechanical legs in a sliding mode and used for being worn on an upper body of a human body, Each mechanical leg sequentially comprises a trunk mechanism, a hip mechanism, a gravity balance mechanism, a one-way ratchet and pawl clutch mechanism and a plantar mechanism from top to bottom, the trunk mechanisms are in sliding connection with the protective tool, each plantar mechanism comprises a shoe used for being worn on a foot of the human body, a plantar joint and a plantar triggering assembly, The shoes and the plantar joints are both connected with the plantar triggering assembly, Bowden cables used for transmitting force is arranged between the plantar triggering assemblies and the one-way ratchet and pawl clutch mechanisms, and the plantar joints are rotationally connected with the one-way ratchet and pawl clutch mechanisms. Compared with the prior art, the human body can be supported, the gravity can be loaded, and the self-weight of the exoskeleton and the gravity of legs of the human body can be balanced.
title: Lower limb exoskeleton based on load bearing support and self-weight balance

abstract: A robot has a body and at least two legs extending from the robot body, each leg comprising a plurality of links that are rotatably connected. A ground contacting assembly is rotatably connected to the distal link of each leg. The ground contacting assembly is configured to provide an increase in roll range of motion and to facilitate abduction and adduction of the leg for traversing terrain.
title: Method and system for improving stability in a legged robot

abstract: The invention discloses a slip driving-based curved surface adaptive all-round omni-directional wall climbing robot, which comprises a body and two mechanical legs, wherein each mechanical leg comprises a feeding mechanism, a rotating mechanism and at least three adaptive curvature adsorption mechanisms; and the flexibility of an electric push rod and the degrees of freedom of rotation of the rotating mechanisms enable the mechanical legs to realize front and back interference-free continuous reciprocating motion under the driving of a linear sliding table. The slip driving-based curved surface adaptive all-round omni-directional wall climbing robot can passively adapt to curvature changes of various working surfaces, and has motion flexibility and passability to realize omni-directional motion and obstacle crossing on a working surface with a complex variable curvature. Based on a discrete fixed contact form, the wall climbing robot and the working surface have no relative slip, whicheffectively avoids damage of the robot to a paint film on the working surface. By adoption of an electromagnet and permanent magnet combination adsorption form, reliable adsorption and flexible lifting up in a moving process of the robot can be realized. A permanent magnet guarantees the reliable adsorption property of the robot in a power-losing state on the working surface, so that the safety coefficient is substantially increased.
title: Slip driving-based curved surface adaptive all-round omni-directional wall climbing robot

abstract: The two legged robot has a stabilising actuator in the form of a gyroscopic rotor [1] with a coupled motor [2] that is controlled [3] based upon rotational speed [5] and robot position [4]. The actuator speed is controlled such that its inertial force varies dependent on position to provide a stabilising action.
title: Stability control of a two legged robot is provided by controlling the speed of the inertial rotor of a gyroscopic actuator

abstract: A bipedal robot 21 has articulated legs 23L, 23R moved by servo motors 29L, 29R, 30L, 30R, 31L, 31 R at its simulated hip, knee and ankle joints, respectively. These are controlled by an electronic control system 25 which is fed motion data by a remote computer, along wires or wirelessly. The motion data may be captured using a harness 1 worn by an experimental subject 2. The harness 1 is strapped to each leg of the subject 2 and has potentiometers at its ankle 9, knee 10 and hip joints 11, aligned with the subject's corresponding joints, which provide data on angular displacement of the joints against time. These data may be transmitted to the robot 21 in real time, or stored for later transmission, possibly after further processing. The computer may also display the data on-screen as graphs and/or as a mannequin image.
title: Motion logging and robotic control and display system

abstract: The lower extremity exoskeleton comprises two leg supports connectable to person's lower limbs and configured to rest on the ground during their stance phase. Each leg support comprises a thigh link and a shank link; a knee joint configured to allow flexion and extension between the shank link and the thigh link. The lower extremity exoskeleton further comprises an exoskeleton trunk connectable to the person's upper body. The exoskeleton trunk is connectable to the thigh links of the leg supports allowing for the flexion and extension between the leg supports and the exoskeleton trunk. Two torque generators are coupled to each of the knee joints. A power unit, capable of providing power, is coupled to the torque generators. In operation when a leg support is in a stance phase and climbing a slope or stairs, the power unit injects power into the respective torque generator thereby extending the respective knee angle. When a leg support is in stance phase and not climbing a slope or stairs, the power unit does not inject any power to the respective torque generator, but without dissipating any stored power in said power unit, it forces the torque generator to resist flexion of the respective knee joint. When a leg support is in a swing phase, the power unit does not inject any power to the respective torque generator, but without dissipating any stored power in said power unit, it forces the torque generator to minimize its resistance to knee flexion and extension.
title: Semi-powered lower extremity exoskeleton

abstract: In a mobile robot (1) having at least a body (3) and two leg members (2) connected to the body, a parallel linkage (7) is provided between the body and the two leg members such that each of the two leg members is movable relative to the body in a substantially vertical direction. More specifically, the parallel linkage (7) is composed of upper and lower links (90, 92) and right and left links (94R, 94L) each connected to the upper and lower links, and the body is connected to the upper and lower links through first and second fulcrums (100, 102), while the two leg members are each connected to the right and left links. An actuator (104) is provided at the second fulcrum (102) to move the two leg members relative to the body substantially in the vertical direction. Moreover, the body is connected to the parallel linkage through a joint such that the body is movable relative to the two leg members around the gravity axis. With this, the robot can effectively absorb and mitigate footfall impact, offer a high degree of freedom in gait design, thereby enabling rapid, energy-efficient locomotion in a stable attitude, and permit free body movement. <IMAGE>
title: Legged mobile robot

abstract: A mobility enhancing device in the form of an exoskeleton provides mobility assistance or enhancement to a user within the exoskeleton. The exoskeleton may include a torso support and two leg supports coupled to the torso support. Each leg support may include a hip joint, a knee joint, a foot module, and panels connecting the torso support to the hip joints, the hip joints to the knee joints, and the knee joints to the foot modules. Actuators such as motors may be positioned in a discrete location on exoskeleton away from the relatively bulky knee and hip joints to provide for a low profile of the exoskeleton, which may allow the exoskeleton to be worn inconspicuously under a user's clothing.
title: Low profile exoskeleton

abstract: The present disclosure provides a zero moment point jitter processing method as well as an apparatus and a robot using the same. The method includes: obtaining left foot force information and right foot force information collected by sensors; calculating a first zero moment point and a second zero moment point of soles of two feet of a robot based on the left foot force information and the right foot force information; calculating a third zero moment point of the robot according to the first zero moment point and the second zero moment point; calculating a jitter amplitude of the third zero moment point within a preset period; and adjusting a position of the third zero moment point in response to the jitter amplitude being not larger than a predetermined jitter amplitude threshold. In this manner, the robot can eliminate zero moment point jitters within a certain amplitude.
title: Zero moment point jitter processing method and apparatus and robot using the same

abstract: A heterogeneous exoskeleton robot comprises a back part and two leg parts, and the back part is rotationally connected with the two leg parts; the device further comprises an adjustable straddle bandage and an adjustable upper limb structure used for underarm supporting. Each leg part comprises a power driving structure, a telescopic leg, a grounding detection structure and a flexible pressure detection structure; the flexible pressure detection structure comprises a hydraulic detection module and a hydraulic sensor module; the power driving structure is rotationally connected with the back part; the upper end of the telescopic leg is connected with an output part of the power driving structure; the grounding detection structure is arranged at the lower end of the telescopic leg; and the hydraulic detection module is arranged on the ground contact detection structure and is connected with the hydraulic sensor module arranged on the telescopic leg. The device is compact in structure, reduces the weight of a human body, overcomes the influence of gravity on walking of the human body, achieves gait detection in a hydraulic mode, and is high in reliability.
title: Heterogeneous exoskeleton robot

abstract: The invention provides a labor-saving walking aid without external power input. The labor-saving walking aid without external power input comprises a walking aid body, a connecting kit, a ratchet mechanism and an energy storing torsional spring. The labor-saving walking aid can be worn on two feet of a user, energy used for doing negative work in the human body walking process is stored and released when positive work is done, and then external power input free type assisting is achieved. Meanwhile, the exoskeleton dead weight is reduced on the basis of optimized structure design, and the exoskeleton flexibility and the people walking efficiency are improved. In addition, any state stopping of the user in the walking process is achieved by applying the non-return ratchet mechanism, therefore, the walking aid locks the energy when the user is static, the design purposes of storing energy and saving labor are achieved, and the stability and the controllability of the device are greatly improved. According to the novel exoskeleton wearing mode, the portability and the practicability of the product are enhanced.
title: Labor-saving walking aid without external power input

abstract: A machine such as a machine tool includes a pair of spaced platforms. One platform may mount an operator such as a tool in a spindle, and the other platform may mount an object such as a workpiece. The spaced platforms are joined by six powered and extensible legs joined to the respective platforms by universal joints. The length of the legs is individually manipulated to vary the positions of the platforms and, therefore, the object and operator relative to each other. Four of the legs are arranged into two pairs which are spaced apart to provide between them a part of a corridor for moving the workpiece into a working position. The two legs in each pair may cross each other. The other two legs extend away from each other and provide another part of the corridor between their inboard ends.
title: Six axis machine tool

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of special service robots, and discloses a Bowden cable transmission-based modular knee joint power-assisted exoskeleton device, which comprises a waist binding module, two leg binding modules, two execution end modules, two motor end modules, two Bowden cables and a main control module, each leg binding module comprises a thigh binding module, a knee binding module and a shank binding module which are sequentially connected from top to bottom; the execution end module is arranged on the knee binding module, and the motor end module is arranged on the waist binding module; bowden cables are respectively connected between the motor end modules and the execution end modules on the corresponding sides. The main control module is arranged on the waist binding module and used for controlling the working state of the motor end module, the motor end module controls the execution end module through a Bowden cable, and therefore assistance of the leg binding module is achieved. The forward extension assisting device can output torque for forward extension assisting when the knee joint is switched from the flexion state to the extension state, and the forward extension assisting capacity of the knee joint is enhanced.
title: Modularized knee joint power-assisted exoskeleton device based on Bowden cable transmission

abstract: A robotic platform for traversing and manipulating a modular 3D lattice structure is described. The robot is designed specifically for its tasks within a structured environment, and is simplified in terms of its numbers of degrees of freedom (DOF). This allows for simpler controls and a reduction of mass and cost. Designing the robot relative to the environment in which it operates results in a specific type of robot called a 'relative robot'. Depending on the task and environment, there can be a number of relative robots. This invention describes a bipedal robot which can locomote across a periodic lattice structure made of building block parts. The robot is able to handle, manipulate, and transport these blocks when there is more than one robot. Based on a general inchworm design, the robot has added functionality while retaining minimal complexity, and can perform numerous maneuvers for increased speed, reach, and placement.
title: BIPEDAL ISOTROPIC LATTICE LOCOMOTING EXPLORER: ROBOTIC PLATFORM FOR LOCOMOTION AND MANIPULATION OF DISCRETE LATTICE STRUCTURES AND LIGHTWEIGHT SPACE STRUCTURES

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of space suit performance testing and particularly relates to a testing robot of lower limb performance of a space suit. The robot comprises a pressure keeping box, an air circulation component, an air cooling unit, a cooling hose component and two mechanical legs. The air cooling unit is connected to the pressure keeping box. The air circulation component is arranged in the pressure keeping box. The mechanical legs are installed on the pressure keeping box and are internally provided with the cooling hose component. Air in the pressure keeping boxis cooled through the air cooling unit and is sent to the cooling hose component via the air circulation component. Each of the mechanical legs comprises a thigh, a knee joint component, a calf, an ankle joint component and a foot. The thigh is connected to the calf through the knee joint component, the calf is connected to the foot through the ankle joint component, the knee joint component is provided with a knee joint driving component and a knee joint transmission component, and the ankle joint component is provided with an ankle joint driving component and an ankle joint transmission component. The testing robot has the advantages that the control precision of a motion trajectory is high, the size is adjustable, and the robot can be applied to lower limb tests of different space suits.
title: Testing robot of lower limb performance of space suit

abstract: Disclosed are robotic systems, methods, bipedal robot devices, and computer-readable mediums. For example, a robotic system may include a robotic body, a robotic hip connected to the robotic body, and a ball screw connected to the robotic hip. Further, the robotic system may include a robotic leg connected to the robotic hip parallel to the ball screw. Yet further, the robotic hip includes a motor that is linearly movable to one or more positions along the ball screw between one end of the robotic leg and an opposite end of the robotic leg.
title: Robotic leg parallel to a ball screw

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic control, and concretely relates to a multi-mode deformation wheel, a control method and device thereof, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and aims to improve the environmental adaptability of the deformation wheel. The deformation wheel comprises a wheel body, a first motor for controlling the wheel body to rotate, a control part rotationally assembled on the wheel body, a second motor for controlling the control part to rotate and at least two groups of telescopic leg parts, each group of telescopic leg parts comprises two legrods, and the first ends of the two leg rods are rotationally connected to form a connecting end; the second end of the first leg rod is rotationally connected with the control part, and the second end of the second leg rod is rotationally connected with the wheel body; and the second motor drives the control part to rotate to drive the two leg rods of the telescopic leg part to rotate, so that the connecting end moves towards the edge of the wheel body and extends out of the edge of the wheel body, or the connecting end and the two leg rods are retracted into the edge of the wheel body fromthe outside of the edge of the wheel body. Deformation is realized through the telescopic leg parts, so that the environmental adaptability is enhanced.
title: Multi-mode deformation wheel, control method and device thereof, electronic equipment and storage medium

abstract: The invention relates to a frog kick scooter sliding robot capable of adjusting a gravity center based on a ball screw. The frog kick scooter sliding robot capable of adjusting the gravity center based on the ball screw comprises two rear wheels, two inclined wheel carriers, two legs, a motor, a lead screw platform, a mass block, a sliding table, a gravity center adjustment control box, a front wheel control platform and a front wheel, wherein the rear wheels are installed on the inclined wheel carriers, the inclined wheel carriers are connected with the legs, and a certain inclination angle exists between the free rotating axes and the vertical axes of the inclined wheel carriers; the motor, the lead screw platform, the mass block, the sliding table and the gravity center adjustment control box form a gravity center adjustment mechanism, the lead screw platform is fixedly arranged on the two legs, the motor is installed at one end of the lead screw platform, the gravity center adjustment control box is installed at the other end of the lead screw platform, the sliding table is installed on the lead screw platform, and the mass block is installed on the sliding table; the two legs are symmetrically installed, certain ends of the two legs are installed on the front wheel control platform, and the front wheel is installed on the front wheel control platform. The frog kick scooter sliding robot capable of adjusting the gravity center based on the ball screw has the features of fewer control degrees of freedom, simple mechanism and the like.
title: Frog kick scooter sliding robot capable of adjusting gravity center based on ball screw

abstract: A method and processor (16) for obtaining torques to be applied to joints (8,10,12) of a leg (2) of a biped walking system (1) are provided. The method comprises the steps of obtaining moments acting around the joints (8,10,12) of the leg (2), using the vertical component (Fz) of the ground reaction force acting on the leg (2) at the point of application of the ground reaction force, the vertical components (F 1 z,F 2 z) of forces acting on the joints (8,10,12) of the leg (2) and a term of the acceleration of gravity and without using the horizontal components of the forces acting on the joints (8,10,12) of the leg (2) and a term of acceleration except the term of the acceleration of gravity and obtaining the torques to be applied to the joints (8,10,12) of the leg (2), based on the moments acting around the joints (8,10,12) of the leg (2). The vertical component of the ground reaction force acting on the leg (2), is obtained based on which leg or legs (2) are in contact with the ground. The processor (16) is configured to perform the above steps.
title: Method and processor for obtaining moments and torques in a biped walking system

abstract: The invention relates to a double-leg type medical leg massage manipulator. The double-leg type medical leg massage manipulator comprises L-shaped base poles, the bottom ends of the two L-shaped base poles are symmetrically arranged at the back of an L-shaped base frame; two leg massage devices are symmetrically mounted on the upper end surface of the L-shaped base frame; each leg massage device comprises a massage base plate welded on the left side surface of the upper end of the L-shaped base frame, a hydraulic cylinder IV is mounted on the inner wall of the massage base plate, a massage moving block is mounted at the top end of the hydraulic cylinder IV, a linear sliding rail II is mounted on the left end surface of the massage moving block and is mounted on the left side surface of the upper end of the L-shaped base frame through a screw, the left end surface of the massage moving block is limited by the linear sliding rail II, so that the left end surface of the massage moving block can stably move back and forth on the linear sliding rail II, and a linear sliding rail III is mounted on the lower end surface of the massage moving block and on the bottom surface of the upper end of the L-shaped base frame through a screw. The manipulator can perform automatic and uniform lifting massage function on the legs, and a new approach is provided for leg massage.
title: Double-leg type medical leg massage manipulator

abstract: The invention provides a motion analysis method and system based on image and sole contact modeling, and the method comprises the steps: reconstructing a three-dimensional posture of the motion of a subject according to recognized 2D key points, and generating a personalized skeleton model matched with the subject according to the height data of the subject; the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a pelma image of a subject, automatically generating a plurality of contact balls in a pelma region according to an extracted pelma contour shape to approximately represent each region where the pelma is in contact with the ground, and optimally setting the positions and radiuses of the contact balls according to the foot type of the subject to form a personalized pelma contact model; according to the personalized skeleton model, the joint movement data and the personalized plantar contact model, solving a ground reaction force GRF which enables dynamics to be consistent under a given kinematics condition; determining a moving path of a resultant force acting point of stress along with time according to the stress condition of each contact ball of the two feet, and calculating a track of a plantar pressure center COP. Motion analysis can be carried out based on image and plantar contact modeling.
title: Motion analysis method and system based on image and sole contact modeling

abstract: The invention provides a wall climbing device, and relates to the technical field of climbing equipment. The wall climbing device comprises an adsorption module which comprises an electromagnet; the switch module is used for controlling the power-on and power-off of the electromagnet; the number of the adsorption modules is four, and the adsorption modules correspond to the two hands and the two feet of the human body respectively. The two adsorption modules located on the same side or at the opposite angles are connected in series and share the same switch module. The wall climbing device hasthe advantages of being simple in structure, low in cost, convenient to operate, small in occupied space and the like, a worker only needs to wear the wall climbing device on the body when using thewall climbing device, and meanwhile the wall climbing device can help the worker to work high above the ground in a narrow area.
title: Wall climbing device

abstract: The invention discloses a parallel leg-imitating type quick tree climbing robot which comprises a trunk rack, a clamping mechanism, an operation manipulator, two arm holding modules and two mechanical legs, the operation manipulator is mounted at the top of the trunk rack, and the clamping mechanism is mounted on the trunk rack; the two embracing arm modules and the two mechanical legs are symmetrically installed on the two sides of the trunk rack respectively, each mechanical leg comprises a hip joint module, a thigh module, a shank module, an ankle module, a foot plate and a climber module, the thigh module comprises a first connecting rod, a second connecting rod, a second motor and a third motor, the second motor is connected with the first connecting rod, and the third motor is connected with the second connecting rod; the shank module comprises a third connecting rod and a fourth connecting rod, the third connecting rod is connected with the first connecting rod, the fourth connecting rod is connected with the second connecting rod, and the fourth connecting rod is connected with the third connecting rod, so that the thigh module and the shank module are connected in parallel; through cooperation of the clamping mechanism and the operation mechanical arm, the function that the tree climbing robot works on tree trunk branches is achieved.
title: Parallel leg-imitating type quick tree-climbing robot

abstract: The invention discloses a hexapod robot. The robot comprises a head part, a body, a driving device, a transmission system and six mechanical legs. The hexapod robot is characterized in that the six mechanical legs are reversely and symmetrically mounted on both sides of the long edge of the body, and adopt the completely same structures; the driving device and the transmission system are arrayed at the inner part of the body; the driving device performs driving through a servo motor, and the transmission system performs transmission through sprocket chains; three output rods are also arranged at the inner part of the body, and the two mechanical legs are reversely and symmetrically mounted on both sides of each output rod; the six mechanical legs are divided into three groups, and the three groups of output rods are connected in a transmission manner by adopting the sprocket chains; the servo motor of the driving device designed at the inner part of the body simultaneously drives the six mechanical legs to move.
title: Hexapod robot

abstract: The invention discloses a magnetic adsorption type climbing detection robot. The magnetic adsorption type climbing detection robot comprises a body device and at least two mechanical legs, the body device comprises a body shell, a power supply, a control module and a detection device, and the power supply, the control module and the detection device are installed in the body shell; the mechanical leg comprises a steering device and an electromagnetic adsorption leg, the steering device is installed on the body shell, one end of the electromagnetic adsorption leg is connected with the steering device, an electric appliance assembly of the steering device is connected with the control module through a wire, and when the control module sends a steering instruction, the steering device acts to drive the electromagnetic adsorption leg to rotate; the other end of the electromagnetic adsorption leg is provided with an electromagnet, the electromagnet is connected with the control module through a wire, the control module controls on-off of current on the electromagnet, the electromagnetic adsorption leg is made to adsorb or break away from the surface of the magnetic metal to be detected, and therefore the robot stably walking on a magnetic conductive metal surface in a complex detection environment is provided.
title: Magnetic adsorption type climbing detection robot

abstract: A servo system for controlling locomotion of a biped walking robot to follow up a target angle for each drive predetermined in series with respect to time. The control is stabilized by reducing the load on the on-board computer through the provision of an analog circuit for velocity control which has to be carried out in short control cycle and a digital circuit for positional control which can be carried out in relatively long control cycle. For reducing the control deviation to substantially zero, open-loop control is adopted for the motor angular velocity so as to prevent delay from arising in the joint angle control and position feedback control is conducted only in case where a deviation arises between the target joint angle and the actual joint angle owing to external disturbance or the like. <IMAGE>
title: System for controlling locomotion of legged walking robot

abstract: The invention provides a power-assisted exoskeleton. The power-assisted exoskeleton comprises a bracket unit, a driving unit, a waist transmission unit, a back power-assisted unit and two leg power-assisted units, the bracket unit is suitable for being fixed on a human body; the driving unit comprises a first rotating shaft; the waist transmission unit is arranged on the bracket unit and comprises a second rotating shaft which is in reverse transmission connection with the first rotating shaft; the back power assisting unit is in circumferential limiting connection with the second rotating shaft; the two leg assisting units are connected with the first rotating shaft in a circumferential limiting manner; when the driving unit operates, the first rotating shaft rotates in the clockwise direction and drives the second rotating shaft to rotate in the anticlockwise direction, so that the back assisting unit is driven to rotate in the anticlockwise direction to apply pulling force to the back of the human body, and the leg assisting unit is driven to rotate in the clockwise direction to apply pressure to the legs of the human body. Under the dual effects of pulling force applied to the back and pressure applied to the legs, a person can be assisted to bend down to lift a heavy object, and the weight of the waist of the human body can be remarkably reduced.
title: Power-assisted exoskeleton

abstract: The invention relates to a method and system for estimating the mass center state of a biped robot in real time, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the stress information of the two feet of the biped robot and the IMU information of the biped robot through a six-dimensional torque sensor and an IMU, and obtaining the mass center state of the biped robot according to the stress information and the IMU information; calculating to obtain COP point information and centroid information of the biped robot under different supporting legs; according to the IMU information, the position and speed of the mass center under the COP points corresponding to different supporting legs are obtained through calculation, and according to the optimal estimated value of the mass center state obtained through previous prediction, the current position and speed of the mass center are predicted through a linear inverted pendulum model, and prediction data are obtained; through Kalman filtering, the calculated positions and speeds of the center of mass at the corresponding COP points of different supporting legs are fused with prediction data, the optimal estimation value of the current center of mass state is obtained, and through the method, accurate center of mass state information can be obtained to be used for controlling the biped robot.
title: Method and system for estimating mass center state of biped robot in real time

abstract: The invention relates to a hexapod robot for fruit and vegetable picking and an operating method thereof. The hexapod robot for fruit and vegetable picking is characterized by comprising a body and six mechanical legs arranged thereof; the body is also provided with a picking mechanical arm, a collecting box, a visual recognition module, a tracking sensor arrangement plate, a gyroscope module, a control module and a power source. A picking claw is arranged at the tail end of the picking mechanical arm. Four mechanical legs are arranged at four corners of the body respectively; the other two mechanical legs are arranged symmetrically in the middle of the body. The movement mode of the hexapod robot is a leg mode; the hexapod robot is suitable for picking fruits and vegetables on a soft ground or severely uneven terrain, and has good flexibility; tracking sensors in rectangular arrangement are arranged on a lower plate of the body, and advancing may occur according to a preset path; thevisual recognition module is mounted on the picking mechanical arm, so that picking accuracy is improved; automatic picking on a relatively uneven terrain according to the set path is achieved; the hexapod robot has high practical value.
title: Hexapod robot for fruit and vegetable picking and operating method thereof

abstract: Walking mechanism for a robot, as well as a robot equipped with the walking mechanism walking mechanism (61) for a robot comprises two brackets (63, 65) each having two legs (67 - 73) which are rotatably connected to shoulder elements (83, 85). These shoulder elements are fitted to straight arms (87, 89) which are arranged at right angles to the shoulder elements. The free ends of the arms are connected to each other via a universal joint (9). The universal joint (91) comprises two U-shaped forks (93, 95) which are connected to each other via a cross of two shafts (97, 99) arranged at right angles to each other. The walking mechanism (61) is equipped with three motors for executing the necessary rotations for moving on. Motor (101) is capable of rotating the fork (93) around the shaft (97) of the cross. Motor (102) is capable of rotating the other fork (95) around the other shaft (97) of the cross. And motor (103) is capable of rotating the first bracket (63) around an imaginary axis (105) running parallel to the centre line of the first fork.
title: WALKING MECHANISM FOR A ROBOT, AS WELL AS A ROBOT EQUIPPED WITH THE WALKING MECHANISM

abstract: The invention discloses a foot force and moment following control method of a bipedal robot. According to the method, a double-spring damping model is designed, a force following controller is designed by using an LQR optimization method, and the following of the foot force and moment of the bipedal robot is realized; and the foot expected force and the foot expected moment are calculated by a planned ZMP (Zero Moment Point) distribution method, and finally, the ZMP following of the bipedal robot is better, and can adapt to a certain uneven ground. According to the foot force and moment following control method of the bipedal robot provided by the invention, the traditional ZMP following is abandoned, so that a control mode adaptive to the stable walking and the uneven ground of the bipedal robot can be realized, the foot expected force and the force moment that enable the robot to stably work are directly calculated, and the following of the foot force and the force moment is realized by directly controlling the foot expected force and the force moment, so that stable control is carried out in a more intrinsic and easier implementation manner, the control response is faster, the capability of adapting to the uneven ground is stronger, and the ZMP following effect is very ideal.
title: Foot force and moment following control method of bipedal robot

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and particularly discloses a quadruped robot which comprises a robot body provided with a control device. The two leg devices are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the machine body respectively, each leg device comprises a first motor, a first driving rod, a second motor, a second driving rod, a transmission rod and a leg rod, a driving shaft of the first motor is fixedly connected with one end of the first driving rod, a driving shaft of the second motor is fixedly connected with one end of the second driving rod, and a driving shaft of the transmission rod is fixedly connected with the other end of the second driving rod. The two ends of the transmission rod are pivoted to the other end of the first driving rod and the end of the leg rod respectively, the other end of the second driving rod is pivoted to the leg rod, and the leg rod is used for making contact with the ground. The control device is used for changing the rotating directions and rotating speeds of the first motor and the second motor so as to change the walking posture. The four-foot robot is good in walking stability and high in advancing efficiency.
title: Quadruped robot

abstract: PURPOSE: A method for generating the movement of the center of waist and feet in a vertical, lateral, and front side of a robot to bipedal walk is provided to solve the short time in a bipedal support section by setting the movement around the waist and the feet in a horizontal direction with respect to the bipedal support section and to smoothly move even if the bipedal support section is increased. CONSTITUTION: A method for generating the movement of the center of waist and feet in a vertical, lateral, and front side of a robot to bipedal walk comprises a step of controlling the time in a bipedal support section by drawing the time of the bipedal support section of the bipedal robot and the trace of the waist and the feet using a central pattern generator(S10). [Reference numerals] (AA) Start; (BB) End; (S10) Draw the trace of the waist center and feet of a bipedal robot using a central pattern generator and control the time of a bipedal support section of the bipedal robot
title: STABLE BIPEDAL WALKING ROBOT METHOD FOR GENERATING VERTICAL DIRECTION AND THE CENTER OF THE WAIST AND FEET, THE MOVEMENT DIRECTION OF THE FRONT OF THE ROBOT

abstract: The invention provides a wheel-foot robot with a balancing device. The wheel-foot robot comprises a robot body, the balancing device and two legs symmetrically installed on the two sides of the robot body, the working modes of the balancing device comprise a balancing mode and a grabbing mode, connecting structures are arranged at the two ends of the balancing device, one end can be connected with a mechanical arm and other operation structures, so that the balancing device has the functions of grabbing objects and the like while keeping the robot in a balanced state, and the functional diversity of the wheel-foot robot is increased. According to the wheel-foot robot, foot end suites of the legs and wheel type components are integrated on the same robot, and free switching between a foot type motion state and a wheel type motion state can be achieved in different environments; and a motor is arranged on the robot body and is driven by a connecting rod system, so that the effects of reducing the inertia of the foot ends, increasing the movement speed and reducing the energy consumption are achieved.
title: Wheel-foot robot with balancing device

abstract: PURPOSE: A vertical direction gravity center movement generating method using an evolutionarily optimized center pattern generator for stable biped walking is provided to change a walking figure by a variable walking pattern generator. CONSTITUTION: A gravity center path of a three-dimensional linear pendulum model in a vertical direction is generated through a center pattern generator. Disturbance by the movement of a gravity center in a vertical direction is compensated through a sensor feedback of the center pattern generator. The center pattern generator is optimized as an evolutionary algorithm. [Reference numerals] (AA) Start; (BB) Finish; (S11) Generate a vertical gravity center pattern of 3D linear inverted pendulum model by using a central pattern generator; (S12) Compensate distortion by the vertical movement of gravity through a sensor feedback of a central pattern generator; (S13) Optimize a central pattern generator for generating a vertical gravity path with an evolutionary algorithm; (S14) Produce μ0, r,r' of a neural scillator and K_f of a sensory feedback by optimizing a central pattern generator
title: VERTICAL CENTER OF MASS MOTION GENERATION METHOD USING EVOLUTIONARY OPTIMIZED CENTRAL PATTERN GENERATOR FOR HUMAN-LIKE STABLE BIPEDAL WALKING

abstract: The invention provides a robot hip structure and a biped walking robot. The robot hip structure comprises a hip joint base and two hip joint mechanisms. The hip joint mechanisms in the two hip joint mechanisms are symmetrically mounted on the two sides of the hip joint base; the hip joint mechanism comprises a first motor, a first telescopic rod, a second motor, a second telescopic rod, a connecting assembly, a hip joint tooth piece assembly, a differential tooth piece assembly, a hip joint connecting rod, a thigh supporting column, a hinge part and a four-connecting-rod assembly. The first telescopic rod is controlled by the first motor to do linear motion, and front-back swing of the thigh supporting column can be achieved; a second telescopic rod is controlled by a second motor to do linear motion, so that a hip joint connecting rod rotates under the action of the second motor, the hip joint connecting rod rotates to drive a differential tooth piece assembly to rotate, the degree-of-freedom motion of the hip in two directions can be achieved, and meanwhile the hip structure can adapt to various complex terrains.
title: Robot hip structure and biped walking robot

abstract: A bipedal exoskeleton configured to be worn by a human user. The exoskeleton includes a soft “backpack”-style harness that interfaces primarily with the user's waist, back, and shoulders. A chassis is provided to mount two positively-driven legs. Each leg includes features that are analogous to a human leg—a hip joint, a thigh, a knee joint, a calf, and a foot plate. Each leg of the exoskeleton is physically connected to one of the human user's legs. A thigh cuff is used to connect to the user's thigh. A shin cuff is used to connect to the user's calf. A foot plate rests beneath the sole of the user's foot. Power actuators are provided in the exoskeleton's hip and knee joints, and possibly additional locations. A user interface is provided in one or more locations so that the user can control desired functions of the exoskeleton.
title: Bipedal Exoskeleton and Methods of Use

abstract: The present invention relates to an exoskeleton (100) configured to be worn by a user in order to support and transfer a load carried by the user comprising a hip module (300) which is connected to two leg modules (400) each connected to two foot modules (500) respectively, wherein said exoskeleton (100) is adapted to be maintained on the body of the user and follow the user's movements and wherein said exoskeleton (100) is configured in such a way as to transfer to the load carried by the user from the hip module (300) down to the ground via the leg modules (400) and the foot modules (500) when the exoskeleton (100) is in use. In one embodiment, the exoskeleton further comprises a back module (200).
title: ADJUSTABLE PASSIVE EXOSKELETON

abstract: A legged mobile robot having a body and two legs each connected to the body. The robot is quipped with a mechanism for absorbing and moderating impacts produced by external forces during footfall or the like. The mechanism includes an elastic member interposed between the body and legs, or interposed between the leg links, or interposed between the distal end of the legs and foot portions. The robot further has a foot structure for enhancing the ground gripping force and absorbs the impacts. For enhancing the gripping force, the foot sole is provided, for example, with a first elastic member and second elastic member sandwiching a plate spring therebetween. The first elastic member absorbs the impacts, while the second elastic member enhancing the gripping force. The plate spring restrict the deformation of the elastic members in the direction vertical to the foot sole. The invention further includes a locomotion control system using one shock absorbing mechanism.
title: Legged mobile robot and a system for controlling the same

abstract: A mobile robot system has a robot body attached to a mobile base. The robot body has a torso, a first robotic arm mechanically coupled to the torso, a first robotic leg, and a second robotic leg. The first robotic leg and the second robotic leg are controllably actuatable to enable the robot body to execute bipedal walking. The mobile base has a platform to receive a lower end of the first robotic leg and a lower end of the second robotic leg, at least one wheel and a controllable steering mechanism to enable the mobile base to travel both while the robot body is positioned on the platform and while the robot body is not positioned on the platform. The mobile base also has a plurality of components, at least one of which operable to support at least one function of the robot body.
title: SYSTEMS, DEVICES, AND METHODS FOR A MOBILE ROBOT SYSTEM

abstract: The invention discloses a tumble behavior detection method based on double-layer judgment, and the method comprises the following steps: (1) human body detection: inputting an image into an improved YOLOv8 network, and extracting a human body target; (2) inputting a result detected in the step (1) into an Openpose network to extract key points of a human body and analyze coordinate information of the key points, and performing feature extraction and classification on the image by using a fall feature judgment method; (3) inputting the image of the suspected tumble category detected in the step (2) into a scene semantic segmentation network, and segmenting scene information into a tumble region (bed, sofa and chair) and a non-tumble region (ground); the key point information of the neck and the midpoint of the two feet of the human body is obtained according to the improved YOLOv8 and Openpose network combined method, the falling characteristics are analyzed, whether the target falls or not is judged in combination with the scene semantic segmentation network, and the method can solve the problems of missing detection and error detection caused by human body shielding and similar falling behaviors in a multi-person scene.
title: Fall behavior detection method based on double-layer judgment

abstract: In the case of a handling device, in particular for wafers, having a gripper (1) which can be moved in one plane between at least two working positions via a linkage (6), in order to achieve a compact design at little constructional cost and in order to optimise the positioning accuracy, it is proposed that the linkage (6) has at least two legs (3, 4, 3', 4') which are coupled to one another via a joint, and that the free end of the one leg (3, 3') is fixed on a drive shaft (8, 8') so as to be pivotable through approximately 180@, that the free end of the other leg (4, 4') bears the gripper (1) via a further joint, and that the two legs (3, 4, 3', 4') coupled to one another are coupled to one another via a mechanism (5, 5') in such a way that the pivoting angle, corresponding to the angle of rotation of the drive shaft (8, 8'), of the one leg (3, 3') relative to the gripper (1) is of the same size but opposite to the pivoting angle of the other leg (4, 4') relative to the gripper (1). <IMAGE>
title: Handling device

abstract: The invention relates to a method for moving a bipedal exoskeleton (1) accommodating a human operator, the method being characterised in that it involves the implementation, by data processing means (11) of the exoskeleton (1), of the following steps: (a) obtaining at least one postural instruction to be applied by the exoskeleton (1) in order for the operator to perform an exercise movement; (b) determining a trajectory of the exoskeleton (1) by means of hierarchised inverse kinematics based on the at least one determined postural instruction, said hierarchised inverse kinematics comprising a stack of hierarchised tasks comprising, as the task of highest priority, a task of keeping the feet of the exoskeleton (1) on the ground as the operator performs the exercise movement.
title: METHOD FOR MOVING AN EXOSKELETON

abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for learning a phase reaction curve that updates a phase reaction curve effective to stabilize cyclic movements such as walking movements, and the like.

SOLUTION: In a phase reaction curve learning device 1, whether an event that should establish synchronism (synchronous event) occurs between a controlling device 3 and a bipedal robot 5 is detected in a synchronous event detection section 12. If the occurrence of a synchronous event is detected in the synchronous event detection section 12, a feasibility judging section 13 judges the feasibility of the synchronous event. A reward setting section 14 sets rewards as the performances of each event from the judgment results by the feasibility judging section 13, a curve parameter updating section 15 updates a curve parameter 11a so as to allow an accumulative total value of each event set at the reward setting section 14 to be a maximum. The control device 3 establishes synchronism between the control device 3 and the bipedal robot 5 by resetting a phase, based on a phase reaction curve optimized by the phase reaction curve learning device 1.

COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT
title: METHOD AND DEVICE FOR LEARNING PHASE REACTION CURVE, METHOD AND DEVICE FOR CONTROLLING CYCLIC MOVEMENT, AND WALKING MOVEMENT CONTROLLER

abstract: The invention discloses a biped semi-passive split upper body walking device. The biped semi-passive split upper body walking device comprises a hip and two leg parts, wherein the hip comprises a hip balancing plate and supports, wherein a vertical rotating shaft is arranged on each support and is rotationally matched and connected with the hip balancing plate; vertical plates are separately arranged at the front ends and the rear ends of the supports; a side moving plate is arranged between every two vertical plates; horizontal rotating shafts I which are coaxial are arranged on the front sides and the rear sides of the side moving plates separately and are rotationally matched and connected with the corresponding vertical plates; the leg parts comprise thighs and shanks; the thighs are arranged on the side moving plates in a rotational fit manner; a front-back swing driving mechanism is arranged on each side moving plate; leg opening driving mechanisms for driving the two thighs to do synchronous opening motion in the deviating direction or a synchronous closing motion towards the opposite direction are arranged between the hip balancing plate and the side moving plates; the thighs are connected with the shanks in a hinging manner; in addition, semi-passive knee joint mechanisms are arranged between the thighs and the shanks; and hip twisting mechanisms for driving the two supports to synchronously rotate towards the opposite directions and further driving the hip to twist are arranged between the hip balancing plate and the supports.
title: Biped semi-passive split upper body walking device

abstract: The invention provides a robot stepping control method and device, robot control equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control. The expected supporting force of the two feet is determined according to the current zero moment point planning data and the actual position data of the two feet of the biped robot, and then the expected supporting force of the two feet is obtained according to the expected supporting force of the two feet, the current mass center movement planning data, the actual mass center movement data, the two-foot stepping planning data and the actual stress data of the two feet. The current expected joint attitude angles of the ankle joints and the expected joint positions matched with the actual foot supporting state are determined based on a compliance control algorithm, and therefore all-directional compliance control over the expected foot pose condition is conducted according to the actual motion condition of the biped robot. The expected foot position and the expected foot posture are both substantially matched with the actual ground condition, so that the foot falling impact force in the single-foot supporting period and the inter-foot internal force in the double-foot supporting period are reduced, and the walking stability and the terrain adaptability of the biped robot are improved.
title: Robot stepping control method and device, robot control equipment and storage medium

abstract: Robots for moving relative to a surface, robotic systems including the same, and associated methods are disclosed. A robot includes a body, at least two legs, and at least two feet. Each leg has a proximal end region operatively coupled to the body at a respective body joint with one rotational degree of freedom and a distal end region operatively coupled to a respective foot at a respective foot joint comprising two rotational degrees of freedom. Each foot is configured to be translated relative to the surface with two degrees of translational freedom. Robotic systems include one or more robots and a surface along which the one or more robots are positioned to move. Methods of operating robots and of operating robotic systems include translating at least one foot of a robot to operatively move the body of the robot with six degrees of freedom.
title: ROBOTS, ROBOTIC SYSTEMS, AND RELATED METHODS

abstract: The invention discloses a multifunctional exoskeleton, belongs to the technical field of wearable exoskeletons, and aims to solve the problem that an existing exoskeleton robot cannot quickly replace a back plate according to working requirements and does not conform to a torque curve of a knee joint of a human body, so that the use is inconvenient. The exoskeleton comprises a carrying assembly, a back assembly and two leg structural members, a fixing part of the carrying assembly is arranged on the back side of the back assembly, an executing part of the carrying assembly extends to the front side of the back assembly, and the two leg structural members are both arranged on the lower portion of the back assembly. The two leg structural members are symmetrically arranged along the center line in the width direction of the back assembly, each leg structural member is detachably connected with the back assembly, each leg structural member comprises a crotch assembly, a leg assembly and a foot assembly, and the crotch assembly, the leg assembly and the foot assembly are sequentially connected from top to bottom. The exoskeleton robot is mainly used as an exoskeleton robot for assisting personnel in carrying.
title: Multifunctional exoskeleton

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and belongs to the technical field of robots, the robot comprises a robot body, two leg assemblies arranged on one side of the robot body and a swing leg joint fixed on the other side of the robot body, the swing leg joint is provided with a swing leg rotating shaft in the horizontal direction, and the swing leg joint is used for driving the leg assemblies to swing around the swing leg rotating shaft; the leg assembly comprises a leg structure and a leg rotating joint, the leg rotating joint is provided with a leg rotating shaft in the vertical direction, and the leg rotating joint is used for driving the leg structure to rotate around the leg rotating shaft; the leg structure comprises a thigh, a thigh joint for driving the thigh to rotate, a shank, a shank joint for driving the shank to rotate, a foot and a foot joint. According to the biped robot, through reasonable arrangement of the robot body, the leg assemblies and all the joint modules, the overall structure is simple and light, control is easy during walking, energy consumption is low, and dismounting and later maintenance are also facilitated.
title: Biped robot, humanoid robot and robot

abstract: The invention provides a robot. The robot comprises two mechanical legs and two foot bottom discs, wherein each mechanical leg is arranged on the corresponding foot base disc; the foot bottom discs each comprise a shell, a collision detection assembly and a slippage assembly, and the collision detection assemblies and the slippage assemblies are arranged on the shells; the collision detection assemblies each comprise a collision strip, at least one light touch switch and at least one elastic element, wherein the light contact switches and the elastic elements are all arranged in the shells, the collision strips are arranged at the front ends of the shells, free ends of the elastic elements and pressure sensing parts of the light touch switches abut against the collision strips, and the light contact switches are electrically connected with the slippage assemblies; and when the collision strips are collided by an obstacle to extrude the elastic elements and the pressure sensing parts ofthe light touch switches, the light touch switches send out a control signal so as to enable the sliding assemblies to move away from the obstacle. According to the robot, the effect of double feet is achieved on the whole appearance, the appearance effect is good, and the collision situation under the double-foot condition can be really simulated.
title: Robot

abstract: A computer controlled machine comprises a platform (7) suspended by three pairs of supportive legs (8) which are coupled to the platform at triangularly spaced-apart locations by means of universal joints (9), the two legs of each pair extending in divergent directions to spaced-apart locations in an overhead mounting (500). Each leg (8) is driven by a motor (10) to move the leg (8) in its own longitudinal direction. A laser rangefinder (600) mounted on the platform (7) enables the computer to monitor the position of the platform and construct a database of positional accuracy. The platform may mount a rotary cutting tool.
title: Improvements relating to mechanical manipulators

abstract: The invention discloses a semi-passive biped walking machine provided with bionic metatarsophalangeal joints. The semi-passive biped walking machine comprises a hip assembly, a leg assembly and a foot assembly. A second rack, a third rack, a pair of fourth racks and a pair of fifth racks are symmetrically arranged at the two sides of a first rack from inside to outside, so that a rack main body part of the walking machine is constituted. A left leg and a right leg are consistent in structure, and the length of each leg can be adjusted freely within a certain range. A left foot and a right foot are symmetrical in structure; through spherical hinges, functions of human ankles can be simulated; first foot toe connecting pieces, torsional springs and second foot toe connecting pieces constitute connecting parts of the bionic metatarsophalangeal joints; and the angle of the motional rotation axis of the bionic metatarsophalangeal joints is designed by referring to human metatarsophalangeal joints. According to the semi-passive biped walking machine provided with the bionic metatarsophalangeal joints, a gear set is utilized, so that the hip portion of the walking machine is always maintained on the angle bisector, on the sagittal plane, of the left leg and the right leg; and meanwhile, the bionic metatarsophalangeal joints are introduced, so that ground adaptability of the walking machine is improved.
title: Semi-passive biped walking machine provided with bionic metatarsophalangeal joints

abstract: The invention relates to the field of intelligent machines, in particular to a four-footed amphibious flying robot dog which comprises a machine body, two pairs of mechanical legs used for supporting the machine body and walking are arranged on the machine body, the two mechanical legs in the same pair are symmetrically arranged, and a mechanical head is arranged at the front end of the machine body. A head photoelectric system is arranged on the mechanical head, and a tail photoelectric system is arranged at the tail of the machine body; foldable rotor wing storage grooves and foldable rotor wings are correspondingly arranged on the two sides of the fuselage, one ends of the foldable rotor wings are rotationally connected with the fuselage, and the other ends of the foldable rotor wings are arranged in the foldable rotor wing storage grooves in a matched mode; the four-footed amphibious flying robot dog has the beneficial effects that the functions of an aircraft and the functions of the robot dog are integrated, and the four-footed amphibious flying robot dog which can fly and can walk on the ground, run, climb stairs and other complex actions is provided. According to the invention, the robot dog can fly to improve the moving speed, and is not limited by the geographical environment, so that the use requirements in different environments are met.
title: Four-footed amphibious flying robot dog

abstract: The invention provides a posture adjusting method, device and equipment of a biped robot and a storage medium, and relates to the field of biped robots. The method comprises the steps of obtaining the rolling angle and the rolling angle speed of the body of the biped robot; calculating a target rolling compensation angle of the sole of the biped robot according to the rolling angle and the rolling angle speed; calculating height compensation values of the two feet according to the target rolling compensation angle and the horizontal position distance between the two feet of the biped robot; and according to the height compensation value, adjusting the foot sole height of the two feet. Compared with the prior art, the problems that the mass center position of the robot cannot be effectively adjusted, and the posture control effect is poor are solved.
title: Posture adjusting method, device and equipment of biped robot, and storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses a running posture analysis method and device, equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a running video stream of a target object, the running video stream comprising multiple frames of continuous images; respectively analyzing and processing the multiple frames of continuous images to obtain respective corresponding target joint points of the target object in the multiple frames of continuous images and a ground base line of the running area where the target object is located; the target joint points are used for representing joint points of two feet of the target object; according to the ground base line, performing position analysis processing on the target articulation points corresponding to the multiple frames of continuous images to obtain gait parameters of the target object; the running posture of the target object is analyzed and processed according to the gait parameters, and a target running posture analysis result of the target object is obtained; according to the method, the running posture of the target object is analyzed through the relatively accurate gait parameters, and the accuracy and reliability of the running posture analysis of the target object can be effectively improved.
title: Running posture analysis method, device and equipment and storage medium

abstract: Many buildings are not provided with elevators, living is inconvenient, many difficulties exist when elevators are additionally arranged, people often feel tired when walking upstairs and downstairs,and knee joints are damaged. Although an electric stair climbing vehicle is sold on the market, people can go upstairs and downstairs only by being supported by people, and the electric stair climbingvehicle serves the old, the weak, the sick and the disabled who are inconvenient to move. The self-driving stair-climbing vehicle is mainly used for ordinary people to go up and down stairs by themselves, a motor or a mechanical energy accumulator is used for driving a toothed plate or a chain to form the self-driving stair-climbing vehicle, the self-driving stair-climbing vehicle is controlled by the stair-climbing people by themselves in the using process similar to a child walk learning bicycle, and the two feet of the stair-climbing people still step on stair steps. The down-to-earth effect is realized and the safety is high. However, the lifting force for going upstairs is provided, the impact force of knee joints during going downstairs is avoided, people can go upstairs and downstairs easily, and a double-vehicle structure can serve people who are difficult to move slightly.
title: Self-driving stair climbing vehicle

abstract: The invention belongs to the field of exoskeleton robots, and particularly relates to a wearable protective machine armor exoskeleton. Comprising a protection device, a back frame mechanism, a waist and hip support and two leg mechanisms. The back frame mechanism comprises a Y-shaped back frame, a back assisting mechanism and an artificial spine; the back power assisting mechanism comprises a back driving motor, a torque sensor and a force bearing waist rod; the two groups of leg mechanisms comprise foot end wearing parts; the lower portion of the Y-shaped back frame is connected with an artificial spine through a spherical hinge, the back frame mechanism is installed on the waist-hip support, the back assisting mechanism is installed on the waist-hip support through a force bearing waist rod, the two sets of leg mechanisms are symmetrically installed on the waist-hip support, and the protection device is hung on the Y-shaped back frame. Through the back driving motor and the torque sensor, assistance from bending to a vertical state of the back is realized; load generated by the back power assisting mechanism is transmitted to the ground through the hip joint and the lower limb exoskeleton through the force bearing waist rod.
title: Wearable protective machine armor exoskeleton

abstract: The invention discloses a double-mechanical-arm five-connecting-rod wheel-foot robot, and belongs to the technical field of robots, the double-mechanical-arm five-connecting-rod wheel-foot robot comprises a robot body, two leg parts symmetrically installed on the two sides of the robot body and two mechanical arms symmetrically installed at the front end of the robot body, the top ends of the thigh front arm and the thigh rear arm of each leg are connected with output shafts of a front hip joint motor and a rear hip joint motor which are installed on one side of the robot body respectively, the top end of the shank front arm is rotationally connected with the bottom end of the thigh front arm, and the top end of the shank rear arm is rotationally connected with the bottom end of the thigh rear arm. A driving wheel and a hub motor for driving the driving wheel to rotate are arranged between the foot ends of the front shank arm and the rear shank arm; and each leg part and the machine body form a closed-chain five-connecting-rod mechanism. The double-mechanical-arm five-connecting-rod wheel-foot robot can keep high load capacity at the same time, and expected work can be completed in different scenes.
title: Double-mechanical-arm five-connecting-rod wheel-foot robot

abstract: A charging system is capable of charging a battery (11) of a biped walking robot (10) while stabilizing the posture of the biped walking robot and also restraining the occurrence of spark discharge or noises. A charger (1) of the charging system for charging the battery provided in the biped walking robot includes a seating and retaining unit (2) for retaining the biped walking robot in a seated posture, a power feeding connector (3) that is fitted to a power receiving connector (12) provided in the biped walking robot when the biped walking robot sits on the seating and retaining unit, and acharging unit (4) having a connection detector for detecting whether the power receiving connector and the power feeding connector are in a connected state, a charging power source for supplying charging current to the battery, and a charging controller that supplies charging current to the battery from the charging power source to charge the battery when the connection detector detects that the power receiving connector and the power feeding connector are in the connected state.
title: Charging system of biped walking robot

abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of robots, and provides a biped robot walking control method. The method comprises the steps of acquiring distance information between the mass center of the biped robot and a preset foot key point, and acquiring initial mass center position information; calculating a mass center position offset based on the distance information and a preset calculation strategy; adjusting the initial mass center position information based on the mass center position offset to obtain target mass center position information of the biped robot; and based on the target mass center position information and a preset inverse kinematics algorithm, determining target walking parameters of the biped robot, wherein the target walking parameters are used for enabling the biped robot to walk. According to the method, the mass center position offset is obtained so that the mass center position of the biped robot is adjusted to the position between two feet, and the robot can stably walk when going uphill.
title: Biped robot walking control method and biped robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a bipedal or multi - legged robotic orthesis and exoskeleton system that can be used for apoplectic persons and robots. The system developed in the present invention is characterized in that, ' It has no outfit form, ' Has struts (12) possessing any type or several types of rotational and/or linear movement motors (3,11) and passing through any side of the right or left legs of the individuals, ' The person is suspended or connected to the struts (12) from any part of his/her body, ' Has motors (3,11) installed for moving the plates (6), functioning as feet, to a specific point and/or to cause the same to perform a specific action, and ' The feet of the suspended person are attached to the plates (6) of the system.
title: BIPEDAL OR MULTI-LEGGED ROBOTIC ORTHESIS AND EXOSKELETON SYSTEM

abstract: A robot remote manipulation system is provided, including a bipedal walking robot (20) and a remote manipulation device (10) for remotely manipulating the bipedal walking robot (20). The robot (20) is connected to the remote manipulation device (10) via a communication network (100) and controlled by controlling data from the remote manipulation device (10). In the system, the remote manipulation device (10) comprises a pair of bilateral mechanical rotating elements (11,50) providing a quantity of motion for each bilateral leg of the bipedal walking robot (20); and a controlling data transmitter (18) for transmitting controlling data corresponding to the quantities of motion to the bipedal walking robot (20). The bipedal walking robot (20) comprises a controlling data receiver (23) for receiving the controlling data transmitted from the remote manipulation device (10); and a leg motion controller for processing the received controlling data and causing the bilateral legs to move forward or backward. <IMAGE>
title: Walking robot remote-control system, apparatus and method

abstract: The invention relates to a walking mechanism of a robot and a walking method thereof. A double-feet air cushion boot type walking robot is characterized in that. swaying thighs (3) are arranged on the two sides of a hip part board (9), swaying shanks (5) are connected to the lower ends of the swaying thighs (3), the lower ends of the swaying shanks (5) are connected with air cushion boots (6) by a ball hinged structure, controllable bolts (4) are arranged between the swaying thighs (3) and the swaying shanks (5), the lower parts of the swaying shanks (5) extend out of supporting horizontal rods (11), at least one vertical spring is arranged between each supporting horizontal rod (11) and a top layer hard board (17), the structure of each air cushion boot (6) is that a soft apron (15) is arranged on the lower part of the corresponding top layer hard board (17), an air-blowing draught fan (14) driven by an air-blowing draught fan motor (13) is arranged above each top layer hard board (17), and the walking method of the robot provides and limits the operation characteristic in an operation segmenting mode. The robot is simple in structure, small in two-leg freedom degree and low in control unit requirement, two feet bear the load during walking, the walking stability is good, the ground specific pressure has better inclusiveness for complicated ground, and the energy using efficiency is high.
title: Double-feet air cushion boot type walking robot and walking method thereof

abstract: The invention relates to a soil raising type six-foot fire-fighting robot. The robot comprises a box body, four vertical moving supporting mechanisms, a six-foot walking mechanism composed of six mechanical legs, two soil taking mechanisms, two multi-angle soil raising mechanisms and four obstacle removing mechanisms. Two soil inlets are formed in the side ring edge of the box body, each soil inlet is provided with a soil inlet box door, and a soil storage vertical cavity is formed at the position, corresponding to each soil inlet, in the box body; and the four vertical moving supporting mechanisms are connected to the four edges of the lower end of a bottom plate of the box body. The six mechanical legs are evenly distributed and connected to a top plate of the box body in the circumferential direction, and each mechanical leg is composed of an upper section, a middle section and a lower section. The two soil taking mechanisms are mounted on two mechanical legs which are opposite to each other at 180 degrees, and each soil taking mechanism comprises a soil crushing part and a soil shoveling and moving part; the soil outlet end of each soil shoveling and moving part is aligned with the corresponding soil inlet in the box body; each multi-angle soil raising mechanism is composed of an upper soil lifting part and an outer soil raising part; and the other four mechanical legs are respectively provided with one obstacle removing mechanism. The fire extinguishing efficiency is improved through the robot.
title: Soil raising type six-foot fire-fighting robot

abstract: The z-component z(t) at a given time t is computed by using an auxiliary equation having the term about the z-component z(t) of the center of gravity of a biped walking robot in the equation of motion and a linear expression (a1t+a0) (S120 to S140). The x- and y-components x(t), y(t) of the center of gravity of the biped walking robot at the given time t are computed by using an equation of motion defined by substituting a linear expression for the term about the z-component z(t) of the center of gravity of the former equation of motion (S150, S160). The target angle ?<SUB>k</SUB>(t) of each joint k of the biped walking robot is computed by using the computed x-, y-, and z-components x(t), y(t), and z(t) of the center of gravity (S170). With this, a gait determined taking the motion of the z-component z(t) of the center of gravity into consideration can be generated, thus generating various gates.
title: GAIT GENERATING DEVICE, WALKING BODY DEVICE HAVING SAME, AND GAIT GENERATING METHOD

abstract: The invention discloses a human exoskeleton bionic walking aid lower limb and a control method thereof. The human exoskeleton bionic walking aid lower limb comprises a supporting frame, a first supporting piece is fixed to the two sides of the supporting frame, the lower end of the first supporting piece is rotationally connected with the upper end of a second supporting piece, the lower end of the second supporting piece is rotationally connected with the upper end of a third supporting piece, and the lower end of the third supporting piece is rotationally connected with a right pedal; a first motor is installed on the outer side of the first supporting piece and drives the second supporting piece to rotate through a first gear set, a second motor is installed on the outer side of the second supporting piece and drives the third supporting piece to rotate through a second gear set, and a third motor is installed on the outer side of the third supporting piece and drives the pedals to rotate through a third gear set. According to the invention, the device is fixed on two legs in a wearable manner, data of three corresponding motors are collected through three groups of encoders on the leg on one side of normal walking, and then three motors on the other leg are driven to work through a PLC (Programmable Logic Controller).
title: Human exoskeleton bionic walking aid lower limb and control method

abstract: The invention provides an underactuated lower limb assistance exoskeleton robot based on a rope-pulley mechanism, and relates to an underactuated lower limb assistance exoskeleton robot. The robot aims to solve the problems that a prior active joint-driving exoskeleton has large self-mass, large drive energy consumption, and a passive joint exoskeleton cannot provide effective assistance.
