The robot comprises a harness device, a drive control power system, two thigh bar devices, two leg bar devices, two ankle devices, two drive devices and two strings; wherein each drive device includes a motor shell bracket, a first motor shell, a waist frame, a planetary reducer, a second motor shell, a servo motor, a third motor shell, a hip joint spline shaft, a drive pulley, an elastic actuator, a first shaft sleeve, a small bevel gear, a large bevel gear, a second shaft sleeve, a fourth motor shell, a fifth motor shell, a sixth motor shell, a fixing plate and two first bearing end covers with bearings. The underactuated lower limb assistance exoskeleton robot based on the rope-pulley mechanism is used for the field of assistance exoskeleton robots.
title: Underactuated lower limb assistance exoskeleton robot based on rope-pulley mechanism

abstract: The invention discloses a multi-foot robot based on flexible bending structures, which comprises at least two feet, and each foot comprises a flexible bending structure; the flexible bending structure comprises a soft body formed by sequentially connecting a plurality of hard outer frames and a plurality of soft silica gel base bodies in a staggered mode. The connecting component is used for connecting each foot; a steering engine is arranged at the bottom of each foot, and an adhesive tape is adhered to the upper part of the steering wheel of each steering engine in the circumferential direction; the robot further comprises a control module, and the control module controls the operation states of a first gear motor and a second gear motor of the flexible bending structure to achieve bending of the flexible bending module according to needs. The control module controls the steering wheel to rotate so that the glue sticker can make contact with the ground according to needs. When the robot crawl, the front feet and the rear feet alternately land or lift up. The marching mode of bionic marine organisms is adopted, and the marching stability of the multi-legged robot on different road conditions is improved. And meanwhile, the multi-legged robot has a large load.
title: Multi-legged robot based on flexible bending structure

abstract: The present invention relates to a boarding-type two-leg walking assistant system including a balancing unit that is positioned on the front surface of a passenger and has a central shaft and both blade sections which can pivot on both sides of the passenger about the central shaft; a saddle section that extends from the central shaft to a lower end back surface portion so that the passenger can sit thereon; a horizontal supporting unit that extends vertically from both of the blade sections to a back surface portion and has an end portion connected to a first pivot link; a thigh supporting unit that is connected by the first pivot link to be pivotable, has an end portion connected to a second pivot link, and supports the thigh of the passenger; a lower leg supporting unit that is connected to a second pivot link to be pivotable and supports the lower leg of the passenger; a ground contact section that extends with the lower leg supporting unit and supports the foot of the passenger; and a walking actuator where the first pivot link and the second pivot link are connected by a wire and the first pivot link is mounted on and connected to a lower portion of the horizontal supporting unit for driving the pivoting of the first pivot link. The walking assistant has a simple structure and configuration for efficient and natural walking motion and can ensure that balance is maintained for stable walking and posture maintenance. Also, a shock attributable to walking can be mitigated and the ride and stability of the passenger can be improved.
title: TWO-LEG WALKING ASSISTANT SYSTEM FOR BOARDING TYPE

abstract: The invention provides a flying bionic quadruped robot, and relates to the technical field of intelligent robots, the flying bionic quadruped robot comprises a machine body, a control system is arranged in the machine body, the machine body comprises a carbon fiber pipe frame fixed through an aviation aluminum connecting plate, and a motor connecting plate is arranged at the bottom of the carbon fiber pipe frame; the two mechanical legs are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the machine body correspondingly; the flying part comprises a connecting rod mechanism support fixed to the upper portion of the aircraft body, a fourth gear motor is arranged on the connecting rod mechanism support, a cross rotating block is fixed to the upper portion of the connecting rod mechanism support, four legs of the cross rotating block are each connected with a carbon fiber connecting rod, and the carbon fiber connecting rods are connected with carbon fiber pipes; and the carbon fiber tube is connected with the double-disc double-paddle amorphous motor. The four mechanical legs are all directly driven by single-circle double-encoder gear motors, movement is flexible, the response speed is high, and due to the four-rotor design, the robot has the capability of climbing mountains and crossing ridges.
title: Flying bionic quadruped robot

abstract: The invention discloses a series-parallel walking robot construction method and a series-parallel walking robot and belongs to the field of walking robots. The series-parallel walking robot comprises a leg mechanism A and a leg mechanism B, one leg mechanism is a series-parallel leg mechanism, and the other leg mechanism is a series-parallel leg mechanism or a foot parallel mechanism. The series-parallel leg mechanism is formed by connecting a thigh mechanism with a foot parallel mechanism in series. The two leg mechanisms have a specific combination of degree of freedom, the upper portions of the two leg mechanisms are fixedly connected together, all components of the two leg mechanisms contain and cross one another and each have an own independent moving space. Toes of the two leg mechanisms are triangular, and the projections of the toes on the horizontal plane are overlapped. When the robot goes forwards, steady walking in any direction can be conducted without adjusting the center of gravity leftwards and rightwards. The number of kinematic pairs of the robot is small, and the height of a robot body is small. The series-parallel walking robot has the advantages of being high in bearing capacity, flexible in steering, high in obstacle crossing ability and uphill and downhill ability, and the like, and can be applied to the service field, the industrial field, the agricultural field, the military field, the spaceflight field and other fields.
title: Series-parallel walking robot construction method and series-parallel walking robot

abstract: The invention discloses a passive biped robot with bionic hip joints and ankle joints, and relates to the technical field of bionic robots, the passive biped robot comprises a hip assembly, a leg assembly and an ankle assembly; and the leg assembly is arranged between the hip assembly and the ankle assembly. The bionic hip joint realizes the movement of the biped robot hip joint on three planes, is more similar to the hip joint movement range of human gaits, and is beneficial to natural walking. Under the condition that no external drive is added to the biped robot, alternate swing of the two legs is achieved through elastic starting of the foot springs. The bionic ankle achieves elastic starting in the walking process, and meanwhile the adaptability of the toes to walking on the ground is improved.
title: Passive biped robot with bionic hip joints and ankle joints

abstract: The invention provides a robot and a leg assembly thereof. The leg assembly comprises a first leg connecting piece, a second leg connecting piece and a protection piece. The first leg connecting piece and the second leg connecting piece are connected in a hinged mode through a hinged shaft, the protection piece is arranged around the hinged shaft and fixedly connected with the second leg connecting piece, and the protection piece is used for protecting the hinged position of the first leg connecting piece and the second leg connecting piece. According to the leg assembly of the robot, the protection piece structure is arranged between the two leg connecting pieces, the hinged position of the leg connecting pieces can be protected, hands are prevented from being clamped, and the situation that the leg connecting pieces are stuck due to the fact that foreign matter enters the leg connecting pieces is avoided.
title: Robot and leg assembly thereof

abstract: A method and apparatus for characterizing the gait of a subject uses a treadmill (1) having a movable support surface with multiple transducers (5) mounted beneath the movable support surface. The subject performs locomotion on the movable surface. The computer (6) accepts a series of signals from each transducer (5) and identifies the occurrence of heel-strike and toe-off. The computer (6) identifies the subject's activity as walking or as running. The computer (6) identifies two non-contiguous groups of transducers that are measuring a force greater than zero associated with the two feet and calculates quantities related to the forces exerted by each foot during each phase of walking or running.
title: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR CHARACTERIZING GAIT

abstract: The present disclosure relates to the technical field of intelligent robots, and particularly provides a quadruped robot, a control method thereof, and an apparatus. A control method of a quadruped robot, comprising: determining a reference torque of each joint motor of front legs on the basis of a preset foot plantar force, and, according to the reference torque, controlling each joint motor of the front legs to rotate; in response to a front-leg span length being not smaller than a preset threshold value, determining a target time according to a current robot body angle and a target angular speed; according to the current robot body angle and the target angular speed, determining a reference angle during a motion process of each rear-leg hip joint motor of the quadruped robot; and, according to the reference angle and an actual motion angle of each rear-leg hip joint motor, controlling a torque of each rear-leg hip joint motor in real time until the motion time reaches the target time. In the embodiments of the present disclosure, the quadruped robot can be switched to a bipedal supporting state by means of control of the joint motors, so that more operation functions and specific actions can be achieved by utilizing the front legs, thus improving the operation performance.
title: QUADRUPED ROBOT, CONTROL METHOD THEREOF, AND APPARATUS

abstract: The invention discloses a semi-passive dynamic biped walking device with a halving upper body. The semi-passive dynamic biped walking device comprises a hip support, wherein a cross shaft is arranged at the lower end of the hip support; a first rotary rack and a second rotary rack are arranged on the cross shaft; a first side shaft is arranged on the first rotary rack; a second side shaft is arranged on the second rotary rack; a driving conical gear is arranged on the cross shaft; a first driven conical gear is arranged on the first side shaft; a second driven conical gear is arranged on the second side shaft; a first driving device for driving the cross shaft to rotate and a second driving device for driving the first rotary rack and the second rotary rack to symmetrically rotate about the cross shaft are arranged on the hip support. The walking device can ensure that during the forward straight walking and transverse straight walking, the upper body of a robot is always positioned between two legs, namely the halving position of the walking device, so that the straight and transverse walking stability of the robot can be ensured.
title: Semi-passive dynamic biped walking device with halving upper body

abstract: The invention provides an abnormal traffic early warning method and device and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: defining a gate region through a target region frame, and when a specified position of a detection frame of a target object falls into the gate region, determining that the target object is a passenger to pass; performing small image cutting processing on the detection frames of all the to-be-passed passengers, and removing part of hand images of the to-be-passed passengers to obtain small image images of the to-be-passed passengers; inputting the small image of the to-be-passed passenger into a preset abnormal passage detection model, and judging whether the to-be-passed passenger has abnormal passage or not; when the passenger waiting for passing passes abnormally, IOU tracking is carried out on the passenger passing abnormally, and when the behavior of the passenger passing abnormally reaches the preset early warning condition, an abnormal alarm is given, so that the passenger passing the gate abnormally can be accurately detected, and an alarm is given. And various different abnormal gate passing behaviors such as single-leg crossing, double-leg jumping and squatting are supported.
title: Abnormal traffic early warning method and device and electronic equipment

abstract: A multi-modal robot that is configured to operate with a bipedal locomotion that may be augmented with aerial locomotion. Many embodiments of a robot may incorporate a robot with a main body portion that houses the various control systems and mechanical controls of the robot. The body of the robot can have a number of different propellers connected to an upper portion of the body and configured to generate lift and/or stability for the body of the robot. Additionally, many embodiments have at least two leg elements connected to a bottom portion of the body by way of a servo mechanism. The legs are configured to provide support for the body of the robot as well as generate a walking locomotion through the movement of the legs.
title: Synchronized multi-modal robot

abstract: The invention discloses a waist and leg connecting device for an exoskeleton, and belongs to the technical field of exoskeletons.The waist and leg connecting device comprises a waist supporting piece and two leg rotating joints which are located on the outer sides of thighs respectively when used, and the leg rotating joints are lower than the waist supporting piece; and the two waist and leg connecting pieces are further included, the upper ends of the two waist and leg connecting pieces are connected with the waist supporting piece respectively, and the lower ends of the two waist and leg connecting pieces are connected with the two leg rotating joints respectively. The garment is simple in structure and reasonable in design, a wearer can avoid the waist side position of the human body, and therefore the waist side action of the human body is not affected.
title: Waist and leg connecting device for exoskeleton

abstract: A robot may include a torque generator to generate a torque, and a leg system including one or more legs movably coupled to and supporting the torque generator. Each leg of the one or more legs may include a first leg member, a second leg member, a first joint movably coupling the first leg member and the second leg member, and a first linear elasticity element coupled between the first leg member and the second leg member across the first joint. The first linear elasticity element may be disposed to provide a first force when the first linear elasticity element is actuated that, in combination with the torque, facilitates maintaining an upright position of the bipedal robot.
title: Legged Robot with Joint-Augmented Stability Control

abstract: The invention provides a biped robot impedance control method and device, and relates to the technical field of design of impedance control methods. The method includes the steps of modifying the hitting force borne by landing legs of a biped robot through a natural attenuation function so as to serve as the input of impedance control, obtaining an impedance model of the biped robot, determining an impedance control transmission function according to the impedance model, calculating the impedance control output mode according to the input of impedance control and the impedance control transmission function, and modifying the external force input in the impedance control through the natural attenuation function. The aim of adjusting the impedance control over the two legs of the robot is realized, then it is avoided that the robot deformation caused by the impedance control influences the balance the robot during walking, and the walking process of the robot is more stable and natural.
title: Biped robot impedance control method and device

abstract: The invention provides an identification control system and an identification control method of power-assisted exoskeletons. The identification control system comprises a sole pressure information processing module used for detecting sole pressure information of a wearer in real time, a terrain information preprocessing module coupled with a power-assisted exoskeleton robot and used for collecting terrain information in a motion environment of an exoskeleton device in real time, an inertia measurement module used for correspondingly preprocessing hip joint angles, angular speeds and myoelectricity information of two legs of the wearer during walking to obtain inertia measurement signals, and a data processing and analyzing module used for transmitting a matching result to the power-assisted exoskeleton robot to control the power-assisted exoskeleton robot. According to the identification control system, identification of gait intentions of an exoskeleton wearer when coping with different terrain forms and rapid cooperative auxiliary response actions are realized; and the exoskeleton wearer can smoothly complete various works in different terrain environments.
title: Identification control system and identification control method of power-assisted exoskeletons

abstract: A walking robot and a control method thereof. The control method of the walking robot which walks using two legs includes applying first virtual gravity torque including a vector component in the anti-gravity direction to respective joints of a support leg from among the two legs during walking, and applying second virtual gravity torque including a vector component in the gravity direction to respective joints of a swing leg from among the two legs during walking. Thereby, the walking robot implements a natural walking motion having a low energy consumption rate.
title: Walking robot and control method thereof

abstract: The invention provides a robot which can be applied to various application scenes such as artificial intelligence, robot application and mechatronics. The robot comprises a hip part, leg parts, foot parts and wheel parts, the hip part comprises two first rotating connecting pieces which are symmetrical along the central axis of the hip part, the two leg parts are connected with the two first rotating connecting pieces respectively, the first end of each leg part is connected with at least one foot part, the second end of each leg part is connected with at least one wheel part, and the first rotating connecting pieces are connected with the two first rotating connecting pieces respectively. The first rotary connecting piece can drive the hip to move up and down along the leg part and can drive the leg part to rotate around the axis of the first rotary connecting piece, so that the state that any one of the first end of the leg part or the second end of the leg part is in contact with the ground is adjusted, and the robot is switched between a foot type mode and a wheel type mode; the control complexity of the wheel type mode and foot type mode switching process is reduced, and the stability and reliability of the process are improved.
title: Robot

abstract: A human knee joint power-assisted exoskeleton device relates to the technical field of knee joint power assistance and comprises two exoskeleton assemblies which are opposite left and right, each exoskeleton assembly further comprises a power-assisted assembly, the power-assisted assembly is used for providing power for flexion and extension of a human knee joint, and the power-assisted assembly comprises two discs with opposite openings. A rotating shaft is jointly and rotationally connected between the two discs, a fixed disc is coaxially arranged on the rotating shaft, a plurality of buffer plates are arranged on the outer surface of the fixed disc in the circumferential direction at intervals, a power assisting disc is rotationally connected to the fixed disc, and each buffer plate is in sliding connection with the power assisting disc; the measuring assembly is located between the two power assisting assemblies, and the measuring assembly is used for measuring the longitudinal distance between the two legs; the power assisting device can effectively improve the power assisting effect on the knee joint of the human body.
title: Human knee joint power-assisted exoskeleton device

abstract: The invention discloses a human-shaped wheeled robot of a suspension structure. A coordinate axis is established with the front direction of the robot as the positive direction of an axis X. The robotcomprises shanks, thighs and wheel feet, wherein the tops of the shanks are rotationally connected with the thighs, the bottoms of the shanks are connected with the wheel feet, and each shank is provided with a first hydraulic cylinder driving the shank to rotate around an axis Y; the top of the left thigh is connected with the left side of a connecting board through a left cantilever, the top ofthe right thigh is connected with the right side of the connecting board through a right cantilever, and each thigh is provided with a second hydraulic cylinder driving the thigh to rotate around theaxis Y, a third hydraulic cylinder driving the thigh to rotate around the axis X and a fourth hydraulic cylinder driving the thigh to rotate around an axis Z; and the wheel feet are connected with motors. By the adoption of the human-shaped wheeled robot, the motion speed of the robot can be greatly increased, the flexibility of the two legs is improved, and the explosive power of the robot is improved.
title: Human-shaped wheeled robot of suspension structure

abstract: The invention relates to a wearable lower limb exoskeleton robot based on rope-driven redundant flexible drivers. The wearable lower limb exoskeleton robot comprises a left leg exoskeleton structure and a right leg exoskeleton structure which are symmetrically arranged; the two leg exoskeleton structures are the same, and each leg exoskeleton structure comprises two super-input flexible drivers, two bandage structures and a foot sole plate; each super-input flexible driver comprises two flexible drivers connected through a rope, and outputs a rotational degree of freedom; the two super-input flexible drivers are connected through a mechanical connecting device; one bandage structure is connected with one super-input flexible driver, and the other bandage structure is connected with the mechanical connecting device; and the foot sole plate is connected with the other super-input flexible driver through an adapter bracket. On one hand, the wearable lower limb exoskeleton robot can be applied to the military field to provide assistance for battle soldiers and improve the marching ability of the soldiers; and on the other hand, physiotherapy help can be provided for stroke patients, and then the recovery period of the patients in the rehabilitation process is improved.
title: Wearable lower limb exoskeleton robot based on rope-driven redundant flexible drivers

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a biped robot leg structure which is provided with two leg assemblies, each leg assembly comprises a leg, each leg comprises a thigh, a thigh joint, a shank, a shank joint, a foot, a leg rotating joint used for driving the corresponding leg to rotate and a leg swinging joint used for driving the corresponding leg assembly to swing, the swing leg assembly is provided with a swing leg rotating shaft, the leg assembly is divided into an upper mass part with an upper mass point and a lower mass part with a lower mass point with the horizontal plane where the swing leg rotating shaft is located as the boundary, and the upper mass part and the lower mass part synchronously and reversely swing with the swing leg rotating shaft as the axis. At least part of the upper mass part is located on the horizontal plane where the swing leg rotating shaft is located in the swing process. The leg swinging inertia and torque of the legs of the biped robot are optimized, the torque requirement in the leg swinging process is reduced, and the legs are lifted and put lightly more easily, so that the control difficulty and energy consumption of the biped robot are reduced, and the applicability of the robot is improved.
title: Leg structure, biped robot, humanoid robot, and robot

abstract: The invention discloses a variable-form wheel foot ball picking robot which is characterized in that the functions of wheel foot form switching, efficient ball picking and vibration reduction are achieved through modular design. The robot comprises a trunk module, a wheel leg module and a ball picking module. The trunk module is of an active and passive composite vibration reduction cylinder structure and is connected with a vibration-reduced unit through a vibration reduction cylinder guide rail, and vibration suppression is achieved. The wheel-leg module is composed of a thigh driving joint, a spring damper, a shank driving joint and a single-side shaft wheel-leg assembly, switching of two forms of a double-leg wheel-leg and a four-leg wheel-leg is achieved through separation and reunion of a telescopic push rod, and the wheel-leg module adapts to different terrains. The ball picking module drives a push plate to move along a guide rail through a push plate motor and is matched with a ball storage bin spring to collect and release balls. The core innovation point of the robot lies in wheel-foot shape variability, an active and passive composite vibration reduction system and an integrated ball picking mechanism, has wheel-type high-speed movement and foot-type complex terrain adaptability, is suitable for autonomous ball picking operation in stadiums, outdoor environments and other scenes, can efficiently complete ball picking tasks, and is high in practicability. And meanwhile, the robot has the capabilities of obstacle crossing, vibration reduction and terrain self-adaption.
title: Variable-form wheel foot ball picking robot

abstract: The invention discloses a pneumatically-driven four-footed soft wall-climbing robot. The pneumatically-driven four-footed soft wall-climbing robot comprises a shoulder connecting piece, a soft spine, a hip connecting piece, four soft legs and four soft feet. Each of the soft spine and the soft legs comprises four trunk expansion rods, each soft foot comprises three soft toes, the shoulder connecting piece and the hip connecting piece are connected through the soft spine, the shoulder connecting piece is connected with the two legs, and the hip connecting piece is connected with the other two legs. The soft spine, the soft legs and the soft toes are driven by an external air source and have multiple degrees of freedom. The robot is flexible in mechanism, high in environment adaptability, capable of going straight, turning, crossing obstacles and the like on uneven rough surfaces and high in crawling speed. In addition, the rigidity of the soft spine and the soft legs of the soft robot can be adjusted, and the soft robot has good bearing capacity.
title: Pneumatically-driven four-footed soft wall-climbing robot

abstract: Displacements of respective joints corresponding to respective joint elements (J9 and the like) of a rigid link model (S1) representing a two-legged walking mobile body (1) are sequentially grasped. Also at the same time, values, in a body coordinate system (BC), of an acceleration vector of the origin of the body coordinate system (BC) fixed to a waist (6) as a rigid element, a floor reaction force vector acting on each leg (2), and a position vector of the point of application of the floor reaction force vector are sequentially grasped. With the use of the grasped values, joint moments respectively generated in an ankle joint (13), a knee joint (14), and a hip joint (9) of each leg (2) are sequentially estimated based on an inverse dynamics model using the body coordinate system. The estimation accuracy of the joint moments of the leg can be enhanced by reducing arithmetic processing using tilt information of the two-legged walking mobile body relative to the gravity direction as much as possible.
title: METHOD OF ESTIMATING JOINT MOMENT OF TWO-LEGGED WALKING MOBILE BODY

abstract: A legged walking robot such as a two-legged walking robot, for example, has an articulated structure with at least two degrees of freedom, one of which is a degree of freedom for angularly moving a leg in a pitch direction about a first axis (12) of a hip joint assembly, comprising an electric motor (74) for angularly moving the leg in the pitch direction. The electric motor has an output shaft which is axially aligned with the first axis (12) about which the leg is angularly movable in the pitch direction. The articulated structure also has a speed reducer (72) having an input shaft which is coaxial with the output shaft of the electric motor. The other degree of freedom is a degree of freedom for angularly moving the leg in a roll direction normal to the pitch direction. The articulated structure also includes a second electric motor (52) for angularly moving the leg in the roll direction and a second speed reducer (56) having an output shaft which is coaxial with a second axis about which the leg is angularly movable in the roll direction. <IMAGE>
title: Articulated structure for legged walking robot

abstract: The invention discloses a robot. The robot comprises a hip part and two leg parts, wherein each leg part is a telescopic linear execution mechanism; one end of each linear execution mechanism is hinged to the hip part; and the other end of each telescopic linear execution mechanism forms a free end. According to the robot disclosed by the invention, lower energy consumption can be maintained in the walking process; and in addition, the robot has high balancing and flexible properties.
title: Robot

abstract: The invention provides an all-terrain wheel-legged robot, and aims at solving the technical problem that in the prior art, the application range is narrow. The all-terrain wheel-legged robot comprises a wheel-legged mechanism which is installed on the robot and composed of a fixing support and two leg mechanisms, and the fixing support comprises two triangular supports and two baffles; each of the two ends of the bottom edge of the triangular support is provided with a rotating pair which is installed in an installation hole formed in the side face of each of the two baffles, and the two first joint motors fixed outside one baffle are used for driving the triangular support to rotate around the axis of the bottom edge of the triangular support. Mounting holes are formed in the intersection position of two bevel edges of the triangular support and the intersection position of one bevel edge and the bottom edge respectively and connected with a first connecting rod and a second connecting rod of the leg part respectively, and a second joint motor is fixed to the intersection position of the two bevel edges and used for driving the second connecting rod; the other ends of the first connecting rod and the second connecting rod are connected with supporting rods of the legs, and hub motors are fixed to the lower ends of the supporting rods.
title: All-terrain wheel-legged robot

abstract: The invention relates to a wearable exoskeleton. The wearable exoskeleton comprises: a left shank support and a right shank support; a left footstep part and a right footstep part, configured to placesoles of a wearer; a left ankle joint motor module and a right ankle joint motor module, internally equipped with absolute value encoders, torque sensors and rotation limiting structures, and configured to connect the left shank support with the left footstep part and connect the right shank support with the right footstep part; and a single-wheel part, equipped with pedals for placing the left footstep part and the right footstep part on the two sides correspondingly, and configured to drive the wearable exoskeleton to move. The single-wheel part is flexibly used for being matched with an exoskeleton structure, the advancing speed is increased, parallel movement of two feet is equivalent to single-point movement through balance control of the single-wheel part, and the control process issimple and easy to implement.
title: Wearable exoskeleton

abstract: The invention relates to wearable hip joint flexible power-assisting outer clothes. The wearable hip joint flexible power-assisting outer clothes comprise a backpack assembly, an outer clothes body, two driving units and a gait detecting unit. When a human body wears the flexible power-assisting outer clothes, power assisting of backward-stretching movement of a hip joint is achieved during walking. Shoulders bear the backpack assembly through two straps. The outer clothes body is composed of two leg ring belts and two traction fabric belts, wherein the leg ring belts are attached to the surfaces of normal clothes, and the traction fabric belts are worn on the rear sides of thighs. According to a signal of the gait detecting unit, the driving units conduct traction power-assisting on the hip joint of the human body through the traction fabric belts; the two driving units are placed on the lower portion of the backpack assembly side by side; and each driving unit comprises a fabric belt curling module, traction power-assisting of the backward-stretching movement of the hip joint of the human body is achieved, the required acting force and torque when the thighs make the backward-stretching movement are reduced and shared, accordingly energy consumption of corresponding muscles of the human body is reduced, and power assisting of walking movement of the human body is achieved.
title: Wearable hip joint flexible power-assisting outer clothes

abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and device for controlling a foot type robot, the foot type robot, equipment for controlling the foot type robot and a non-volatile computer readable storage medium. The foot type robot comprises a base and at least two mechanical legs, each mechanical leg comprises at least one joint, and the method comprises the steps that in response to the fact that all the mechanical legs of the foot type robot fall to make contact with a plane, a first expected track and a second expected track corresponding to the foot type robot are determined, the first expected trajectory indicates an expected trajectory of movement of the center of mass of the legged robot in a gravity direction and an expected trajectory of change of an inclination angle of the legged robot; the second expected track indicates an expected track of one end, far away from the base, of each mechanical leg; and on the basis of a kinetic model corresponding to the foot type robot, the first expected track and the second expected track, controlling the action of each joint after the foot type robot is in contact with the plane.
title: Method and device for controlling foot type robot and foot type robot

abstract: The invention provides a horse-imitating gait planar connection rod type quadruped walking robot. The robot comprises a rack, turning mechanisms, lower bodies and leg mechanisms. The turning mechanisms and the leg mechanisms are arranged at the four corners of the rack and are in left-right symmetry. The turning mechanism mainly consists of a servo motor, a coupling and straight tooth bevel gears, is fixed to the rack and is connected with the lower body through flange structures. The leg mechanism comprises a thigh mechanism and a shank mechanism, and a planar six connection rod mechanism isadopted. The thigh mechanism adopts a crank and rocker mechanism, and the shank mechanism adopts a double-rocker mechanism. The leg mechanism is provided with a damping device. Through a horse-imitating gait, double-leg linkage on the diagonal is achieved, and all-dimensional stable movement of the robot can be achieved. The horse-imitating gait planar connection rod type quadruped walking robotis simple in structure, easy to control and low in cost and has good dynamic walking ability.
title: Horse-imitating gait planar connection rod type quadruped walking robot

abstract: A method of controlling a biped walking robot to balance the robot based on a sensed ground reaction force. In the method, X and Y coordinates are assigned to positions of sensors (3) attached to a sole (1) of a leg of the robot and a corresponding Z coordinate is assigned for at least three of the sensors (3) based on the sensed ground reaction force sensed by at the sensors, respectively. A ground reaction force plane is specified based on the sensed ground reaction force and a normal vector perpendicular to the ground reaction force plane is calculated. A roll angle about an X-axis and a pitch angle about a Y-axis are calculated and an actuator is driven in correspondence to the roll angle and the pitch angle to move a part of the robot to align the normal vector with a reference vector of the gravity direction. <IMAGE>
title: Method of controlling biped walking robot

abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot. The biped robot comprises a main body, leg structures, an operation arm and a balance part, wherein the two leg structures are symmetrically installed on the two sides of the main body and can rotate relative to the main body, the operation arm is installed on the main body and can move relative to the main body, the balance part comprises balance wheels, and the balance wheels are rotationally connected with the main body. According to the biped robot, the leg structures can provide power for movement of the robot and support the robot to walk, jump and other actions, and the operating arms can move relative to the main body so that the actuators at tail ends of the operating arms can execute corresponding operations; and the additional torque applied to the robot by the motion of the operating arm is balanced through the torque generated by rotation of the balance wheel, so the whole robot is kept stable, and the operating arm can execute corresponding tasks conveniently.
title: Biped robot

abstract: A system and method is disclosed for controlling a robot having at least two legs, the robot subjected to an event such as a push that requires the robot to take a step to prevent a fall. In one embodiment, a current capture point is determined, where the current capture point indicates a location on a ground surface that is the current best estimate of a stepping location for avoiding a fall and for reaching a stopped state. The robot is controlled to take a step toward the current capture point. After taking the step, if the robot fails to reach a stopped state without taking any additional steps, an updated current capture point is determined based on the state of the robot after taking the step. The current capture points can be stored in a capture point memory and initialized based on a model of the robot.
title: Learning capture points for humanoid push recovery

abstract: The invention provides a high-degree-of-freedom double-leg wheel-foot robot device, a control device and a control method. The high-degree-of-freedom double-leg wheel-foot robot device comprises a robot base and at least two leg assemblies. The leg assembly comprises a hip joint mechanism and a mechanical wheel foot, one side of the robot base is connected with the mechanical wheel foot through the hip joint mechanism, and the robot body arranged on the other side of the robot base is driven to move through the mechanical wheel foot; wherein the hip joint mechanism comprises a spherical hinge-like structure formed by a plurality of rotating assemblies, and the rotating assemblies are used for driving the mechanical wheel feet to rotate relative to the robot base along a yaw angle, a rolling angle and a pitching angle according to a received control instruction.
title: High-degree-of-freedom double-leg wheel-foot robot device, control device and control method

abstract: Provided is a walking control method enabling stable walking operation to be realized, a walking control program and a biped walking robot. A walking control method includes, during walking operation of a biped walking robot having a position of center of gravity being adjusted at a predetermined reference angle that enables the robot to be upright, a step of acquiring information indicative of an inclination angle of an upper body relative to the reference angle, and a step of operating, with one of a first leg and a second leg not being grounded due to the walking operation, the first leg and the second leg such that the upper body is maintained within a predetermined angle range relative to the reference angle according to the inclination angle.
title: WALKING CONTROL METHOD, WALKING CONTROL PROGRAM AND BIPED WALKING ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses a robot. The robot comprises a chest structure, a head structure, two arm structures, two wrist structures, two palm structures, a waist structure, a hip structure, two leg structures, leg driving pieces, foot structures and foot driving pieces, wherein the head structure is hinged to the top end of the chest structure through a first hinge assembly; the two arm structures are hinged to the two sides of the chest structure respectively; the two wrist structures are rotationally connected with the tail ends of the two arm structures respectively; the waist structure is hinged to the bottom end of the chest structure; the hip structure is hinged to the waist structure; the two leg structures are hinged to the hip structure; the leg driving pieces drive the leg structures to rotate relative to the hip structure; and the foot driving pieces are used for driving the foot structures to rotate relative to the leg structures. According to the structural design of the robot, use of a rope and a traction mechanism is avoided, and a driving mechanism can be shielded to achieve a good performance effect.
title: Robot

abstract: The invention provides a bionic frog and a using method. A frog body is hollow, a rib plate is installed in the center of the front end of the frog body, a pair of spring fixing ends are arranged on the two sides of the rib plate, one end of an extension spring is fixed to the spring fixing ends, and connecting parts I are installed on the front portions of the two sides of the upper layer of the frog body. The rear portions of the two sides of the upper layer of the frog body are provided with second connecting portions, the middle of the upper layer of the frog body is provided with a semicircular fixing piece, the front end of the fixing piece is connected with a rib plate, the fixing piece and the rib plate form a supporting body, the supporting body is provided with a round through hole, and a long and thin screw fixes a motor on the supporting body through the round through hole. The upper layer and the lower layer of the rear portion in the frog body are each provided with two bosses, the tail end of the frog body is provided with a pair of double-leg synchronous connecting pieces parallel to the frog body, and the frog leg A is rotationally connected with the connecting part and located at the end of the connecting part. The invention provides a novel bionic frog structure.
title: Bionic frog and use method

abstract: The invention relates to a multi-leg independent mobile carrier. The multi-leg independent mobile carrier comprises a base, control equipment mounted on the base and at least two leg mechanisms, wherein each leg mechanism comprises a supporting component and a traveling component connected with the supporting component; each supporting component can rotate forwards and backwards relative to the base; the forward and backward rotation of each supporting component can drive the corresponding traveling component to move forwards and backwards; each traveling component comprises a leg part, a driving mechanism mounted inside the leg part and a connecting bar assembly arranged on the side surface of the leg part; each driving mechanism is connected with the control equipment to drive the corresponding connecting bar assembly to vertically rotate; a fulcrum component is formed at the end of each connecting bar assembly; each fulcrum component, the corresponding connecting bar assembly and the corresponding leg part form a lever mechanism; and the connecting bar assemblies of at least two leg mechanisms form at least three fulcrum components. The multi-leg independent mobile carrier disclosed by the invention can not only move on steps but also can move on horizontal planes, and is high in stability, high in flexibility and wide in application range.
title: Multi-leg independent mobile carrier

abstract: A robotic platform for traversing and manipulating a modular 3D lattice structure is described. The robot is designed specifically for its tasks within a structured environment, and is simplified in terms of its numbers of degrees of freedom (DOF). This allows for simpler controls and a reduction of mass and cost. Designing the robot relative to the environment in which it operates results in a specific type of robot called a “relative robot”. Depending on the task and environment, there can be a number of relative robots. This invention describes a bipedal robot which can locomote across a periodic lattice structure made of building block parts. The robot is able to handle, manipulate, and transport these blocks when there is more than one robot. Based on a general inchworm design, the robot has added functionality while retaining minimal complexity, and can perform numerous maneuvers for increased speed, reach, and placement.
title: Bipedal isotropic lattice locomoting explorer: robotic platform for locomotion and manipulation of discrete lattice structures and lightweight space structures

abstract: A lower extremity exoskeleton (100), configurable to be coupled to a person, includes two leg supports (101, 102) configurable to be coupled to the person's lower limbs, an exoskeleton trunk (109) configurable to be coupled to the person's upper body, which is rotatably connectable to the thigh links (103, 104) of the leg supports (101, 102) allowing for the flexion and extension between the leg supports (101, 102) and the exoskeleton trunk (100), two hip actuators ( 145, 146) configured to create torques between the exoskeleion trunk (109) and the leg supports (101, 102), and at least one power unit (201) capable of providing power to the hip actuators (145, 146) wherein the power unit (201) is configured to cause the hip actuator (145, 146) of the leg support (101, 102) in the swing phase to create a torque profile such that force from the exoskeleton leg support (101, 102) onto the person's lower limb during at least a portion of the swing phase is in the direction of the person's lower limb swing velocity.
title: AN EXOSKELETON AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING A SWING LEG OF THE EXOSKELETON

abstract: A biped walking robot having load reduction and stability of a motor using a functional structure of toes is provided to stably walk like more human through the toe operation and reduce the load of the articulation motor. A toe structure for a biped walking robot comprises a planar plate-shaped foot sole part(6); a planar plate-shaped toe part(7); a first support(1) fixed at the edge center of the toe direction of the foot sole part and formed with a connection shaft(8) to both side directions; two second supports(4) fixed at both sides of the first support of the foot sole part; two third supports(5) fixed around the edge of both side directions; two spring parts(2) whose both edges are formed with rod-shaped connection ends; and two connection devices(3) where the edges of two connection pieces are connected by the connection shaft. The both connection ends of the spring are connected with the connection shaft of the first support and the third support. The connection device is fixed with the second and third supports, and the toe part is formed with an articulation for shaft-rotation to the direction of the foot sole part.
title: REDUCTION OF MOTOR PAYLOAD AND IMPROVEMENT OF STABILITY FOR BIPED WALKING ROBOT USING A FUNCTIONAL STRUCTURE OF TOE

abstract: The invention discloses a lower limb exoskeleton robot. The lower limb exoskeleton robot comprises an auxiliary component and a lower limb component; the auxiliary component comprises a wearable auxiliary balance mechanism and a first driving part, the auxiliary balance mechanism is used for supporting the human body, the inclination angle of the auxiliary balance mechanism relative to the human body coronal plane can be adjusted through the first driving part, the human body is driven to move, and the inclination angle of the human body is changed; and the lower limb component comprises two leg power assisting mechanisms which are used for providing supporting and assisting power for the left leg and the right leg correspondingly, and the leg power assisting mechanisms are connected with the auxiliary component. According to the lower limb exoskeleton robot, the auxiliary component capable of being actively adjusted is adopted to be matched with the lower limb component capable of assisting walking, the inclination angle of the human body can be actively adjusted while assisting walking is conducted, and falling down in the walking process can be well prevented while the walking assisting function is provided for people with walking function deficiency.
title: Lower limb exoskeleton robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a walking assistance device for a leisure sport for running and, more specifically, to a walking assistance device, enabling a user to run in a high speed by storing energy generated when the user steps and kicks the ground as elastic energy of a spring and using elasticity of the spring as a propulsion force. According to the present invention, the walking assistance device includes: a footboard (20) having a predetermined area and a predetermined thickness in order for a sole of the user to be fixed; one or more foot fixing straps (202) installed in the footboard (20); a leg support unit (10) connecting two leg frames (100) to both sides of the footboard (20) by a first hinge (110) and fixing the each leg frame (100) to each other; a leg fixing strap (101) fixed to the leg support unit (10) while enclosing the leg of the user; a spring (13) including an elastic body (131); a lever unit (30) applying power to the ground by receiving the elastic force of the spring (13); and a latch unit (14) enabling the spring unit (13) to be extended in accordance with a movement of an ankle of the user.
title: Walk assistance device

abstract: An implementation may involve causing a foot of a robot to orient in a first position, where the foot comprises a sole configured to contact a surface, where the sole comprises a first edge and a second edge, and where in the first position: (i) the first edge contacts the surface, and (ii) a zero moment point (ZMP) is located on the first edge; receiving, from a force sensor, (i) first force data indicative of a first force and (ii) first moment data indicative of a first moment; determining a calibration of the force sensor based at least in part on the first force data, the first moment data, and a distance between the ZMP and a measurement location on the robot; and while the robot is engaged in bipedal movement, controlling the bipedal movement of the robot based at least in part on the calibration.
title: Methods and systems for force sensor calibration

abstract: The invention discloses a jumping walking soft robot. The jumping walking soft robot comprises a double-leg assembly (1) and two steering engines (2). The double-leg assembly comprises a supporting frame (11) and two soft legs (12). The two soft legs are assembled on the two sides of the supporting frame respectively, and the two soft legs are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the supporting frame; the structural form of assembling the single soft leg and the supporting frame is that a sliding block (13) is fixedly arranged at the driving end of the soft leg, the sliding block is assembled in a sliding groove of the supporting frame, the fixed end of the soft leg is fixedly connected with the supporting frame, and the walking end of the soft leg faces downwards; the two steering engines correspond to the two soft legs in the double-leg assembly respectively, and the power output end of each steering engine is in driving connection with the driving end of the corresponding soft leg through an intermediate transmission mechanism; based on a vertical guide mechanism formed by matching of the sliding block and the sliding groove, the steering engine can drive the driving end of the soft leg to move up and down. According to the jumping walking soft robot, stable and reliable jumping walking actions can be achieved.
title: Soft robot capable of jumping and walking

abstract: The invention discloses a novel quadruped robot which comprises a robot body. Two leg modules are fixed to the front side and the rear side of the robot body. Each leg module comprises two supportinglegs which are fixed to the two ends of an actuator installation seat. Each supporting leg comprises a hip swing actuator, a shank lifting actuator and a thigh lifting actuator. All the actuators arefixed through actuator connecting pieces. The shank lifting actuators and the thigh lifting actuators are fixedly connected. Thigh plates are connected to the outer walls of the shank lifting actuators. Shank supporting pieces are arranged below the thigh plates. Foot structural parts are arranged at the bottoms of the shank supporting pieces. Synchronizing wheels I are fixed to the output ends ofthe shank lifting actuators. Synchronizing wheels II are arranged on shank joints between the thigh plates and the shank supporting pieces. Synchronous belts are arranged between the synchronizing wheels I and the synchronizing wheels II. The novel quadruped robot has the beneficial effects that all the actuators are integrated, and the size is small; the synchronous belts are used for connection, and motion is smooth; and the robot inclines or gets down through rotation of the hip swing actuators, and the anti-falling capacity of the robot is enhanced.
title: Novel quadruped robot

abstract: A lower extremity exoskeleton (100) includes: at least one power unit (201); two leg supports (101, 102) designed to rest on the ground (130); two knee joints (107, 108) configured to allow flexion and extension between respective shank (105, 106) and thigh links (103, 104) of the leg supports (101, 102); an exoskeleton trunk (109) rotatably connectable to the leg supports (101, 102); and two hip actuators (145, 146) configured to create torques between the exoskeleton trunk (109) and the leg supports (101, 102). In use, the hip actuators (145, 146) create a torque to move the leg supports (101, 102) backward relative to the exoskeleton trunk ( 109) during a stance phase, which pushes the exoskeleton trunk (109) forward. A second torque may be used to move the leg supports (101, 102) forward relative to the exoskeleton trunk (109) into a swing phase. Additionally, a swing torque may be generated during the swing phase to move the leg support (101, 102) forward relative to the exoskeleton trunk (109). This results in decreased oxygen consumption and heart rate of a user wearing the exoskeleton (100).
title: DEVICE AND METHOD FOR DECREASING OXYGEN CONSUMPTION OF A PERSON DURING STEADY WALKING BY USE OF A LOAD-CARRYING EXOSKELETON

abstract: A walking pattern generation system generates a walking pattern of a biped walking robot. The walking pattern generation system includes a pole-zero controller for converting a target pattern data input to the system into a reference pattern data through a first transfer function, and a walking pattern generation unit for converting the reference pattern data into a walking pattern data through a second transfer function and outputting the converted walking pattern data, wherein the second transfer function has an unstable zero, and wherein the first transfer function includes a transfer function approximated to an inverse of the unstable zero of the second transfer function.
title: Walking pattern generation system for biped walking robot

abstract: A self-actuated spring-action human bipedal device includes a back-mounted frame attached to the upper torso of a user, and separate articulated right and left leg frames pivotally attached by U-joints to lower portions of the back frame. The user's feet are secured to the leg frames so that the bottoms of the leg frames contact the ground, rather than the user's feet, behind the point where each foot is attached to its leg frame. A spring actuator is carried on the back frame, and endless cord-like main springs are engaged with the spring actuator. Left and right tension lines running from the left and right leg frames to the spring actuator are arranged so that compression of the leg frames, cause by the force of downward movement of the user's feet and torso, acting on the ground, pulls on the tension lines to apply a pulling force to the spring actuator for stretching the main springs. The tension lines are also each attached to a part of the leg frame which engages on the user's foot so that extension of the user's leg pulls on the tension lines, also stretching the main springs. The energy stored in the stretched main springs is then transferred back to the torso of the user and to the user's feet to cause the user to jump into the air by a distance above the ground approximately proportional to the amount of compression of the leg frame and the amount of stretch transferred to the main springs. Separate pick-up springs connected to each leg frame keep the tension lines under positive tension so that tension on each leg frame will not go slack and will apply a pick-up force to the leg frame to raise it and prevent foot dragging to simulate a natural walking gait.
title: HUMAN BIPEDAL LOCOMOTION DEVICE

abstract: A premium getting game machine capable of getting a premium by walking a bipedal walking robot (more specifically, a humanoidal bipedal walking robot) which is complicated to control. The premium getting game machine (1) designed to get an arranged premium by walking a humanoidal bipedal walking robot (2) based on an operation by a user, comprises a section for controlling the walking of the humanoidal bipedal walking robot (2) in response to an operation by the user, and a hold operation control performing section for allowing the humanoidal bipedal walking robot (2) to hold a premium in response to an operation by the user, wherein a user operates an operation button at an operating section (19) to let the premium held by the humanoidal bipedal walking robot (2) drop into an input port (15) and to deliver the premium to a delivery port (17).
title: PREMIUM GETTING GAME MACHINE AND HUMANOID BIPEDAL WALKING ROBOT

abstract: A radio controlled toy comprises an upper body 5 mounted on a seat plate 7 with two legs 6 mounted on the seat plate 7. The upper body 5 and the two legs 6 are interconnected by way of a link mechanism 80 so that a twisting movement of the upper body 5 and a direction changing movement of the two legs 6 is performed in an interlocking relationship with each other. Further, a rotation controlling unit is provided for stopping rotation or reducing the speed of rotation of a wheel (63, Figure 6) provided on an inner side of one of the two legs when the twisting movement and the direction changing movement are to be carried out. Since the upper body 5 can be twisted when the travelling direction is changed to a direction to which the radio controlled toy is going to be turned with respect to the seat plate 7, the movement of the radio controlled toy becomes more natural. The toy is provided with arms and a first arm may be provided with grasping means; a second arm may be provided with bullet firing means and light beam transmission means. <IMAGE>
title: Radio controlled toy

abstract: A system for analyzing starts and acceleration phases in squat-style track and field events has: a launching stand, a plurality of wireless cameras, a technical analysis host, two foot tracking devices and a gyro group. The launching stand has at least one acceleration sensor and an adjusting support connected to two pedals. The technical analysis host is connected to the acceleration sensor and the wireless cameras, the acceleration sensor actives the wireless cameras to collect instantaneous speed data of a runner, and the technical analysis host generates a 100 m speed curve L1 of the runner, and the 100 m speed curve L1 includes a continuous reduced acceleration section L2. The two foot tracking devices are installed on two feet of each runner. The gyro group have a first gyro, a second gyro, a third gyro and a fourth gyro.
title: System for analyzing starts and acceleration phases in squat-style track and field events

abstract: PURPOSE: A birdlike robot is provided to reduce a load of each actuator by delivering a driving force of the actuator to a second joint unit and a third joint unit through a tendon structure. CONSTITUTION: A birdlike robot includes a leg module (10). The leg module is installed in a body unit and performs a biped walking or swimming. The leg module includes a first leg (20), a first joint unit (30), a second leg (40), a second joint unit (50), a foot unit (60), and a third joint unit (70). The first leg dually rotates relative to the body unit. The first joint unit is arranged between the first leg and the body unit and supplies the dual rotation to the first leg. The second leg is connected to the first leg and rotates forwards and backwards. The second joint unit is arranged between the first leg and the second leg and supplies a rotational movement to the second leg. The foot unit is connected to the second joint unit and supports the ground or supplies a driving force in the swimming. The third joint unit is arranged between the foot unit and the second joint unit to be rotated to left and right sides or forward and backward directions.
title: BIRDLIKE ROBOT

abstract: The application relates to an exoskeleton (100, 100') for assisting a user (600) and to a method for assisting a user (600). The exoskeleton (100, 100') comprises at least one bending spring (200), which is designed to adopt a bent configuration when the body of the user (600) is bent forwards, an upper-body connection (300), which is designed to connect the at least one bending spring (200) to the upper body of the user (600) in such a way that the at least one bending spring (200) is arranged dorsally on the body of the user (600), and two leg connections (500, 500'), which are designed to connect the at least one bending spring (200) to a respective leg of the user (600) and/or to a respective leg part (410) of a leg covering (400).
title: EXOSKELETON AND METHOD

abstract: The present invention relates to an exoskeleton device comprising two legs (2, 3) arranged to be coupled to the feet of a user, a connecting member (4) between the upper ends of the legs to which it is articulated and a tool-carrying arm (5) connected to the connecting member. The arm (5) is mounted sliding on the connecting member (4). The device comprises means (71) for actuating the arms, depending on the movements of the user, in order to ensure movement of same in straight line travel.
title: EXOSKELETON FOR ASSISTING HORIZONTAL EFFORTS

abstract: The present invention relates to a method for moving a bipedal exoskeleton (1) accommodating a human operator, the method comprising the implementation, by data processing means (11c) of the exoskeleton (1), of steps of: (a) obtaining a theoretical elementary trajectory of the exoskeleton (1); (b) executing a control loop defining the change in an actual position of the exoskeleton (1) so as to implement an actual elementary trajectory close to said theoretical elementary trajectory, comprising, in each iteration of the loop: - estimating a current state of the exoskeleton (1) as a function of said actual position; - determining a force torsor to be applied to the exoskeleton (1) in the next iteration of the loop to compensate for a deviation between said estimated current state of the exoskeleton (1) and an expected state of the exoskeleton (1) according to said theoretical elementary trajectory; the determination of the force torsor and/or the application thereof to the exoskeleton (1) taking into account a model of the flexibility of the exoskeleton (1) with respect to a rigid robot.
title: METHOD FOR MOVING AN EXOSKELETON

abstract: The invention discloses a bionic woven ligament for a pulling and pressing body hip joint, and relates to the technical field of mechanical bionic engineering.The bionic woven ligament comprises a bionic iliofemoral ligament body and a bionic pugfemoral ligament body which are woven in a multi-knot transverse grain weaving mode, the near end of the bionic iliofemoral ligament body is used for being attached to anterior inferior spine and acetabular margin, and the near end of the bionic iliofemoral ligament body is used for being attached to the acetabular margin; the far end of the bionic iliofemoral ligament is used for being attached to an intertrochanteric line; the near end of the bionic ligament smegmatis is used for being attached to a pubic protrusion, a pubic superior ramus and the pubic part of the acetabular margin, and the far end of the bionic ligament smegmatis is used for being attached to the lower side of the femoral neck. According to the bionic woven ligament for the pulling and pressing body hip joint, the shape and performance close to those of the hip joint ligament of the human body can be achieved in a biped walking robot.
title: Bionic woven ligament for pulling and pressing hip joint

abstract: The invention provides a double-leg moving mechanism based on tendon-bone collaborative bionics and a robot. The double-leg moving mechanism comprises bionic leg-foot single bodies, a driving mechanism and a rack. The bionic leg and foot single bodies are symmetrically installed on the two sides of the rack, and the driving mechanism is installed on the rack. Each bionic leg and foot single body comprises a bionic tendon-bone cooperative walking device and a bionic toe-web; one end of the bionic tendon-bone cooperative walking device is connected with the driving mechanism, and the other end of the bionic tendon-bone cooperative walking device is connected with the bionic toe-web; the driving mechanism drives the bionic leg and foot single bodies on the two sides of the machine frame to walk alternately in a stepping mode. The efficient and stable tendon-bone synergistic bionic leg-foot single body and the double-leg moving mechanism comprising the bionic leg-foot single body are designed by adopting an engineering bionic technology on the basis of the efficient and stable movement characteristics of a mallard, double-leg synergistic walking can be achieved through one driving motor, and by means of the bionic structural design, the leg-bone synergistic bionic leg-foot single body and the double-leg moving mechanism comprising the bionic leg-foot single body can be obtained. And the walking stability and the movement efficiency of the double-leg moving mechanism are improved.
title: Double-leg moving mechanism based on tendon-bone collaborative bionics and robot

abstract: The invention is a toy mechanism that makes the toy able to imitate the natural gait of bipedal creatures. Are known toys with the mechanism in the form of humans, animals, or different kinds of monsters, that can walk, but the driving force behind them is the electric motor for example with remote control or driving force is already rolled up,unrolling tin metal plate. The driving force of the toy is a hand that holds the toy vertically and moves it forward. Toy with a mechanism consistent with the description of the invention can be the form of variety of bipedal creatures as a human, animal or fairy tale character. The mechanism of the toy according to the description of the invention consists of core (1), wire (4) that passes through it, and a double crank (5) passing through the core (1), on a wire (4) are suspended inner arms (2) with fixed legs (7) to them. Holding the toy vertically we move it forward, one of the inner arms (2) with upright leg (7) that touches the ground is moving backward setting in rotary motion a double crank (5) that pivoting moves forward second inner arm (2). When one of the inner arms (2) with upright leg(7) that touches the ground is tilted far back, leg (7) bends and pushes up a rounded element (6), and this contributes to the continuation of a double crank (5) rotation that makes the second inner arm (2) moving forward and rounded element being part of external arm (3) goes down straightening the leg (7) that touches the ground and when pushing toy forward moves it back and then the course starts again.
title: TOY MECHANISM IMITATING A WALK

abstract: The invention discloses a novel moving and grabbing integrated bionic multi-legged robot which comprises a front robot body provided with two legs and a rear robot body provided with four legs, and the front robot body and the rear robot body are connected through a tensioning structure which has deformation and recovery functions and can be lifted to deform. When the driving wire is driven to be tensioned, the tensioning structure can be lifted upwards to deform, when the driving wire is loosened, the tensioning structure can be put down to restore under the action of the reset spring, the front machine body and the tensioning structure act synchronously, and the front machine body can be lifted to deform or put down to restore. When the front machine body is not lifted, the robot travels according to the three-foot gait through the six leg mechanisms; when the front machine body is lifted, the two legs of the front machine body serve as mechanical arms, the clamping function is achieved through the steering engines at the hip joints, the robot moves the four legs of the rear machine body, the four-foot gait is adopted, and the robot can complete carrying work.
title: Novel moving and grabbing integrated bionic multi-legged robot

abstract: The invention provides a pedestrian abnormal gait recognition method based on human body model analysis, and the method comprises the following steps: 1, building a motion capture system, wearing an IMU sensor, designing a plurality of motion scenes, and obtaining C3D data and IMU data in different motion states; 2, building an Anybody human body model, importing the C3D data into the model, carrying out kinematics and dynamics analysis, and obtaining related simulation data; 3, different motion states are analyzed through simulation data and IMU data, gait phases are divided according to analysis results, and each set of motion data is classified; 4, building a random forest model, combining the classified data training model, and performing single-foot gait phase recognition by using the model; and 5, analyzing the types of the gait combinations of the two feet, and building a K adjacent machine learning model to recognize abnormal gait combinations. Therefore, the abnormal gait recognition of the pedestrian is completed.
title: Pedestrian abnormal gait recognition method based on human body model analysis

abstract: A reconfigurable walking toy which may be operated by turning a control knob which activates a gear mechanism within the toy used to move the leg members of the toy in order to simulate a walking action. The toy has two leg members, each having upper and lower leg members. The two upper leg members are rotatably engaged to a hollow body. Each of the two lower leg members is rotatably engaged to one of the upper leg members. The toy is supported by foot members which rotatably engage the bottom ends of the lower leg members. The gear mechanism features two sector gears which are rotatably mounted to the hollow body of the toy. The sector gears are driven by a pinion gear attached to a gear shaft. A control knob is used to rotate the shaft. Rotation of the knob back and forth causes one leg member to stride forward followed by the other leg member, simulating a walking movement of the toy. Tabs attached to the upper leg members operably engage elongated slots in the hollow body when the toy is in a walking configuration supported by the foot members. The toy can be reconfigured to simulate a flying vehicle or craft by rotating the upper ends of the leg members until the tabs engage smaller slots in the hollow body, locking the legs in a substantially horizontal position.
title: Reconfigurable walking toy with gear mechanism

abstract: The invention discloses an object delivery behavior detection method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, relates to the technical field of image processing, and is used for accurately detecting object delivery behaviors. The method comprises the following steps: identifying a frame of target image in a video file to obtain human body key points in the target image; based on the human body key points in the target image, a person pair in the target image is screened out, the number of intersection points of a connecting line between target points corresponding to two persons included in the person pair and the non-vertex position of the rail lower line is an odd number, and the target point is the midpoint of a connecting line of foot key points of two feet in the human body key points of the persons; if the two persons in the person pair both have the hand raising action, determining that the person pair is a target person pair; and according to the target person pair in the multiple frames of images continuous with the target image, determining whether the object delivery behavior exists or not.
title: Object delivery behavior detection method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium

abstract: The invention provides a bionic robot with two clamping feet, and relates to the technical field of service robots. The bionic robot with the two feet capable of being clamped comprises a vehicle body, a box body is arranged on the upper wall of the vehicle body, and the left side and the right side of the box body are each rotationally connected with a set of mechanical arms through a set of arm bases. According to the invention, by arranging the box body, objects can be carried and contained; the guide wheels can be matched with the driving wheels to support the vehicle body when the robot is static and travels on the flat ground, the connecting rod adjusting device can adjust the motion posture according to the road condition, and therefore the robot can be integrally kept in the horizontal motion state in cooperation with the guide wheels and the driving wheels, and bouncing action can be achieved to improve the obstacle crossing capacity. The first balance structure can keep the stability of the vehicle body when the clamping structure carries out the clamping action, a rubber sleeve provided with a magnetic powder bag and an electromagnetic coil is arranged in the third finger joint, when an object with an uneven surface or an irregular shape is clamped, the third finger joint can be made to be matched with the shape of the clamped object, and the clamping safety is greatly improved.
title: Bio-robot with two clamping feet

abstract: The invention discloses a bipedal walking robot based on a parallel mechanism. The bipedal walking robot comprises a waist platform and two leg part mechanisms symmetrically arranged and connected tothe lower side of the waist platform. Each leg part mechanism comprises an upper platform, a lower platform and three telescopic cylinders hinged between the upper platform and the lower platform through universal joints, and the bipedal walking robot further comprises a steering mechanism installed on the waist platform and a sole mechanism installed at the bottom of each leg part mechanism. According to the bipedal walking robot based on the parallel mechanism, a single-degree-of-freedom waist part is used for driving a motor to drive two three-degree-of-freedom leg part mechanisms based ona parallel structure, so that under the situation that two legs are only provided with four degrees of freedom in total, the robot can realize the functions of straight running, turning, obstacle-crossing and walking up and down stairs stably; and compared with existing six-degree-of-freedom robots, the design structure of the robot is simpler, a workspace is large, and the payload to deadweight ratio is high.
title: Bipedal walking robot based on parallel mechanism

abstract: The invention discloses a gait control method of a robot, the robot and a control terminal, relates to the technical field of robots, and aims to solve the problem that foot end track planning of the robot is difficult to adapt to different motion working conditions and terrains. The robot comprises a robot body, at least two legs, a gait state machine and a motor, the gait state machine and the motor correspond to each leg, and the gait control method of the robot comprises the steps that foot end information of supporting legs of the robot, phase information of each leg and speed instruction information of the robot body are obtained; gait information of the robot is obtained according to the foot end information of the supporting legs, the phase information of each leg and the speed instruction information of the robot body. And according to the gait information of the robot and the phase information of each leg, leg state information of each leg is obtained. According to the leg state information of each leg, the joint torque of the motor corresponding to each leg is obtained. According to the joint torque of the motor corresponding to each leg, controlling the motor corresponding to each leg to rotate so as to control each leg to move.
title: Gait control method of robot, robot and control terminal

abstract: The invention provides an upper limb multi-joint active power-assisted exoskeleton with a load conduction function.
