The upper limb multi-joint active power-assisted exoskeleton comprises an upper limb power-assisted module and a load conduction lower limb module; the upper limb assisting module comprises a left arm module, a right arm module and a back module; each of the left arm module and the right arm module is provided with a plurality of movable joints, and the movable joints correspond to movable joints of human arms; the distance between the left arm module and the right arm module can be adjusted through the back module; the load conduction lower limb module comprises a left leg module, a right leg module and a waist module; each of the left leg module and the right leg module is provided with a plurality of movable joints, and the movable joints correspond to the movable joints of human legs and the waist module; and the distance between the left leg module and the right leg module can be adjusted. Each of the arm modules and the leg modules is provided with the plurality of movable joints, the distance between the two arm modules and the distance between the two leg modules can be flexibly adjusted, and the problems that in existing exoskeleton equipment, the assistance force of all degrees of freedom of joints is not large and the like are solved.
title: Upper limb multi-joint active power-assisted exoskeleton with load conduction function

abstract: The invention relates to a wheel-foot hybrid fire-fighting robot, which comprises a main body, wherein two walking mechanisms for realizing bipedal walking are arranged at the lower part of the main body, and two walking wheel assemblies are arranged at the lower part of each walking mechanism; the relative height of the walking wheel assemblies and the walking mechanisms can be adjusted so that when the lower ends of the walking wheel assemblies are lower than bottom plates, the walking wheel assemblies drive the main body to realize wheeled walking; on the contrary, the walking mechanisms drive the main body to realize bipedal walking; the lowermost ends of the walking mechanisms are the bottom plates, and the upper surfaces of the bottom plates are provided with fire extinguishing assemblies; the upper surfaces of the bottom plates are fixedly provided with support frames, the support frames are fixed with a double-shaft motor, and the output shaft of the double-shaft motor is respectively and fixedly connected with a lead screw.
title: Wheel-foot hybrid fire-fighting robot

abstract: A floor shape estimation system for a legged mobile robot, in particular a biped walking robot, which estimates a foot-to-foot floor inclination difference (138) based on at least a control error of the total floor reaction force's moment and corrects a feet compensating angle based on the estimated value. Further, the system estimates a foot floor inclination difference (144) based on at least a control error of the foot floor reaction force about a desired foot floor reaction force central point and corrects a foot compensating angle based on the estimated value. Furthermore, it determines whether it is in a situation where the accuracy of estimation is liable to degrade based on at least a time of the gait of the robot and when it is in the situation, the system interrupts the estimation (140, 146). With this, the system can accurately estimate the shape of floor with which the robot is in contact. <IMAGE>
title: FLOOR SHAPE DEDUCING DEVICE FOR LEGGED MOBILE ROBOT

abstract: DYNAMIC LEGGED LOCOMOTION PROCESS USING THE SPRING LOADED INVERTED PENDULUM (SLIP) FOR SOFT ROBOT Delicate mechanical technology and its connected innovations empower robot capacities in a few mechanical technology areas including, however not solely identified with, control, producing, human-robot communication, and headway. The SLIP comprises of a Spring-Loaded Inverted Pendulum with the expansion of pitch elements and can be utilized to contemplate the Sagittarius plane movement of bipedal running. Occasion based control is utilized to settle the shut circle mixture framework along an intermittent circle of the SLIP elements. This invention plans to give a reference control for analysts moving toward portable delicate advanced mechanics, to depict the hidden standards of delicate robot motion with its advantages and disadvantages, and to conceive applications and further improvements for versatile delicate advanced mechanics. A DYNAMIC LEGGED LOCOMOTION PROCESS USING THE SPRING-LOADED INVERTED PENDULUM (SLIP) FOR SOFT ROBOT Diagram wriG FUNCTIONS OF SOFT TENSGRIT JD Fig 1: Functions of soft robot Fig 2: Components of soft robot
title: A dynamic legged locomotion process using the spring-loaded inverted pendulum (SLIP) for soft robot

abstract: Disclosed is a wearable robot controlling apparatus. The wearable robot controlling apparatus comprises: two leg links of a wearable robot; a joint actuator for generating a relative motion of the two leg links; a controller for controlling the joint actuator; and a sensor measuring a wearer′s bio-signal of the wearable robot for a control gain adjustment value for the control.
title: Apparatus for controlling wearable Robot using bio signal Method thereof and Computer readable storage medium having the method

abstract: The invention discloses a substation collaborative inspection robot based on visual inspection and a method thereof, and the robot body structure comprises a head, a trunk, two arms and two legs, so that the robot has maneuverability and operation capability similar to those of human beings, and can freely move in a complex substation environment. The sensing system of the head integrates a vision sensor, a thermal imaging sensor, a sonic sensor and an external loudspeaker, environment information is comprehensively collected, data is transmitted to the control system to be processed, and real-time monitoring and analysis of the equipment state are achieved. Under the control of the central processing unit, the joint drivers and the force sensors of the two arms and the two legs can simulate walking and operation actions of human beings, so that the inspection efficiency is improved, and refined maintenance is executed. The navigation system plans an optimal inspection path to ensure efficient task execution; and the communication system realizes data transmission and remote control with external equipment.
title: Substation collaborative inspection robot based on visual inspection and method thereof

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots. The invention relates to a walking mechanism, in particular to a walking mechanism capable of walking with two legs. The walking mechanism comprises a mounting frame connected to a machine body, first walking mechanisms are mounted at two ends of the mounting frame; second walking mechanisms are mounted at two ends of the mounting frame; under the condition that the first walking mechanisms and the second walking mechanisms are cooperated, a first motor drives a first rotating rod to rotate, a second motor drives a second rotating rod torotate, the first walking leg drives the machine body to move under the effect of a first connecting frame and a first connecting rod, the second walking leg drives the machine body to move under theeffect of a second connecting frame and a second connecting rod, the walking mechanism with the double-leg walking function can be conveniently used on various road surfaces, and steering of the robotis facilitated.
title: Walking mechanism capable of walking with two legs

abstract: The invention discloses an air-ground amphibious robot combining tilting four rotors and double-wheel feet, and relates to the technical field of air-ground amphibious robots. The problems that an existing air-ground amphibious robot combines a single moving mode with a flying platform, the function of a crawling mechanism is single, walking is achieved by means of the flying platform, and then the cruising ability of the robot is reduced are solved. The rocker arms of the tilting steering engines are connected with the steering engine driving rotating shafts, the propellers are installed on the motor shafts of the rotor wing driving motors, the steering engine driving rotating shafts are driven by the two tilting steering engines connected with the steering engine driving rotating shafts to rotate, and then the propellers and the rotor wing driving motors at the two ends of the steering engine driving rotating shafts are driven to tilt. The two leg assemblies are symmetrically installed on the outer side walls of the two longitudinal installation side plates respectively. The wheel-leg type composite moving crawling mechanism is combined with the flying platform, the function of the robot is increased, meanwhile, assistance of the flying platform is eliminated, independent walking is achieved, and the cruising ability of the robot is improved.
title: Air-ground amphibious robot combining tilting four rotors and double-wheel feet

abstract: The invention discloses a body-variable and modular four-foot walking robot with an energy storage function. The body-variable and modular four-foot walking robot comprises a body structure unit, wherein an energy storage structure unit is arranged below the middle of the body structure unit; two leg structure units are respectively arranged below the left side and the right side of the body structure unit; and a body structure is provided with a controller unit. Size variation of a body is adjusted through the energy storage structure unit, so that the body-variable and modular four-foot walking robot is formed; the change of the body of a bionic mammalian is simulated; and the robot has a jumping function preliminarily. By the structure, the structure of the robot and control on the robot are simplified simultaneously, and the development cost and the using cost are reduced. The robot has high movement flexibility and high ground adaptive capacity; and the obstacle crossing ability of the robot is improved, so that the robot can be used in lots of special environments and places, and has a wide application prospect.
title: Body-variable and modular four-foot walking robot with energy storage function

abstract: The present invention provides a biped walking mobile apparatus, its walk controller, and walk controlling strategy therefor, which are to realize walk stability even under the road surface condition where the foot stance is unstable, for example, such as wet floor, ice, mud, or the carpet of long hair, or when only a part contacts with the floor surface due, for example, to its roughness. A walk controller (30) of the biped walking mobile apparatus comprises the force sensors (23L, 23R) for detecting the forces applied to soles of respective foot portions (14L, 14R) which drive-control the drive means of the respective joint portions (15L, 15R to 20L, 20R) of respective leg portions of the biped walking mobile apparatus based on gait data, and the compensation part (32) for correcting gait data from the gait forming part (24) based on horizontal floor reaction force among the forces detected by the force sensors, and it is constituted so that each force sensor (23L, 23R) comprises 3-axis force sensors set to each part of the soles of each foot portion (14L, 14R) divided in plurality. <IMAGE>
title: Bipedal walking type moving device, and walking control device and walking control method therefor

abstract: A bipedal vehicle 1 comprising two extendible output legs 5 L, 5 R (to support the vehicle), two foot holds 5 9L, 5 9 R (to accept input movement from an operator) and a control system 253 comprising powered actuators to move the output legs in 5 relation to the input movement to produce output movement.
title: A vehicle

abstract: The invention relates to a comfortable hydraulic muscle driving exoskeleton. The exoskeleton comprises a waist plate and two leg plates, the waist plate is arc-shaped; each leg plate is of a cross-shaped structure; the two ends of the waist plate are rotationally connected with the upper ends of the leg plates respectively; a leg sleeving ring is fixedly installed at the lower end of each leg plate, a front hydraulic muscle and a rear hydraulic muscle are connected between the front end of each leg plate and the waist plate and between the rear end of each leg plate and the waist plate respectively, the front hydraulic muscles and the rear hydraulic muscles are symmetrically distributed relative to the leg plates, a waist plate buffering cushion is installed on the inner side of the waistplate, and a comfortable cushion is installed on the inner side of each leg sleeving ring. The exoskeleton is simple in structure, small in size and light in weight, hydraulic muscles are used as drivers of the exoskeleton, the structure is compact, the weight of the exoskeleton can be greatly reduced, and the load of a human body is reduced. The hydraulic muscles have certain flexibility in the axial direction of the hydraulic muscles, so that driving force is soft, impact of the front tail end position and the rear tail end position in the exoskeleton movement process can be reduced, the waist plate buffering cushion is additionally arranged in waist plate, comfortable cushions are arranged in leg sleeving rings, and a human body can feel more comfortable when wearing the hydraulic muscles.
title: A comfortable hydraulic muscle driving exoskeleton

abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot. The biped robot comprises a main body, two leg structures and a balance part, wherein the two leg structures are symmetrically installed on the two sides of the main body and can swing relative to the main body; and the balance part comprises a flywheel and a first driving piece, the first driving piece is installed on the main body, the first driving piece is connected with the flywheel and used for driving the flywheel to rotate, and the extending direction of the rotating axis of the flywheel is perpendicular to the distribution direction of the leg structures on the main body. According to the biped robot in the above embodiment, the leg structures swing relative to the main body, so the robot can avoid obstacles in an advancing process; and the torque generated by rotation of the flywheel can offset the torque applied to the main body due to lifting of the leg structures, and the robot keeps balanced in a walking process, so the walking stability of the biped robot is improved.
title: Biped robot

abstract: Whether a motion state of leg bodies 2 is a single stance state or a double stance state is sequentially determined and a total reaction force F is estimated on the basis of an equation of motion for a center of gravity (G0) of a bipedal walking body 1. If the motion state is the single stance state, then the estimated value of the total floor reaction force F is directly used as an estimated value of the floor reaction force of the leg body 2. If the motion state is the double stance state, then a floor reaction force Fr of the leg body 2 at the rear side is determined, using measurement data of elapsed time of the double stance state and moving speed of a bipedal walking body 1 and pre-established characteristic data, and the floor reaction force Fr is subtracted from the total floor reaction force F to determine a floor reaction force Ff of the leg body 2 at the front side. Thus, it is possible to provide a method that allows floor reaction forces acting on leg bodies of a bipedal walking body, such as a human being, and moments acting on joints of the leg bodies to be determined in real time with high accuracy by a relatively simple technique.
title: METHOD OF ESTIMATING FLOOR REACTIONS OF BIPEDAL WALKING BODY, AND METHOD OF ESTIMATING JOINT MOMENTS OF BIPEDAL WALKING BODY

abstract: The invention provides a standing assisting lower limb exoskeleton robot. The standing assisting lower limb exoskeleton robot comprises a back frame, a hydraulic swing cylinder, a hip joint electro-hydraulic servo valve, a flange plate, a thigh rod, a shank rod, a hydraulic linear cylinder, a piston rod, a displacement sensor, a knee joint electro-hydraulic servo valve, a foot sole mechanism, a shock absorber, an oil tank, an oil pump, a motor, a pressure gauge and an overflow valve. The thigh rod is connected with the hydraulic swing cylinder through the flange plate, the purpose that the hydraulic swing cylinder directly drives the thigh rod to rotate is achieved, compared with a traditional linear cylinder driving mode, the rotation angle of the hip joint is increased, and the requirement for the rotation angle of the hip joint in the erecting process is met; the occupied space is small, the boundary dimension is small, the stability is good, the reliability and the safety are high, and the self-weight and the cost are reduced; the invention provides a control method adopting an intelligent displacement feedback compensation control principle for an erecting assisting lower limb exoskeleton robot, real-time control signals of knee joint electro-hydraulic servo valves are adjusted through an intelligent controller, and the purpose of improving the position synchronous control precision of movable parts of two legs in the erecting process is achieved; and the human-computer interaction comfort and the user experience are greatly improved.
title: Standing assisting lower limb exoskeleton robot

abstract: The present invention provides a transformable robot, the transformable robot comprises an arm structure, a leg structure and a head of the robot which are fixed to a ribcage structure. The arm structure comprises a left arm and a right arm, the leg structure comprises a left leg and a right leg; the ribcage structure comprises a first steering gear fixed on an upper part of a second fixing frame, a rotating output shaft of the first steering gear successively passes through a top wall of the second fixing frame and a first backing plate to fixedly connected with a first steering wheel fixed on a first rotating frame; the first steering wheel is provided with an arc-shaped limited opening; a limited column on the first backing plate is movably passed through the limited opening; the rotating output shaft of the first steering gear rotates to drive the first rotating frame to rotate. The transformable robot may realize a transformation from a human form to a car form or from the car form to the human form by controlling the steering gears on each joint of the robot through a controller. In the car form, the transformable robot may realize a movement through the steering gears. In the human form, the robot may realize a biped walking through the steering gears.
title: TRANSFORMABLE ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot climbing stair gait planning method and device and a robot. The biped robot climbing stair gait planning method comprises the steps that in the stair climbing process, a variable-length first-order inverted pendulum model is adopted to carry out trajectory planning on a forward gait, the motion trajectory of an ankle joint is constrained according to preset constraint conditions, and a first-order linear inverted pendulum model is adopted to carry out trajectory planning on a lateral gait to realize stair climbing of a biped robot; the process is that whenfacing the first stair, the center of gravity of a body is controlled to move to the left; a right foot of a swing leg is lifted to drop the right foot onto the stair; the center of gravity of the body is moved to the right foot, and the left foot of the swing leg is lifted so that the left foot falls onto the stair; the steps are repeated until the first stair is the last stair; whether the center of gravity falls within a stable region or not is judged; if yes, the walking is finished; and if not, the two legs are controlled to close and return to the starting state. Based on the biped robot climbing stair gait planning method and device and a robot, an effective application of a robot walking mode can be realized, so that the robot can walk on the stairs as freely as a human.
title: Biped robot climbing stair gait planning method and device and robot

abstract: A method for modeling a robot simplified for stable walking control of a bipedal robot provides a robot model that is simplified as a virtual pendulum model including a virtual body, two virtual legs connected to the body at a virtual pivot point (VPP) that is set at a position higher than the center of mass (CoM) of the body, and virtual feet connected to the two legs, respectively, to step on the ground. A ground reaction force, which acts on the two legs, acts towards the VPP, thereby providing a restoring moment with respect to the CoM such that stabilization of the posture of the body naturally occurs.
title: METHOD FOR MODELING ROBOT SIMPLIFIED FOR STABLE WALKING CONTROL OF BIPEDAL ROBOT

abstract: Disclosed is a four-foot robot static gait planning method based on terrain fuzzy self-adaption. The four-foot robot static gait planning method based on terrain fuzzy self-adaption comprises the following steps of (1) calculating a trunk pitching angle according to foot falling position information of a robot; (2) planning a trunk movement track, and ensuring the stability of the robot in a nextstepping stage; (3) estimating the complexity of walking terrain by using the time of ground touching of two feet of the robot, and automatically adjusting parameters of truck moving track planning onthe basis of a fuzzy algorithm; and (4) completing a complete gait cycle and repeating the whole process. By means of the method, the pitching angle of a trunk can be automatically adjusted accordingto the terrain fluctuation in the walking process of the fur-foot robot, and the height and the terrain adaptability of the four-foot robot swinging feet across an obstacle are effectively increasedand improved respectively; the situation that the robot loses stability due to the fact that the speed or the acceleration is suddenly changed is effectively avoided; the self-adaption of the four-foot robot to the terrain is realized, and the terrain adaptability of the four-foot robot is effectively improved.
title: Four-foot robot static gait planning method based on terrain fuzzy self-adaption

abstract: The invention provides a joint type self-adaptive pipe climbing robot which comprises a left upper limb, a right upper limb, an upper trunk, a lower trunk and feet, the structures of the left upper limb and the right upper limb are completely identical, the left upper limb and the right upper limb are symmetrically arranged, and the left upper limb and the right upper limb are movable mechanical arms with mechanical grippers at the tail ends and are connected with the upper trunk through left and right shoulder joints respectively; the lower trunk and the upper trunk are connected through a pin shaft to form a revolute pair, and a waist mechanism of the lower trunk is a mechanism capable of enabling the two trunks to rotate relatively and composed of a direct-current motor, a harmonic reducer, a belt wheel, a flange bearing and an inclined support. The tail fixing plate of the feet is fixedly connected with the lower trunk through screws, and an electric push rod, a telescopic fixing block, two legs, a telescopic rod and an elastic block form a mechanism with two legs capable of being opened and closed at the same time. Under the action of movement of the waist mechanism, the leftupper limb, the right upper limb and the feet, the pipe climbing robot has good climbing capacity and self-adaptive capacity.
title: Joint type self-adaptive pipe climbing robot

abstract: A two-legged walking robot constructed such that a lower thigh link (9) and a foot sole section (11) of a leg section (2) are connected to each other by a linear actuator (124) at a position away from an ankle joint section (10) and that the foot sole section (11) rocks about the ankle joint section (10) relative to the lower thigh link (9) by extension and retraction of the linear actuator(124), wherein predetermined moment required for the robot to walk on stairs can be applied to the foot sole section (11) without an increase in the size of the linear actuator (124). The linear actuator (124) is placedso that its extension and retraction force acts on a line (L2) tilted backward relative to a connection line (L1) interconnecting a knee joint section (8) and the ankle joint section (10). Preferably, a connection section (Y3a) at which the linear actuator (124) is connected to the lower thigh link (9) is positioned behind the connection line (L1) and a connection section (Y3b) at which the linear actuator (124) is connected to the foot sole section (11) is positioned in front of the connection line (L1).
title: TWO-LEGGED WALKING ROBOT

abstract: The invention relates to the field of power-assisted exoskeletons, in particular to an active power-assisted exoskeleton which comprises a waist supporting assembly, two leg supporting assemblies, two power assemblies, two speed limiting devices and two joint shells. One end of the leg supporting assembly is connected with the joint shell, the other end of the leg supporting assembly is used for being fixed to the thigh of the human body, and the power assembly is arranged in the joint shell and used for driving the leg supporting assembly to rotate. The speed limiting device is arranged between the power set and the leg supporting assembly and used for limiting the rotating speed of the power assembly. The rotating speed of the joints is kept within a safe range through the speed limiting device, and occupational injuries such as sprain and strain caused by too high rotating speed of the joints are prevented.
title: Active power-assisted exoskeleton

abstract: The device comprises two leg elements (12, 14) fastened at the top along an axis (a) around which they are able to oscillate; each element ends with a support foot (18, 20) whose lower surface is arched both longitudinally and transversely. A means or an individual user operates the device by imparting to it a slight oscillation around a horizontal longitudinal axis and, in various ways, a traction or thrust in the direction of movement. The device can be realized as a toy, or as an aid for paraplegics, or as part of a robot or as a piece of sports equipment. <IMAGE>
title: Walking movement device

abstract: The invention discloses a biped semi-passive bipartition upper body walking robot which comprises a hip and two legs. The hip comprises a hip support and two lateral swinging parts, the lateral swinging parts are rotatably mounted on the hip support in a matched manner, a lateral swinging drive mechanism is arranged on the hip support, rotating parts are arranged on the lower portions of the lateral swinging parts respectively, a first rotating shaft is arranged on each rotating part and matched with the corresponding lateral swinging part, leg expansion drive mechanisms are arranged among the hip and the rotating parts, each leg comprises a thigh, a shank and an imitation foot plate, second rotating shafts are arranged on the rotating parts, thigh connectors are arranged at the upper end of the thighs and rotatably sleeve the second rotating shafts in a matched manner, front and back swinging drive mechanisms are arranged on the rotating parts, the shanks are hinged to the thighs, a knee joint drive mechanism is arranged between each thigh and the corresponding shank, the imitation foot plates are rotatably mounted at the bottoms of the shanks through ankle joint rotating shafts in a matched manner, the ankle joint rotating shafts are parallel to the second rotating shafts, and ankle joint drive mechanisms are arranged among the imitation foot plates and the hip or the legs.
title: Biped semi-passive bipartition upper body walking robot

abstract: The invention discloses a personification biped walking robot. The personification biped walking robot comprises a trunk mechanism and two leg walking device assemblies fixedly connected at the bottom of the trunk mechanism. Each leg walking device assembly comprises a hip-joint driving mechanism, a leg driving device and a foot sole walking device, wherein the hip-joint driving mechanism, the leg driving device and the foot sole walking device are sequentially arranged from top to bottom. According to the personification biped walking robot, the technical defects of a traditional series robot and a traditional parallel robot are overcome, and the technical advantages of the traditional series robot and the traditional parallel robot are achieved at the same time; the personification biped walking robot has the advantages that various motions can be simulated, the simulation performance and the reliability are high, the structural design is reasonable, and the practicability is high.
title: Personification biped walking robot

abstract: The invention discloses a triphibian bionic flapping rotor micro aircraft. The aircraft comprises an air bag shell, wings, an empennage, a leg mechanism and a control device, the air bag shell is internally inflated and is used for realizing floating in water; each wing comprises a driving device and two flapping rotors which are mounted in an antisymmetric manner; the driving device is connected with the flapping rotor wings and is used for driving the flapping rotor wings to rotate and/or flap; the two leg mechanisms are symmetrically installed on the two sides of the bottom of the driving device and each provided with a metal spring leg with a duck web-shaped foot sole. The empennage is mounted on the rear side of the top of the driving device; the driving device and the control device are both installed in the air bag shell. The leg mechanisms and the wings are installed outside the air bag shell. The miniature aircraft has the triphibian motion ability of flying in the air, running on the ground and swimming in water.
title: Triphibian bionic flapping rotor micro aircraft

abstract: The invention discloses a lower limb structure for exoskeleton, and belongs to the technical field of exoskeleton, the lower limb structure for exoskeleton comprises an approximately long-strip-shaped leg component, and an avoiding groove for avoiding leg muscles of a wearer is formed in the leg component. According to the exoskeleton lower limb structure, due to the fact that the receding grooves are formed in the leg components, calf muscles of a wearer can be receded by the receding grooves when the leg components are used, then the leg components can be attached to the calf of the wearer as much as possible, and the width distance between the two leg components arranged on the exoskeleton lower limb structure can be as small as possible; therefore, the width of the lower part of the exoskeleton can be reduced.
title: Lower limb structure for exoskeleton

abstract: A system and method is disclosed for controlling a robot having at least two legs, the robot falling down from an upright posture and the robot located near a plurality of surrounding objects. A plurality of predicted fall directions of the robot are determined, where each predicted fall direction is associated with a foot placement strategy, such as taking a step, for avoiding the surrounding objects. The degree to which each predicted fall direction avoids the surrounding objects is determined. A best strategy is selected from the various foot placement strategies based on the degree to which the associated fall direction avoids the surrounding objects. The robot is controlled to implement this best strategy.
title: HUMANOID FALL DIRECTION CHANGE AMONG MULTIPLE OBJECTS

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of exoskeleton supports, in particular to hip joint assisting equipment. Comprising a guide mechanism, two back supports are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the guide mechanism, connecting assemblies are arranged at the two ends of each back support and connected with a waist support, and one end of each waist support is rotationally connected with a leg support; a differential steel wire rope is arranged on the guide mechanism, an elastic mechanism is arranged in the back bracket, two ends of the differential steel wire rope are respectively connected with the top end of the elastic mechanism, the elastic mechanism is connected with a transmission steel wire rope, and one end, far away from the elastic mechanism, of the transmission steel wire rope penetrates through the waist bracket and is connected with the leg bracket; and the device further comprises a shoulder strap and a waist strap, the shoulder strap is connected with the guide mechanism and the connecting assembly, and the waist strap is connected with the two leg supports. The hip joint assistance equipment can provide assistance for people with stooping dysfunction or waist movement difficulty, and life quality is improved.
title: Hip joint assisting device

abstract: In a walking robot, particularly a biped walking robot (1), having a body (3) and two articulated legs (2) each connected to the body and each having a foot (22) at its free end such that the robot is controlled to walk by landing a heel (68) of the foot first on a floor. The heel of the foot has projections and packing or filler (76a, 80, 86, 88, 90) charged in gaps between the projections. The projections are constituted to have a relatively higher rigidity against forces acting in the vertical direction and a relatively lower rigidity, which is lower than the first rigidity, against forces acting in other directions, when the heel (68) is landed, thereby enabling to achieve an optimum balance between absorption/mitigation of shock at footfall and attitude stabilization after footfall. <IMAGE>
title: Legged walking robot

abstract: The invention discloses a corridor public area light automatic control system based on big data, and the system comprises an illumination acquisition module, a central control module, an image acquisition module, a computer processing analysis module and a storage module. The invention has the beneficial effects that the storage module pre-stores back contour bending degrees and step frequencies,which are obtained through the analysis of a certain amount of sample data through a statistical method, corresponding to crowds of different ages; pedestrian images passing through a corridor publicarea at present are collected, collected data and data in a storage module are compared and analyzed, corresponding light intensity adjustment is conducted according to the judged age obtained throughanalysis so as to provide proper light intensity, and the lighting requirements of people of different ages can be met; meanwhile, the light intensity of the public area of the corresponding corridoris adjusted again according to the landing parts of the two feet of the pedestrian during walking, falling accidents caused by illumination are reduced to a greater extent, and the personal safety isguaranteed.
title: Corridor public area light automatic control system based on big data

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of safety early warning, in particular to a drilling platform space personnel safety early warning method and system, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the operation position of designated equipment on a drilling platform, and receiving to-be-detected images collected by a plurality of cameras; detecting the to-be-detected image by adopting a personnel behavior detection model to obtain current behavior states of all personnel in the image; if the current behavior state of the person is that the person stands or squats, a person key point detection model is adopted to detect an ROI area including the corresponding person, key point pixel coordinates of the ankles of the two feet of the corresponding person are obtained, based on the key point pixel coordinates, space position information of the ankles of the two feet of the corresponding person is calculated, and the position information of the ankles of the two feet of the corresponding person is obtained. According to the current behavior state and the spatial position information of the person, setting an alarm area of the corresponding person; and if the operation position of the equipment intrudes into the alarm area of the corresponding personnel, warning is carried out. According to the method, the behavior states of different persons are processed in a targeted manner, and the method is more detailed and intelligent.
title: Drilling platform space personnel safety early warning method and system

abstract: A heterogeneous load-bearing exoskeleton robot comprises a back part, a waist part and two leg parts, the back part is connected with the waist part, and the two leg parts are rotationally connected with the waist part; each leg part comprises a motor, a supporting seat, a connecting rod, an ankle joint bandage, a gear pair, a steel wire rope and two wire wheels; the three connecting rods are all of tubular structures, and the ankle joint bandage is installed on the inner sides of the connecting rods and can rotate relative to the connecting rods in the vertical plane. The two supporting seats are rotatably connected with the waist part, the motor is mounted on the supporting seats, two gears of the gear pair are respectively connected with one wire wheel and are coaxially arranged, a gap is formed between the two wire wheels in the radial direction, and one group of the gear and the wire wheel which are coaxially arranged is fixed on a motor shaft. The structure is compact, exoskeleton load bearing operation is achieved in a heterogeneous multi-stage connecting rod telescopic mode, and the large-range telescopic ratio can be achieved.
title: Heterogeneous load-bearing exoskeleton robot

abstract: An exoskeleton lower limb is provided with an upper connecting end, a leg motion device and a foot connecting device. The upper connecting end is used for receiving loads borne by the upper body of a user. The leg motion device is provided with a first body and a second body. The first body and the upper connecting end are hinged through a first hinged portion. The first body and the second body have relative linear motion. The foot connecting device is worn on the foot of the user and is hinged to the second body through a second hinged portion. The relative linear motion is in the direction of the connecting line between the first hinged portion and the second hinged portion. A wearable robot is provided with a carrying device and exoskeleton lower limbs arranged on the two legs of the user correspondingly. The carrying device is worn on the upper body of the user and is connected with upper connecting ends. The exoskeleton lower limb and the wearable robot are high in adaptive ability and good in motion flexibility.
title: Exoskeleton lower limb and wearable robot

abstract: Provided is an automatically controlled robot walking on two feet. The middle of a first connecting rod is connected with one end of a first support rod, one end of the first connecting rod is connected to a first sliding block, the other end of the first connecting rod is connected with one end of a second connecting rod, the other end of the second connecting rod is connected to the middle of a third connecting rod, one end of the third connecting rod is connected with one end of a second support rod, the other end of the third connecting rod is connected with one end of a fourth connecting rod, the other end of the fourth connecting rod is connected to a sole part, the middle of a seventh connecting rod is connected with one end of a third support rod, one end of the seventh connecting rod is connected to a second sliding block, the other end of the seventh connecting rod is connected with one end of an eighth connecting rod, and the other end of the eighth connecting rod is connected to the middle of the fourth connecting rod. According to the automatically controlled robot walking on the two feet, only one servo motor is adopted to serve as a power source, motion is divided into two ways through a chain-drive mechanism to drive reciprocating motion of a thigh and reciprocating motion of a shank respectively, the structure is simple, the layout is reasonable, the range of motion of the robot legs is wide, the bearing capacity of the robot legs is high, and assembling is convenient.
title: Automatically controlled robot walking on two feet

abstract: The invention discloses an exoskeleton hip joint cooperative movement energy storage amplification mechanism for material moving. The exoskeleton hip joint cooperative movement energy storage amplification mechanism is composed of a hip installation fixing piece, an energy storage swimming assembly and a hip joint flexion and extension winding roller assembly. According to the energy storage swimming assembly, a passive energy storage release element serves as a core, and is connected to left and right hip joint flexion and extension winding roller assemblies through matching of steel wires and movable and static pulleys, so that energy storage and release in the thigh flexion and extension process are completed. In the operation process, when the two legs are bent at the same time, the steel wires on the two sides drive the winding idler wheels and the movable pulleys to compress the energy storage element at the same time to achieve bidirectional energy storage, and the energy storage element is forced to move towards the middle of the hip installation fixing piece; when a single leg is bent, single-side energy storage and one-way swimming of an energy storage element can be completed, and in the alternate gait walking process, two-side energy storage release conversion along with changes of the supporting direction is achieved, and cooperative auxiliary assistance of free movement of the swing phase is achieved. The mechanism is compact and light, and can be used as an important component of an exoskeleton system.
title: Material moving exoskeleton hip joint cooperative motion energy storage amplification mechanism

abstract: Its aim is to provide a robot which is simpler and more mobile than existing robots with multiple feet. The robot of the invention of the bipedal type. A body (9) carries two legs (1, 2) equipped with feet (5, 6) capable of transmitting to the support surface the bending means resulting from the lack of balance of the robot when it is connected to this support surface via a single leg. Each leg can catch in predetermined locations on the support surface, the power and the command or information signals pass via the foot and the support surface in at least some of the predetermined locations. <IMAGE>
title: ROBOT CAPABLE OF MOVING ON INCLINED OR VERTICAL SURFACES

abstract: A power system is provided for robotic systems such as dynamically balancing robots, including inverted pendulum robots, robots that balance on two legs, and dynamically balancing robotic personal vehicles. Under normal operation, the power system provides operating power from a power source such as an internal battery system or an external AC power supply. The power system includes an energy storage device, such as an ultracapacitor assembly, that can provide emergency power sufficient to power components of the robotic system to a stable shutdown configuration in the event of a deleterious power event.
title: Self-balancing robot including an ultracapacitor power source

abstract: The invention provides a foot type robot and a control method of the foot type robot. The foot type robot comprises a trunk assembly, a storage bin, foot assemblies and mechanical arms. The storage bin is fixedly connected with the trunk assembly, and the storage bin is provided with a storage space which can be used for placing articles; the foot assembly is movably connected with the trunk assembly, the foot assembly comprises at least two feet arranged at intervals, and the at least two feet move so that the foot type robot can move; and the mechanical arm and the storage bin are arranged on the trunk assembly in a spaced mode, and the mechanical arm can move relative to the storage bin so as to move the objects out of the storage bin or put the objects into the storage bin. The function of conveying the articles is achieved through the foot type robot, the articles can enter and exit from the storage bin through the mechanical arm, and the convenience of article conveying can be improved.
title: Foot type robot and control method of foot type robot

abstract: The invention discloses a novel semi-passive quadruped robot turning structure and a control method thereof. The novel semi-passive quadruped robot turning structure comprises a walking mechanism, a steering device, a driving device, a data collecting device and a main control device, wherein the driving device is used for driving a quadruped robot to walk; the data collecting device is used for collecting walking data; and the main control device is used for providing a real-time walking scheme to the walking mechanism. The walking mechanism comprises a leg part and a hip part, wherein the leg part comprises two internal side legs and two external side legs; the left parts and the right parts of the two internal side legs and the two external side legs are completely symmetric. According to the invention, through exerting the main control device to transmit a command, the driving device provides power to the walking mechanism of the quadruped robot so as to drive the two legs on the left to alternately move forwards (backwards), drive the two legs on the right to alternately move backwards (forwards) and ensure that the left leg and the right leg on the two sides to rise or fall at the same time in the process; therefore, the quadruped robot turns in place. The invention has the advantages of simple structure, simple operation, stable walking and energy-saving property and can be widely applied to the field of rescue, toys, medical treatment and the like.
title: Novel semi-passive quadruped robot turning structure and control method thereof

abstract: A system and method is disclosed for controlling a robot having at least two legs that is falling down from an upright posture. An allowable stepping zone where the robot is able to step while falling is determined. The allowable stepping zone may be determined based on leg Jacobians of the robot and maximum joint velocities of the robot. A stepping location within the allowable stepping zone for avoiding an object is determined. The determined stepping location maximizes an avoidance angle comprising an angle formed by the object to be avoided, a center of pressure of the robot upon stepping to the stepping location, and a reference point of the robot upon stepping to the stepping location. The reference point, which may be a capture point of the robot, indicates the direction of fall of the robot. The robot is controlled to take a step toward the stepping location.
title: Intelligent stepping for humanoid fall direction change

abstract: A method for controlling walking of a robot includes: determining a stance of the robot, in response to the robot being in a single-leg stance, determining a rotational angle of each of the joints, and calculating a value of a torque produced by a force of gravity acting on the robot about each of the joints; in response to the robot being in a double-leg stance, calculating a position of a projection of a center of mass of the robot on a surface where the robot stands, and calculating a value of a torque produced by a force of gravity acting on the robot about each of the joints according to the position of the projection; obtaining a feed-forward current of each of the joints; and applying the feed-forward current of each of the joints to a corresponding actuator of this joints.
title: Method for controlling walking of robot and robot

abstract: The invention provides a wheel-legged robot, and relates to the technical field of robotics.The wheel-legged robot comprises a thoracic cavity body, two leg assemblies symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the thoracic cavity body and driving wheel assemblies arranged on the leg assemblies, and each leg assembly comprises a thigh connecting rod, a shank connecting rod, an energy storage spring, an auxiliary connecting rod, an auxiliary rolling wheel and a leg driving part; the leg driving part is arranged on the chest body, one end of the thigh connecting rod is arranged at the driving end of the leg driving part, the other end of the thigh connecting rod is rotationally connected with the shank connecting rod, and the driving wheel assembly is arranged at the end, away from the thigh connecting rod, of the shank connecting rod. The auxiliary rolling wheel is arranged at the end, away from the driving wheel assembly, of the shank connecting rod. And through the auxiliary rolling wheels arranged on the shank connecting rods, four-wheel movement can be formed, and therefore the movement speed and the overall stability of the wheel-legged robot are improved.
title: Wheel-legged robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a robot control system and a controlling method thereof, which can variably control the length of a joint frame of a multi-joint multi-leg robot. When changing the joints of a robot from two legs to four legs or from four legs to two legs, the robot varies the length of a joint in order to correspond to the operation for performing natural operation, by comprising: an actuator which is installed in a part where the weight of a joint is great; and a motion motor which variably regulates the length of a joint frame. The robot control system supplies power to the actuator and the motion motor, and controls the actuator and the motion motor to operate or move depending on a command through data communications. The robot control system can perform control for natural operation by varying the length of a joint in order to correspond to the operation when changing the joints of a robot from two legs to four legs or from four legs to two legs. [Reference numerals] (110) Control unit; (120) Sensor unit; (122) Distance sensor; (124) Motion sensor; (130) Dynamic cell motor; (140) RC motor; (150) Joint frame; (2) Robot; (70) Operator; (80) Computer; (82) Touching program
title: ROBOT CONTROL SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING THEREOF

abstract: The invention discloses a wheel-legged robot with multiple walking modes. The wheel-legged robot with the multiple walking modes comprises four wheel-leg devices distributed on the front, back, left and right, and the four wheel-leg devices are connected to a same machine body. The wheel-leg devices are connected with the machine body in a hinged mode, the wheel-leg devices arranged on the two sides are symmetrically arranged, and space which accommodates the two front wheel-leg devices is arranged between the two back wheel-leg devices. The machine body is of a foldable structure to shorten the wheelbase between the front and back wheel-leg devices through folding of the machine body. The machine body is further connected with a deformation driving device for folding and unfolding. Preferably, the deformation driving device is of a crank-connecting-rod structure, and two dead-point states of the crank-connecting-rod are used to realize locking of the two states of the machine body. The invention has the beneficial effects that the mutual switching among the four-footed movement, two-footed movement and wheel movement is achieved by folding and deformation of the machine body, so that the robot has high movement ability and good adaptability to complex terrains, can conveniently pass through the terrains, such as steps and ravines, has superior mobility on the flat road surface, and the adaptive capacity to environment is high.
title: Wheel-legged robot with multiple walking modes

abstract: The invention provides a pond-skater imitating piezoelectric actuation type ultramicro wing-flapping amphibious robot. The robot comprises two wings, two longitudinal frameworks, two lateral panels, a piezoelectric actuator, a wing fixing piece, a piezoelectric actuator fixing piece and four high-elasticity leg supporting pieces, wherein the wing fixing piece comprises a passive hinge; every two leg supporting pieces are connected with and fixed to the corresponding lateral panel; two wings are connected and fixed through the wing fixing piece; the piezoelectric actuator is arranged along a central axis and connected and fixed through the piezoelectric actuator fixing piece; and the two lateral panels are separately connected with and fixed to the two longitudinal frameworks. The robot disclosed by the invention can fly in the air through the flapping of the wings, can keep balance on a water surface through the hydrophobic characteristic of the leg supporting pieces, and can move on the water surface through the flapping of the wings. The robot disclosed by the invention adopts a pond-skater type bionic structure, is low in size, light in weight and good in stability, can controllably move on the water surface and in the air, has amphibious characteristics, and can adapt to different environment.
title: Pond-skater imitating piezoelectric actuation type ultramicro wing-flapping amphibious robot

abstract: The invention relates to a reconstructable multi-legged robot which is formed by a plurality of leg units and connection plates. Any two leg units are connected through the corresponding connection plates to achieve multi-legged robots of different types. Regarding each leg unit of the reconstructable multi-legged robot, a single motor drives leg rods on the two sides to achieve the alternative walking action. When the reconstructable multi-legged robot walks, multiple leg rods support the robot on the ground at any moments so as to ensure the stability of the robot. Marching, retreating and turning of the robot are achieved by controlling the rotating speeds and rotating directions of the motors of different leg units. The reconstructable multi-legged robot is simple in structure, easy to control, and high in movement stability, adaptability to different environments and practical value in the fields of military, exploration, entertainment and the like.
title: Reconstructable multi-legged robot

abstract: The invention relates to a fire rescue exoskeleton robot which comprises a back assembly, two drivers, a heat dissipation assembly, a leg rod assembly and a joint assembly. The back assembly comprises a back frame, a back shell and a battery pack. The side, facing the back frame, of the back shell is a mounting face. A battery bin is formed between the back shell and the back frame. And the drivers are arranged on the mounting surface. The heat dissipation assembly comprises a cooling box, a heat pipe set and a driver heat dissipation plate. And a cold storage medium is accommodated in the cooling box. The two driver heat dissipation plates are both arranged on the installation face and attached to the sides, away from the back frame, of the drivers respectively. The heat pipe set comprises a plurality of heat pipes. One end of each heat pipe is connected to the cooling box, and the other end of each heat pipe is connected to any driver heat dissipation plate. And each driver radiating plate is at least connected with one heat pipe. The joint assembly comprises two joint motors and two waist rods. The leg rod assembly comprises two leg rods. The temperature of the driver can be limited within the working temperature range of the driver, and the robot can continuously work in the high-temperature environment.
title: Fire rescue exoskeleton robot

abstract: An intelligent man of a simulation man is composed of a double-leg walking system, a double-hand execution system, a head movement system, a heat dissipation protection system and other intelligent systems; and the double-leg walking system is composed of a four-area clutch, an electric pusher, a crankshaft wheel, an intelligent controller, a control motor, a driving motor, a stooping and waist raising mechanism, a turning movement mechanism, a squatting and body raising mechanism, a side push-pull leg mechanism, thighs, calves and feet and other chain opening mechanisms. The double-hand execution system is composed of an arm swinging mechanism, an arm lifting mechanism, a side arm swinging mechanism, a side arm pulling mechanism, an arm rotating mechanism, a hand lifting mechanism, a handrotating mechanism, a hand waving mechanism, a finger pulling mechanism, various controllers and other chain opening mechanisms. The head movement system is composed of a head-up mechanism, a left rotating head mechanism, a right rotating head mechanism, a mouth opening mechanism, an eye turning mechanism, an eyelid pulling mechanism, a smiling mechanism and other chain opening mechanism. The heat dissipation protection system is composed of a pump gear, a piston rod, a piston pump, a flow direction intelligent controller, a corrugated pipe, a spraying pipe, a flow divider, a filter, a heat dissipation exoskeleton, a movable exoskeleton and the like. The intelligent man is suitable for executing tasks in military, civilian, industrial, battlefield, fire scene, water, space, planet and other environments, and the country can quickly enter the intelligent era.
title: Intelligent robot

abstract: The invention discloses a gait generation and optimization method for a biped robot. The method is characterized in that a gait library of the biped robot is constructed in a finite state machine according to a target pose of the state of the biped robot; mutual switching conditions among all states of the robot are set and triggered; in each state switching process, a joint cubic interpolation method is used for planning the movement track of support legs, and a gauss pseudo-spectral method is used for optimizing the movement track of swing legs; and finally, the gait of the biped robot in different motion modes is generated by the finite state machine. According to the gait generation and optimization method for the biped robot, the constraint of ZMP is not considered, and all the bipedrobots with or without the sole edges of the feet can generate the walking track by the method; and the planning process is simple and operable and is more suitable for online generation, and the biped walking robot can stably walk and finish walking, running, jumping and other actions by matching with a simple control strategy.
title: Gait generation and optimization method for biped robot

abstract: A double-leg and double-wheel composite motion robot comprises a trunk part, two mechanical legs and two mechanical arms, wherein the trunk part comprises a trunk and a crotch, the trunk and the crotch are connected through a rotary joint, and a trunk-crotch hydraulic cylinder is connected between the trunk and the crotch; the two mechanical legs are arranged on the two sides of the crotch, each mechanical leg is connected with the crotch through a rotary joint, and a driving wheel is installed at the bottom end of each mechanical leg; and the two mechanical arms are arranged on the two sidesof the trunk and connected with the trunk through rotary joints. The robot has the vertical walking and jumping capacity of a biped robot and the high moving speed of a wheeled robot. Meanwhile, the mechanical arms can achieve the functions of grabbing, carrying and the like; when the robot walks on a flat road surface, the robot can be driven by the driving wheels to move, the advancing speed isincreased, and the energy utilization efficiency is improved; when the robot needs to cross obstacles, the robot can play the advantages of a biped motion mode, and the functions of jumping, squatting, landing buffering and the like are achieved.
title: Double-leg and double-wheel composite motion robot

abstract: The invention relates to an exoskeleton manpower driving device, which is an exoskeleton driving device for converting pushing and pulling forces of two arms and two hands into auxiliary forces for driving two legs to walk by utilizing two handles and two sets of mechanical transmission mechanisms, and adopts a pulley structure, a gear structure or a connecting rod structure for transmission. Therefore, the design effects of being simple in structure, light in weight, low in development and manufacturing cost and free of noise are achieved, the pushing force and the pushing speed of walking of the lower limbs can be freely controlled by a wearer through the two hands according to the advancing speed of the two legs, and the walking speed of the lower limbs can be freely controlled. In the walking process, the common idle strength of the two arms is used for pushing the two legs to walk, so that the exercise load of the two legs can be reduced in the mountaineering, stair climbing and walking processes, the two legs and the two arms achieve synchronous and coordinated exercise from the angle of fitness, and then balanced development of the strength of the four limbs of the human body can be promoted.
title: Exoskeleton manpower driving device

abstract: The invention discloses a gecko-imitating glass cleaning robot and a glass cleaning method. The robot comprises a body, a front working part and a rear working part, the front working part and the rear working part are symmetrically installed at the two ends of the body, the structures of the front working part and the rear working part are the same, the front working part comprises a front bent plate, a wiping structure, a bionic palm and two leg structures symmetrically installed on the wiping structure, and the wiping structure and the two leg structures are both installed on the front bentplate; the robot can replace human beings to complete a glass cleaning task in a high-altitude dangerous environment. The body adopts an elastic metal sheet, the structure is simple, the robot is lighter and more flexible by adopting an adsorption type instead of an air pressure type bionic palm, and a wiping mechanism and a gecko-imitating robot are combined, so that the robot can be applied toa glass cleaning task in a high-altitude dangerous environment.
title: Gecko-imitating glass cleaning robot and glass cleaning method

abstract: The invention discloses a human motion intention recognition method for a load maneuvering exoskeleton and an exoskeleton system. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, acquiring a foot GCF signal and an IMU signal through a sensing system of the exoskeleton; then, through periodical judgment of signal characteristics, classifying sitting postures and standing into non-periodical activities, and classifying running, walking and going up and down stairs into periodical activities; for non-periodic activities, calculating knee joint angles of two legs according to IMU signals, and distinguishing the sitting posture and standing according to the fact that the knee joint angles of the two legs in the sitting posture are larger than those of the two legs in the standing posture; for periodic activities, judging whether both feet are supported or not according to foot GCF signals so as to distinguish running and other activities, and then adopting a fuzzy inference system to recognize walking states of walking, going upstairs or going downstairs according to knee joint angles at heel impact or toe impact moments in the foot GCF signals. The human body motion intention can be smoothly and continuously recognized.
title: Load maneuvering exoskeleton human motion intention recognition method and exoskeleton system

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a three-motor companion robot. The three-motor companion robot comprises a robot body, a head device, foot devices and hand devices, wherein the head device, the foot devices and the hand devices are arranged on the robot body. Each foot device comprises a shell, a power supply structure which is arranged inside the shell, a first driving structure which is arranged inside the shell and connected with the power supply structure, and a first obstacle avoidance structure which is arranged inside the shell. The robot body is internally provided with a second driving structure which is connected with the first driving structures and the head device. The robot is provided with three motors, the motors can be awakened through body induction, and the two feet and the head are controlled to move. The feet are provided with the obstacle avoidance structures, and therefore the three-motor companion robot achieves better obstacle avoidance capacity.
title: Three-motor companion robot

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of attendance machines, discloses an outdoor light-proof face recognition attendance machine, and solves the problems that an existing attendance machine is poor in barrier protection, and personal attendance data are wrong because staff pass by and are punched by two-dimensional scanning beyond the specified attendance time. Through a pressure button, a rotating rod, a pull rope, a sliding block, a spring, a sliding rod and a baffle plate, when an employee needing attendance punching stands on a placement area on a pedal by aligning two feet to apply certain gravity to the pressure button, the pressure button drives a motor to drive an electrically connected sensor; the motor drives the sliding block connected with the pull rope on the surface of the rotating rod to slide upwards, so that the sliding block can drive the baffle to slide from the front end of the display screen to the top of the display screen through the hinge, sunlight at the top is shielded, and the baffle does not block the display screen and the two-dimensional recognition head. Therefore, the staff just face the two-dimensional recognition head to carry out face recognition, and the face recognition efficiency is improved.
title: Outdoor light-proof face recognition attendance machine

abstract: The invention discloses a pneumatic artificial muscle biped walking control method and system based on imitation learning, and the method comprises the steps: firstly collecting the walking posture data of a human body, and generating an expert track based on a Mujoo simulation platform; then training a strategy model by using an imitation learning algorithm, deploying the strategy model to an embedded controller, sending an action instruction to a PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) based on an action strategy, analyzing the action instruction by the PLC, generating a PWM (Pulse-Width Modulation) signal, and controlling the inflating and deflating time sequence of the lower limb pneumatic artificial muscle group; finally, lower limb joint angle and air pressure data are fed back in real time through a sensor, the PWM duty ratio is adjusted in a closed-loop mode, and the walking posture is optimized. The simulation learning algorithm and pneumatic artificial muscle driving are combined, the human walking mode is mapped, more natural and more stable bionic walking is achieved, and meanwhile the integration level and expandability of the system are improved. A PWM dynamic air pressure distribution mode is adopted, redundant energy loss is reduced, and the response speed and the control precision of the system are improved.
title: Pneumatic artificial muscle biped walking control method and system based on imitation learning

abstract: The invention discloses a walking method of a strawberry picking robot of which the stability is better. A system for realizing the walking method comprises a six-leg strawberry picking robot; six legs are respectively and symmetrically arranged on the left side and the right side of the six-leg strawberry picking robot, and each leg is provided with a hip joint and a knee joint; three legs on theleft side are tagged as a number one leg, a number three leg and a number five leg from front to back, and three legs on the right side are tagged as a number two leg, a number four leg and a numbersix leg from front to back; and the six legs of the six-leg strawberry picking robot are divided into two sets, wherein the first set of the legs includes the number one leg, the number four leg and the number five leg, and the second set of the legs includes the number two leg, the number three leg and the number six leg. The six-leg strawberry picking robot disclosed by the invention has a linear gait and a turning gait during walking.
title: Walking method of six-leg strawberry picking robot

abstract: A bipedal robot where the legs are configured such that extraneous movement during bipedal motion is constrained to one plane. In particular, the extraneous movement is constrained to the sagittal plane of the robot. The robot has an upper body and a pair of legs. The upper body has a sagittal plane and a coronal plane where the sagittal plane and the coronal plane are substantially perpendicular. Each of the pair of legs includes an upper portion and a lower portion. Hip joints and connected at opposing ends of the upper body along the sagittal plane and have one degree of freedom around an axis parallel to the coronal plane. One end of the upper portion of each leg connects to a hip joint. A knee joint in each leg has one degree of freedom around an axis parallel to the coronal plane connects to the second end of the upper portion of the leg and to one end of each of the at least one lower portions. A foot then connects to the second end of the at least one lower portions of each leg.
title: NON-ANTHROPOMORPHIC BIPEDAL ROBOTIC SYSTEM

abstract: The invention provides a large robot swing part convenient to dismount and with a rotatable body. The large robot swing part is characterized in that the head (2) is movably connected to the top of the body (1), the lower portion of the body (1) is movably connected to the lower body (3) through a rotary shaft (9), the lower portion of the lower body (3) is connected with two legs (4), the upper portions of two sides of the body (1) are movably connected with arms (5) through shoulders (8), the arms (5) are connected with front arms through movable elbow joints (6), and the front arms are connected with hands through movable wrists (7). The large robot swing part has the advantages that by the adoption of the technical scheme, a robot can be convenient to dismount and move and easy to install and can be formed only by mutually inserting the head, the body, the lower body, the legs and the arms. In addition, the head, the body, the arms and the like of the robot are rotatable, and the robot is life-like and cool in appearance and is attractive for children.
title: Large robot swing part convenient to dismount and with rotatable body

abstract: A robot, such as a bipedal robot, that includes three or more rigid links such as two legs and a pelvis. The robot includes joints pivotally connecting pairs of the rigid links and an actuator associated with each of the joints. The robot includes a universal balancing controller with an output feedback control module providing control signals to selectively drive the actuators to balance the robot on a support element which may be configured to provide a dynamic, unstable environment or to provide a static, stable environment. During use, the control signals are generated in response to processing of global robot data from sensors associated with the rigid links or the joints. The control signals are generated by the output feedback control module without any need for measurements of the support element or without any measurement of a dynamic environment.
title: Universal balancing controller for lateral stabilization of bipedal robots in dynamic unstable environments

abstract: A two-leg walking moving device comprising join-use drive motors for respectively swinging leg-swinging joints (15L, 15R) of the waist, rolling-direction joints (16L, 16R) of the waist, pitch-direction joints (17L, 17R) of the waist, pitch-direction joints (18L, 18R) of knees (12L, 12R), pitch-direction joints (19L, 19R) of ankles with respect to feet (14L, 14R), and roll-direction joints (20L, 20R) of ankles, and a walking control device (30) for producing gait data at a gait generation unit (31) in response to a motion command and drive-controlling respective drive motors at a control unit (32) based on this gait data, wherein the gait generation unit (31) detects a robot's attitude based on sensor information from an angle detection sensor (24) for detecting the walking conditions of respective joints and from ZMP detection sensors (23L, 23R) for detecting ZMP at each foot, produces in real time angle command values as final gait data from a target value by a motion command and the current values of sensor information based on this attitude, acquires environmental information for each walk, and controls a walk in real time according to this environmental information.
title: TWO-LEG WALKING MOVING DEVICE

abstract: A thrust generation mechanism in a foot of a biped walking robot is provided to improve the walking speed and posture and adaptability to the ground surface of the robot. A thrust generation mechanism in a foot of a biped walking robot comprises a pneumatic cylinder(12) provided between the heel and ankle of the robot foot, and two servo motors(15) generating propulsion torque for the foot. The robot makes instantaneous linear motion by a pair of pneumatic cylinder structure as the foot generates propulsion force against the ground surface.
title: THE MECHANISM OF GENERATING PUSHING UP FORCE IN THE FOOT OF THE BIPED ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses a redundant drive crawler leg robot based on a multi-stage parallel folding and unfolding parasitic mechanism. The redundant drive crawler leg robot comprises a robot body. The two leg mechanisms are distributed on the two sides of the machine body and are used for supporting the machine body; each leg mechanism comprises a connecting assembly, a folding and unfolding leg and a driving assembly; the upper ends of the crawler feet are connected with the driving assembly, the connecting assembly is arranged on the machine body, the upper ends of the folding and unfolding leg parts are connected with the connecting assembly, and the lower ends of the folding and unfolding leg parts are connected with the driving assembly. According to the redundant drive crawler leg robot, redundant drive is provided, the spaces on the two sides of the upper ends of crawler feet are effectively utilized, the design is more compact, and therefore the problem that a large-power motor is large in size is effectively solved, the leg structure adopts the design of a multi-stage parallel folding and unfolding parasitic mechanism, the large movement range of a series mechanism can be achieved, and the reliability is high. The mechanism has the advantages of high strength, high motion precision and high effective load of a parallel mechanism, and has the advantages of a series mechanism and the parallel mechanism at the same time.
title: Redundant drive crawler leg robot based on multi-stage parallel folding and unfolding parasitic mechanism

abstract: A system for controlling locomotion of a biped walking robot. The system is constituted to carry out feedback control for eliminating the deviation between the target value and the detected angle of inclination of the linkage mechanism in the absolute coordinate system, stable dynamic walking can be ensured at all times even during locomotion over rough terrain. In the stability control, the number of joints with respect to which control is conducted is reduced to the minimum required and control is conducted separately but in coordination with respect to the movement or motion in the pitch direction and the movement or motion in the roll direction, while the remaining joints are subjected locally. Thus, the control is considerably simplified. In addition, feedback control is conducted with respect to the velocity components so as to realize the desired posture angles and the feedback gain adjusted so as to achieve the response speed required by the individual linkages. This further enhances the capability of the robot to walk stably at high speed. <IMAGE>
title: System for controlling locomotion of legged walking robot.

abstract: The present invention relates to a method for manufacturing a baby album using a camera device, which comprises: a first step of receiving audio data, and storing and managing the same in a specific storage area; a second step of recognizing a designated feature point of a designated part; a third step of recognizing at least one baby motion; a fourth step of extracting source data; a fifth step of storing the extracted source data and event information in a designated operation D/B in association with each other; a sixth step of providing a combination of the source data and the event information; and a seventh step of receiving album data, and storing the same in the designated operation D/B. Therefore, an album can be manufactured through an application of a wireless terminal by separately storing a video or a photo or sound for a predetermined time corresponding to a predetermined event (e.g. speaking of a mom/dad, flipping, standing on two feet, etc.) or a predetermined date (e.g. a birthday and the like).
title: Method for Making Baby Album by Using Camera Device

abstract: The invention provides a parallel leg structure for a bionic robot and the bionic robot. The parallel leg structure comprises an outward swing motor, a U-shaped frame, a leg rod assembly and two leg rod motors. The outward swing motor is used for being fixed to a robot body of the robot, and the output end of the outward swing motor is fixedly connected with the end of the U-shaped frame. Shells of the two leg rod motors are fixed to two side arms of the U-shaped frame respectively, and output shafts of the two leg rod motors are coaxially arranged. The leg rod assembly comprises a first leg rod, a second leg rod, an ankle joint, a foot, two thigh power arms and two knee joints, wherein the two knee joints are located on the two sides of the axes of the output shafts of the leg rod motorsrespectively, the first ends of the two thigh power arms are fixedly connected with the output ends of the two leg rod motors respectively, and the second ends of the two thigh power arms are connected with the first end of the first leg rod and the first end of the second leg rod through the knee joints respectively. The leg rod assembly of the parallel leg structure can rotate in the vertical plane, so that the robot has multiple motion modes.
title: Parallel leg structure for bionic robot and bionic robot

abstract: The present application addresses the problem of providing a moving device that can accommodate a difference in speed between a boarding location (F1) and a step (Q) of an escalator (E), or between an alighting location (F2) and the step (Q) of the escalator (E), and that can board and alight from the escalator (E) while an object (X) being moved is loaded on the moving device.
