The moving device according to the present invention moves while an object (X) being moved is loaded thereon, the moving device comprising two leg parts (10) each having an end-section wheel (14) and an intermediate wheel (13), a loading part (20) supported by the two leg parts (10), and a control unit (30) that controls the two leg parts (10), and the wheel speed of the end-section wheels (14) being controlled by the control unit (30) when the end-section wheels (14) have moved from a boarding location (F1) of an escalator (E) to a step (Q) thereof, and/or when the end-section wheels (14) have moved from the step (Q) of the escalator (E) to an alighting location (F2) thereof, in a state of four-wheel ground contact in which the end-section wheels (14) and intermediate wheels (13) are in contact with the ground.
title: MOVING DEVICE

abstract: The invention discloses a flexible driving hip joint for a semi-passive biped robot. The flexible driving hip joint comprises an angular bisector mechanism and a hip joint flexible driving mechanism; and a hip bracket is fixedly arranged at the middle part of a shaft through a locating pin, thus forming a rack main body part of the flexible driving hip joint. The angular bisector mechanism comprises first connecting pieces, first connecting rods, a second connecting rod and sleeves, is a connecting rod mechanism, is simple in structure and works reliably. The hip joint flexible driving mechanism is distributed in a bilaterally symmetric manner, and is powered by a right side steering engine and a left side steering engine; during working, the right side steering engine and the left side steering engine rotate at equal speeds and in the opposite directions all the time, and with the combination of the use of the angular bisector mechanism, a gait of biped walking can be simulated very well; and the driving of the right side steering engine and the driving the left side steering engine are transferred by tension springs, so that the problems like inertia impact arising from rigid driving are solved, the stability is brought to a system, and the natural mechanical properties of the flexible driving hip joint can be reflected better.
title: Flexible driving hip joint for semi-passive biped robot

abstract: The invention relates to a high-low pressure switching type hydraulic mechanical leg with a robot and a load port independently controlled, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The mechanicalleg comprises two adjacent leg rods, a control actuator and a hydraulic cylinder used for driving the two leg rods to swing relatively, the control actuator comprises a high-pressure end valve, a first low-pressure end valve and a second low-pressure end valve which are three-position three-way valves, one of double pipe joints of the high-pressure end valve communicates with an inlet of an oil tank, and the other one of the double pipe joints communicates with a high-pressure hydraulic source; one of double pipe joints of the first low-pressure end valve communicates with a low-pressure hydraulic source, the other one of the double pipe joints communicates with the oil tank and a single pipe joint of the first low-pressure end valve and a single pipe joint of the high-pressure end valveare communicated with a rodless oil cavity connector through a three-way pipe structure; and one of double pipe joints of the second low-pressure end valve communicates with the low-pressure hydraulicsource, the other one of double pipe joints communicates with the oil tank, and a single pipe joint of the second low-pressure end valve communicates with a rod oil cavity connector. The structure can effectively improve the energy utilization rate of a robot system and can be widely applied to the technical field of multi-legged robots and the like.
title: High-low pressure switching type hydraulic mechanical leg with robot and load port independently controlled

abstract: The multi-legged skating robot comprises a robot body, a first supporting leg, a second supporting leg and a skating plate, the first end of the first supporting leg is rotationally connected with the robot body, the first end of the second supporting leg is rotationally connected with the robot body, and the second ends, arranged on the same side, of the first supporting leg and the second supporting leg are rotationally connected with the skating plate. And a first ice skate blade is also mounted at the bottom of the skating plate. The gravity center of the multi-legged robot body is always kept between the two skating plates, the gravity center is low, stability is high, and guarantee is provided for rapid skating; by means of the rotary connection design, the first supporting leg and the second supporting leg which are arranged on the same side are connected to one ice skating plate, the ice skating plates can achieve actions needed during ice skating by driving the driving mechanisms on the two legs, meanwhile, due to the fact that one ice skating plate is controlled by the first supporting leg and the second supporting leg which are arranged on the same side, the ice skating effect is improved, and the service life of the ice skating plate is prolonged. And enough force can be provided for driving the skating plate to realize loads required by various angle changes.
title: Skating multi-legged robot

abstract: The invention aims to provide a wall-climbing robot based on electrostatic adsorption, which comprises a middle electrostatic chuck and electrostatic chucks, namely a left electrostatic chuck and a right electrostatic chuck, positioned on two sides of the middle electrostatic chuck, the motion mode of the gait of the two feet is achieved through transmission of the motor and the worm and gear, meanwhile, the steering engine is used as a switch to control adsorption and desorption of the electrostatic chuck, cooperative control over the driving motor, the control steering engine and the boosting module is achieved through an integrated circuit board, and seamless switching of adsorption force of the two feet can be achieved.
title: Wall climbing robot based on electrostatic adsorption

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical treatment, in particular to a flexible exoskeleton for assisting movement of hip joints and knee joints, which comprises a waist controller, two ends of the waist controller are connected with waist ropes, and the two waist ropes bypass the waist and are detachably connected and fastened. Two leg fasteners used for binding thighs are arranged below the waist controller, and the two ends of the waist controller are matched with the two leg fasteners respectively; the two leg fasteners are used for binding the thighs of a user, then the waist controller is bound to the waist of the user through the two waist ropes, meanwhile, it is ensured that the waist controller is located at the front end of the waist controller, and the two ends of the waist controller are connected and matched with the leg fasteners correspondingly; therefore, the movement of the legs is controlled through the waist controller, and the user can be assisted to walk and lift the legs.
title: Flexible exoskeleton for assisting movement of hip joint and knee joint

abstract: A biped walking robot and system for controlling the robot. The system provides smooth posture control by eliminating interference arising between the frictional force of the ground acting on the legs of the robot and the driving force of the leg joints. A six-dimensional force and torque sensor (26) is provided to detect six force or moment components and based thereon, an angular command to joint motors is corrected. Joint structures of the robot are described, wherein the axes of the drive joints are arranged at right-angles to one another to thereby enable accurate positional control to be effected using Cartesian coordinates.
title: Legged walking robot and system for controlling the same.

abstract: A servo system for controlling locomotion of a biped walking robot, made up of a body link and two leg linkages each connected to the body link by a first drive joint and each including knee and ankle joints, to follow up a target angle for each drive joint predetermined in series with respect to time such that the robot walks. In order to stabilize robot posture when it could turn over, the drive speed of the joints are feedback controlled in responsive with the robot turnover probability. Moreover, the predetermined robot gait is modified at such instance, for example, in such a manner that robot leg lands one of additionally preestablished candidate positions for robot leg landing. <IMAGE>
title: System for controlling locomotion of legged walking robot

abstract: The invention discloses a splicable five-connecting-rod double-arm wheel-foot robot and a splicing method, and belongs to the technical field of robotics.The robot comprises a robot body, two leg parts symmetrically installed on the two sides of the robot body and two mechanical arms symmetrically installed at the front end of the robot body; the top ends of the thigh front arm and the thigh rear arm of each leg are connected with output shafts of a front hip joint motor and a rear hip joint motor which are installed on one side of the robot body respectively, the top end of the shank front arm is rotationally connected with the bottom end of the thigh front arm, and the top end of the shank rear arm is rotationally connected with the bottom end of the thigh rear arm. A driving wheel and a hub motor for driving the driving wheel to rotate are arranged between the foot ends of the front shank arm and the rear shank arm; two electromagnets and electronic switches for controlling on-off of currents of the two electromagnets are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the rear end of the machine body, butt joint grooves are symmetrically formed in the two sides of the rear end of the machine body, and adsorption iron is arranged on the two mechanical arms. The robot can keep high load capacity at the same time, and expected work can be completed in different scenes.
title: Splicing five-connecting-rod double-arm wheel-foot robot and splicing method

abstract: A bipedal robot having five degree of freedom leg assemblies is disclosed. The example leg assemblies each have a hip joint; a thigh link assembly rotatably coupled to the hip joint; and a knee joint coupled to the thigh link assembly. A calf link assembly is rotatably coupled to the knee joint. An ankle joint is coupled to the calf link assembly. A set of actuators is configured to control movement of the leg assembly. At least some of the actuators are positioned near the hip joint to concentrate mass of the leg assembly proximate to the hip joint. A transmission system is configured to transmit force from at least one of the actuators to either the knee joint or the ankle joint of the leg assembly.
title: A BIPEDAL ROBOT FOR DYNAMIC AND ROBUST LOCATION IN DIVERSE ENVIRONMENTS

abstract: The robot for movement on a smooth surface has a rectangular chassis (1) with four feet (3) having suction cups at the corners, and two rollers (4) in the middles of the longer sides. When two feet on the same diagonal are raised, the others are in contact with the suction cups operative. The cups in contact are moved rearwardly to move the robot forward and released as the other pair engage.
title: Robot, for movement on smooth surfaces, has suction cup feet to allow engagement with surface in pairs for forward movement

abstract: The invention relates to a multi-mode two-foot walking mechanism. The multi-mode two-foot walking mechanism comprises a support platform and two feet, each foot is a planar four-link mechanism, the two feet are arranged on the two opposite sides of the support platform correspondingly, the feet are connected with the support platform through links, one ends of the links are pivoted with the support platform through first rotating pairs, the other ends of the links are pivoted with the feet through second rotating pairs, each planar four-link mechanism is formed by connecting the correspondingfour links in a pivoting mode through a plurality of third rotating pairs, and the first rotating pairs, the second rotating pairs and the at least one third rotating pair are driven by independent driving pieces. According to the mechanism, the structure is symmetrical, the planar four-link mechanisms are used as the two feet, the deformation characteristics of the planar four-link mechanisms areutilized, and the time division control of each steering engine is achieved through the control circuit board, so that multiple modes such as width-changing direct moving, lateral walking, steering are achieved, the adaptability is good, and the mechanism extremely has the application prospect.
title: Multi-mode two-foot walking mechanism

abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and device for controlling a foot type robot, the foot type robot, equipment for controlling the foot type robot and a non-volatile computer readable storage medium. The present invention relates to a method for controlling a legged robot, the legged robot comprising a base and at least two mechanical legs, each mechanical leg comprising at least one joint, the method comprising: in response to determining that the legged robot falls into contact with a plane, determining a first desired trajectory and a second desired trajectory corresponding to the legged robot, the first desired trajectory indicating a desired trajectory of a centroid of the legged robot; the second expected track indicates an expected track of one end, far away from the base, of each mechanical leg; and based on a kinetic model corresponding to the foot type robot, the first expected track and the second expected track, controlling the action of each joint after the foot type robot is in contact with the plane. According to the embodiment of the invention, a good anti-impact protection effect is formed on the foot type robot while the landing function is ensured.
title: Method and device for controlling foot type robot and foot type robot

abstract: The present invention relates to an exoskeleton posture harness (1) comprising an upper part (2) configured to be held on the shoulders of an operator, the upper part (2) being connected to at least a dorsal structure (3) which extends along a longitudinal axis (X-X) of a sagittal plane (A), the dorsal structure (3) being elastically deformable and/or mobile at least along its longitudinal axis (X-X), the dorsal structure (3) being connected respectively to two leg fasteners (5), via an elastically deformable leg structure (4), the leg structure (4) being mobile between an engaged position and a disengaged position, in the disengaged position the elastic nature of the leg structure (4) being deactivated. The invention also relates to an exoskeleton incorporating the posture harness (1).
title: EXOSKELETON POSTURE HARNESS

abstract: Each of two legs of a walking toy robot comprises an external part 9, moved by a motor-driven crank 19 (or 19a-180 DEG out of phase) and guided by a slot 12 receiving a pin 5, and an internal part 7, pivotal about pin 5 and located in a hole 13 formed in part 9. A rolling part 8 at the foot of part 7 alternately projects from and is received within recess 14 of part 9. When rolling part 8 is within recess 14, surfaces 10a of part 9 contact the surface over which the toy moves. A coupling 22, 3 causes swinging of arms 6. <IMAGE>
title: Legs for a walking robot toy

abstract: The invention discloses a wearable body weight support type walking aiding device. Through the addition of a chair and shoe part, the wearing and the fixation of the device are facilitated; meanwhile,through the structural design between the two legs, the space occupation can be reduced; the walking convenience can be realized; a motor is used for driving a gear; the bending and the extending ofa leg connecting rod are driven; a chair is further lifted so as to support the partial body weight; the burden of the leg muscle and joints during walking can be reduced; a Teflon rope and a spring device are arranged inside a calf connecting rod; the shinbone outwards extending assistance force during the walking is provided; the walking efficiency is improved; through the human body exercise and physical parameters obtained by a gyroscope and a foot sole force sensor, the exercise intention of the user is detected; the natural walking effect is achieved. In addition, the communication connection is built between an embedded control system and a mobile phone, so that the man-computer interaction and the real-time control on the robot can be better realized. The wearable body weight support type walking aiding device can be well applied to the wearable walking aiding device, can reduce the energy consumption during walking, can improve the comfort degree, and has great application values.
title: Wearable body weight support type walking aiding device

abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of the Internet of Things, and provides an abnormal user identity detection method, device and equipment based on the Internet of Things, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining video data, and extracting a first frame image and a tail frame image of a user in a walking period in the video data; calculating a first included angle between two legs in the human body joint points and a first intersection point corresponding to the first included angle, and calculating a first angular velocity according to the first included angle and the frame duration; calculating a second included angle between two arms in the human body joint points and a second intersection point corresponding to the second included angle, and calculating a second angular velocity according to the second included angle and the frame duration; and detecting whether the user in the video data is an abnormal user according to a preset parameter, the initial confidence coefficient, the first angular velocity, the second angular velocity, the first intersection point and the second intersection point. Due to the fact that data of multiple dimensions are adopted, gait recognition is not merely carried out based on the human body contour, and the recognition accuracy is high.
title: Method, device and equipment for detecting abnormal user identity based on Internet of Things

abstract: The walking robot is a mobile robot. The walking robot moves in a bipedal manner. The bipedal movement of the walking robot is autonomous. The walking robot is a programmed device that: 1) can move in a bipedal fashion; 2) pick up and put down objects; 3) performs optical data processing functions such as avoiding objects during motion or identifying objects to pick up and put down; 4) performs speech recognition functions such as receiving spoken instruction; and, 5) responds to spoken instruction in an audible manner using a spoken language. The walking robot comprises a torso, a plurality of legs, a plurality of arms, and a helmet. The plurality of legs, the plurality of arms, and the helmet is attached to the torso. Both the plurality of legs and plurality of arms both rotate in the coronal plane, sagittal plane and the transverse plane.
title: Walking robot

abstract: The machine has a machine body (2) carried by at least two legs (3A,3B). A first single or multiple leg has a first foot (4A,4B) movable in six degrees of freedom with respect to. the machine body. At least one of two single or multiple legs or of the attached feet spans an upwardly open supporting position with the grounded surface. Each leg is attached to the machine body so that the foot on the other leg can be placed at least partially in the first supporting surface on the floor, whereby during the transfer of load from one leg to the other the second surface spanned by the other leg or foot and the first supporting surface are at least partially covered.
title: Mobile machine or walking robot

abstract: The invention relates to an active and passive knee joint exoskeleton robot based on modularization, and belongs to the technical field of knee joint exoskeletons. Comprising a waist seal, two leg mechanisms, a detachable driving unit, a binding part and a lining. The waist seal is sleeved on the waist of a wearer; the two leg mechanisms are symmetrically and vertically installed below the waist belt and installed on the two legs of a wearer. The detachable driving unit is mounted on the side wall of the waist seal and one of the leg mechanisms; the binding parts are respectively sleeved on the thigh part, the knee part and the shank part of a wearer; the binding part is connected with the leg mechanism, so that the leg mechanism is fastened on the leg of a wearer; the linings are arranged on the binding inner wall of the thigh part of the wearer and the binding inner wall of the shank part of the wearer respectively and make contact with the thighs and the shanks of the wearer; the problems that an exoskeleton is single in function, a traditional knee joint power source dismounting structure is complex in installation, and a control sensing element is inconvenient to dismount are solved, and the function that a power source and a control sensor system are rapidly dismounted is achieved.
title: Modularization-based active and passive knee joint exoskeleton robot

abstract: The mechanical movement system comprises a platform 7 having three pairs of supportive legs 8 coupled at triangularly spaced-apart locations by three universal joints 9 each of which couples to one end of each of the two legs of a respective pair. The universal joints each have a bifurcated ball having two halves 23, 24 which provide mountings for the leg and are constrained for rotation about a common axis. The system also has a member having a complementary recess of spherical form within which the bifurcated ball is received so as to be rotatable about any axis. <IMAGE>
title: Mechanical manipulator

abstract: The invention relates to a transformation robot, which belongs to the technical field of robots, and is characterized in that the transformation robot consists of a movement mechanism, a transformation mechanism, an execution motor and a machine body, and can be switched among four feet, four wheels, two feet and two wheels. The movement mechanism is composed of four four-bar mechanisms and serves as limbs of the robot, and switching of a wheel type and a foot type of the movement mechanism is achieved through the four-bar mechanisms driven by an execution motor. The deformation mechanism is composed of five hinge mechanisms; standing and bending of the robot body are achieved in the mode that an execution motor drives a robot waist hinge mechanism to rotate and drives an execution motor connected with posterior limbs. The switching between four feet and two feet is realized by standing and bending over of the machine body; in addition, according to the robot, the limbs can transversely swing through hinge mechanisms installed between the limbs and the robot body, and therefore transverse movement of the robot is achieved. Switching of multiple motion modes can be achieved, and the motion flexibility and practicability of the robot are improved.
title: Transformation robot

abstract: The invention discloses a multi-mode double-mechanical-arm wheel-foot robot and a control method thereof. The multi-mode double-mechanical-arm wheel-foot robot comprises a robot body, two legs symmetrically installed on the two sides of the robot body and two mechanical arms symmetrically installed at the front end of the robot body. Each leg part comprises a thigh part, a shank part, an auxiliary wheel, a driving wheel, a hub motor, a thigh driving motor, a shank driving motor and a transmission assembly; when the wheel-foot robot is in a wheel-foot type motion state, the legs abut against the ground through the driving wheels, and foot type walking is achieved; when the wheel-foot robot is in a four-wheel type motion state, the legs abut against the ground through the driving wheels and the auxiliary wheels, and wheel type walking is achieved. The robot can be switched between a wheel-foot robot and a four-wheel robot and between the wheel-foot robot and a multi-foot robot, the inertia of the foot ends is reduced, the movement speed can be increased, and the energy utilization rate is increased.
title: Multi-mode double-mechanical-arm wheel-foot robot and control method thereof

abstract: The invention relates to a robust control method and device for an under-actuated double-leg supporting hydraulic power-assisted exoskeleton. The control method comprises the following steps: initializing a sampling period of the real-time controller; the motion states of the left leg foot and the right leg foot of the exoskeleton are judged; establishing a physical model of the exoskeleton and converting the physical model into a state equation; the back acting force is obtained, and reference displacement is obtained in an upper-layer controller; an expected driving torque is obtained in a middle-layer controller according to the reference displacement; the expected flow of the electro-hydraulic servo valve is obtained in a lower-layer controller according to the expected driving torque; generating a current signal according to the expected flow; according to the current signals, all joints of the exoskeleton are driven to rotate, and tracking motion of the exoskeleton is achieved. The human-computer interaction exoskeleton following motion model is established by integrating multiple factors, the closed-chain dynamics problem of the exoskeleton is effectively solved, the influence of various interferences and uncertainties on the exoskeleton following motion is eliminated to a great extent, and the robustness of exoskeleton control is enhanced.
title: Robust control method and device for under-actuated double-leg supporting hydraulic power-assisted exoskeleton

abstract: The present invention relates to systems and methods for self-learning of locomotion characteristic and speed during bipedal locomotion using sensor and GPS technology.
title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR SELF-LEARNING AND REFERENCE TUNING ACTIVITY MONITOR

abstract: The invention discloses a bipedal robot capable of quickly walking. The bipedal robot comprises a counterweight assembly, a linear motor, a motor shaft, a motor seat, a telescopic fixing rod, left and right connecting rods, left and right thighs, left and right crura and left and right rotary air cylinders, wherein the linear motor is used for driving the left and right connecting rods to swing so as to drive the thighs hinged to the motor seat to swing back and forth; the left and right rotary air cylinders are used for driving the left and right crura to swing according to the relative position between the motor shaft and the motor seat to enable the supporting legs of the robot to be longer than the swinging legs of the robot so as to enable the robot to walk. Compared with the prior art, the bipedal robot has the advantages that the thighs are simultaneously driven to swing through the linear motor only, so that coordinated movement is facilitated; the control is convenient and the control precision is high; the structure is simple and compact and the stability is good; quick movement can be realized and the walking efficiency is relatively high; the robot is especially suitable for occasions with quickness and stability requirements.
title: Bipedal robot capable of quickly walking

abstract: A robot design and control system including a procedural animation engine and a graphical animation editor that enable animators to author stylized walking gaits achievable by physical robotic characters, including bipedal robots of varying design. The animation engine generates dynamically feasible reference trajectories for omnidirectional walking given a desired walking velocity that may be input from a joystick or an artificial intelligence (AI) planner. This allows a legged robot to walk along an arbitrary path while expressing a custom animation “style,” e.g., a happy walk, a sneaky walk, or other manner of walking. The stylized walking motion or gait is generalized by the animation engine from a small number of animation samples that are defined at key walking velocities and tracked using a whole-body controller. The set of samples that are used as input to define a walking style is authored by an animator using the animation editor.
title: Procedural animation engine and editor for sample-based design of stylized walking gaits for bipedal robots

abstract: A servo system for controlling the locomotion of a biped walking robot (1), having a body link and two leg linkages (1, 12) each connected to the body link and each including knee joint (16) and ankle joint (18,20), connecting an upper link (27) and a lower link (28), to follow up a target angle for each drive joint predetermined in series with respect to time such that the robot walks. In order to cushion shock received at robot foot landing, moment generated at foot landing is detected and drive speed of the joints is feedback controlled in proportion to the detected moment so as to carry out a virtual compliance control on the robot foot. The gain of the feedback being variable in time over the footfall. <IMAGE>
title: System for controlling locomotion of legged walking robot

abstract: The invention discloses an exoskeleton device and a using method thereof.The exoskeleton device comprises a waist supporting structure and two leg supporting structures, the two leg supporting structures are arranged on the two opposite sides of the waist supporting structure respectively, and each leg supporting structure comprises a thigh supporting mechanism, a shank supporting mechanism and a moving mechanism; the thigh supporting mechanism is rotatably connected to the waist supporting structure, the shank supporting mechanism is connected to the thigh supporting mechanism through a first rotating motor, the first rotating motor can drive the shank supporting mechanism to rotate relative to the thigh supporting mechanism, the moving mechanism comprises a first supporting rod, a moving structure and a mechanism driving part, and the first supporting rod is hinged to the moving structure; the end, away from the moving structure, of the first supporting rod is hinged to the end, away from the shank supporting mechanism, of the thigh supporting mechanism, the end, away from the first supporting rod, of the moving structure is hinged to the end, away from the thigh supporting mechanism, of the shank supporting mechanism, and the mechanism driving part is in transmission connection with the moving structure.
title: Exoskeleton device and use method thereof

abstract: A biped walking robot control method is for master-slave control of walking of a biped walking robot. The biped walking robot control method includes a weight detection step of detecting weights applied to a ground respectively by a right leg and a left leg of an operator, a target ZMP calculation step of calculating a target ZMP when the biped walking robot produces weights having a ratio of the detected right leg weight and left leg weight, and a control step of controlling the biped walking robot in accordance with the calculated target ZMP.
title: Biped walking robot control method and biped walking robot control system

abstract: A locomotion control system of a biped walking robot having a body and two articulated legs including ankle joints and connected to the body. A mathematical model is predesigned to approximate the robot. The mathematical model is assumed to have ideal rigidity and based on the model target angles of the joints including the ankle joints are preestablished in advance. Robot joints are provided with servo motors and control values are determined on the basis of the target joint angles to drive the servo motors to follow the target joint angles. A sensor is provided to detect moment acting on the ankle joints or the legs. The detected moment is multiplied by a gain made up of the reciprocal number of the amount of rigidity of the ankle joints. And based on the product, the control value is corrected so as to compensate the deformation. As a result, the discrepancy between the model and the actual robot is compensated so that, not only the robot can walk more stably, but the freedom of possible compliance control can be increased. Moreover, the legs can have low weight and inertia so that the walking stability can be further enhanced.
title: Locomotion control system for legged mobile robot

abstract: The invention relates to a gear transmission halving upper body energy-saving passive moving device. The gear transmission halving upper body energy-saving passive walking device comprises an upper body, legs, a driving unit and a data acquisition unit and further comprises a hip, knees, a main control unit and a spring unit. The driving unit comprises a battery, a direct current motor and a servo motor. The upper body is directly connected to the hip of the robot. The hip is of a symmetrical structure and in connection with the upper body and both sides of the hip are connected to the legs respectively. The hip comprises partial leg connecting shafts, bearings, an absolute encoder connecting shaft and bevel gears. The bevel gears of the hip are of a triple-bevel-gear symmetrical structure and the two bevel gears in bilateral symmetry are connected to the legs through the partial leg connecting shafts respectively. The partial leg connecting shafts are connected to the bearings. The third bevel gear is directly connected to a transmission shaft of the motor. The gear transmission halving upper body energy-saving passive walking device is a bipedal walking device which is simple and compact in structure, ingenious in design and energy-saving.
title: Gear transmission halving upper body energy-saving passive walking device and control method thereof

abstract: The invention discloses a four-foot robot walking mechanism comprising linear joints. The four-foot robot walking mechanism comprises a robot trunk part, two pairs of leg mechanisms are arranged at the two sides of the robot trunk part, each pair of leg mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on the robot trunk part, and the leg mechanisms are connected with the robot trunk part through hip joints and connected with foot mechanisms; the leg mechanism comprises a leg body, and one linear joint is arranged in the leg body in a matched mode; each linear joint comprises a driving part and a driven part, wherein the driven part is connected with a transverse rotation power device through a connecting part, the driving part acts to drive the driven part to linearly move up and down so that the corresponding leg body can move up and down to achieve leg lifting, the transverse rotation power device drives the corresponding leg body to swing in the front and back direction, the transverse rotation power devices of each pair of leg mechanisms operate alternately, and the transverse rotation power devices of the two leg mechanisms at the same side operate alternately to drive the leg bodies to achieve four-foot gait walking.
title: Four-foot robot walking mechanism comprising linear joints

abstract: The invention discloses a mechanical structure of a three-dimensional human-simulate biped walking robot. The mechanical structure comprises a trunk, two hip joints arranged in symmetry, an angle bisection mechanism, an arm-thigh coupling mechanism, and leg mechanisms arranged in symmetry in sequence from top to bottom, wherein the leg mechanism at each side comprises a thigh, a knee joint, a shank, an ankle joint, and a vola in sequence from top to bottom, and the trunk is provided with a master control chip. According to the mechanical structure, based on related principle of passive mechanics, the human-simulation degree is high, the problems of low energy efficiency and stiff gait of the conventional robot are effectively solved, the robot can serve as exoskeleton to help the disabled to realize walking and serve as walking equipment in future wars, and the individual combat ability is improved. The invention also discloses a waking method for the mechanical structure of the three-dimensional human-simulated biped walking robot.
title: Mechanical structure of three-dimensional human-simulated biped walking robot and walking method

abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide technology to realize walking with a target stride in a robot walking in natural motion by passively moving an ankle joint of a supporting leg made free to rotate.

SOLUTION: This robot has more than two leg links having the ankle joints and connected to a trunk part free to oscillate by hip joints, freely oscillates the ankle joint of the grounding leg link, regulates the remaining joints in accordance with an angle of the ankle joint and changes the ankle joints made free to oscillate every time in exchanging the grounding leg. The robot advances by swinging out the idle leg in accordance with a cycle of stepping motion in the body side direction. The robot walks with the target stride by regulating inclination of the trunk part in accordance with the joint angle of the joint made free to oscillate and the cycle of the stepping motion.

COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI
title: ROBOT WALKING USING PASSIVE VARIATION OF JOINT ANGLE AND ITS CONTROLLING METHOD

abstract: The present invention relates to a method for moving a two-legged exoskeleton (1) receiving a human operator, the method comprising the implementation, by data processing means (11c) of the exoskeleton (1), of steps of: (a) obtaining a theoretical basic trajectory of the exoskeleton (1) corresponding to one step; (b) setting the parameters of the theoretical basic trajectory based on a single parameter so as to define the theoretical basic trajectory of the exoskeleton (1) as a virtual guide with a single degree of freedom; (c) in response to forced movements of the exoskeleton (1) made by the human operator, operating a controller defining the progression from an actual position of the exoskeleton (1) based on said single parameter by stimulating a spring-damper link between the exoskeleton (1) and the virtual guide so as to implement an actual basic trajectory close to the theoretical basic trajectory.
title: METHOD FOR MOVING AN EXOSKELETON

abstract: The invention provides a knee flexible exoskeleton device based on lightweight bidirectional driving assistance. The knee flexible exoskeleton device comprises a fixing module, a control module, a power module, a stretching module and a sensing module; the fixing module comprises a knapsack and a fixing hard plate, and the fixing hard plate is fixed in the knapsack; the control module and the power module are fixed on the fixed hard plate; the power module comprises a motor, a motor driving module and a power supply; the motor driving module is connected with the control module, the stretching module is connected with the motor, a differential gear mechanism is arranged in the motor, and two legs are driven in a time-sharing mode through the stretching module; and the sensing module is arranged on the stretching module and is wirelessly connected with the control module. The two-way driving mode is adopted, two-way time-sharing control is achieved, in other words, during power transmission of swing legs, supporting legs are not stressed, and the problem of asymmetrical time-sharing assistance on the two sides is effectively solved.
title: Knee flexible exoskeleton device based on lightweight bidirectional driving assistance and exoskeleton

abstract: The invention discloses road condition simulation equipment with a force measuring device. The road condition simulation equipment comprises at least two road condition simulation devices and the force measuring device, wherein the at least two road condition simulation devices are used for simulating road conditions along with feet; the road condition simulation device comprises a horizontal moving mechanism and a vertical moving mechanism which are arranged in a linkage mode. The output end of the vertical moving mechanism is provided with a bearing plate used for bearing the weight of the feet. A force measuring device is arranged on the bearing plate; the force measuring device comprises a slippage stress detection device and a contact stress detection device; the invention further provides a control method of the road condition simulation equipment with the force measuring device, walking movement of two feet or multiple feet can be simulated through the horizontal moving mechanism and the vertical moving mechanism, the structure is simple, control is easy, and the device can detect the stress states of the feet under various road conditions.
title: Road condition simulation equipment with force measuring device and control method thereof

abstract: The biped robot comprises first hip joint driving modules, second hip joint driving modules, a crotch part and two leg parts located on the left side and the right side of the crotch part, and the left side and the right side of the crotch part are each provided with one first hip joint driving module and one second hip joint driving module. The legs are provided with thighs, one end of each first hip joint driving module is rotationally connected with the crotch, the other end of each first hip joint driving module is connected with the crotch, each first hip joint driving module is provided with at least one downward output end, each downward output end is connected with one end of the corresponding second hip joint driving module, and each second hip joint driving module is connected with one end of the corresponding third hip joint driving module. One end of the first hip joint driving module is rotationally connected with the leg part, the other end of the second hip joint driving module is rotationally connected with the thigh part, the first hip joint driving module and the second hip joint driving module jointly form a hip joint, and the first hip joint driving module and the second hip joint driving module can independently control the leg part to rotate in different directions.
title: Biped robot

abstract: A method and processor (16) for obtaining torques to be applied to joints (8,10,12) of a leg (2) of a biped walking system (1) are provided. The method comprises the steps of obtaining moments (M 1 ,M 2 ) acting around the joints (8,10,12) of the leg (2), using the vertical component (F z ) of the ground reaction force (F) acting on the leg (2) at the point of application of the ground reaction force (F), the vertical components (F 1z ,F 2z ,F 3z ) of forces acting on the joints (8,10,12) of the leg (2) and a term of the acceleration of gravity and without using the horizontal components (F 1x ,F 2x ,F 3x ) of the forces acting on the joints (8,10,12) of the leg (2) and a term of acceleration except the term of the acceleration of gravity and obtaining the torques to be applied to the joints of the leg, based on the moments acting around the joints (8,10,12) of the leg (2). The vertical component (F z ) of the ground reaction force (F) acting on the leg, is obtained based on which leg or legs (2) are in contact with the ground, the attitude of the leg (2) and the vertical component of acceleration of the center of gravity of the whole body including the leg (2). The processor is configured to perform the above steps.
title: Method and processor for obtaining moments and torques in a biped walking system

abstract: The invention provides a multi-modal motion bionic inchworm crawling and climbing soft robot, which comprises feet and three deformable bodies sequentially connected between the two feet, and each deformable body is provided with an extensible face and a non-extensible face. The extensible faces are located on the opposite sides of the non-extensible faces so that the deformable bodies can deform between a linear structure and a C-shaped structure, and when the three deformable bodies are all in a linear structure, the direction of the non-extensible face of the middle deformable body is the same as the direction of the ground grabbing face of the foot, and the direction of the non-extensible face of the middle deformable body is opposite to the direction of the non-extensible faces of the deformable bodies located on the two sides, so that the deformable bodies can be matched with the feet in a flexible deformation mode to complete the horizontal crawling action and/or the climbing action. The multi-modal motion bionic inchworm crawling and climbing soft robot is simple in structure, light in mass and good in compliance, has the ability of multi-modal motion, adapts to motion in different environments and active conversion among the motions, and expands the motion adaptability of the soft robot in a complex environment.
title: Multi-modal motion bionic inchworm crawling and climbing soft robot

abstract: A walking robot (1) is provided with a torso (20) connected to top parts of two legs (10) so as to be able to change orientation relative thereto, and orientation control parts (105, 106, 107) for stabilizing the orientation of a main body on the basis of the orientations of the legs (10) and the torso (20). The present invention is also provided with state calculation parts (101, 102, 103) for periodically calculating an angular motion amount P1 about ankles of the legs in a standing state and the integrated value PI1 thereof from angle information of the legs (10) and the torso (20), and a stability determination part (104) for determining whether the calculated angular motion amount P1 and the integrated value PI1 thereof are approaching or distancing from target values and outputting a determination result to the orientation control parts (105, 106, 107). Tipping over is thus prevented using angular motion amount about the ankles and the integrated value thereof.
title: LEGGED MECHANISM, WALKING ROBOT, ORIENTATION CONTROL METHOD, AND PROGRAM

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of bionic crawling robots, in particular to a hexapod crawling robot imitating a spider. The hexapod crawling robot comprises leg structures and a centraldriving unit; a body comprises six legs, the six legs are uniformly arranged the circular central driving unit, the angle between each two legs are 60 degrees, and each mechanical leg is connected with the central driving unit through two connecting rods; each leg structure comprises a steering engine which drives a pair of gears to move, the steering engines are fixedly arranged in a base plate of the central driving unit, the lower connecting rods are connected with steering rods, the gears arranged on shafts of the steering engines and the gears arranged on the steering rods are matched with each other to rotate in the horizontal direction, and the rotation angles of the gears are 30 degrees, so that forward and backward movements of the mechanical legs are achieved. The hexapod crawling robot imitating the spider has the advantages of being good in stability, simple in structure, high in flexibility and the like.
title: Bionic hexapod crawling robot

abstract: The invention discloses a robot comprising two self-balancing electric vehicles, two legs capable of swinging in a crossed manner and feet arranged at the bottom of the legs. The wheels of the self-balancing electric vehicles are installed on the feet respectively, and the feet contact with the ground through the wheels. When the legs of the robot contact with the ground, in other words, a robot body stands on a two-wheeled self-balancing electric vehicle and is prevented from falling over in any adjusted postures; when one leg of the robot lifts up, in other words, one leg of the robot stands on a single-wheeled self-balancing electric vehicle, by means of the control of the self-balancing electric vehicle, the robot is capable of maintaining in a posture of one leg contacting with the ground for a long term and is prevented from falling over no matter how the upper portion of the robot moves.
title: Robot

abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a biped robot path planning method and device and a biped robot, and the method comprises the steps: generating a candidate node set of a next foothold through the parameters of the biped robot and the joint movement information of a current node, adding effective candidate nodes in the candidate node set to the priority queue to select optimal nodes to achieve expansion of the next node, wherein the output optimal nodes generate a foothold sequence from the initial node to the target node so that the path node search amount of the biped robot during double-leg crossed landing can be greatly reduced; and thus the path planning efficiency is improved.
title: Biped robot path planning method and device and biped robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a method for training a neural network for stabilizing a bipedal robot (1) presenting a plurality of degrees of freedom actuated by actuators, the method being characterised in that it comprises the implementation by the data processing means (11) of a server (10) of steps of:(a) In a simulation, applying a sequence of pushes on a virtual twin of the robot (1).(b) Performing a reinforcement learning algorithm on said neural network, wherein the neural network provides commands to said actuators of the virtual twin of the robot (1), so as to maximise a reward representative of a recovery of said virtual twin of the robot (1) from each push.
title: METHODS FOR TRAINING A NEURAL NETWORK AND FOR USING SAID NEURAL NETWORK TO STABILIZE A BIPEDAL ROBOT

abstract: A single or double leg support state of movable body on floor is determined, based on motion state of legs (2). Height of front leg flat portion (13) from floor surface is estimated during double leg support state on floor. Vertical component of force exerted by front leg on floor, is calculated based on relationship of vertical components of force exerted by rear leg, estimated height, total force exerted on floor.
title: METHOD OF ESTIMATING FLOOR REACTION OF BIPEDAL MOVABLE BODY

abstract: The invention discloses a quadruped bio-robot comprising a control system and a mechanical system. The mechanical system comprises two trunks and a waist adjusting motor arranged between the two trunks for adjusting swinging of the trunks. Each trunk is connected with two leg mechanisms, each leg mechanism comprises a multi-degree-of-freedom hybrid mechanism and a driving motor driving the hybrid mechanism to swing, the swing axis of the hybrid mechanism is parallel to that of the two trunks, and the control system coordinates and controls the waist adjusting motor and the driving motors to achieve continuous swing of the two trunks and the four leg mechanisms as well as realize jumping. Through the waist adjusting motor and the four leg mechanism, the control system coordinates and controls the waist adjusting motor and the driving motors to drive the two trunks and the four leg mechanism to swing, so as to realize attitude changes of the overall mechanism, and further continuous jumping actions are realized. The quadruped bio-robot is simple in structure and flexible in movement, and is applied to the technical field of robots.
title: Quadruped bio-robot

abstract: The invention relates to the field of terminals, and discloses intelligent glasses, an adjusting method, a face recognition method and a storage medium. The intelligent glasses comprise a glasses frame, two leg parts, a pressure sensor, a driving device, a camera, a sound pickup and an induction electrode, the two leg parts are connected to the two end parts of the glasses frame respectively, and each leg part comprises an ear bending part; each ear bending part comprises a flexible base material and a deformation body, and the deformation body is made of a memory material and is arranged on the flexible base material; the pressure sensor is arranged on the flexible base material; the driving device is connected with the deformation body and the pressure sensor and can drive the deformation body to deform according to the pressure detected by the pressure sensor. The camera is arranged on the bottom edge of the frame; the sound pick-up is arranged on the leg part of the intelligent glasses; the sensing electrode is arranged on the surface of the flexible base material. The intelligent glasses provided by the invention can be automatically adjusted to adapt to different wearing scenes, so that the wearing stability and comfort are effectively improved, and full-face facial recognition can be realized.
title: Intelligent glasses, adjusting method, face recognition method and storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses an agricultural environment-friendly robot device which comprises a machine frame. A walking device is arranged on the machine frame and comprises a walking motor arranged in the machine frame, an output gear connected to the walking motor, a transmission gear engaged with the output gear and two feet. A transmission shaft is arranged in the center of the transmission gearand installed on a shaft frame, the shaft frame is installed on the machine frame, and the two ends of the transmission shaft are each provided with a planetary gear device. Each planetary gear devicecomprises a planetary wheel, a sun wheel fixedly installed on the transmission shaft and a disc rotationally installed on the transmission shaft, wherein the disc is provided with a gear ring, and the planetary wheel is engaged with the sun wheel and the gear ring. The walking device controls the feet to move alternately through the planetary gear devices, the robot can move forwards constantly and stably, the structure is simple, design is reasonable, and movement reliability is high.
title: Agricultural environment-friendly robot device

abstract: The invention provides a biped walking robot with a constant speed device and a control method thereof. The biped walking robot with the constant speed device comprises the constant speed device, a rotating supporting shaft, a base frame and telescopic supporting legs; through rotating of the supporting legs, the walking of the walking robot is realized; the integral structure is simple and compact; and the turning radius is small. In addition, the invention further provides the control method of the biped walking robot with the constant speed device, by controlling relative motion between a longitudinal movement compensating device and a transverse movement compensating device of the constant speed device, a load above the constant speed device does constant speed motion relative to a geodetic coordinate system while the walking robot horizontally and stably moves on a road in the moving process; and therefore, problems of huge body and non-uniform load motion speed of an existing loading robot are solved.
title: Biped walking robot with constant speed device and control method thereof

abstract: Disclosed are a biped walking robot, which carries out walking with a high energy efficiency through adjustment of the stiffnesses of joints of legs and improves walking stability through control of the pose of a torso, and a method of controlling the walking robot. The method includes generating a walking pattern of plural legs connected to a torso of the walking robot; adjusting stiffness of each of the plural legs interlocking with walking phases of the plural legs driven according to the walking pattern; and measuring a tilt of the torso, and compensating for the tilt of the torso such that the torso is parallel with the gravity direction.
title: Walking robot and method of controlling the same

abstract: The invention provides a wheel-foot robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The wheel-foot robot comprises a main body assembly, a control assembly, two driving assemblies and two wheel-foot assemblies, wherein the control assembly, the two driving assemblies and the two wheel-foot assemblies are arranged on the main body assembly. The wheel-foot assembly comprises a first upper leg part, a second upper leg part, a first lower leg part hinged to the first upper leg part, a second lower leg part hinged to the second upper leg part and a walking wheel arranged on the first lower leg part, wherein the first upper leg part and the second upper leg part are rotationally arranged on the main body assembly. The first lower leg part and the second lower leg part are hinged. The driving assembly includes two leg driving members disposed on the main body assembly and a wheel driving member disposed on the first lower leg member. The two leg driving parts are used for driving the first upper leg part and the second upper leg part to rotate correspondingly. The wheel driving component is used for driving the walking wheels to rotate. The control assembly is electrically connected to the two leg driving components and the wheel driving component. The relative positions of the main body assembly and the walking wheels can be adjusted only through small driving force.
title: Wheel-foot robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of auxiliary supporting devices and relates to an auxiliary supporting device for ship heavy-duty tool operation. Through the auxiliary supporting device for ship heavy-duty tool operation, the technical problems that an existing auxiliary supporting device is complex in structure, low in freedom degree and the like are solved. The auxiliary supportingdevice for ship heavy-duty tool operation comprises a supporting plate. One end of the supporting plate is fixedly connected with a supporting cross beam I. The supporting plate is curved. The upper side of the supporting plate is provided with a backup plate. A belt is connected between the two ends of the supporting plate. The lower sides of the two ends of the supporting plate are fixedly connected with two leg supporting frames in a left-right spaced mode. The outer end of the supporting cross beam I is fixedly connected with a telescopic rod. The telescopic rod is fixedly connected with an electromagnet used for being absorbed to a ship body. A supporting cross beam II is arranged at the other end of the supporting plate. The outer end of the supporting cross beam II is movably connected with a plurality of movable arms in sequence. All the movable arms are connected in series in sequence. The supporting cross beam II is rotatably connected with the first movable arm, and the adjacent movable arms are rotatably connected. The auxiliary supporting device for ship heavy-duty tool operation improves the degree of freedom, and the structure is simplified.
title: Auxiliary supporting device for ship heavy-duty tool operation

abstract: Provided is a two-legged passive walker comprising: two legs (1), each leg being connected pivotally to the hip shaft and having a femur section (1a) and a crus section (1b) that rotate relative to one another through a connection mechanism which constitutes the knee joint; an upper body (2) connected to the hip shaft and of which the center of gravity is located above the hip shaft while the walker is being walked; and an assistance fixture (3) connected to the hip shaft for making the two-legged passive walker walk. The two-legged passive walker is made to walk by being assisted by a person with the use of the assistance fixture.
title: TWO-LEGGED PASSIVE WALKER

abstract: A robot in accordance with at least some embodiments of the present technology includes a torso having a superior portion, an inferior portion, and an intermediate portion therebetween. The robot further includes two legs connected to the torso via the inferior portion of the torso, two arms connected to the torso via the superior portion of the torso, and a protrusion also connected to the torso via the inferior portion of the torso and extending anteriorly from the torso. The robot is configured to move an object toward the torso at least partially via contact between the object and at least one of the arms. The robot is further configured to support a weight of the object at least partially via the protrusion while the robot ambulates via the legs.
title: Torso protrusion for robotic manipulation of objects and related technology

abstract: The invention discloses a movable hip joint assisting robot. The robot comprises a waist device worn on the waist of the human body and two leg devices worn on the left thigh and the right thigh of the human body correspondingly, and the waist device is connected with the two leg devices through two inhaul cables correspondingly; each leg device comprises a thigh fixing plate, a tension sensor and a spring; the tension sensor is arranged on the thigh fixing plate and connected to the inhaul cable through a spring, and the other end of the inhaul cable is fixedly connected with a line wheel on the waist device; the waist device comprises a waist fixing plate worn on the waist of the human body, straps, a bottom plate installed on the back face of the waist fixing plate, two connecting rods, a motor base, a wire wheel, a motor, a motor controller, two tension sensor transmitters and a battery. When the lower limbs need assistance, the tension sensor detects the reduced tension, the motor controller controls the motor to rotate and drives the wire wheel to move, finally the tension is provided for the leg device through the connecting rod and the inhaul cable, and the assistance function is achieved.
title: Movable hip joint assisting robot

abstract: The invention discloses a millipede bionic crawling equipment for detecting leakage of a deep-buried oil conveying pipeline in a desert area. The millipede bionic crawling equipment comprises at leastthree sections of mutually-connected millipede bodies, an audio sensor, a detector, a power supply battery, a tracking module and a data processing center; each millipede body is composed of two reversed mechanical crawling legs, and every two corresponding reversed mechanical crawling legs are fixedly connected through two leg connecting rods to form a mechanical foot; the audio sensor is used for detecting the oil conveying pipeline; the detector is used for detecting the oil conveying pipeline; the power supply battery is used for supplying power to crawling equipment parts; the tracking module is arranged at the front portion of the millipede bodies, and is used for detecting the oil conveying pipeline which is deeply buried underground so as to provide the basis of correct driving direction for a desert vehicle; and the data processing center is used for receiving the data information from the detector, processing and analyzing the received large amount of information which is not calculated and processed and transmitting the information back to a ground pipeline detection station. The invention further provides a method for detecting leakage of the deep-buried oil conveyingpipeline in the desert area. According to the equipment and the method, the problem of leakage detection of the deep-buried oil conveying pipeline in the desert depopulated area is solved, and automatic detection and data remote real-time transmission of the unmanned leakage detection equipment are realized.
title: Millipede bionic crawling equipment for detecting leakage of deep-buried oil conveying pipeline in desert area

abstract: A floor shape estimation system for a legged mobile robot, in particular a biped walking robot, which estimates a floor shape (130), more specifically a foot-to-foot floor inclination difference based on at least a control error of the total floor reaction force's moment based on the estimated value and corrects a feet compensating angle (114b) based on the estimated value. Further, the system estimates a floor shape (130), more specifically a foot floor inclination difference based on at least a control error of the foot floor reaction force about a desired foot floor reaction force central point and corrects a foot compensating angle (114c) based on the estimated value. With this, it can accurately estimate the shape of a floor with which the robot is in contact. Further, if the floor shape is different from what has been supposed, it can produce the floor reaction force as desired by absorbing the influence of difference.
title: FLOOR SHAPE DEDUCING DEVICE FOR LEGGED MOBILE ROBOT

abstract: The parasitic mechanism type robot with the gravity balancing and parallel folding and unfolding functions comprises leg structures, a waist structure, a chest structure, arm structures and a head structure, the chest structure is arranged at the upper end of the waist structure, and the head structure is arranged at the upper end of the chest structure; the arm structures are arranged on the two sides of the chest structure, the leg structures are arranged on the two sides of the lower end of the waist structure, crawler feet are arranged at the lower ends of the leg structures, and the two leg structures, the waist structure and the two arm structures adopt parasitic decoupling folding and unfolding mechanisms. Parasitic decoupling folding and unfolding mechanisms are adopted for leg structures, arm structures and a waist structure of the robot, the robot has the large movement range of a series mechanism and also has the high strength of a parallel mechanism, high movement precision and high effective load of all movement joints of the robot are achieved, and the functions of gravity balance and parallel folding and unfolding are achieved.
title: Parasitic mechanism type robot with gravity balancing and parallel folding and unfolding functions

abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot travelling mechanism containing a linear joint. The biped robot travelling mechanism containing the linear joint comprises a waist mechanism, wherein one leg mechanism is arranged at each of the two sides of the waist mechanism, the two leg mechanisms are respectively connected with the waist mechanism by virtue of a hip joint, and the bottom of each leg mechanism is connected with a foot mechanism; each leg mechanism comprises a leg body, the linear joint is cooperatively arranged in the leg body, the linear joint comprises a driving part and a driven part, the driven part is connected with a lateral rotary power device by virtue of a connecting piece, the driving part operates to drive the driven part to do linear vertical motion, then the leg body moves up and down and lifts a leg, the lateral rotary power device operates to drive the leg body to swing forward and backward, the lateral rotary power devices of the two leg mechanisms alternately operate to drive the leg body to realize an alternate leg striding action. Thighs, knee joints and shanks of a biped robot are integrated into one complete linear joint, and the biped robot travelling mechanism containing the linear joint has the characteristics of simple mechanism, easy maintenance, low energy consumption and strong weight bearing capability.
title: Biped robot travelling mechanism containing linear joint

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a foot retracting device transforming mechanism of a biped robot. The foot retracting device transforming mechanism comprises two retracting mechanisms and two traveling mechanisms which are mounted on two feet of the robot. Each retracting mechanism comprises a fixing frame, a retraction driving motor and a retraction transmission device, wherein the fixing frame is connected with one foot of the robot, the retraction driving motor and the retraction transmission device are mounted on the fixing frame, and an output shaft of the retraction driving motor is connected with the retraction transmission device. Each traveling mechanism comprises a supporting frame, a traveling driving motor and a traveling wheel, wherein the supporting frame is connected with the corresponding retraction transmission device, the traveling driving motor and the traveling wheel are mounted on the supporting frame, and an output shaft of the traveling driving motor is connected with the traveling wheel. The foot retracting device transforming mechanism has the advantages that the motors drive a retracting device to control retraction of the traveling wheels, so that the biped robot can be transformed into a two-wheel balance robot in a specific environment, and motion superiority of the biped robot and the balance robot can be fully used.
title: Foot retracting device transforming mechanism of biped robot

abstract: The invention provides a symmetrical rimless wheel model motion behavior adjusting method based on a motion stopping attraction domain. The method comprises the steps: constructing and describing theinitial state of a symmetrical rimless wheel model based on the initial kinetic energy and slope inclination angle of the symmetrical rimless wheel model, creating a state coordinate system, and enabling an interval formed by the state coordinate system to be an attraction domain region; classifying the final stable state attraction domain according to the model parameters, and constructing and obtaining a corresponding attraction domain area in the state coordinate system; calculating boundaries among a plurality of different attraction domain areas; according to the initial state and the attraction domain area, jointly calculating a final stable state of the symmetrical sideless wheel model; and enabling the final stable state to meet the expectation by adjusting model parameters. According to the method, a complete adjustment method capable of realizing expected motion characteristics is constructed based on calculation and analysis of a stop motion attraction domain of the symmetrical rimless wheel model, and a practical scheme is provided for guiding biped walking simulation research of a real robot by using the rimless wheel model.
title: Symmetrical rimless wheel model motion behavior adjusting method based on motion stopping attraction domain

abstract: The invention provides a magnetic control bionic adhesive sole device based on a magnetic-sensing adhesive material. The magnetic control bionic adhesive sole device based on a magnetic-sensing adhesive material involves the structural design and manufacturing manner of a sole and comprises a sole adhesive part, a main body part and a corresponding adjustment and control coil, wherein a three-dimensional molding and manufacturing technology is used for assisting the manufacturing of the palm surface of the sole adhesive part; the magnetic-sensing adhesive material is used as the sole adhesivepart for processing the sole; the adjustment and control coil is designed and filled to produce a magnetic field for adjusting the adhesive performance of the sole; and meanwhile, part of palm surfaceis driven to deform and displace, so that the sole has certain movement assisted ability. The magnetic control bionic adhesion sole device based on the magnetic-sensing adhesive material can be usedfor a two-legged or multi-legged robot so as to be suitable for the surface detection of high-altitude buildings, bridges, ships, oil tanks and the like in a complicated heterogeneous wall surface environment, urban anti-terrorism, intelligence reconnaissance and the like.
title: Magnetic control bionic adhesive sole device based on magnetic-sensing adhesive material

abstract: A mechanical manipulator, which is useful inter alia as a machine tool, has a platform (6) suspended by three pairs of supportive legs (4) which are coupled to the platform at triangularly spaced-apart locations by means of three universal joints (5) each of which couples to one end of each of the two legs of a respective pair, and the two legs of each pair extend from their respective universal joint in divergent directions to spaced-apart locations in an overhead mounting (2) whereat each leg is drivingly engaged by a respective universal joint mounted electric motor (3) arranged to move the leg in its own longitudinal direction. The platform orientation and position can thus be precisely controlled by operation of the six leg drive motors. The overhead mounting (2) is domed for enhanced rigidity.
title: Improvements relating to mechanical manipulators

abstract: The invention provides a survey vehicle which comprises a main body, a sensor, a controller, at least two mechanical legs and a crawler-type driving mechanism; the sensor and the controller are both arranged on the main body; the sensor is used for detection; the controller is used for obtaining a detection result to send out a first control instruction or a second control instruction; the at least two mechanical legs are connected to the main body and used for receiving the first control instruction to drive the main body to move; and the crawler-type driving mechanism is connected to the main body and used for receiving the second control instruction to drive the main body to move. According to the surveying vehicle, the at least two mechanical legs and the crawler-type driving mechanismare arranged on the main body at the same time, so that the survey vehicle moves in different road condition environments in different modes, the survey vehicle has great advantages in the aspects ofspeed, energy consumption and stability, the search and rescue capacity and the search and rescue efficiency of the survey vehicle are further improved, and the functions of ruins and cave search andrescue, ruins surface search and rescue and the like are realized.
title: Surveying vehicle

abstract: The invention relates to an elastic energy-saving upper body half-dividing passive walking device. The elastic energy-saving upper body half-dividing passive walking device comprises a hip, legs, knees, an upper body, a spring unit, a drive unit, a data acquisition unit and a main control unit. The upper body and the hip are directly connected to each other and fix the drive unit together. The drive unit is in transmission from driving transmission wheels, to driven transmission wheels and to thighs, the left belt transmission is backward transmission, and the right belt transmission is forward transmission. The thighs are respectively fixed to the left side and the right side of the lower end of a hip support and respectively connected to the driven transmission wheels L and R on both left and right sides through transmission shafts for achieving real-time equal back and forth swing amplitude of the thighs on both left and right sides. The spring unit connected to belts stores and releases energy all the time during the swing of the upper body. The elastic energy-saving upper body half-dividing passive walking device is a two-leg walking device being simple and compact in structure, ingenious in design and capable of saving energy.
title: Elastic energy-saving upper body half-dividing passive walking device

abstract: A system and method is disclosed for predicting a fall of a robot having at least two legs. A learned representation, such as a decision list, generated by a supervised learning algorithm is received. This learned representation may have been generated based on trajectories of a simulated robot when various forces are applied to the simulated robot. The learned representation takes as inputs a plurality of features of the robot and outputs a classification indicating whether the current state of the robot is balanced or falling. A plurality of features of the current state of the robot, such as the height of the center of mass of the robot, are determined based on current values of a joint angle or joint velocity of the robot. The current state of the robot is classified as being either balanced or falling by evaluating the learned representation with the plurality of features of the current state of the robot.
title: Machine learning approach for predicting humanoid robot fall

abstract: When an operator attempts to move a robot from a current position to a desired position, she/he operates a manipulator lever 26 corresponding to a desired direction of a manipulator 23 of a remote control device 22, for example, a number of times corresponding to a predetermined moving amount in the moving direction. At this point, the moving amount for each moving direction depending on this number of operations is set, and a leg of the robot is actuated according to a setting value of the moving amount for each moving direction to move the robot. The moving amount that can be set by the operation of the manipulator lever 26 has a relatively small moving amount that the robot may be moved by performing a lifting/landing action once for both the legs of the robot, and a relatively large moving amount requiring multiple walking steps of the lifting/landing action for each leg of the robot. The movement of the bipedal mobile robot to the desired position may surely be carried out by a relatively simple operation. <IMAGE>
title: Remote control device of bipedal mobile robot

abstract: A two-legged walking type human-shaped robot, which enables smooth actions with wirings, simplified in an action controller. This robot comprises a barrel section 11, leg sections 12L, 12R comprising knee sections 21L, 21R and foot sections 17L, 17R, arm sections 13L, 13R comprising elbow sections 31L, 31R and hand sections 27L, 27R, and a head section 14 and has drive means for driving joint sections 11d, 11e 18L, 18R-24L, 24R 28L, 28R-33L, 33R 35, 36, respectively, and action controllers 40 for controlling the respective drive means on the basis of gait data matching with a requested action. The action controller is constituted of a main control section 41 provided in the barrel section and subcontrol sections 42 dispersedly disposed adjacent to the respective drive means. Each subcontrol section 42 is LAN-connected to the main control section 41. Further, each control section includes a processor section 45 which operates a control signal for at least one corresponding drive means on the basis of a drive control signal from the main control section and a driver section 46 which drives a corresponding drive means on the basis of a control signal from the processor section.
title: TWO-LEGGED WALKING TYPE HUMAN-SHAPED ROBOT

abstract: The invention relates to a quasi-passive biped walking robot system with a hip vibrator, and aims at solving the problems that an existing active robot is unnatural in gait and high in energy consumption, coronal plane motion of an existing three-dimensional passive robot is unstable, and the reliability degree of a system is poor. The quasi-passive biped walking robot system comprises a hip assembly, two leg assemblies and two foot assemblies, and each leg assembly is arranged between the hip assembly and the corresponding foot assembly. The quasi-passive biped walking robot system further comprises the hip vibrator, and the hip vibrator comprises a speed reducer, a support, a bevel gear pair, a coupling and a gear shaft. The hip assembly comprises a barrel, a gear rack, a guide rail and two annular connecting pieces. Each foot assembly is mainly composed of a foot plate.
