Each leg assembly comprises a hip and leg connecting piece, a straight leg and a leg and foot connecting piece, and the upper ends of the straight legs are connected with the hip and leg connecting pieces. Stable three-dimension walking of the quasi-passive robot on a slope is achieved, and meanwhile the advantages of being natural in gait and low in power consumption are achieved.
title: Quasi-passive biped walking robot system with hip vibrator

abstract: The invention provides an intelligent biped walking robot. The intelligent biped walking robot comprises a curved-surface display system, a vision sensing system, an infrared induction system, a driving mechanism and a gyroscope stabilimeter mechanism. An upper joint on each thigh is hinged to a body through a steering engine, and a lower joint of each thigh is hinged to an upper joint of a shank through a steering engine, a lower joint of each shank is hinged to a foot upper cover through a steering engine. A steering engine is mounted on the neck of the robot and can control the robot to node for communication. The vision sensing system which can achieve face recognition and has a memory function is mounted in eyes on a head. The steering engines can control motions of leg joints according to programs set in the control system, so that walking of the robot is achieved. The curved-surface display system comprises a curved-surface display screen and an audio playing system. The infrared induction system which can achieve imaging recognition is mounted above the curved-surface display screen. The eyes are connected with the corresponding steering engine and can be driven by the steering engine to rotate for eye contact.
title: Intelligent biped walking robot

abstract: A robotic system where a pair of legs is configured such that a knee joint can rotate continuously 360 degrees around an axis. The upper body connects to a pair of legs each including an upper portion and a lower portion. One end of the lower portion of each leg connects to a hip joint. A knee joint in each leg has one degree of freedom around an axis where the knee joint can rotate 360 degrees around the axis. Control circuitry can be housed in the upper body for providing bipedal movement by activating actuators in hip joints and knee joints.
title: CONTINUOUS ROBOTIC KNEE JOINT SYSTEM

abstract: The invention provides a bionic biped robot and a stable gait planning method thereof. The robot is composed of an electromechanical control box, two mechanical legs with three degrees of freedom and a joint yaw assembly. The joint yaw assembly controls steering motion of the robot. Each mechanical leg comprises a thigh part, a shank part and a buffer hoof foot; the thigh part adopts a quadrilateral serial mechanism, and a hip joint rolling motor, a hip joint pitching motor and a knee joint pitching motor are arranged at the hip joint; the shank adopts a light carbon fiber structure and is passively controlled; the buffering hoof foot is designed by referring to the characteristics of hoof walking type biological feet. And the robot is simplified into a spring-load inverted pendulum model for kinetic analysis and gait planning, the gait stability is evaluated by adopting a method of combining a Poincare cross section and attraction domain characteristics, the optimal parameters of the stable gait are obtained, and the robustness of the robot in the motion state is ensured. The robot has the characteristics of flexible walking, quick response, high efficiency and energy conservation.
title: Bionic biped robot and stable gait planning method thereof

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of AGV control, in particular to a goods shelf supporting leg recognition and tail end path re-planning method for an AGV. According to the invention, through parameter setting, data acquisition and preprocessing, and a DBSCAN clustering algorithm based on an adaptive neighborhood radius, clustering division processing is carried out on laser point cloud data; performing fitting processing on each group of'support leg reflection point sets' obtained by clustering, and screening out'single support leg groups' conforming to the sizes of the support legs of the goods shelf; adding the combination of all table matching conditions into a'double-leg group '; finding an optimal choice with a small slope and a short distance from the double-leg group, and determining the optimal choice as a left leg and a right leg of the goods shelf; calculating the center point coordinate according to the coordinates of the left and right support legs of the goods shelf, and re-planning a third-order Bezier curve type route; and converting the coordinate system of the newly planned route into a navigation map coordinate system. A specific station device does not need to be installed, the problems that the goods shelf is not placed correctly and deviates are solved only from the software layer, and cost is saved.
title: Goods shelf supporting leg identification and tail end path re-planning method for AGV (Automatic Guided Vehicle)

abstract: The invention discloses a gait detection method and system and a storage medium, relates to the technical field of biological recognition, is applied to a gait detection device, and comprises the following steps: collecting a plurality of walking gait images of a target object; performing deep recognition on the walking gait image through the controller to obtain joint point coordinates of the walking gait image; according to the joint point coordinates, determining center position coordinates and ankle joint point coordinates of the target object; according to the ankle joint point coordinates, the foot state of each step of the target object is determined, and the foot states are used for recording the supporting state and the swinging state of the two feet of the target object; according to the ankle joint point coordinates corresponding to the foot state, step length data is obtained through calculation; according to the step length data and the foot state, gait data are obtained through calculation; and according to the center position coordinate and the corresponding walking time, calculating to obtain speed data. According to the invention, the test efficiency can be improved while the test steps are simplified.
title: Gait detection method and system and storage medium

abstract: A robotic vehicle (1) comprises a body (2) and two wheeled legs (3) for locomotion. The two legs (3) are attached to opposing sides of the body (2). For each of the two legs, the leg (3) comprises a respective hip joint (31), an upper link (32), a knee joint (33), a lower link (34), a wheel joint (35), and a wheel (36).For at least one of the two legs (3), in particular for both, the relative angular position of the respective hip joint (31) has a range of at least 180°.
title: ROBOTIC VEHICLE

abstract: A legged mobile robot includes at least two legs. The legs are movable in a front-rear direction of the legged mobile robot. Each of distal end portions of the legs is provided with a plurality of protrusions. Protruding directions of the protrusions are a plurality of directions including a lateral direction intersecting with the front-rear direction. The protrusions can come into contact with a moving surface on which the legs move. Further, the legged mobile robot includes a drive device that displaces each of the protrusions up down with respect to a sole in contact with the moving surface in the leg. The legged mobile robot further includes a control device that controls movement of the protrusions.
title: Legged mobile robot, leg control method, and program storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses a hydraulic drive robot hip joint cantilever structure, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The structure comprises servo hydraulic cylinders, a robot waist, hydraulic rods, hip joints, thigh shells, shank shells and foot shells, the upper ends of the servo hydraulic cylinders are fixed to the robot waist, and the lower ends of the servo hydraulic cylinders are connected with the hydraulic rods; the hydraulic rods are connected with the hip joints, the hip joints are connected with the thigh shells, the thigh shells are connected with the shank shells, and theshank shells are connected with the foot shells. By means of the cantilever structure, linear driving of the hydraulic servo cylinders is converted into rotation of the hip joints, and the flexibility of the hip joints is improved. Meanwhile, the cantilever structure also greatly improves the lateral swing range of legs, and the lateral stepping capability and external disturbance resistance of the robots are improved.
title: Hydraulic drive robot hip joint cantilever structure

abstract: The invention discloses a scalable robot torso and a bionic four-footed robot. The scalable robot torso comprises torso connecting rods and annular metamorphic mechanisms; two annular metamorphic mechanisms which are structurally symmetrical are connected by the torso connecting rods; each of the metamorphic mechanisms is constituted in a way that a plurality of first connecting rods are flexiblyconnected with each other in a head-to-tail mode via first connectors; second connecting rods are connected with the joints between each two first connecting rods, and only one end of each first connecting rod is connected with a second connecting rod; the second connecting rods are flexibly connected with each other via second connectors; and two second connecting rods at the central symmetricalposition of each metamorphic mechanism are connected by an elastic rod. According to the scalable robot torso and the bionic four-footed robot, the metamorphic mechanisms which are foldable and structurally symmetrical are adopted, and two metamorphic mechanisms are connected by the torso connecting rods to constitute the robot torso; each metamorphic mechanism adjusts the radial dimension of therobot torso via the elastic rod; a leg mechanism is coupled with the torso in a mode of elastic movement; and the inter-leg distance and ground clearance of the torso of the robot can be realized viascaling and deformation of the torso.
title: Scalable robot torso and bionic four-footed robot

abstract: PURPOSE: A method for controlling a wearable robot is provided to drive the robot with specific amplification ratio by driving the end through applying intention of a wearer to the end of the robot as operating power. CONSTITUTION: A method for controlling a wearable robot comprises: a step of calculating the support power to support an object in the end of the robot by amplifying operating power which applies to the robot to specific amplification ratio; and a step of deriving the operating power required to lift the object by the end of the robot through a virtual spring damper model by applying a virtual mass damper spring model to the end of the robot and dividing to a required torque at each joint of the robot through Jacobian transpose. [Reference numerals] (AA) Robot upper limb frame; (BB) Second F/T sensor; (CC) First F/T sensor; (DD) Handle
title: METHOD FOR CONTROLLING WEARABLE ROBOT

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of machine vision control, and particularly relates to a lower limb rehabilitation robot knee joint driving control system based on machine vision, which comprises a central processing module, a machine vision module, a driving control module, a feedback and adjustment module and a man-machine interaction module. A training target can be set, the progress can be checked, parameters can be adjusted, closed-loop control over the whole system can be achieved, motion state monitoring is provided through machine vision, the control system adjusts the driving device according to feedback, and the safety in the training process is guaranteed by monitoring the motion condition of knee joints in real time and adjusting the driving force according to the feedback of a patient.
title: Lower limb rehabilitation robot knee joint driving control system based on machine vision

abstract: The invention discloses a method for distinguishing the crowd with balance disorder based on a center of gravity shift model. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, human walking posture video of a normal person and an abnormal person in a built virtual reality scene is collected from 45 DEG; then, the video of normal person and abnormal person is loaded, the video image is extracted into pictures, and then the pictures are processed to obtain the barycenter coordinates of normal person and abnormal person respectively, finally, according to the center of gravity data, the center of gravity angle data and the mean and variance of the upper and lower center of gravity of human body are extracted, and the center of gravity data are classified by SVM classifier, and then combinedwith the center of gravity angle data and the mean and variance of the upper and lower center of gravity of human body, the balance ability disorder crowd is quickly judged. The method disclosed by the invention solves the problems that the traditional subjective method is too coarse and the gauge evaluation method is too complex and the cost is too high, and the video and the image are processedthrough a plurality of steps, and the final classification accuracy rate is above 85%.
title: A method for distinguishing the crowd with balance disorder based on the center of gravity shift model

abstract: The robotic upper limb rehabilitation device assists in rehabilitation of an upper limb of a human patient recovering from a stroke or the like. The device is an exoskeleton having an articulated shoulder assembly having five degrees of freedom, including at least two degrees of freedom simulating inner shoulder movement. An upper arm member is pivotally attached to the shoulder assembly, and a forearm assembly is pivotally attached to the upper arm member. An inflatable handgrip is pivotally attached to the forearm assembly. A robotic control unit receives signals from sensors and is configured to activate actuators attached to the exoskeleton to assist upper limb movement when required, or to permit the exoskeleton to conform to upper limb movement when no assistance is required.
title: ROBOTIC UPPER LIMB REHABILITATION DEVICE

abstract: The invention discloses a wire winding driven exoskeleton robot knee joint which comprises a crus supporting component, a knee joint winch, a thigh supporting seat, a thigh supporting cover and a clutch positioning assembly, wherein an inner side top plate and an outer side top plate are fixed at the upper end of the crus supporting component; a connecting through hole is formed in each of the inner side top plate and the outer side top plate; a first spline hole is formed in the lower end of each of the thigh supporting seat and the thigh supporting cover; the knee joint winch is provided with a second spline hole and is arranged between the thigh supporting seat and the thigh supporting cover; the thigh supporting seat and the thigh supporting cover are arranged between the inner side top plate and the outer side top plate; the connecting through holes, the first spline hole and the second spline hole are coaxial; the clutch positioning assembly comprises a clutch sleeve, a clutch core, a clutch cover plate, a compression spring and a steel ball; the clutch positioning assembly is arranged in the connecting holes and the spline holes in a penetrating manner and can be locked with the first spline hole or the second spline hole and can be unlocked from the first spline hole or the second spline hole. The wire winding driven exoskeleton robot knee joint is simple in structure, can decrease weight of the lower limbs of an exoskeleton robot, and is simple in locking and unlocking structure and convenient to operate.
title: Wire winding driven exoskeleton robot knee joint

abstract: The invention discloses a leg type walking robot. The leg type walking robot comprises a robot body, which is rotatingly provided with a left front support leg, a left rear support leg, a right frontsupport leg and a right rear support leg. The leg type walking robot is characterized in that a first Z-type connecting rod is connected between the left front support leg and the right rear support leg, a second Z-type connecting rod is connected between the right front support leg and the left rear support leg, a reciprocating disc is rotatingly arranged in the middle of the robot body, both sides of the reciprocating disc are provided with a first stand column and a second stand column, the first Z-type connecting rod is provided with a first connecting sleeve, the second Z-type connectingrod is provided with a second connecting sleeve, the bottom of the robot body is slidingly provided with a sliding bar and rotatingly provided with a swing rod, one end of the swing rod is provided with an outer gear, the other end of the swing rod is provided with a bar-shaped groove, and a slider is arranged under the reciprocating disc and slidingly arranged inside the bar-shaped groove. The leg type walking robot can simulate the walking gesture of tetrapods and meanwhile has the advantages of being simple in structure and high in walking stability.
title: Leg type walking robot

abstract: According to the exoskeleton robot knee joint clutch, a jaw clutch driving body and a transmission wheel are in coaxial transmission connection, and matched tooth structures are arranged on the opposite end faces of the jaw clutch driving body and a jaw clutch driven body correspondingly; the transmission wheel is in transmission connection with the stepping motor; the jaw clutch driving body is of a cylindrical cam structure, a curve groove is formed in the side surface of the jaw clutch driving body, the jaw clutch driving body and the cam follower are coaxially connected in a sleeved mode and can rotate relative to the cam follower, and a protruding column on the cam follower is matched with the curve groove of the jaw clutch driving body. When the jaw clutch driving body rotates, the protruding column of the cam follower can push the jaw clutch driving body to move in the axial direction of the cam follower by moving along the curve groove of the jaw clutch driving body, and therefore the tooth structure of the jaw clutch driving body and the tooth structure of the jaw clutch driven body are separated or meshed. The motion trail of the exoskeleton robot better conforms to gait motion of a human body, and more electricity is saved.
title: Knee joint clutch of exoskeleton robot

abstract: The invention provides a mobile smart phone robot and discloses a robot model capable of changing the human face at any time. According to the mobile smart phone robot, hands and feet are mounted on asmart phone, and arms and legs of the robot can be controlled to move through a hand control box or a remote controller. The mobile smart phone robot is characterized in that the robot composed of the smart phone has a round body, a beautiful hairpiece and colorful clothes; the small smart phone on the head of the robot displays changeable faces, and the flexible hands and feet give a real three-dimensional sense. The robot can store Bluetooth or conduct Bluetooth pairing to control movement of another robot. The four limb joints are driven by a plurality of stepping motors. All the parts ofthe robot are made of plastic and are controlled by an electronic system. The robot can conduct playing as a small real person in front of the background of a television. As a mouse is mounted at thefeet of the puppet, the robot can be connected with a computer to conduct computer games. The robot can dance on the surface of a flat plate. Moreover, the two smart phone robots can conduct fighting.Compared with the VR, the smart phone performing robot capable of changing different faces can turn a common virtual person image into the reality again and brings a broader stage for extension and development of smart phones.
title: Mobile smart phone robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots and particularly relates to a real-time judgment and recognition device for lower limb exoskeleton two-foot supporting areas. The real-time judgment and recognition device particularly comprises a lower limb exoskeleton left foot gait information collection shoe and a lower limb exoskeleton right foot gait information collection shoe. Each gait information collection shoe is composed of multiple parts, and a custom-made shoe pad is the core component of each gait information collection shoe. Each custom-made shoe pad is provided with a pressure measuring unit and an inertia measuring unit, and related sensors are connected to information processing units through flexible wires; the information processing units process and calculate gait information collected by the pressure sensors and the inertia measuring units and then transmit the gait information to a lower limb exoskeleton control host; the host judges and recognizes the two-foot supporting areas accurately in real time by synthesizing the effective information of the left and right foot devices; and thus, a detecting measure is provided for control over the walking stability of a lower limb exoskeleton robot.
title: Real-time judgment and recognition device for lower limb exoskeleton two-foot supporting areas

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of driving devices, in particular to a joint variable rigidity parallel elastic driving device of a jumping robot, which comprises a tibia frame and a thigh skeleton positioned above the tibia frame, the joint driving mechanism is arranged in the middle, close to the bottom end, of one side of the femoral skeleton, the power output end of the joint driving mechanism penetrates through the femoral skeleton to be fixedly connected with a transmission frame, and the bottom end of the transmission frame is detachably connected with the tibia frame; the parallel elastic mechanism is arranged between the strand framework and the transmission frame; the limiting mechanism is arranged on the transmission frame; the reset elastic force release strength of the parallel elastic mechanism can be effectively controlled through the limiting mechanism, so that the relative swing speed of the tibia frame and the thigh skeleton is switched, the jumping height of the robot can be increased when the reset elastic force is large, and normal walking can be achieved when the reset elastic force is small; therefore, the robot can be effectively and flexibly switched between the jumping gait and the walking gait, and the effect of adapting to complex road conditions is achieved.
title: Joint variable rigidity parallel elastic driving device of jumping robot

abstract: Provided is a gait training apparatus. The gait training apparatus according to an embodiment comprises: a treadmill that includes a walking surface that moves circularly along an endless trajectory so that a user walks in place; a pair of first correction units that provide an external force in the lateral direction to a pair of legs of the user; a sensor unit that detects the user's movements; and a control unit that controls the pair of first correction units in real time based on information detected by the sensor unit to correct the user's walking posture, wherein the pair first correction units comprise: a pair of first seating units seated on a pair of legs of the user; a pair of first driving units that provide an external force to the pair of first seating units; and a pair of first cables connecting the pair of first seating units and the pair of first driving units.
title: GAIT REHABILITATION APPARATUS

abstract: The invention discloses a metal wall surface self-adaptive climbing robot, which comprises a vehicle frame and a plurality of vehicle wheels arranged at the bottom of the vehicle frame. One or more vehicle wheel is provided with a driving device, at least two of the vehicle wheels at the bottom of the vehicle frame are mounted in pairs, one or more magnetic adsorption module is arranged between the two paired vehicle wheels, the magnetic adsorption module comprises an upper bracket, a lower bracket and a permanent magnet, the upper bracket is relatively and fixedly mounted at the bottom of thevehicle frame, the lower bracket is mounted at the bottom of the upper bracket by the rotational degree of freedom, the permanent magnet is fixedly mounted at the lower end of the lower bracket, thebottom height of the permanent magnet is lower than the bottom heights of the vehicle wheels, and the permanent magnet comprises a flat yoke iron located at the top and a plurality of rectangular neodymium iron boron permanent magnet arrays fixed to the bottom of the flat yoke iron. According to the metal wall surface self-adaptive climbing robot, the magnetic adsorption module with the axial degree of freedom greatly improves adaptability of robot climbing, the structure is simple, walking stability is good, and loading capacity is strong.
title: Metal wall surface self-adaptive climbing robot

abstract: A robot is provided with a motion control unit. The motion control unit of the robot comprises - a distance computing module calculating the two closest points of different segments of the robot connected to each other via at least one joint, or a segment of the robot and another object, and outputting - a whole body control module, - a collision avoidance module supplied with an output signal from the distance computing module, - a blending control unit for combining the weighted output control signals of the whole body control module and the collision avoidance control module, wherein the weight of the whole body control output signal is the higher the lower a calculated collision risk, and wherein the weight of the collision avoidance control output signal is the higher the higher the calculated collision risk. The collision avoidance module is designed for - calculating the two closest points of different segments of the robot connected to each other via at least one joint, or a segment of the robot and another object, and - controlling a collision avoidance action only in the dimension along the connection line between the closest points.
title: Robots with collision avoidance functionality

abstract: The invention discloses a wheeled robot based on consumption complaints and services, and relates to the technical field of robots. The service robot main body is arranged in the robot shell; the walking base assembly is arranged at the bottom of the robot shell. The microphone assembly is arranged on the inner wall of the robot shell; the walking base assembly comprises a fixing base arranged at the bottom of the robot shell, a chassis with wheels is arranged on the fixing base, and auxiliary wheels are movably connected to the side wall of the chassis with the wheels through a plurality of adjusting connecting rods. The microphone assembly comprises a jacking air cylinder arranged at the bottom in the robot shell, a microphone is arranged on a piston rod of the jacking air cylinder, the jacking air cylinder and the microphone are electrically connected with a bidirectional switch arranged on the outer wall of the robot shell, and a plurality of recording grooves corresponding to the microphone in position are sequentially formed in the outer wall of the robot shell from top to bottom. The robot has the advantages that the walking stability of the robot is improved, and the like.
title: Wheeled robot based on consumption complaint and service

abstract: The invention discloses a power component for a walking robot and a walking posture adjustable robot. The power component comprises a planetary reducer, a second chuck is fixed on a planet carrier of the planetary reducer, a first chuck is fixed on a sun gear of the planetary reducer, and the power component further comprises a locking piece. The locking piece comprises a mounting seat, a worm shaft on which a worm is coaxially arranged, and a second clamping jaw; a worm gear is further arranged on the second clamping jaw; and the second clamping jaw can generate transverse movement between the first chuck and the second chuck relative to the mounting seat under the driving of the worm to the worm gear. The robot adopts the power component. By adopting the technical scheme provided by the scheme, the complexity and the weight of a power structure of the robot can be simplified, and the walking posture switching position precision of the walking robot is improved.
title: Power component for walking robot and walking posture adjustable robot

abstract: The invention provides an 18-axis six-leg constant tension walking motion control system and method. The system comprises a machine body, six leg structures, a motion control unit and a motion controller. The six leg structures comprise the first leg structure, the second leg structure, the third leg structure, the fourth leg structure, the fifth leg structure and the sixth leg structure. The six leg structures are the same, and any one leg structure comprises a hip joint, a thigh, a knee joint, a shank and a sole. The 18-shaft 6-leg constant tension walking motion control system is provided with the two sets of leg structures, each set of leg structure comprises the three legs arranged in the triangular shape, and therefore when one set of leg structure is in the air, the other set of leg structure tends to move forwards but does not leave the ground, triangular stable supporting is achieved, and walking stability is improved.
title: 18-shaft 6-leg constant tension walking motion control system and method

abstract: The invention discloses a quadruped robot control method combined with terrain constraints. The quadruped robot control method comprises the following steps that a quadruped robot single rigid body model is established; simplifying the treading area into a plurality of polygonal areas determined by three-dimensional space lines; a nonlinear model predictive control method is adopted, terrain constraints are added, and the optimal control quantity of expected values of the position, the speed and the acceleration of the joint space of the quadruped robot within a time period is obtained and serves as a first-layer control framework; a whole-body control model of the quadruped robot is established, topographic constraints are introduced, and the optimal control quantity of expected values of the position, the speed and the acceleration of the joint space of the quadruped robot is obtained and serves as a second-layer control architecture; and the first-layer control framework and the second-layer control framework are combined, and the joint torque, meeting the terrain constraint, of the quadruped robot is obtained. According to the method, the form of nonlinear model predictive control is adopted, terrain constraints can be added from the planning level, the foothold of the quadruped robot conforms to dynamic constraints, and the quadruped robot can adapt to complex terrains with high foothold position requirements.
title: Quadruped robot control method combined with terrain constraints

abstract: The invention discloses a leg and foot walking device with variable scaling and a scaling conversion method. The leg and foot walking device comprises a machine body assembly and a connecting rod assembly. The machine body assembly is used for installing the driver and the connecting rod assembly. The connecting rod assembly comprises a thigh module, a shank module, a long connecting rod, a short connecting rod and a non-linear transmission module, the length of the thigh module and the length of the shank module can be adjusted according to a certain non-linear proportional relation, and therefore scaling is adjusted while the scaling characteristic is guaranteed. According to the leg-foot walking device, the scaling ratio can be adjusted without disassembling the leg-foot walking device and replacing parts, the energy utilization efficiency can be improved, the peak power requirement is reduced, and control can be easily achieved on the basis that walking stability is guaranteed.
title: Variable-scaling leg and foot walking device and scaling conversion method

abstract: The invention discloses a service robot trunk. The service robot trunk comprises a chest mechanism, a waist mechanism, a knee mechanism and a base, wherein a waist pitching joint comprises a waist pitching driving mechanism, a waist pitching transmission mechanism, a waist pitching upper plate and a waist pitching lower plate; the waist pitching upper plate is fixedly connected with the chest mechanism; the waist pitching transmission mechanism can drive the waist pitching upper plate to move; a waist rotating joint comprises a waist rotating supporting mechanism and a waist rotating driving mechanism; the waist rotating driving mechanism is fixedly connected with the waist rotating supporting mechanism; the waist pitching lower plate is fixedly connected with the waist rotating driving mechanism; the knee mechanism comprises a knee pitching joint; the knee pitching joint comprises a knee pitching driving mechanism, a knee pitching transmission mechanism, a knee pitching upper plate and a knee pitching lower plate; the knee pitching lower plate is fixedly connected with the base; and the knee pitching upper plate is fixedly connected with the waist rotating supporting mechanism. The service robot trunk can be adjusted in multiple degrees of freedom, and therefore the stability of a robot is improved. The trunk is simple in design structure and reliable in performance and can bewell combined with other elements of the service robot.
title: Service robot trunk and service robot thereof

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and relates to a motion decoupling parallel drive type exoskeleton robot ankle joint. The motion decoupling parallel drive type exoskeleton robot ankle joint comprises an ankle joint drive assembly and a foot support assembly. The ankle joint drive assembly comprises a shank rod, a flexion and extension drive assembly and an inward and outward turning motion assembly. The shank rod is hinged to the foot support assembly. The flexion and extension drive assembly and the inward and outward turning motion assembly are arranged on the shank rod and drive the foot support assembly to conduct flexion and extension motion and inward and outward turning motion correspondingly. According to the motion decoupling parallel drive type exoskeleton robot ankle joint, a motion decoupling parallel drive structure of the motion decoupling parallel drive type exoskeleton robot ankle joint has the characteristics of two rotation freedom degrees, good structural rigidity, high overall gravity center and small foot end inertia, ankle joint active motion assistance of two freedom degrees of dorsiflexion/plantar flexion and inward turning/outward turning is achieved, and the wearing comfort, motion flexibility and stability of the human body are improved.
title: Motion decoupling parallel drive type exoskeleton robot ankle joint

abstract: The invention discloses a five-leg biomimetic robot mechanism which comprises a trunk, mechanical legs and a control device. An upper regular pentagon supporting plate and a lower regular pentagon supporting plate are fixed through a supporting rod to form the trunk, the control device comprises a control circuit board, a driver and a power supply, the control device is mounted in the trunk, same mechanical legs are mounted at five apexes of the trunk respectively, each mechanical leg is a four-free-degree serial mechanism, three digital rudder controllers are mounted on each mechanical leg and control the revolving pairs respectively, the revolving pairs are connected through swing rods, a supporting disk is arranged at the tail end of each leg, and the contact area between each mechanical leg and the ground is enlarged. According to the five-leg biomimetic robot mechanism, joints in each leg are serially connected, multiple legs are parallelly connected and coordinated, steering can be achieved without rotating the robot trunk when movement direction is changed, and the robot mechanism has the advantages that the mechanism is light in body, high in stability and high in carrying capacity, the mechanism rapidly steers when walking and the like.
title: Five-leg biomimetic robot mechanism

abstract: A Stewart platform includes six electromagnetic linear actuators, each provided with a cylindrical bering and positioned encoder. The actuators are surrounded by a crash ring made of cushioning material to absorb shocks in case of power loses of the platform. Such a motion platform may be included in an apparatus and method for testing footwear where a stationary shoe is truc k by the platform in a manner simulating the running or walking gait.
title: MOTION PLATFORM AND METHOD OF USE

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of manipulators, in particular to an exoskeleton robot hip joint direct-drive power assisting device which comprises a waist and back assembly, a connecting assembly and a hip assembly, the waist and back assembly comprises a bearing unit, the bearing unit comprises a waist plate, the connecting assembly is arranged on the lower portion of one side of the waist plate, and the hip assembly is arranged on the lower portion of the other side of the waist plate. The hip assembly is movably connected to the lower portion of the connecting assembly, the hip assembly comprises a power device and a leg connecting piece, the leg connecting piece comprises a connecting body and a leg binding piece, and the connecting body comprises a first horizontal part, a first bent part, a first vertical part, a second bent part and a second vertical part; the fitness of the human body is good, the man-machine collaboration is high during wearing, the movement is flexible and comfortable, and the assistance effect is good.
title: Exoskeleton robot hip joint direct-drive power assisting device

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot posture control method and device and a robot. The method comprises the steps that a first joint angular speed of the robot is obtained according to a balance control algorithm; a second joint angular velocity of the robot is obtained according to a momentum planning algorithm; a third joint angular speed of the robot is obtained according to a posture zero returning control algorithm; and the posture of the robot is controlled according to the first joint angular speed, the second joint angular speed and the third joint angular speed. By means of the robot posture control method and device and the robot, rotation of the robot trunk in the balance control process can be effectively reduced, the robot is controlled to recover to the initial posture, and therefore the robot overturning phenomenon is avoided.
title: Robot posture control method and device and robot

abstract: The invention discloses a modularized flexible climbing robot. The robot comprises four foot modules, four stretchable modules and four connecting modules. Each connecting module is formed by fixedlyconnecting three adjacent and perpendicular installing plates, the bottom face of each connecting module is fixedly connected with one foot module, every two adjacent connecting modules are connectedthrough one stretchable module, and the four stretchable modules and the four connecting modules are alternately connected in the annular axial direction to form a square structure; each stretchable module is formed by butt joint of a clockwise turning actuator and an anti-clockwise turning actuator; the side hook faces of the turning actuators are sealed, wrapped and connected between the peripheries of the upper and lower bottom faces, and the whole turning actuators form a sealing air chamber; each foot module is mainly composed of the turning actuator additionally provided with a suction cup and a suction cup silica gel tube. By adopting the walking gait, the wriggling gait, the rotating gait and various motion patterns, the smoothness, the flexibility and the impact bearing capabilityare greatly improved compared with a traditional robot.
title: Modularized flexible climbing robot

abstract: The invention discloses a longitudinal robot hip structure and a robot, and relates to the field of robots. The robot hip structure comprises a hip joint frame, a waist main frame, a first motor, a second motor and a third motor. The hip joint frame is rotatably mounted at the relative lower part of the waist main frame; the third motor is installed on the relative upper portion of the waist main frame. An upper fixing opening extending in the X-axis direction is formed in the relative upper portion of the upper base, and a lower containing opening is formed in the relative lower portion of the upper base. The lower seat is rotatably mounted in the lower accommodating opening around the X axis; the first motor is installed on the upper fixing opening and used for driving the upper rotating piece to rotate around the X axis and driving the lower rotating piece to rotate through the connecting rod. The second motor is mounted at the lower fixing opening and is used for driving the leg connecting block to rotate around the Y axis; the output end of the third motor is connected to the upper base and used for driving the upper base to rotate around the Z axis. According to the scheme, the problems that the motor connecting structure from the hip to the thigh of the robot on the X-axis, the Y-axis and the Z-axis is complex, large space is occupied, and movement and attractiveness are affected are solved.
title: Longitudinal robot hip structure and robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and relates to an exoskeleton robot knee joint based on an electromagnetic clutch. The exoskeleton robot knee joint based on the electromagnetic clutch comprises a shank connecting piece, a crossed roller bearing, a coil assembly, a thigh connecting piece and a clutch positioning assembly. The shank connecting piece and the thigh connecting piece are connected through the crossed roller bearing so that the knee joint can flexibly rotate, the coil assembly is fixedly arranged in the thigh connecting piece, the clutch positioning assembly comprises a rotating shaft sliding platform, and the rotating shaft sliding platform penetrates through the crossed roller bearing, the coil assembly and the thigh connecting piece and then is fixedly connected with the shank connecting piece. The coil assembly is engaged with and separated from a gear ring of the clutch positioning assembly by powering on and powering off the coil assembly, and finally locking and unlocking between the shank connecting piece and the thigh connecting piece are implemented.
title: Exoskeleton robot knee joint based on electromagnetic clutch

abstract: The invention discloses a human body walking posture real-time prediction method and system based on a deep learning algorithm, and relates to the technical field of computer vision and digital twinning. The method specifically comprises a data acquisition step, a training step, a walking posture prediction step, a virtual human display step, a judgment step and a Web system real-time early warning step. The deep learning algorithm and the digital twinborn technology are combined, prediction and early warning can be performed on whether an abnormal posture occurs in the future or not according to the human body walking posture, meanwhile, the human body walking posture data are collected through the infrared camera, and the prediction result can be visually presented through the virtual human image. And the privacy and dignity of people are effectively protected while the health and safety of the human body are guaranteed.
title: Human body walking posture real-time prediction method and system based on deep learning algorithm

abstract: PURPOSE: A walking planning method for a biped robot is provided to optimize a unit vector field for securing shortest time, walking stability, and minimized energy consumption. CONSTITUTION: A walking planning method for a biped robot is as follows. A CS(Command State) including information about the steps of a biped robot is determined based on a unit vector field navigation method(S5). The trajectories of all the leg joints of the biped robot are calculated using the CS(S10).
title: Footstep Planning Method for Bipedal Robot

abstract: The invention discloses a home service robot. The home service robot comprises a robot upper body, the lower end outer surface of the robot upper body is provided with a robot leg portion, the outer surface of one side of the robot leg portion is fixedly provided with an umbrella spin-dry device, the rear end outer surface of the robot leg portion is fixedly provided with a frequently-used articleplacement mechanism, the lower end outer surface of the robot leg portion is provided with a robot moving base, and the rear end outer surface of the robot moving base is provided with weight carrying moving equipment. According to the home service robot, by means of the umbrella spin-dry device, spin-dry can be performed on a wet umbrella in a rainy day, people bring the umbrella indoors conveniently, and use for the people is facilitated; by means of the weight carrying moving equipment, physical power consumption of the people can be reduced, and the people are made to work more efficiently; and by means of the frequently-used article placement mechanism, time for the people to look for articles can be saved, the people are made to be more comfortable, and the use for the people is facilitated.
title: Home service robot

abstract: The robot trunk comprises a robot trunk body, the robot trunk body is provided with a plurality of female end interfaces, unlocking buttons are symmetrically arranged on the upper side and the lower side, close to the female end interfaces, of the robot trunk body, and a system state indicator lamp, a starting button and a power indicator lamp are arranged at one end, in the length direction, of the robot trunk body; a USB interface is arranged on one side of the robot body in the length direction. The number of the female end interfaces is seven. The female end interface is formed by combining a female end cover and two semicircular female end fixing seats, the female end cover is fixedly connected with the two semicircular female end fixing seats through screws, a hexagonal column hole is formed in the female end cover, and a near-field signal receiving circuit board is nested in the female end cover and is annular; the semicircular female end fixing base is provided with a button supporting base connected with the unlocking button, the button supporting base is provided with a spring bolt, and the female end connector is used for being connected with a structure moving element. The system state indicating lamp is used for indicating the initialization, readiness, program downloading, operation, abnormity and other states of the system.
title: Robot trunk capable of being quickly inserted and pulled

abstract: The invention discloses an integrated ankle-foot system for improving walking stability of a biped robot. The integrated ankle-foot system comprises a robot shank and ankle drive transmission system, a two-degree-of-freedom ankle joint, a bionic design foot and a foot sensing and data processing module, wherein the ankle drive transmission system is integrated in the internal space of a shank, the foot sensing and data processing module is integrated in a foot body, and the whole system is compact in design and high in integration degree. The foot part comprises a half sole passive joint and a heel buffering module, the road surface impact on the foot part can be effectively buffered, human gait-simulated walking is achieved, and the stability and the movement capacity of the robot are improved. A parallel linear driving system is integrated at the shank of the system, so that the ankle drive performance is ensured, and meanwhile, the exposure of parts of a driving transmission system is reduced. Various sensors in the system are used for collecting posture information of the road surface and the ankle-foot system, and adaptive posture adjustment of the ankle-foot system on the uneven road surface is achieved through the data processing module.
title: Integrated ankle-foot system for improving walking stability of biped robot

abstract: The invention provides a robot trunk provided with an engine and a control method of the robot trunk. The robot trunk comprises a driving section, a middle section and a driven section, wherein at least one swinging hydraulic cylinder is arranged at the upper part of the driving section, a liquid fuel engine and a hydraulic pump are arranged in the driving section, and the liquid fuel engine, thehydraulic pump and the swinging hydraulic cylinder share one casting skeleton; fixed pulleys and hinges are arranged at the front part and the rear part of the middle section; fixed pulleys and hingesare arranged at the front part and the rear part of the driven section; the driving section, the middle section and the driven section are sequentially connected through the respective hinges; the liquid fuel engine starts an output shaft to rotate forwards, the robot trunk provided with the engine bends due to the gravity, and the robot trunk stops bending when the liquid fuel engine stops; theliquid fuel engine starts the output shaft to rotate reversely, the robot trunk provided with the engine is straightened on the basis of the lever principle, and the straightening state is kept when the liquid fuel engine stops.
title: Robot trunk provided with engine and control method of robot trunk

abstract: The invention relates to the field of engineering machinery, in particular to a wheel-leg-track composite chassis with retractable wheel legs, which comprises a chassis frame, tracks, wheel-leg arms and leg wheels, the tracks are respectively mounted on two sides of the chassis in the width direction, the wheel-leg arms are arranged between the tracks on two sides and connected with the chassis frame, and the leg wheels are connected with the wheel-leg arms. One end, not connected with the chassis frame, of each wheel leg arm is provided with a supporting leg wheel; the wheel-leg arms are movably installed on the chassis frame through the wheel-leg driving assemblies, and the wheel-leg driving assemblies drive the wheel-leg arms to extend towards the outer side of the chassis frame and can drive the wheel-leg arms to rotate relative to the chassis frame so as to adjust the installation angles of the wheel-leg arms relative to the chassis frame. The wheel leg arms of the chassis can retract into the chassis frame under the action of the wheel leg driving assemblies, the space of the top of the chassis frame is not occupied, the adaptability of the chassis can be improved, and the trafficability of equipment installed on the chassis when the equipment travels on some road sections with limited heights can also be improved.
title: Wheel-leg-track combined type chassis with retractable wheel legs

abstract: The invention discloses an exoskeleton robot lower limb mechanism with adjustable length. The mechanism comprises an outer rod, an inner rod, a nut, a bolt, an outer rod power support, an outer rod length adjusting hole, a slot, a rotary shaft support plate, an outer rod joint rotary shaft, an outer rod joint rotary shaft hole and an inner rod joint arc. The inner rod joint arc is coaxial with the connected joint connecting rod; the outer rod and the inner rod are mounted together by the bolt and the nut, and the outer rod length adjusting hole can be matched with any inner rod length adjusting hole. The mechanism can be adjusted to different lengths according to the height of users.
title: Exoskeleton robot lower limb mechanism with adjustable length

abstract: The invention discloses a control method of a multi-legged bionic ship spraying robot, and relates to the technical field of ship spraying, ship surface information of a current drop point and a next drop point of a leg is obtained, the posture of the robot is combined, and the starting mode of an electromagnet is controlled; and the attraction force of the electromagnet on each leg is determined by reading the pressure value of the pressure sensor, so that the attraction force of the electromagnets is adjusted, and efficient self-adaptive control is realized, thereby ensuring that the robot can cope with the change of the surface of the ship, providing a guarantee for the reliable work of the robot, and achieving the purposes of energy conservation and consumption reduction. In addition, the central control system can determine the walking gait mode of the robot according to the current ship surface state, and the working capacity and the moving capacity of the robot on the complex surface are ensured; meanwhile, the central control system controls all joints of the mechanical arm to rotate, so that the spray gun uniformly moves relative to the surface of the ship, and uniform spraying is ensured; and spraying quality detection can be automatically carried out after spraying is completed.
title: Control method of multi-legged bionic ship spraying robot

abstract: The invention discloses a robot information determination method and device, equipment, a robot and a medium. In some embodiments of the invention, the plate springs are mounted on the advancing feet of the robot, and the landing impact in the walking process of the robot can be buffered due to the elastic deformation characteristic of the plate springs, so that the walking stability is improved; by obtaining the joint deformation information of the target advancing foot of the robot, the plate spring deformation information of the plate spring can be obtained, and then the sole stress information of the target advancing foot can be accurately determined through the plate spring deformation information; a force sensor with high cost is not needed, and the plate spring with low cost is adopted, so that sole stress information with high accuracy can be obtained.
title: Robot information determination method, device and equipment, robot and medium

abstract: The invention relates to a biped robot motion control method based on human body motion collaborative analysis, belongs to the technical field of robot control, and solves the problem that the motion personification degree of an existing robot is low. Comprising the following steps: pre-collecting and processing human body motion data in different motion scenes, calculating motion primitives and weight coefficients in each motion scene, and putting the motion primitives and the weight coefficients into a primitive database; the state data of the biped robot are collected in real time, the current motion scene of the biped robot is recognized, the expected mass center track and the expected foot end motion track of the biped robot are calculated according to the current motion scene and the primitive database, then a whole-body control algorithm is adopted to execute a plurality of control subtasks, and the optimal joint torque is solved. And the optimal joint torque is converted into a control signal of an actuator, and movement of the biped robot is controlled and tracked. And the movement personification degree of the robot is improved.
title: Biped robot motion control method based on human body motion collaborative analysis

abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot kinematic analysis method based on toddler gait extraction. The method comprises the following steps: (1) walking videos of a toddler in different months are acquired, and corresponding supporting phases, oscillating phases, uniped or biped supporting phases, a gait cycle and a step frequency are extracted; (2) based on a D-H pose conversion method, a human lower limb coordinate system is built, skeletons of thighs, lower legs and soles are regarded as connecting rods, parts driving the skeletons to move are regarded as joints connecting the connecting rods, and a corresponding D-H parameter table is solved; (3) a forward kinematic model and an inverse kinematic model of the lower limb are solved; and (4) change values of joint angles are subjected tocurve fitting to analyze the spatial characteristics of a toddler walking gait. On the basis of acquiring the toddler walking data and extracting the gait time parameters, the forward kinematic modeland the inverse kinematic model of the lower limb are deduced based on the D-H pose conversion method, a toddler gait development space parameter change law is thus acquired, and a theoretical supportcan be provided for gait planning for the biped robot.
title: Biped robot kinematic analysis method based on toddler gait extraction

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot lower limb capable of being replaced quickly. The robot lower limb comprises a thigh joint, a first hydraulic rod, a mounting shell, a thigh, a knee joint, a shank, an ankle joint and a foot. During jumping, the impact force borne by a limb body is increased, at the moment, the impact force borne by the limb body extrudes corresponding second hydraulic rods through transmission of mounting columns, connecting rods, friction arc plates and guide arc plates, the hydraulic rods have certain telescopic resistance, so that swing of the mounting columns and the connecting rods on the lower side is blocked, under the condition, the impact force of the bottom surface to the limb body is transmitted upwards, a second buffer spring in a second buffer mechanism is compressed, a friction cambered surface is in contact friction with the upper side face of a second sliding groove in a second cambered surface guide rail, and through friction braking, the situation that the limb body continues to swing rapidly under the impact force, the telescopic resistance of the second hydraulic rods is too large, and internal breakage is caused is prevented.
title: Robot lower limb capable of being replaced quickly

abstract: The invention relates to a robot lower limb device and a robot. The robot lower limb device comprises thighs, shanks, transmission assemblies, driving assemblies and feet. The thigh part and the shank part are rotationally connected through the transmission assembly; the driving assembly is used for driving the transmission assembly to drive the thigh part and the shank part to relatively bend or stretch; the foot part is connected to one end, far away from the thigh part, of the shank part; the robot further comprises an electromagnetic acceleration assembly, and the electromagnetic acceleration assembly is used for driving the transmission assembly to move in an accelerated mode within preset time so as to drive the shank part to bend or stretch in an accelerated mode relative to the thigh part. The method has the advantage that the simulation accuracy and the operation stability are improved.
title: Robot lower limb device and robot

abstract: Disclosed are a walking assistance robot system capable of improving walking stability by operating a robot after determining whether a proper weight balance is maintained when operating a walking assistance robot for a paraplegic patient who requires usage of a crutches, and a control method thereof. The walking assistance robot system comprises: a walking assistance robot including links fixated to a wearer lower limb, joints between links, and a joint operation unit to operate the joints; a left and right crutches to support a wearer in front of a walking direction of the walking assistance robot in a state of being held by both hands of the wearer; a plurality of sensors to detect each ground reaction force caused by legs of the wearer and a ground reaction force caused by the crutches; and a controller to determine a walking intention of the wearer based on each ground reaction force detected from the sensors, and controlling the joint operation unit in accordance with the determined walking intention.
title: WALKING ASSISTANC ROBOT SYSTEM AND CONTROL METHOD THEREFOR

abstract: The invention discloses a wheel-foot composite mobile robot. Relates to the technical field of walking robots, and comprises a robot trunk, an energy supply bin is arranged in the robot trunk, an induction side detection assembly is arranged on the robot trunk, movable grooves are symmetrically formed in the left side and the right side of the robot trunk, two movable grooves are formed in each side of the robot trunk at intervals, and a fixed buffer assembly and a driving motor are arranged in each movable groove; the driving motor is electrically connected with the energy supply bin; and the driving mechanisms are arranged in the movable grooves, the number of the driving mechanisms is four, the driving mechanisms are arranged corresponding to the fixed buffering assemblies, each driving mechanism comprises a wheel-foot combined type driving assembly and a wheel-foot switching assembly, and the wheel-foot switching assemblies are arranged on the wheel-foot combined type driving assemblies. The robot trunk and the driving mechanism are arranged, the movement reliability is not sacrificed while continuously changing road conditions are dealt with, wheel foot movement modes are switched, the robot can be suitable for outdoor complex environments to the maximum extent, and therefore the outdoor movement operation requirement is met.
title: Wheel-foot composite mobile robot

abstract: The invention discloses a seven-connecting-rod biped robot building method and a hybrid control method based on ZMP and CPG, and belongs to the field of artificial intelligence and robot control. The invention designs a small biped robot, the robot comprises a control module, a driving module, a sensor module and a power supply module, and has the characteristics that the open source property is strong, a bottom layer drive can be built by the robot, and environmental perception can be fully performed, and the ZMP and CPG hybrid control method is provided based on the robot. The zero moment point of the robot is measured and calculated through a pressure sensor module of the robot, the deviation between an actual zero moment point and an expected zero moment point serves as compensation and is fed back to open-loop CPG control, closed-loop control of the system is achieved, and walking stability is improved. According to the invention, the biped robot can have higher open source performance and environment perception capability, and the hybrid control method can enable the robot to realize closed-loop control of a robot walking system on the premise of avoiding huge calculated amount.
title: Design of seven-connecting-rod biped robot and hybrid control method based on ZMP and CPG

abstract: The invention relates to a nuclide labeling robot. The nuclide labeling robot comprises a robot body and a clamping sleeve arranged on the robot body detachably; the robot body comprises a robot upperbody, a movable base and two robot arms, a platform is arranged on the top of the movable base, the platform is provided with a clamping groove matched with the clamping sleeve, the two robot arms include a grabbing arm and a suction head arm, the robot upper body is further provided with a camera and an activity detection assembly, and the activity detection assembly is connected to the robot upper body through a lifting arm. According to the nuclide labeling robot, automatic labeling, finished product transfer, waste liquid collection and other work of nuclide can be achieved, manual operation is not needed, the radiation injury to an operator due to the radioactive element is avoided, meanwhile, the operation efficiency is greatly improved, and the operation precision is greatly improved.
title: Nuclide labeling robot

abstract: The invention provides a robot motion control method and device, a controller and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control. The method comprises the steps that a whole-body angular momentum vector of a robot in each posture is calculated according to a pre-planned whole-body motion track of the robot; according to the whole-body angular momentum vector of each posture, the whole-body angular momentum vector of the posture before each posture and a preset time interval, the angular momentum change rate of the robot in each posture is calculated, and the preset time interval is the time interval between every two adjacent postures; a target centroid track of the robot is calculated according to the angular momentum change rate and a pre-planned zero moment point track of the robot; and motion control is performed on the robot according to the target centroid track. According to the robot motion control method and device, the controller and the storage medium, the walking stability of the robot can be improved.
title: Robot motion control method and device, controller and storage medium

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot structure design, and discloses a robot arm with a form switching function, a robot leg and a robot. Comprising robot arms with a form switching function, robot legs with a form switching function, a robot head, a robot trunk part and a robot crossing part, and the robot head and the robot trunk part are movably connected through a first connecting structure; robot arms with a form switching function are mounted on the two sides of the robot trunk, and the lower end of the robot trunk is movably connected with the robot straddle part through a second connecting structure; the robot has the advantage of meeting the requirements of fast and stable walking and flexible operation at the same time.
title: Robot arm with form switching function, robot leg and robot

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of manipulators, in particular to an exoskeleton robot upper limb power assisting device which comprises a supporting assembly, an elastic assembly, a reversing assembly, a hook assembly and a waist assembly. The supporting assembly comprises a first mounting seat, a connecting piece and a second mounting seat, the first mounting seat is fixedly connected with one end of the connecting piece in the vertical direction, and the second mounting seat is fixedly connected with the other end of the connecting piece in the vertical direction; the elastic assembly comprises a first elastic unit and a second elastic unit, the first elastic unit is arranged on one side of the connecting piece, and the second elastic unit is arranged on the other side of the connecting piece; the reversing assembly comprises a first reversing unit and a second reversing unit, the first reversing unit is fixedly connected with the outer side of one end of the second installation base in the vertical direction, and the second reversing unit is fixedly connected with the outer side of the other end of the second installation base in the vertical direction. The power assisting device has high synergy and a good power assisting effect.
title: Upper limb power assisting device of exoskeleton robot

abstract: The invention discloses a mechanical bionic walking mechanism. The mechanical bionic walking mechanism comprises a machine body and walking leg connection rod mechanisms. The machine body is in a square or box shape, and used for storing a driving device and a power source. The four pairs of walking leg connection rod mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on the outer side of the machine body, theconnection rod mechanisms are driven to simulate a walking gait in a driven mode by driving a crankwheel at the front end to rotate, four legs cooperate with one another to achieve the walking function, a front crankwheel and a rear crankwheel on the same side are connected and driven by a synchronous belt, the front walking leg connection rod mechanisms walk in a driving mode, and rear walking leg connection rods move in a following mode. The mechanical bionic walking mechanism simulates a tetrapod operation mechanism by adopting the mechanical connection rod mechanisms, has the advantages of being simple in structure, convenient to mount, easy to control and the like, and can be suitable for various kinds of different geographical occasions.
title: Mechanical bionic walking mechanism

abstract: The invention relates to a drive device that can cause a sled toy to swing automatically and a sled comprising the drive device. The technical proposal employed is that the drive device which can cause the sled toy to swing automatically comprises a core and a base, wherein, the core is connected in the base through a shaft flange in a pivotal way; the base is arranged on the sled; the core comprises a shell and a transmission mechanism; the transmission mechanism comprises a television set that is mutually parallel to a shaft, a drive shaft for swinging movement, a drive shaft for rippling movement and a coalition of a large transmission gear wheel and a small transmission gear wheel. The sled comprising the drive device that can cause the sled toy to swing automatically comprises the sled and an ornament; the drive device is arranged in the ornament; the ornament is a Father Christmas who stands on the sled by riding a horse. The head and arms of Father Christmas are fixed on the top end of an undulated mandril and the legs thereof are fixed at the bottom of the base that is fixed on a horse back, and the horse is fixedly connected with the sled.
title: Device capable of automatically swinging sleigh toy and sleigh having the driving device

abstract: The invention discloses a real-time remote sensing control method for a walking double-arm robot, and particularly relates to the technical field of remote sensing control, and the method specifically comprises the following steps: presetting a mimicry walking path of the double-arm robot in a background server, video data in the walking process of the double-arm robot is collected through an image collecting device, and state information is transmitted to a background server provided with an action real-time control program through the Ethernet to be comprehensively processed; the collected video data is automatically matched with a mimicry walking path; the current state of the double-arm robot is corrected by using an automatic correction program; and the action which should be executed by the double-arm robot in the next step is calculated by using an action real-time control program, and the control information of the action is transmitted back to the double-arm robot through the Ethernet. Real-time accurate control over the double-arm robot in the walking process can be achieved, and therefore the walking stability of the robot is ensured.
title: Real-time remote sensing control method for walking double-arm robot

abstract: The invention discloses a walking wheel with retractable supporting legs. The walking wheel comprises a tire and a spoke plate connected to one side of the tire, a plurality of supporting legs arranged in the circumferential direction of the tire are arranged on the other side of the spoke plate of the tire, the multiple supporting legs are hinged to a base in the tire and define a circle on one side of the tire, and supporting leg covers are arranged on the outer sides of the supporting legs; the walking wheel controls unfolding or folding of the supporting legs through a hydraulic folding and unfolding mechanism. When a driving posture is switched into a walking posture, a gear and rack mechanism drives the supporting legs and a base to horizontally move towards the outer sides of the wheels together, so that the supporting legs have space to be unfolded, and the hydraulic folding and unfolding mechanism is connected with the supporting legs to provide the supporting force; when thewalking posture is switched into the running posture, the supporting legs are folded, the gear and rack mechanism drives the supporting legs and the base to return to the initial positions, and therefore the robot can rapidly run on a good straight road surface and can also achieve walking, passing or obstacle crossing and other operations under complex road conditions.
title: Walking wheel with retractable supporting legs

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of motorized tools, and particularly relates to a Bowden cable power-assisted flexible lower limb multi-joint exoskeleton robot and a control method. The robot can assist the hip and knee joints of the lower limbs when a human body walks; a reversing bevel gear set, a two-way wire spool and an electromagnetic clutch are adopted, so that a single motor assists hip joint extension and knee joint bending in the left leg and the right leg of the lower limb; the prediction of the walking gait position and the gait period is realized through inertial measurement units mounted on the two sides of the left leg and the right leg; in the control system, an upper computer drives a motor through dspace to drive hip and knee joints of lower limbs to move, an inertial measurement unit performs angle feedback, and normalized gait prediction is realized. Through a designed dynamic model, PD iterative control and fuzzy PID control, the tracking of the hip and knee joint expected power-assisted curve is realized.
title: Bowden cable assisted flexible lower limb multi-joint exoskeleton robot and control method

abstract: The invention relates to the field of intelligent robots, and discloses an intelligent robot walking control system based on bionic collaboration, which effectively solves the problem that when one mechanical foot of an existing robot is lifted, the walking balance is easy to weaken, and the robot is unbalanced and topples, and comprises a trunk, and mechanical foot bodies are symmetrically mounted at the bottom end of the trunk; the mechanical foot body is divided into a left mechanical foot body and a right mechanical foot body, the left mechanical foot body corresponds to a left leg of a human body, and the right mechanical foot body corresponds to a right leg of the human body. Due to the fact that the screw rod is in threaded connection with the balancing weight, and the balancing weight is in sliding connection with the inner wall of the moving groove, the balancing weight moves downwards, the gravity center of the robot falls on the mechanical bottom foot of the supported mechanical foot body, and the walking stability of the robot is improved.
title: Intelligent robot walking control system based on bionic cooperation

abstract: The invention discloses a method for distinguishing human body balance obstacles based on multiple features and SVM. The method comprises the steps that firstly, shooting human body walking posture videos of a normal person and an abnormal person in a built virtual scene simulating reality according to the angle of 90 degrees with the front face when a human body walks; then, respectively extracting acquired walking posture videos of the normal person and the abnormal person into images, preprocessing the extracted images, and respectively extracting SIFT features, Hu invariant moment featuresand PHOG features of the preprocessed images of the normal person and the abnormal person; finally, fusing and training the obtained SIFT features, Hu invariant moment features and PHOG features through an SVM, acquiring a human body balance ability classification model and judging and classifying people with balance ability disorder. According to the method disclosed by the invention, the threefeatures of the human body posture image are collected, the people with the balance ability disorder are judged and classified, and the final classification accuracy is 87% or above.
title: Method for distinguishing human body balance obstacles based on multiple features and SVM

abstract: The invention relates to a hydraulic hexapod robot and a walking gait control method based on mass center fluctuation, which belong to the technical field of robots. The robot comprises a body and three hydraulic mechanical legs arranged on the two sides of the body respectively. Each hydraulic mechanical leg comprises a root joint, a hip joint, a thigh rod, a knee joint, a shank rod and a foot end fixedly arranged on the shank rod, and the gait control method comprises the steps that the hydraulic mechanical legs are controlled to walk according to the three-foot gait according to the plannedfoot end track, so that the mass center track of the six-foot walking robot is a cosine curve track; specifically, under a calcaneal joint coordinate system, the components of the foot end track in the advancing direction and the vertical direction are all sextic polynomials, and displacement, speed and acceleration are continuous. Compared with a control method for keeping the mass center heightapproximately unchanged in the prior art, the control method provided by the invention has the advantages that the average flow and average power of the robot in one gait period can be effectively reduced through the gait with the fluctuated mass center, so that the energy utilization rate is effectively increased, and the method can be widely applied to the technical field of robots.
title: Hydraulic hexapod robot and walking gait control method based on mass center fluctuation

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a double-narrow-foot robot. The double-narrow-foot robot comprises a top plate, a control panel, copper columns, U-shaped connecting pieces, steering engines and foot plates. The copper columns include first copper columns and second copper columns. The U-shaped connecting pieces include first U-shaped connecting pieces, second U-shaped connecting pieces, third U-shaped connecting pieces, fourth U-shaped connecting pieces and fifth U-shaped connecting pieces. The steering engines include first steering engines, second steering engines and third steering engines. The top plate and the control panel are fixedly connected through the first copper columns and keep parallel. The lower surface of the control panel 3 is correspondingly connected with bases of the two first U-shaped connecting pieces through fixing connecting pieces respectively. The double-narrow-foot robot has the advantages that the walking stability is improved, and the single step length during walking is increased.
title: Double-narrow-foot robot

abstract: The invention relates to a dual-mode passive ankle power-assisted exoskeleton, and belongs to the technical field of wearable power-assisted machinery. The dual-mode passive ankle power-assisted exoskeleton solves the technical problems that the walking gait of a wearer is unnatural due to the fact that an existing exoskeleton exerts additional load on a human body due to the own weight and an elastic element of the exoskeleton exerts resistance to movement of an ankle joint.
