The dual-mode passive ankle power-assisted exoskeleton comprises a calf mechanism, a mode switching device, a calf length adjusting rod, a spring, a rope, a pre-tightening mechanism, a tension sensor, an ankle joint mechanism and a sole support plate. The mode switching device is arranged on the calf mechanism, and the calf mechanism is connected with the ankle joint mechanism through the calf length adjusting rod. The sole support plate is disposed under the ankle joint mechanism. The spring is connected with themode switching device and the pre-tightening mechanism through the rope, and the pre-tightening mechanism is disposed on the ankle joint mechanism. The dual-mode passive ankle power-assisted exoskeleton can provide assistant power for an ankle, reduces the metabolic energy consumption of the human body, and does not affect the normal gait of the wearer.
title: Dual-mode passive ankle power-assisted exoskeleton

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and relates to a bionic three-axis intersection type exoskeleton robot hip joint. The bionic three-axis intersection type exoskeleton robot hip joint comprises a left hip joint and a right hip joint which are symmetrically arranged; the right hip joint comprises an inward folding/outward unfolding assembly, an inward rotation/outward rotation assembly, a forward bending/backward stretching assembly, an upper-layer remote rotation center mechanism assembly and a lower-layer remote rotation center mechanism assembly; the inward rotation/outward rotation assembly drives the forward bending/backward stretching assembly to do inward rotation or outward rotation through the upper-layer remote rotation center mechanism assembly and the lower-layer remote rotation center mechanism assembly; and the forward bending/backward stretching assembly drives a thigh rod piece to do forward bending or backward stretching motion. According to the exoskeleton hip joint, active motion assistance with three degrees of freedom of forward bending/backward stretching, inward folding/outward unfolding and inward rotation/outward rotation is achieved, the motion flexibility is improved, the three rotating shafts are intersected at the center of the human body hip joint, no motion deviation exists, and the wearing comfort is improved.
title: Bionic three-axis intersection type exoskeleton robot hip joint

abstract: The invention discloses a bionic cockroach specialized robot in an unstructured environment. The robot is divided into four parts, namely a shell, a control device, a mechanical mechanism and a camera module. The shell, the control device, the mechanical mechanism and the camera module cooperate with one another, and the operation function of the robot in the special environment is achieved. The control device serves as the core of the whole robot, the walking gait and speed of the robot are controlled by controlling the motors, the walking gait of the robot determines the angular speed of rotation of the motors on one hand and also determines the unique leg mechanical structure of the robot on the other hand, under driving of rotating shafts of the motors, six-foot structures are matched with one another, and the functions of walking, steering and obstacle crossing at different speeds are completed, so that special operation is completed. According to the invention, special operation is carried out in an unstructured terrain by using the characteristics of rapidness, flexibility and compactness, and an observed image can be returned by configuring a camera.
title: Bionic cockroach specialized robot in unstructured environment

abstract: The invention discloses a multi-information fusion human exoskeleton robot control protection system. The system comprises a plurality of inertia measurement assemblies, a plurality of electromyogramsensors, respiration sensors, a depth camera and machine learning processing computers, wherein the inertia measurement assemblies and the electromyogram sensors are installed at arms and legs of a human body, the respiration sensors are installed on a chest, the depth camera is worn on a head, and the machine learning processing computers are installed at any position of the human body; effectivedata acquired by all the sensors at a certain moment are used as input of an LSTM neural network based on a BPTT algorithm, the sum of time consumed by processing a machine learning algorithm throughthe computers and the maximum delay time of receiving control signals by a steering engine at each position of the robot from the moment is used as a time interval, a control signal representing a movement intention of the human body at the moment after the time interval is used as output, a nonlinear function mapping relation which is difficult to express through an analytic expression in engineering is established through neural network training, the movement intention of the human body at the next moment is judged through the action at the moment, so that a function that the correspondingcontrol signal is output is achieved.
title: Multi-information fusion human exoskeleton robot control protection system

abstract: The invention discloses a lifting type conveying robot. The robot can effectively improve the walking stability and smoothness, and when the robot is lifted, a lifting conveying platform of a to-be-lifted conveying sub-robot performs vertical lifting guiding on a front conveying sub-robot in front of the to-be-lifted conveying sub-robot and a rear conveying sub-robot at the back of the to-be-lifted conveying sub-robot, so that the stability of the lifting conveying platform in the lifting process is improved; in this way, followed by recycling, the smoothness of running of all the conveying sub-robots can be guaranteed. Accordingly, a base plate of the robot can be arranged to be of a light structure, the flexibility of the robot is effectively improved, and the conveying sub-robot runningspeed is guaranteed; detection positioning assemblies are arranged in front of and at the back of a walking assembly, a buffer anti-collision assembly is arranged in front of the walking assembly, the front conveying sub-robot and the rear conveying sub-robot can be effectively positioned, and the mutual guiding stability is improved; an annular rail base is adopted, the annular circulating conveying action can be achieved, and the robot is suitable for batched product or cargo conveying.
title: Lifting type conveying robot

abstract: The invention discloses a crawling robot hip device suitable for a slope road surface and control, belongs to the technical field of robots, and solves the problems that a crawling robot hip in the prior art is lack of an efficient damping mechanism, and machine body pose regulating efficiency on the slope road surface is low. The crawling robot hip device comprises a machine body, a supporting mechanism, a regulating joint and a control system, wherein the supporting mechanism comprises a supporting frame, a suspending frame, a central rotary shaft and a fastening device; the regulating jointcomprises a left regulating joint and a right regulating joint; the regulating joint adopts a damping mechanism, and can effectively buffer impact, on the machine body, of ground in case of not affecting travelling efficiency; for solving the problem that machine body pose regulating efficiency is not high, the control system adopts RBF setting PID control based on a speed-up rate, introduces speed-up rate parameters into RBF setting PID, performs amplitude limitation on PID parameters, can guarantee machine body pose regulating precision, also can improve regulating efficiency, shortens timeof passing through the slope road surface, of the climbing robot, and reduces energy loss of a step motor.
title: Crawling robot hip device suitable for slope road surface and control

abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot space domain gait planning and control method which comprises the following steps: setting the horizontal distance of a biped robot hip joint relative to a supporting leg ankle joint as a phase variable delta, and designing and optimizing a swing leg joint reference angle track based on the phase variable according to a current state, a reference step length and a reference speed; swinging leg gait planning in a space domain is completed; a second-order inverted pendulum model is established, and a support leg hip joint reference moment for speed control is optimized through nonlinear model prediction control; after the swing leg joint reference angle track and the supporting leg hip joint reference torque are obtained, the joint torque is optimized in a multi-target task through whole-body dynamics Quadratic Programming control, and then gait walking of the robot is controlled. According to the method, the motion of swinging the ankle joint is separated from the time, so that the ankle joint only depends on the own state, and the robustness is enhanced.
title: Biped robot space domain gait planning and control method

abstract: The mechanical structure comprises a machine body structure and a plurality of leg structures evenly distributed along the outline of the machine body structure, and the leg structures are connected with the machine body structure through fixing assemblies; a connecting assembly is fixed to the bottom of the fuselage structure. The robot can adapt to various complex dangerous working terrains, the gait of the robot is planned, and the walking stability of the robot is improved; the mechanical structure of the robot leg is designed, one-pair three-degree-of-freedom movement is achieved, and the maneuverability, practicability and flexibility of the robot are improved.
title: Mechanical structure applied to anti-explosion inspection robot

abstract: The present invention relates to an apparatus for identifying the intention of a user using a wearable robotic upper limb, which identifies the intention of a user using a wearable robotic upper limb. The apparatus comprises: a sight sensing unit for sensing the sight of a user; a wrist sensing unit for sensing a wrist movement; a hand sensing unit for sensing a hand movement; and a control unit which is connected to the sight sensing unit, the wrist sensing unit (20), and the hand sensing unit (30) and controls the wearable robotic upper limb based on the result of identifying the user intention by integrating the respective sensing results. Therefore, according to the present invention, the control unit integrates and controls the sensing results of the sight sensing unit, the wrist sensing unit, and the hand sensing unit, such that the type of sensors can be changed and a new algorithm can be applied to be used in an upper limb wearable suit, the required number of sensors and purchase costs can be reduced, and the reluctance of a wearer can be reduced.
title: APPARATUS FOR DETERMINING INTENTION OF USER USING WEARABLE ROBOT OF UPPER LIMB

abstract: The present invention belongs to the field of somatosensory interaction, and specifically relates to a work posture analysis system measurement method. The method comprises the following steps: Step one, starting a Kinect V2 device, and collecting template data of 25 skeletal points when an operator stands up; Step two, determining the score of the head of the operator; Step three, determining thescore of the back of the operator; Step four, determining the score of the leg of the operator; Step five, determining the score of the arm of the operator; and Step six, according to the scores of the four parts, obtaining a final rating through a form. In the present invention, the head, back, arm and leg of the operator are evaluated by using the human skeleton data captured by the Kinect V2,and a work posture analysis system measurement method of the behavior level is obtained according to the classification of the action levels, so that the gap in the present market is filled.
title: Work posture analysis system measurement method

abstract: The invention discloses a wheel-foot switching robot system and a control method thereof, a robot comprises a robot trunk, a mechanical leg mechanism mounted at the bottom of the robot trunk and a wheel type mechanism mounted at the upper part of the robot, and the wheel type mechanism and the mechanical leg mechanism are independent of each other; the mechanical leg mechanisms achieve switching of the motion postures of the robot through contraction or extension. The control method of the robot system comprises the following steps of switching real-time postures of a robot before switching; planning a gravity center motion track of the robot trunk part; judging whether each zero moment point in the planned gravity center motion trail of the robot trunk part meets a balance condition within a stability threshold of the robot or not; and if the balance condition is met, contracting or stretching the mechanical leg mechanisms according to the rotating angles of all joints of the robot toachieve stable switching, the problem that the robot loses balance due to the fact that the gravity center of the robot changes during trade wheel-foot switching is avoided, and stable wheel-foot switching can be conducted on complex terrains.
title: Wheel-foot switching robot system and control method thereof

abstract: The invention provides a robot lower limb mechanism and a robot. The robot lower limb mechanism comprises a hip assembly, a leg assembly, a foot assembly and an ankle joint assembly, the leg assembly comprises a thigh support and a shank support, and a first ankle joint motor controls the rotation angle of the foot assembly relative to the shank support in the front-back direction through a first transmission piece; the second ankle joint motor controls the rotation angle of the foot assembly relative to the shank support in the left-right direction, and meanwhile the walking wheel can be switched between a foot type mode and a wheel type mode and locked in the wheel type mode. Knee joint transmission is used, the mounting position of the joint motor for controlling the shank support is increased, the rotational inertia of the whole robot lower limb structure relative to the hip joint is reduced under the condition that the degree of freedom of legs is not reduced, then the control precision and response speed of the hip joint are improved, hip joint loss is reduced, and the service life of hip joint components is prolonged.
title: Robot lower limb mechanism and robot

abstract: The invention discloses a wireless dual-core three-wheel free-lifting high-speed robot electric hospital bed controller. The controller comprises a battery, a control panel, a wireless control device, a motor X, a motor Y, a motor Z, a motor R and a motor W, wherein the control panel comprises ARM and FPGA; the ARM is communicated with an external nursing master station through the wireless control device; the FPGA is used for receiving a sensor signal fed back by the sensor; and the forwarding speed, operating speed, operating direction and lifting motion of a robot electric hospital bed are controlled by the motor X, the motor Y, the motor Z, the motor R and the motor W through an electromagnetic coder. By adopting the mode, axle electric lifting devices are arranged at head part and tail part of the electric hospital bed to achieve the function of freely lifting head, waist and legs of a patient body; and information of the electric hospital bed body and patient is transmitted to the nursing master station at any time via the wireless local area network, and corresponding response is given by the nursing master station according to requirement.
title: Wireless dual-core three-wheel free-lifting high-speed robot electric hospital bed controller

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of inspection robots, in particular to a mine tunnel inspection robot with an adjustable walking posture. The mine tunnel inspection robot comprises a robot body running on two rails, a monitoring module is arranged below the robot body, driving assemblies are arranged on the two sides of the robot body, and the driving assemblies can automatically change the moving postures of the driving assemblies when the driving assemblies advance to a slope road section so as to increase the friction force between the driving assemblies and the rails. According to the mine tunnel inspection robot, on the premise of keeping the output power of the original driving motor, when the robot body encounters an uphill or downhill road section, the walking posture of the robot body can be adaptively changed, so that the robot body can stably pass through the slope road section and can also be changed back to the initial walking posture after returning to a parallel road section, the inspection speed is not influenced, and the intelligent degree is high; and a plurality of existing problems are solved at one stroke, and the use value is high.
title: Mine tunnel inspection robot with adjustable walking posture

abstract: A position and posture compensation reconfigurable connecting rod device is composed of a reconfigurable connecting rod (A) and a position and posture compensation assembly (B), when the reconfigurable connecting rod (A) rolls transversely, the position and posture compensation assembly (B) compensates a roll angle, a connected execution unit can be kept still, and the position and posture compensation reconfigurable connecting rod device is applied to a multi-legged bionic robot with a reconfigurable trunk. And the roll angle generated by the reconfigurable rod piece in the robot trunk deformation process is compensated, stable supporting of the walking mechanism is guaranteed, and extra driving and control complexity is not increased.
title: Pose compensation reconfigurable connecting rod device

abstract: A system and method is provided for a wearable robotic upper body garment. In an embodiment, an upper body garment or apparatus comprises a shoulder saddle, one or more actuators, one or more flexible tendons, back torso section, front, torso section, torso wrap, and upper arm cuff. The shoulder saddle may be comprised of a yoke and one or more elevated shoulder sections. The one or more elevated should sections may be comprised of a first elevated shoulder section. In an embodiment, the back torso and front torso sections may be structurally connected to the yoke. In an embodiment, the one or more actuators may be structurally connected to either said back torso section or front torso section. In an embodiment, the one or more flexible tendons may be operationally connected to a predetermined one or more actuators and an upper arm cuff. In an embodiment and during operations, the one or more actuators effectuate a pulling motion on one or more flexible tendons enabling or augmenting movement about an upper extremity joint.
title: Wearable robotic upper body garment

abstract: The invention discloses a damping-type walking mechanism for a robot. The mechanism comprises outer casings, gasbags and a control motor; walking columns are arranged inside the outer casings, connecting pieces are connected to the bottoms of the walking columns, air cushions are arranged at the bottoms of the gasbags, the gasbags are arranged inside the connecting pieces, front and rear rotatingmotors are arranged at the two sides of the control motor and connected with the walking columns through slide blocks, and damping springs are fixed to the upper sides of the slide blocks; connectingblocks are arranged at the upper sides of the damping springs, the bottoms of the connecting blocks are fixed to the outer casings, walking baseboards are fixed to the bottoms of the air cushions, slide grooves are formed in the walking columns, lead screws are fixed to the interiors of the slide grooves, and rubber balls are arranged between the outer casings and the walking columns. By means ofthe damping-type walking mechanism for the robot, through the arrangement of the air cushions and the gasbags, the generation of vibration is reduced, and the walking stability is thus guaranteed.
title: Damping-type walking mechanism for robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots and particularly relates to a robot lower limb with a buffering effect. The robot lower limb comprises thigh joints, side joints, a mounting shell, thighs, knee joints, shanks, ankle joints and feet, when disassembly is needed, a second speed reducing motor is controlled to work, so an arc-shaped mounting plate drives corresponding mounting columns to rotate through two connecting rods, after the arc-shaped mounting plate slides to be separated from the fifth gear, the two connecting rods are manually swung, so that the arc-shaped mounting plate is separated from the mounting guide rail, at the moment, the arc-shaped mounting plate is located on the back face of the mounting cover, and in the state, the mounting column, the connecting rods, the arc-shaped mounting plate and components on the lower side of the mounting column are manually disassembled from the arc-shaped guide rail on the upper side; and disassembly is simple and quick. In the friction braking process, the arc-shaped mounting plate is arranged on the outer side, the heat dissipation performance is good, and reliability is high.
title: Robot lower limb with buffering function

abstract: The invention provides a robot knee joint structure which is applied to a robot leg structure, the robot leg structure comprises a foot sole and a thigh supporting column, and the robot knee joint structure comprises a connecting rod driving mechanism and a tooth moving mechanism; one end of the connecting rod driving mechanism is fixedly connected with the thigh supporting column, and the other end is hinged with the gear mechanism; one end of the thigh supporting column is fixedly connected with the connecting rod driving mechanism, and the other end is hinged with the gear moving mechanism; one end of the tooth-moving mechanism away from the thigh supporting column is connected with the sole; the connecting rod driving mechanism is started, the connecting rod driving mechanism controls the tooth moving mechanism to rotate around the thigh supporting column, the tooth moving mechanism can control the bending angle of the knee joint structure, and the foot sole rotates synchronously along with the tooth moving mechanism. The knee joint is bent through the tooth moving mechanism, the needed driving force is provided for the tooth moving mechanism through the connecting rod driving mechanism, and the defects that the robot knee joint structure is poor in bending capacity, and a driving source is insufficient in leg control force are overcome.
title: Robot knee joint structure and humanoid robot

abstract: The method and system employ double-acting, fluid-­driven, twistor-pairs (30) as combined joints and motors in the arms and legs of robots. Thus, the twistor-pair at each joint (20) advantageously serves as the hinge or flexural support for the limb (40) carried (supported) by the joint and simultaneously serves as the double-acting turning motor for moving the limb portion of the arm or leg which is supported by the twistor pair. By controllably varying the fluid pressures P₁ and P₂ (usually pressurized air) being fed into the two elastic shells (33) which form the respective fluid chambers of the double-acting, twistor-pair located at each joint, the joint becomes deflected into predetermined predictable angular positions, depending upon the fluid pressure values. Costly and friction-­producing bearings are eliminated at the robot joints, and by virtue of eliminating such rotary bearing mountings at all desired joints not only are mass, weight and inertia substantially reduced, but also frictional effects and the torque drags caused by friction­al effects are nearly eliminated. By virtue of the fact that the deflection of the joint into different angular positions is a predictable and predetermined linear function of the two fluid pressures P₁ and P₂ fed into the interiors of the two shells of the twistor-pair at each joint, an advantageous uncomplicated, low cost open loop control method and system can be employed to operate these robots. Programmed motion of each jointed arm or jointed leg is produced by the convenient method of transmitting two control­lably variable fluid pressures P₁ and P₂ from a modulated supply through a pair of feed lines (42,44) in each arm or leg, thus achieving open loop dispatch control for many different industrial appli­cations.
title: Method and system employing double-acting, fluid-driven, twister-pairs as combined joints and motors in robots.

abstract: The invention discloses an active lower limb exoskeleton bearing device which comprises a trunk assembly, a left leg assembly and a right leg assembly. The left leg assembly and the right leg assembly are fixedly connected to the two sides of the trunk assembly, the width between the left leg assembly and the right leg assembly can be adjusted, and the left leg assembly and the right leg assembly comprise thigh structures, shank structures and foot assemblies which are in mirror symmetry; the trunk assembly comprises a back frame, a wearing binding mechanism and a waist supporting mechanism. The length of the shank function module is adjusted, the influence on the walking gait is reduced, and the practical value and the comfort degree are greatly improved.
title: Active bearing lower limb exoskeleton device

abstract: The invention relates to a biped robot lower limb structure based on modular joints. The biped robot lower limb structure comprises hip joint mechanisms, thigh pieces, knee joint mechanisms and shankmechanisms, the lower ends of the hip joint mechanisms are rotationally connected with the thigh pieces, and the hip joint mechanisms are used for driving the knee joint mechanisms and the shank mechanisms to swing front and back, swing left and right and rotate inside and outside; the knee joint mechanisms are fixedly arranged on the thigh pieces and used for driving the shank mechanisms to swingfront and back; and the shank mechanisms are movably arranged at the lower ends of the thigh pieces and driven by the knee joint mechanisms to rotate forwards and backwards. The gravity center of thelegs of the biped robot can be adjusted upwards, so that the inertia of the legs of the biped robot is smaller during swinging, and the biped robot can walk more stably and quickly.
title: Biped robot lower limb structure based on modular joints

abstract: The invention discloses a human body balance ability classification method based on a three-dimensional convolutional neural network. The method is specifically implemented according to the followingsteps: step 1, shooting human body walking posture videos of a normal person and an abnormal person in a built virtual scene simulating reality; 2, respectively extracting the walking posture videos of the normal person and the abnormal person collected in the step 1 into images, respectively training the images of the normal person and the abnormal person in a three-dimensional convolutional neural network, and calculating feature vectors; and 3, inputting the feature vector obtained in the step 2 into a Softmax function, and classifying the balance ability by utilizing a numerical value obtained by the Softmax function, so that the problem of low classification accuracy caused by single extracted feature in the prior art is solved.
title: Human body balance ability classification method based on three-dimensional convolutional neural network

abstract: The invention discloses a robot lower limb structure and a robot. The robot lower limb structure comprises a first joint; the second joint is movably connected with the first joint; the third joint is movably connected with the second joint; the fourth joint is movably connected with the third joint; the foot structure is movably connected with the fourth joint; wherein the third joint comprises a joint body, a first motor and a speed reducer, the two ends of the joint body are movably connected with the second joint and the fourth joint respectively, the first motor and the speed reducer are connected with the joint body and arranged oppositely, and a first output shaft of the speed reducer is arranged in the center of the speed reducer and the first motor; a part of the joint body is connected with the output shaft. The gravity center of the legs of the robot is concentrated on the thigh joints of the lower limbs, the motion control ability of the robot is improved, and motion and walking of the robot can be controlled more accurately.
title: Robot lower limb structure and robot

abstract: The invention discloses a training device for a robot to go on a trunk based on an actuator. The training device comprises a rigidity control module structure, a variable rigidity module structure and a connecting module structure. The parallel elastic actuator combines a variable stiffness module and a stiffness control module, which serve as passive and active inputs, respectively, and generate an output torque on the trunk through an output link. The input torque of the connecting module comes from the output connecting rod and is transmitted to the trunk through the four-rod connecting rod mechanism. Compared with other medical equipment, the robot trunk training equipment provided by the invention has the advantages that an output connecting rod is combined with a customized cam profile design, the rigidity of the variable rigidity module is changed through a stepping motor in the rigidity control module, and the supporting force can be actively controlled. For real human body application, a link can be connected to the rehabilitation robot through a connector and a wire harness structure, and the rehabilitation robot can be fixed to a movable platform such as a wheelchair or a fixed platform such as a treadmill according to needs.
title: Training equipment for robot to get on luggage case based on actuator

abstract: The invention discloses a leg mechanism for a serial-parallel hybrid human-simulated soccer robot. The leg mechanism comprises a hip joint, two thigh connecting rods, a knee joint, two shank connecting rods, an ankle joint and a sole which are successively hinged, wherein the hip joint is arranged in a traditional serial form but the short span design of a hip joint U-shaped frame can strengthen the rigidity of the hip joint; a four-connecting-rod mechanism is arranged at the knee joint; the four-connecting-rod mechanism of the knee joint can promote the rigidity of the knee joint and can increase the walking stability; an arranging space for the knee joint tension spring is further supplied by the four-connecting-rod mechanism; the ankle joint has a parallel structure; the parallel structure of the ankle joint can realize the simultaneous power output of two driving units of the ankle joint; the rigidity is promoted while the inertia of shank is greatly reduced and the loads of the driving unit of the knee joint and the driving unit of the hip joint are relieved; the target of being light, quick, powerful and stable is achieved; the tension spring on the rear part of the knee joint has the functions of compensating for gravity and storing energy.
title: Leg mechanism for serial-parallel hybrid human-simulated soccer robot

abstract: The stepping platform car comprises a car body, a bottom frame is fixed to the bottom of the car body, the front end and the rear end of the bottom frame are each provided with three installation frames, each installation frame is provided with an independently-controlled walking leg, and the walking legs are connected with the bottom frame and the bottom frame. Each walking leg comprises a thigh rod mounted on a mounting frame, a shank rod is mounted at the free end of each thigh rod, a driving motor for driving the thigh rods to rotate is arranged on the mounting frame, and the thigh rods and the shank rods are connected through a transmission mechanism; the stepping platform car adjusts the walking gait according to the terrain and the height condition of obstacles. According to the stepping platform car, the three vertically-controlled walking legs are arranged at the front end and the rear end of the car body respectively, the thigh rods and the shank rods are connected through the transmission mechanisms, it is guaranteed that when the thigh rods rotate, the shank rods are perpendicular to the ground all the time, and the stepping platform car adjusts walking gaits according to the terrain and the height condition of obstacles and has high universality.
title: Stepping platform car suitable for load-bearing mobile operation of shrubs and grassland

abstract: The present invention relates to a wearable robot module for assisting muscular power, comprising: an intention recognition unit configured to determine a movement intention of a wearer; a control unit configured to generate an actuation control signal to an actuation unit by the signal from the intention recognition unit; and a flexible actuation unit configured to generate actuation force for assisting muscular power by the actuation control signal from the control unit. The flexible actuation unit includes: a waist bonding unit and leg bonding units configured to be bonded with the waist and legs of the wearer; and a cloth-type flexible actuator including a plurality of connection members connected to each of the waist bonding unit and the leg bonding units and configured to transfer the actuation force, and configured to be installed at a part corresponding to a muscle responsible for making an unfolding motion between the waist bonding unit and the leg bonding units and generating an actuation force. The present invention aims to provide a wearable robot module for assisting muscular power, which is capable of improving response performance.
title: Wearable robot module using a cloth-type flexible actuator and wearable robot having the same

abstract: The invention discloses a robot control method and device and a robot, and relates to the field of automatic control. By means of face recognition or walking posture recognition, the robot control device determines a current position of a bound user, determines a path of the robot for moving to an adjacent region of the bound user from the current position and drives the robot to move to the adjacent region of the bound user along the determined path. According to the robot control method and device and the robot, the user and the robot are bound through image recognition, the robot follows beside the user by means of automatic moving, and therefore two hands of the user can be liberated, and the user experience can be significantly improved.
title: Robot control method and device and robot

abstract: The invention discloses a mobile robot. The mobile robot comprises a two-wheeled self-balancing electric vehicle, a rotating base and a manipulator. The two-wheeled self-balancing electric vehicle comprises a vehicle frame. Two bilaterally symmetric wheels and two bilaterally symmetric pedals are arranged on the vehicle frame. The manipulator is installed on one pedal through a rotating base and used for grabbing objects and controlling the walking posture of the two-wheeled self-balancing electric vehicle. According to the technical scheme, compared with the prior art, the mobile robot has the advantages of simple structure, multiple degrees of freedom, flexible movement, fine and accurate executable actions and the like.
title: Mobile robot

abstract: The invention relates to a suspension structure of a walking mechanical body, in particular to a rocker-arm type suspension mechanism of a high-stationarity walking box body. Supporting balancing frames are configured on the two sides of the high-stationarity walking box body, the suspension structure is formed by configuring of an external rocker arm (11) and an internal rocker arm (2) in a spaced mode, and a pair of rotatable supporting legs (4) is clamped between the two rocker arms. Angle bisection brackets (7) are symmetrically configured at the two ends of a configured electric pushing rod (9), the upper supporting points of the angle bisection brackets (7) are rotatably connected to one end of the electric pushing rod (9) and the upper end of a shock absorber (3), the lower supporting points of the angle bisection brackets (7) are fixedly connected with a pair of angle bisection gears (13) which are engaged mutually, and the lower end of the shock absorber (3) is rotatably connected to the supporting legs (4). According to the suspension structure of the walking mechanical body, with shape changing of the ground, the lower ends of the pair of supporting legs make symmetricalor asymmetric rotation on both sides of the central vertical line of the electric pushing rod, with extending and retraction of the electric pushing rod, and the two upper supporting points of the angle bisection brackets on the two sides always make symmetrical moving on both sides of the central vertical line of the electric pushing rod, so that the attached walking box body is always not deviated, and high walking stability is ensured.
title: Rocker-arm type suspension mechanism of high-stationarity walking box body

abstract: The invention discloses an auxiliary robot for rehabilitation of children with autism, which comprises a robot trunk part, a moving assembly is mounted at the bottom of the robot trunk part, a robot main component is mounted at the top of the robot trunk part, the robot main component comprises a bearing part, and a camera module and a loudspeaker A are fixedly mounted on the top of the bearing part in the circumferential direction; the top of the bearing part is fixedly provided with a touch screen play display and a control button, and the camera module is provided with a face recognition technology. The auxiliary robot for rehabilitation of the autistic children serves as intelligent auxiliary treatment equipment, can be arranged in a medical institution or a family, records and analyzes expressions and actions of the autistic children, intervenes the behaviors of the children in an interactive mode, helps doctors or parents to carry out auxiliary treatment on the children, promotes early intervention and rehabilitation of the children, and improves the rehabilitation efficiency of the children. The treatment systematicness of the auxiliary robot is higher, systematic training enables trained children to obtain standard and unified auxiliary treatment, and the medical cost is reduced.
title: Auxiliary robot for rehabilitation of children with autism

abstract: The invention relates to a shaft-driven three-degree-of-freedom wheel foot walking mechanism. Three degrees of freedom of legs comprise a forward swing joint degree of freedom, a lateral extension joint degree of freedom and a knee joint degree of freedom. Knee joint motors are integrated in a robot trunk mainly through connecting rod mechanisms, and wheel motors are integrated at the upper ends of thighs through transmission shafts. Rotational inertia generated when the wheel foot mechanism moves is reduced, and the maneuvering performance of the wheel foot mechanism is improved. Compared with a wheel edge motor, the wheel foot mechanism has the advantages of light weight of a moving end, small rotational inertia, small motor load, low control difficulty and the like, so that the performance requirement and the use burden of a joint motor can be greatly reduced by shaft transmission, and the overall reliability of the wheel foot mechanism is improved.
title: Shaft-driven three-degree-of-freedom wheel foot walking mechanism

abstract: The invention discloses a corridor multi-camera gait detection system and a control method thereof, and a storage medium. The control method comprises the following steps: acquiring images acquired by a plurality of depth cameras; when the target object continuously walks and passes through the detection area of each depth camera, left ankle joint information and right ankle joint information of the target object are obtained through identification according to the images; determining a walking posture of the target object according to the left ankle joint information and the right ankle joint information; acquiring continuous gait time of each walking posture; and obtaining a gait statistical data set according to the left ankle joint information, the right ankle joint information and the gait time corresponding to each gait posture. According to the invention, the gait can be detected more conveniently, and the accuracy is high.
title: Corridor multi-camera gait detection system, control method thereof and storage medium

abstract: The invention relates to a driveless car. The driveless car aims to achieve unmanned driving through simple improvement and installation of a robot on a traditional vehicle. The robot comprises a seattype chassis, a robot head, a robot lower body base, a robot upper body, robot bionic arms, robot bionic feet, a battery pack and a data processing computer database. A visual glass for the robot isformed by a laser range finder, a 360-degree camera and a sensing device to deal with external things and the movement of the robot. The robot uses one driving arm to fix a gripper and realize steering, and uses the other driving arm to realize gear shifting or complete gear shifting and other operations through electronic processing, wherein the gripper is mounted on a steering wheel in a drivingmode. The bionic feet of the robot are fixed to a brake and an accelerator to complete vehicle speed control. Meanwhile, the robot cooperates with 5G, WiFi and VR technologies to realize cloud operation and remote operation. The driveless car realizes unmanned driving for users, and also can provide intelligent entertainment facilities.
title: Driverless car

abstract: The invention discloses an exoskeleton mechanical joint with a walking assisting function and a control method thereof.The exoskeleton mechanical joint comprises a left connecting frame and a right connecting frame, and knee joint power transmission mechanisms are installed on the outer side faces of the two knee joint connecting frames in a penetrating and inserting mode; the lower portions of the outer surfaces of the two knee joint power transmission mechanisms are fixedly connected with shank adjusting supporting pieces, and the two shank adjusting supporting pieces and the two thigh adjusting supporting pieces are the same in structure. Ankle joint power transmission mechanisms are installed on the outer side faces of the two ankle joint connecting frames in a penetrating and inserting mode, and the two ankle joint power transmission mechanisms and the two knee joint power transmission mechanisms are the same in structure. According to the exoskeleton mechanical joint with the walking assistance function and the control method of the exoskeleton mechanical joint, the knee joint power transmission mechanism and the ankle joint power transmission mechanism control the flexion and extension angles and speeds of the knee joints and the ankle joints, so that when the exoskeleton assists a user in walking, the natural walking posture of the human body can be better simulated, and actions are more coordinated and smoother.
title: Exoskeleton mechanical joint with walking assisting function and control method of exoskeleton mechanical joint

abstract: The invention discloses a household mental and psychological disease patient accompanying robot which comprises a robot lower body and a robot upper body, an adjusting assembly is installed on the inner wall of the robot lower body, a second auxiliary assembly is arranged on the inner wall of the robot upper body, and a monitoring assembly and an interaction assembly are installed on one side of the robot upper body. An anti-falling assembly is installed on the robot upper body, through the adjusting assembly arranged on the robot lower body, the height and angle can be conveniently adjusted according to the use condition when a patient uses the household mental and psychological disease patient accompanying robot, and meanwhile the monitoring assembly and the interaction assembly are arranged on the robot upper body; facial expression and heart rate of a patient can be monitored, mental emotion of the patient can be better known, impurities or dust attached to the interactive display screen can be cleaned in an auxiliary mode, and follow-up use of the patient is facilitated.
title: Accompanying robot for patient with mental and psychological diseases at home

abstract: The invention discloses a method for distinguishing human body balance obstacles based on a gravity center area model under visual stimulation. The method comprises the following steps of firstly shooting a human body walking posture video of a normal person and an abnormal person in an established simulated reality scene according to an angle of 90 degrees with the front face when the human bodywalks; secondly, respectively extracting acquired walking posture videos of the normal person and the abnormal person into pictures, and respectively processing the extracted pictures to obtain upper,middle and lower gravity center coordinate data of the normal person and the abnormal person; and finally, judging and classifying the crowd with the balance ability disorder by combining the gravitycenter area data, the triangular area mean square error, the speed and the track route map. According to the method, the tumbler principle is used for explaining the crowd with the balance obstacle capability through the gravity center area deviation model, so that the balance capability of the crowd or other people is objectively judged, videos and images are processed through a plurality of steps, and the final classification accuracy is ensured to be 86% or above.
title: Method for distinguishing human body balance disorders based on gravity center area model under visual stimulation

abstract: The invention relates to the field of robot motions and discloses a robot with a movable head. The robot comprises the robot head, a robot trunk and a drive mechanism. The two ends of the drive mechanism are connected with the robot head and the robot trunk correspondingly, accordingly, the robot head is driven to do the head rotation movement in the horizontal direction, and the robot head is driven to do the nodding movement in the vertical direction. According to the robot with the movable head, the problems that the head movement of a robot in the prior art is not multifunctional enough, and the motion direction is too single are solved, and multi-direction and high-performance movement of the robot head is achieved.
title: Robot with movable head

abstract: The invention discloses a robot visual servo control system and method combining double mechanical arms with a hand-eye camera. The system comprises a robot trunk, double mechanical arms, a dexterous hand, a hand-eye camera, a camera light source and a robot controller. The two mechanical arms are installed on the robot body, the hand-eye cameras are installed on flanges at the tail ends of the mechanical arms, and the dexterous hands are installed at the tail ends of the mechanical arms. Diffuse reflection cooperative target two-dimensional codes are pasted on three side surfaces of the hand-eye camera. The robot controller is installed on the robot body and can control the robot to move. The robot controller is connected with the mechanical arm and the dexterous hand through an electronic circuit and controls the mechanical arm and the dexterous hand to move. The robot controller is connected with the two hand-eye cameras to obtain images. The robot controller is connected with the two camera light sources through an electronic circuit, and it is guaranteed that the cameras have the best illumination condition. The system covers far, near and ultra-near working distances, realizes high-precision non-cooperative target-oriented grabbing, saves the research and development cost and shortens the research and development period.
title: Robot visual servo control system and method combining two arms with hand-eye camera

abstract: The present invention relates to a wearable equipment for muscle assistance. The wearable equipment includes: a fixing support unit removably fixed to the upper part of an arm or leg; a muscular strength sensing unit attached to the arm or leg to sense the muscular movement of the arm or leg; a rotational force generating unit mounted at one end of the fixing support unit to generate force for normal and reverse rotation; a moving support unit removably fixed to the lower part of the arm or leg, and having one end connected to the rotational force generating unit to be angularly rotated by the rotation force from the rotational force generating unit; a power supply unit supplying power to the rotational force generating unit; and a control unit enabling the moving support unit to be angularly rotated on reciprocation by generating force for normal and reverse rotation on the rotational force generating unit in accordance with the muscular movement sensed by the muscular movement sensing unit. According to the present invention, a user who has to work by repeatedly moving the arms and legs can spend less effort for work, and also, the movement of the user wearing the equipment is more comfortable.
title: WEARABLE APPARATUS FOR ASSISTING A POWER

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and relates to an exoskeleton robot ankle joint with three flexible driving branches. The exoskeleton robot ankle joint with three flexible driving branches comprises a shank fixing block, a constraint branch, a sole plate, a first driving branch, a second driving branch and a third driving branch; the sole plate is connected to the shank fixing block through the constraint branch; one end of the first driving branch, one end of the second driving branch and one end of the third driving branch are arranged on the shank fixing block, and the other ends are hinged to the sole plate; the first driving branch and the second driving branch are linked to drive the sole plate to realize inward turning/outward turning rotation; and the first driving branch, the second driving branch and the third driving branch are linked to drive the sole plate to realize dorsiflexion/plantar flexion rotation and inward rotation/outward rotation. The exoskeleton robot ankle joint with three flexible driving branches has three rotational degrees of freedom, each degree of freedom is an active degree of freedom, and dorsiflexion/plantar flexion rotation, inward turning/outward turning rotation and inward rotation/outward rotation of ankle joints of lower limbs of a human body can be simulated and reproduced.
title: Exoskeleton robot ankle joint with three flexible driving branches

abstract: The invention discloses a robot trunk with a 360-degree adjustable loudspeaker. The robot trunk is characterized in that an adjusting shaft is vertically arranged; the top end of the adjusting shaft is fixedly connected with an adjusting handle capable of driving the adjusting shaft to rotate; the bottom end of the adjusting shaft is connected with one ends of a plurality of adjusting arms; the adjusting arms are uniformly arranged in the axial direction of the adjusting shaft; the other ends of the adjusting arms extend to the inner wall of an annular adjusting barrel and are fixedly connected with the inner wall of the annular adjusting barrel; the diameter of the annular adjusting barrel is smaller than the diameter of a trunk body; a hollowed-out plate is formed in the position, on the same plane with the annular adjusting barrel, on the wall of the trunk body; a plurality of through holes are formed in the hollowed-out plate; and the loudspeaker is mounted on the outer wall of the annular adjusting barrel and is arranged on the inner side of the hollowed-out plate. According to the robot trunk, structure is simple, utilization is convenient, direction of the loudspeaker can be flexibly adjusted by 360 degrees according to the requirement, normal utilization of the loudspeaker is prevented from being affected by fly dust in external air, and communication convenience of a robot and an interaction object and self-heating degree are greatly improved.
title: Robot trunk with 360-degree adjustable loudspeaker

abstract: The invention discloses an exoskeleton robot knee joint with an adjustable force increasing ratio. The exoskeleton robot knee joint comprises a thigh bar, a hydraulic cylinder, a first connecting piece, a second connecting piece, a shank extension bar and a shank sleeve bar, wherein the thigh bar, the first connecting piece, the second connecting piece and the shank extension bar are hinged so as to form a planar four-bar force increasing mechanism; the second connecting piece is connected with different holes in the shank extension bar according to required working conditions, and correspondingly, the length of a rocking bar in the four-bar mechanism is changed, thereby changing the force increasing ratio; the shank extension bar is inserted into a hole of the shank sleeve bar so as to form a sliding pair, a grating type displacement sensor is installed, and the length can be adjusted by extension and can be informed to a wearer through a display screen on the extension bar; the extension bar and the sleeve bar are locked by tightly screwing a bolt on the shank sleeve bar; and a limiting block on the shank extension bar can be used for limiting the movement in an extreme position, so that the damage of exoskeleton to the wearer is avoided. According to the exoskeleton robot knee joint, by using the simple mechanism and matching, the large boosting ratio is realized, and the applicability and safety of the wearer are increased.
title: Exoskeleton robot knee joint with adjustable force increasing ratio

abstract: The invention discloses a lower limb structure of a three-degree-of-freedom robot. The three-degree-of-freedom robot lower limb structure comprises a plurality of lower limb modules and a hip joint platform connected with the lower limb modules. Each lower limb module comprises a hip joint signal transmission module, a mechanical thigh, a leg joint connecting assembly, a shank joint module and a mechanical foot. The hip joint signal transmission module is connected with the hip joint platform, an output shaft of the hip joint signal transmission module is coaxially and fixedly connected with the upper end of the mechanical thigh, the lower end of the mechanical thigh is connected with the upper end of the shank joint module through the leg joint connecting assembly, and an output shaft at the lower end of the shank joint module is fixedly connected with the mechanical foot. And the mechanical thighs and the mechanical feet are subjected to multi-degree-of-freedom control through joint signal transmission. Accurate control over the lower limb structure of the robot is achieved, the lower limbs of the robot can be freely and rapidly adjusted, and the robot has the advantages of being high in precision, excellent in controllability and the like.
title: Lower limb structure of three-degree-of-freedom robot

abstract: The invention discloses a double-foot robot ankle joint buffering device and a robot single-leg structure. An ankle joint is arranged between a robot shank and a robot foot, a connecting rod is arranged on the back surface of the robot shank, and the tail end of the connecting rod is connected with a heel of the robot foot through a spring; the ankle joint is taken as a fulcrum of a lever, and thetension force of the spring and the gravity force of a robot are respectively positioned on two sides of the lever to form moments with opposite directions; and the gravity moment of the robot is balanced through the tension moment of the spring, so that the gravity center of the robot is restored to the balanced position of the robot. According to the double-foot robot ankle joint buffering device and the robot single-leg structure, the vibration of the robot caused by uneven ground can be buffered by arranging the spring; and through the contraction of the spring, when the gravity center isin an adjustable area, the robot has certain capability of automatically adjusting the posture to a stable standing state.
title: Double-foot robot ankle joint buffering device and single-leg structure

abstract: A stroke counter and a method of analyzing strokes of swimmer are provided. The stroke counter and method use changes in pressure proximate the arms and legs of the swimmer to determine when the swimmer performs a swimming stroke using either the arms or legs.
title: Swim stroke counter

abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of electronic information, and discloses a face recognition method and device and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring and judging whether a face of a user exists in an image of the user or not; if yes, judging whether the human face is shielded or not; when the face is shielded, acquiring a shielding proportion of the face and judging whether the shielding proportion is greater than or equal to a preset proportion; if yes, performing pedestrian re-identification according to a preset pedestrianre-identification algorithm; extracting an image of a pedestrian matched with the walking posture of the user from the historical images to determine identity information of the user, and restoring the face image of the user according to a preset face restoration algorithm if not to determine the identity information of the user according to the restored image. The method can recognize the identity information of the user under the condition that the face is shielded.
title: Face recognition method and device and electronic equipment

abstract: The invention discloses walking assisting flexible exoskeleton and a control method thereof. The flexible exoskeleton is mainly composed of a control system, a detection system, a pneumatic flexible execution system and an air pipe assembly. The control system analyzes user movement information and pressure information of the flexible assistance execution system acquired by the detection system, and realizes identifying and understanding of movement intention of lower limbs on the basis of a gait estimation model; and calculating is conducted to obtain corresponding instructions of aerodynamicforce opening and closing, pressure, flow rate and the like based on a hip joint moment model, corresponding actions are executed, real-time control is conducted on the negative pressure input and unloading processes of the pneumatic flexible execution system, the pneumatic flexible execution system can convert air pressure provided by the control system into mechanical energy capable of realizing linear movement in real time, assisting moment required by buckling and stretching of a hip joint is provided in real time according to the walking posture of a user, and the purpose of walking assisting is achieved.
title: Walking assisting flexible exoskeleton and control method thereof

abstract: The invention discloses an improved transmission structure of a biped robot hip joint. The improved transmission structure comprises a hip joint seat. A driving motor is installed in the hip joint seat. A coupling is arranged at one end of the driving motor. A bearing screw rod is arranged at the other end of the driving motor. A front-back swing arm part is arranged on one side of the coupling. An up-down swing arm part is arranged on the other side of the coupling. Angle sensors are installed between the front-back swing arm part and the up-down swing arm part. A damping piece is installed on a stress part of the angle sensor. An elastic compressed spring serves as the damping piece. A pressure sensor is installed at the bottom of the hip joint seat. The angle sensor and the pressure sensor are connected with a hip joint driving controller through a signal transmitting circuit. A filter filtering a digital signal is arranged in the hip joint driving controller. A power controller isarranged on one side of the filter. A PLC control chip is arranged on the other side of the filter. Stability of robot operation is improved, and thus connection of all parts is more coordinated.
title: Improved transmission structure of biped robot hip joint

abstract: A moving doll toy capable of positively and repeatedly carrying out walking action and being protected from damage due to misoperation. The moving doll toy includes each pair of arms and legs pivotally connected to a body so as to be pivotally moved in forward and backward directions and a driving structure. The driving structure includes a motor, a gear transmission mechanism connected to the motor, each pair of first and second cams connected to an output shaft of the gear transmission mechanism, and each pair of first and second connecting members engaged with the first and second cams and operatively connected to the arms and legs, respectively.
title: MOVING, E.G. WALKING DOLL

abstract: The invention discloses an omnibearing gait switching method and system for a parallel wheel-foot robot. The method comprises the steps: establishing a kinematics model of the parallel wheel-foot robot; based on the kinematics model, taking single-leg working space constraint and walking stability constraint as consideration conditions, and stipulating a straight-going intermittent gait and a rotating gait of the parallel wheel-foot robot; and based on the straight-going intermittent gait and the rotating gait, conducting gait switching according to the walking direction and the walking posture of the parallel wheel-foot robot. In the embodiment of the invention, the motion controllability of the parallel wheel-foot robot is improved, and the overall motion stability is effectively guaranteed.
title: Omnibearing gait switching method and system of parallel wheel-foot robot

abstract: The invention discloses a self-balancing system of an aerial operation robot, which is additionally provided with an executing mechanism module and an automatic balancing device on a foot stool of the aerial operation robot, and is characterized in that a control module is used for controlling the automatic balancing device according to attitude information of the aerial operation robot acquired by an attitude detection module and state information of the automatic balancing device fed back by the executing mechanism module; the control module is used for calculating the control quantity needing to be adjusted and sending a posture adjusting instruction to the executing mechanism module, and the executing mechanism module is used for converting the posture adjusting instruction into control signals for driving the two automatic balancing devices and feeding back state information of the two automatic balancing devices to the control module; the automatic balancing devices are used for providing power for the aerial operation robot to recover the balance posture according to respective control signals, and are used for resisting center-of-gravity shift caused by crosswind or movement on the overhead line, and the situation that the center-of-gravity shift disturbs operation of the aerial operation robot on the overhead line is avoided. And the walking stability and safety of the aerial operation robot on the overhead line are obviously improved.
title: Self-balancing system of aerial operation robot

abstract: The invention discloses a crawler-type steel wall surface climbing robot, which comprises a shell, adsorption walking devices and a power supply control device, wherein a main frame is arranged in theshell, and a secondary frame is longitudinally and fixedly connected to the middle of the main frame; the two sets of adsorption walking devices are arranged on the two sides of the auxiliary frame correspondingly; the adsorption walking device comprises a worm and gear motor, a rotary positioning plate, an adsorption walking shell, a magnetic chain transmission mechanism and a chain inner supporting mechanism, the rotary positioning plate is rotationally connected between the main frame and the first positioning frame, and the worm and gear motor is connected into the rotary positioning plate; the adsorption walking shell comprises two sets of first tensioning adjusting plate assemblies, and a first main transmission gear assembly and a second auxiliary transmission gear assembly are connected between the two sets of first tensioning adjusting plate assemblies; and the magnetic chain transmission mechanism is connected to the outer ends of the first main transmission gear assembly and the second auxiliary transmission gear assembly in a sleeving mode. The robot can automatically adapt to steel wall surfaces with different curvature radiuses, and is good in walking stability.
title: Crawler-type steel wall surface climbing robot

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of wall-climbing robots, and discloses a climbing structure and a wall-climbing robot, the climbing structure comprises four moving motors mounted in a storage cavity of a robot trunk, the four moving motors are respectively located at four corners of the storage cavity, output shafts of the four moving motors are fixedly connected with moving rods, and the moving rods are fixedly connected with the robot trunk. The other ends of the four moving rods penetrate through the inner wall of the robot trunk to the outside of the robot trunk and are connected with moving wheels, power mechanisms are connected to the four corners of the inner wall of the storage cavity, and the output ends of the four power mechanisms are connected with reversing assemblies, first transmission assemblies and second transmission assemblies. According to the climbing structure and the wall-climbing robot, when one air draft assembly is blocked by leaves or other sundries, self-balance of the robot trunk can still be guaranteed through the other three air draft assemblies, and the probability that the robot falls off from the wall is reduced; and power can be continuously supplied to the air draft assembly, so that the robot trunk is tightly pressed on the wall surface, and the robot trunk does not fall off.
title: Climbing structure and wall-climbing robot

abstract: A disclosed quadruped robot comprises a robot body, an energy supply structure, a hip part, thigh parts, shank parts and a walking part, the robot body comprises a first framework and a second framework, the energy supply structure is installed in the first framework, the hip part is connected with the second framework, a second driving part is used for driving thigh bodies to rotate, a third driving part is used for driving the shank body to rotate relative to the thigh body, a fourth driving part is used for driving the walking wheel to rotate, and an auxiliary wheel can rotate along with rotation of the walking wheel. According to the robot, the leg structure and the energy supply structure can be disassembled and assembled by disassembling and assembling the first framework and the second framework, later maintenance of the robot is facilitated, the leg structure can advance in a kneeling posture or a crawling state, the overall height of the leg structure can be changed by changing the walking posture, and the application scene is wide.
title: Quadruped robot

abstract: The invention provides a biological characteristic unlocking method. The biological characteristic unlocking method comprises the following steps: establishing an information base of at least two kinds of biological information comprising human walking posture information; packing the at least two kinds of biological information belong to the same object to form a plurality of information packets,wherein one of the plurality of information packets is a human walking posture information packet; acquiring the biological information of a to-be-identified object, wherein the biological information at least comprises human walking posture information serving as retrieve information and other required biological information; comparing the retrieve information and the biological information in the information base; and if the information base contains the biological information consistent with the retrieve information, acquiring the human walking posture information, which corresponds to thesame object together with the biological information, in the human walking posture information packet, and comparing the human walking posture information of the to-be-identified object with the human walking posture information in the information packet.
title: Biological characteristic unlocking method

abstract: The invention discloses a real-time life scene walking stability assessment method. Aiming at the defects in the prior art, the invention provides the human body walking stability evaluation method based on the double cameras, the human body walking stability is evaluated, and when people with poor stability are found, early warning is performed in time, key attention is given, and falling is prevented. The video-based motion capture technology can be divided into a contact type motion capture technology and a non-contact type mark-free motion capture technology. Due to the fact that a special mark needs to be placed on the body of a captured target in the contact type motion capture technology, the action of the captured target can be interfered, and use is complex, the non-contact mark-free motion capture technology which is low in cost and high in usability is adopted. And then acquiring human body walking motion data by using a mark-point-free video analysis technology.
title: Real-time life scene walking stability assessment method

abstract: The invention discloses a pair of bionic electric power shoes. Each bionic electric power shoe comprises a shoe sole, wherein a plurality of rotating wheels are arranged under the shoe sole, a motor is further arranged at the lower part of the shoe sole, an output end of the motor is connected with a transmission device, and the transmission device is in driving connection with the rotting wheels. Each bionic electric power shoe is characterized in that the shoe sole comprises a heel part and a sole part which are in rotational connection. Compared with the prior art, the heel part and the sole part can relatively rotate to adapt to a walking posture of lifting the heel firstly and lifting the forefoot later during walking of a human foot, so that the normal walking posture can be kept when the bionic electric power shoes are worn by people; the bionic electric power shoes are mastered and learned by people more easily due to adoption of the normal walking posture, further, the bionic electric power shoes can adapt to the complicated condition of an urban pavement, for example, people wearing the bionic electric power shoes can switch sidewalks, stride over a puddle and the like, and the practicability of the bionic electric power shoes is greatly improved.
title: Bionic electric power shoes

abstract: The invention discloses an additional leg type walking device suitable for an all-wheel-drive vehicle and a control method. The walking device comprises a walking module, a longitudinal connecting module and a transverse connecting module and is formed by connecting the walking module with the longitudinal connecting module and the transverse connecting module through connecting pins. All-wheel-drive vehicle wheels provide power for the device, the power is transmitted through a first-stage transmission device, a second-stage transmission device and a third-stage transmission device in the walking device, a clutch is engaged or disengaged through a control signal, all parts of the walking module are controlled to rotate or be locked in different directions, and the walking module is driven to move. Therefore, the walking gait of the leg type walking device is controlled.
title: Additional leg type walking device suitable for all-wheel-drive vehicle and control method

abstract: The invention discloses a gait recognition and correction method and system based on deep learning, and belongs to the technical field of gait recognition and correction, and the method specifically comprises the steps: collecting gait video data when a pedestrian walks, carrying out the cleaning and preprocessing of the collected gait data, screening the image data with the maximum step length when the pedestrian walks, and carrying out the recognition and correction of the gait video data; training a deep learning gait recognition model, inputting the screened image data with the maximum step length when the pedestrian walks into the deep learning gait recognition model, carrying out gait recognition, comparing the recognized gait with a standard gait, screening a gait abnormal image when the pedestrian walks, and according to the abnormal walking gait condition, carrying out gait recognition on the abnormal gait. A corresponding correction method is designed, the effect of the designed correction method is evaluated, abnormal images and abnormal positions are accurately judged through feature extraction of key nodes and making of constraint conditions of healthy gaits, a gait correction plan is made, and the correction effect is regularly re-evaluated and adjusted.
title: Gait recognition correction method and system based on deep learning

abstract: The invention discloses an active spring damping waist simulation device for a legged robot mouse, and relates to the technical field of legged robots, and the device comprises a driving module which is installed on an installation bottom plate; the number of the output modules is two, the two output modules are installed at the two ends of the installation bottom plate correspondingly, and the two output modules can be connected with the upper limb part and the lower limb part of the robot correspondingly; and the driving module is connected with the output module through the spring damping transmission module. The invention further discloses a robot comprising the active spring damping waist simulation device for the leg and foot robot mouse. The problems that in the prior art, a leg-foot robot is poor in walking posture bionic performance, low in walking speed, low in energy efficiency and the like can be solved.
title: Leg-foot robot mouse active spring damping waist simulation device and robot

abstract: The invention relates to a method for generating efficient moving gaits of a multi-legged robot in a broken leg injury state. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out an ant broken leg injury walking gait acquisition experiment; constructing gait data sets of different damages of ants; proposing gait movement rules of ants in different broken leg injury states; an upper computer is used for directly applying angle control to a joint steering engine of a physical hexapod robot, linear walking of the robot is achieved, trajectory tracking is completed, and the optimal gait mode and the optimal control strategy of the robot in the linear walking process in the broken leg damage state are found out; seven regular gait generation strategies capable of rapidly recovering the linear motion ability in the injury state are summarized and obtained, and mainly comprise a common control rule conforming to each injury condition and a gait generation rule in some special conditions. According to the method, the gait rhythm of ants in an injury state is obtained through a gait collection experiment of ant injury gaits, and then the optimal gait mode and the optimal control strategy of the robot in the linear walking process in the broken leg injury state are finally obtained through a direct control experiment of a physical robot.
title: Method for generating efficient movement gait of multi-legged robot in broken leg injury state

abstract: The present invention relates to a mobile apparatus (30) for scanning an object space. The mobile apparatus comprises a mobile robot (2), which has a main body (3) to which a plurality of legs (4) are movably attached, and a control device (8), by means of which the movement of the legs (4) is controllable such that the robot, in a walking posture, is movable in a surrounding area by means of pivoting movements of the legs. The mobile apparatus (30) further comprises a scanning apparatus, which has at least one camera (32) and a first multi-sampling scanner (31), and a frame (1), which is mounted on the main body (3) of the mobile robot (2) and to which the camera (32) and the first multi-sampling scanner (31) are attached. The mobile robot (2) is designed so that in a rest state it assumes an image-capture posture, in which the vertical extent of the unit formed by the frame (1) and the scanning apparatus is greater than in the walking posture and the optical axis of at least one camera (32) forms an angle with the horizontal which is in the range of -25° to +25°.
title: MOBILE APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR SCANNING AN OBJECT SPACE

abstract: The invention provides a bionic multi-degree-of-freedom adjustable exoskeleton robot hip joint mechanical structure which is characterized in that a back plate is connected with the back of a human body; the thigh support is connected with the thigh of a human body; the first hip connecting rod is rotatably mounted on the back plate along a first rotating axis, and a set included angle is formed between the first rotating axis and the horizontal plane; the second hip connecting rod is rotatably mounted on the first hip connecting rod along a second rotating axis; the included angle between the second rotation axis and the first rotation axis and far away from the back plate is an acute angle; the driving unit is mounted on the second hip connecting rod; the output end of the driving unit is connected with the thigh support and used for driving the thigh support to rotate along a third rotation axis, and the third rotation axis is perpendicular to the second rotation axis. By means of the structure, the hip and thighs of the human body can stretch inwards and stretch outwards, bend forwards and stretch backwards and rotate inwards and outwards, the coordination between the hip joints and the human body is improved, and the falling feeling of the waist or the back is relieved.
title: Bionic multi-degree-of-freedom adjustable exoskeleton robot hip joint mechanical structure
