abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a one-step prediction whole-body control method and device of a foot type robot and the foot type robotic.The method comprises the steps that motion of the foot type robot is decomposed into a plurality of subtasks related to motion according to the motion instruction requirement of the foot type robot, obtaining a reference parameter and a feedback parameter at the current moment in a task space in which each sub-task is located; according to the feedback state of the robot, each subtask related to motion is set as a one-step prediction task, all the subtasks are placed in an objective function of an optimization problem, proper constraint conditions are set in the optimization problem, and the optimization problem is solved according to feedback parameters so as to coordinate and complete all the subtasks. And generating a control instruction of the foot type robot according to the optimal solution of the optimization problem to realize whole-body control of the foot type robot. Therefore, the problems that a whole-body control method in the prior art lacks predictive control ability and has many control parameters are solved.
title: One-step prediction whole-body control method and device of foot type robot and foot type robot

abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a gait-based personnel identity recognition method and device and electronic equipment; after personnel key point information in each frame is extracted, gait scoring is performed on personnel in each frame; if the gait score of the personnel in a certain frame meets a preset threshold value, the personnel in the frame is considered to be in a normal walking gait; if the gait score of the person in a certain frame does not meet the preset threshold value, it is indicated that the person in the frame is in an abnormal walking gait; all the frames with the gait scores meeting the preset threshold value form a gait sequence, all the frames with the normal walking gait of the person are screened out, and then gait features are extracted based on the gait sequence. According to the invention, the gait feature extraction is only performed on each frame of the normal walking gait of the personnel, the workload of extracting the gait features is reduced, and the personnel identity recognition is performed by using the extracted gait features, so that the personnel identity recognition efficiency is improved.
title: Gait-based personnel identity recognition method and device and electronic equipment

abstract: The invention provides an intelligent network connection accompanying diagnosis-assisting robot and a system thereof, and relates to the technical field of medical information. The system comprises a central information system (100), an accompanying diagnosis-assisting robot (200) and an intelligent network connection system (300). The central information system (100) comprises a cloud server (110), edge servers (120) of all floors of a hospital and a group optimization scheduling algorithm operated on the cloud server (110) and the edge servers (120). The accompanying diagnosis-assisting robot (200) provides an integrated service integrating multiple functions and comprises a man-machine interaction system (210), a walking posture self-stabilization system (220), a state monitoring and early warning system (230), a self-navigation obstacle avoidance system (240) and the like. The intelligent network connection system (300) is an information interaction platform of the central information system (100) and the accompanying diagnosis-assisting robot (200) and also provides an interface for access of a terminal client. The system integrates optimized scheduling, real-time monitoring and early warning, bidirectional information interaction and intelligent network connection, and can effectively relieve the problem that the aged society is insufficient in medical-seeking accompanying resources and the like.
title: Intelligent network connection accompanying diagnosis-assisting robot and system thereof

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, and discloses a biped robot balance control method and a biped robot. The balance control method of the biped robot comprises the steps that when the ground inclines, head IMU information, shank IMU information and hip IMU information of the biped robot are obtained, and then front-back balance adjustment and left-right balance adjustment are conducted on the biped robot at the same time according to the obtained IMU information of the biped robot. The biped robot applies the balance control method of the biped robot. Through simultaneous front-back balance control and left-right balance control, the balance of the biped robot in the front-back direction and the left-right direction can be ensured, so that the biped robot reaches a new balance state when standing and walking on various uneven grounds; therefore, the positions of the COM and the ZMP are always located in a polygonal area defined by the contact of the foot surfaces of the biped robot and the ground, and the walking stability and the environment adaptability of the biped robot are effectively improved.
title: Balance control method of biped robot and biped robot

abstract: A tail-rollable animal toy comprises a head, a trunk, leg assemblies, a tail and a driving mechanism arranged in the trunk, wherein the head, the trunk, the leg assemblies and the tail imitate an animal shape, the tail is an elastic strip which can be rolled under an external force effect and can automatically stretch without an external force, the front end of the tail is fixed to the trunk, thetail end of the tail is located behind the trunk to be connected with the tail end of a pull line, and the front end of the pull line extends into the inner cavity of the trunk along the upper surfaceor the lower surface of the tail and can be connected with a pull rod capable of swinging in a front-back way in the driving mechanism. The tail is rolled when the pull rod forwards swings to tightenthe pull line, and the tail stretches by relying on its elasticity for restoration when the pull rod backwards swings to loosen the pull line. The tail-rollable animal toy has the advantages that thetail can imitate the actions of rolling and stretching the tail of an animal and is life-like in imitation, tail rolling and stretching can be cyclically repeated, an entertainment effect is good, the tail-rollable animal toy is pulled by using the pull line and is ingenious in structure and light in weight, the head and legs can move and produce sound, and a imitation effect is life-like.
title: Tail-rollable animal toy

abstract: The invention discloses a multi-legged robot framework capable of changing walking modes, which comprises a central rack and a plurality of closed chain type connecting rod legs, the plurality of closed chain type connecting rod legs are distributed along the circumferential direction of the central rack, the closed chain type connecting rod legs are hinged with the central rack, each closed chain type connecting rod leg is connected with a rotating shaft motor, and the rotating shaft motors drive the closed chain type connecting rod legs to rotate around the corresponding hinge points. The walking stability and trafficability of the robot on different road surfaces are improved.
title: Multi-legged robot framework capable of changing walking modes

abstract: A walking robot device comprises a robot lower body comprising: a first main drive link rotatably connected to a body; a second main drive link rotatably connected to an end of the first main drive link; an auxiliary drive link rotatably connected to the body; and a transmission link rotatably connected to an end of the auxiliary drive link and the second main drive link, wherein a range allowing movement of a position on the second main drive link, to which the transmission link is connected, is included in a range allowing movement of the other end portion of the transmission link and, when a torque is applied to only the first main drive link and the second main drive link, a torque applied to the auxiliary drive link is determined in consideration of a torque to be applied to each of the main drive links.
title: ROBOT LOWER BODY COMPRISING PARALLEL LINK STRUCTURE, AND WALKING ROBOT DEVICE COMPRISING SAME

abstract: A walking robot having a hydraulic motion control device and a method for controlling the same are provided to improve walking stability of the walking robot by allowing the walking robot to walk according to an orbit of a ZMP(Zero Moment Point). A walking robot having a hydraulic motion control device comprises a pair of foot members(11a,11b), a pair of leg members provided at upper portions of the foot members, thigh members provided at upper portions of the leg members, and pelvic members(50) provided at upper portions of the thigh members. Upper tanks(21a,21b) are installed at upper portions of the pelvic members, intermediate tanks(26a,26b) serving as the thigh members are installed at lower portions of the pelvic members, and lower tanks(27a,27b) serving as the leg members are installed at lower portions of the thigh members. A base frame(40) is located on the pelvic members and a hydraulic tank unit(21) is installed on the base frame. A hydraulic pump(60) is installed at one side of the hydraulic tank unit to supply fluid to the tanks.
title: ROBOT HAVING MOTION CONTROL DEVICE FOR IMPROVING WALKING STABILITY AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING THE SAME

abstract: The invention relates to a lower limb robot and a control method for using the same to perform active movement, wherein the lower limb robot for use with a user comprises a mechanical leg, a sensing system and a control system, wherein the sensing system is used for acquiring torque signals and joint absolute angle signals between the user and joints of the mechanical leg, and transmitting the torque signals and the joint absolute angle signals to the control system, and the control system is used for estimating lower limb physiological walking gait trajectory signals of the user, and driving the mechanical leg according to the physiological walking gait trajectory signals. The torque signals and joint absolute angle signals are acquired through the sensing system and are estimated via the control system to obtain lower limb physiological walking gait trajectory signals of a user, the joints of the mechanical leg are driven to move according to the physiological walking gait trajectory signals, the user is urged to actively move, and movement effect of the user is improved.
title: Lower limb robot and control method for using same to perform active movement

abstract: The present invention improves the posture and the walking stability of a robot by accurately calculating the load acting on the sole surfaces. A robot (1) comprises: foot parts (6) having respective sole surfaces; a plurality of load sensors (63) disposed on each foot part (6); and a control device (20). The control device (20) comprises: a correction-value calculation unit (20B) that calculates a correction value based on the center-of-gravity position of a load; and a load calculation unit (20C) that calculates the load acting on each sole surface on the basis of the calculated correction value and output from the plurality of load sensors (63).
title: ROBOT, AND ROBOT MANUFACTURING METHOD

abstract: A flexible electromagnetic drive device comprises a flexible part (1) made of a flexible material, wherein electromagnetic telescopic units are arranged in the flexible part (1); each electromagnetictelescopic unit comprises a transverse upper conductor (2) fixedly connected with the flexible part (1); a lower conductor (3) is arranged below each upper conductor (2) in the transverse direction and fixedly connected with the flexible part (1); a magnetic conductive material filling cavity (4) is arranged between each upper conductor (2) and the corresponding lower conductor (3) and filled witha magnetic fluid material for magnetic conduction or a powdery magnetic conductive material for magnetic conduction. The invention aims to provide the flexible electromagnetic drive device which is capable of being taken as a power source of a robot arm, a power source of a power assisting device for arms and legs of the disabled and a power source for multiple medical facilities and has functions of drawing and driving load to finish various flexible reciprocating, stretching, retracting and bending actions rapidly and accurately.
title: Flexible electromagnetic drive device

abstract: A person judging device capable of making the same judgment even between temporally separate frames and between frames captured by different cameras. The device judges whether or not the persons appearing in different image sequences are the same person, and comprises a walking posture detecting unit (200) for detecting first and second walking sequences which are image sequences representing the walking states of first and second persons appearing in an image sequence, a walking state deducing unit (180) for deducing the transition state of the walking posture during the periodical walking of the first person at a time or position different from that of the walking sequence of the first person on the basis of the walking sequence of the first person, and a judging unit (190) for judging the conformance between the deduced transition state of the walking posture of the first person and the transition state of the walking posture of the second person and judging, if they conforms, that the first and second persons are the same person.
title: Human identification apparatus

abstract: The invention discloses an automatic navigation snow removing robot system. Automatic navigation control over a robot is achieved through a robot management system software program, and thus the robot can automatically cruise and remove snow. According to the provided snow removing robot which can be well suitable for an ice snow covered pavement and is of a crawler chassis structure, the sufficient ground gripping force under the condition of the ice snow covered pavement can be ensured, and the walking stability is ensured; the robot is higher in obstacle crossing ability and pavement adaptability and more stable in walking; the working pressure of operators on duty in a transformer substation is greatly reduced; all-weather and unattended transformer substation intelligent patrol is achieved in a real sense; and the whole system has the characteristics of high automation degree, automatic mounting of a snow removing shovel, automatic detection of accumulated snow depth, automatic alarm of faults, stable in driving and wide patrol range.
title: Automatic navigation snow removing robot system

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of bionic robots, and particularly relates to a biped robot. In the biped robot, leg structures are arranged on an upper body frame in pairs at an interval. In one leg structure, a first steering engine and a second steering engine are arranged on the upper body frame in parallel at an interval, the first steering engine can drive a first rocker to swing so as to drive a first connecting rod, the second steering engine can drive a second rocker to swing so as to drive a second connecting rod, a supporting leg pivoted with the first connecting rod and the second connecting rod is driven, and the supporting leg can provide an enough supporting effect. The leg structures are simple, and the whole robot is small in mass. According to the biped robot, the first steering engines and the second steering engines which are large in mass are arranged on the upper body frame, parts, except for the first steering engines and the second steering engines,of the leg structures are small in mass relative to an upper body part, the overall mass center of the robot is adjusted to the upper body part, inertia of the leg structures in the working process is reduced, and the influence on the posture of the robot is reduced; and requirements for a walking stability control algorithm are reduced, and required driving force is reduced so as to reduce powerconsumption of the steering engines.
title: Biped robot

abstract: The invention discloses a multi-degree of freedom four-legged bionic robot. The multi-degree of freedom four-legged bionic robot comprises a trunk and four lower limbs, the four lower limbs are uniformly and symmetrically distributed at four corners of the lower part of the trunk, and the structures of the four lower limbs are identical. The trunk comprises a six-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism and four driving units. The two ends of the six-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism are separately provided with two driving units. The six-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism comprises a movingplatform and a static platform which are arranged in parallel with each other, six rod piece motors are fixedly arranged on the moving platform, and six rod pieces are connected between the rod piecemotors and the static platform. Each lower limb comprises a leg, an ankle joint and a sole. The upper ends of the legs are fixedly connected with the driving units, and the lower ends of the legs arerotatably connected with the upper ends of the ankle joints. The lower ends of the ankle joints are rotatably connected with the upper ends of the soles. The six-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism contributes to the adjustment of the attitude of the robot and the rational planning of a motion path, and the adaptability, anti-interference ability and walking stability to complex terrains of the legged robot can be effectively improved.
title: Multi-degree of freedom four-legged bionic robot

abstract: The invention provides a medical intelligent robot with an oxygen breathing function. The medical intelligent robot comprises a robot base, a robot waist, a robot trunk and an intelligent processing system. A robot head is arranged on the top of the robot trunk, an LED lamp is arranged on the front side of the robot head, and a first connecting rod is arranged on one side of the robot head. A first magnet seat is arranged at one end of the first connecting rod, a protective cover mounting frame is arranged on one side of the robot trunk, and a rotating shaft is arranged on one side of the topof the protective cover mounting frame. A protective cover is mounted on the protective cover mounting frame through the rotating shaft, a second connecting rod is arranged on one side of the protective cover, and the second connecting rod is provided with a second magnet seat. A cavity is formed in the robot trunk, and an oxygen storage box is arranged in the cavity. The medical intelligent robotwith the oxygen breathing function is reasonable in design, can be used by many people at the same time, and is convenient to use.
title: Medical intelligent robot with oxygen breathing function

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and relates to an exoskeleton robot knee joint with a self-adaptive binding function. The exoskeleton robot knee joint comprises a knee joint driving and transmission assembly, a thigh rod self-adaptive leg binding assembly and a shank rod self-adaptive leg binding assembly. The knee joint driving and transmission assembly comprises a thigh rod, a shank rod, a flexion and extension transmission rod and a knee joint fixing seat. The thigh rod and the shank rod are connected through a thigh and shank fixing hinge. A knee joint driving unit is arranged at the position, close to a hip joint, of the thigh rod. The power output end of the knee joint driving unit is a flexion and extension motion output end cover. The output end of the flexion and extension motion output end cover is hinged to one end of the flexion and extension transmission rod. The other end of the flexion and extension transmission rod is hinged to one end of the knee joint fixing seat. The other end of the knee joint fixing seat is fixed to the shank rod. The exoskeleton robot knee joint has high force transmission capacity and small leg inertia, and the motion compatibility of an exoskeleton and a wearer and the wearing comfort, convenience and safety of the exoskeleton robot knee joint are improved.
title: Exoskeleton robot knee joint with self-adaptive binding function

abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a robot control method, a robot and a computer readable storage medium. According to the robot control method provided by the embodiment of the invention, the base control information for keeping the balance of the ball body is determined by adding passive control on a nonlinear system consisting of the base part of the wheel-legged robot and the ball body on the base part in whole-body control on the wheel-legged robot; the control of each joint of the robot is determined based on the base control information, so that the wheel-legged robot can keep the balance of a ball on the wheel-legged robot in the moving process, and the ball balancing task of the wheel-legged robot is achieved. Through the robot control method disclosed by the invention, the wheel-legged robot can realize the balance of balls with different rigidities on road surfaces of various terrains, and after different balls are replaced, the stability of a balance ball system can be ensured only by updating corresponding parameters of the balls into the controller, and the controller does not need to be debugged again.
title: Robot control method and robot

abstract: The invention provides a goose walking gait feature recognition method based on machine vision, and the method comprises the steps: employing a gait recognition algorithm of a network model, carryingout the moving target detection and image processing of the legs of a breeding goose, and generating a gait periodic diagram; and a residual network idea is introduced, so that the convergence speed of the network is increased, and the individual recognition rate is improved.
title: Goose walking gait feature recognition method based on machine vision

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of carrying devices, and provides an uphill and downhill wheel and an uphill and downhill vehicle. The uphill and downhill wheel comprises the components of: an advancing wheel; an advancing mechanism which is arranged on the advancing wheel, the advancing mechanism comprises an advancing frame and an advancing claw, the movable end of the advancing frame can rotate around a first rotating shaft, the first rotating shaft and a second rotating shaft of the advancing wheel are coaxial or not coaxial, and the advancing claw is telescopically connected with the advancing frame; the extension length of the advancing end of the advancing claw in the radial direction of the advancing wheel is adjustable, and the telescopic length of the advancing claw ranges from 0 to the maximum extension length; the upslope and downslope vehicle comprises the upslope and downslope wheel, by adopting the technical scheme, the advancing mechanism is arranged, the upslope and downslope functions of the advancing wheel can be achieved, the obstacle crossing performance of the advancing wheel is improved, the walking flexibility of the advancing wheel is improved, the phenomena of step missing and overturning are prevented, and meanwhile the walking stability is improved.
title: Uphill and downhill wheel and uphill and downhill vehicle

abstract: The flywheel energy storage type angular momentum balance biped robot comprises a head, a trunk, arms and legs, and the core structure of the flywheel energy storage type angular momentum balance biped robot is a balance movement mechanism composed of the trunk and the legs. The trunk comprises a sliding rail, a flywheel shell, a motor, a ball screw, a storage battery, a power electronic conversion device, a stepping motor, a coupler, a fastening connecting piece, a shock pad, an upper rolling bearing, a rotating shaft, a magnetic induction coil, a flywheel and a lower rolling bearing. The legs comprise hip joints, knee joints and ankle joints, all the mechanisms operate in a coordinated mode to achieve overall operation of the flywheel energy storage type angular momentum balance biped robot, and the flywheel energy storage type angular momentum balance biped robot comprises a flywheel energy storage structure, a gravity center adjusting structure, a leg movement structure and a balance control structure. The stability is improved; by utilizing the flywheel energy storage principle, mechanical energy is converted into electric energy and stored, so that continuous advancing power is provided; and each leg has four degrees of freedom, so that the mechanical complexity is reduced.
title: Flywheel energy storage type angular momentum balance biped robot

abstract: The invention relates to an external skeleton robot. The external skeleton robot comprises external skeleton robot upper limb structures and external skeleton robot lower limb structures. Each external skeleton robot upper limb structure comprises a shoulder part driving module, a big arm skeleton, an elbow part driving module, a small arm skeleton and a handle, wherein the handles are mounted on the small arm skeletons, and an upper limb sensor which is in signal connection with the corresponding shoulder part driving module and the elbow part driving module is arranged on each handle. Each external skeleton robot lower limb structure comprises a hip part driving module, a thing skeleton, a knee part driving module, a shank skeleton, an ankle part driving module and a foot part shoe, wherein a lower limb sensor which is in signal connection with the corresponding hip part driving module, the knee part driving module and the ankle part driving module correspondingly is arranged in each foot part shoe. The external skeleton robot can achieve various actions of human-like arms and upper limbs, and follow-up control of human over the robot can be achieved.
title: External skeleton robot

abstract: The invention discloses a multi-degree-of-freedom bionic exoskeleton. The multi-degree-of-freedom bionic exoskeleton comprises a fixed seat, thigh rods and shank rods, a balance seat is fixedly installed at the top of the fixed seat, fixed frames are fixedly installed at the top of the balance seat, a balance frame is movably installed between the fixed frames, movable joints are fixedly installed on the two sides of the bottom of the fixed seat, hip joints are movably installed between the movable joints, movable frames are movably installed at the bottoms of the fixed seats at the rear ends of the movable joints, first movable seats are movably installed at the bottoms of the hip joints, and the thigh rods are installed at the bottoms of the first movable seats in a butt joint mode. A multi-degree-of-freedom structure is realized, the hip joints can perform multi-degree-of-freedom movement through mutual cooperation of the movable joints and the hip joints, the flexibility is improved, the device can better fit a real walking posture of a person, the device can be conveniently kept balanced through mutual cooperation of the balance frame and a rotating disc, unbalance is not prone to occurring, and the maintenance cost is reduced.
title: Multi-degree-of-freedom bionic exoskeleton

abstract: The invention discloses a robot sole structure with a retractable fin. The robot sole structure with the retractable fin comprises a sole base, a toe assembly, a gear, a rack and a fin, wherein the sole base has an annular structure; the toe assembly is peripherally arranged on the periphery of the sole base and comprises movable toes and fixed toes; and the movable toes and the fixed toes are connected through the fin. The robot sole structure with the retractable fin can be fully in contact with the ground, and walking stability is improved; the angle of the toe assembly can be controlled by the synergistic effect of the motor, the gear, the rack and the like, pitching of a sole is realized, and the sole can adapt to complicated terrains; and the ground griping effect can be achieved by the synergistic effect of toes of the toe assembly of the robot, the fin is arranged among the toes of the toe assembly, the fin of the robot can stretch and retract between the movable toes and the fixed toes, contact area is increased further, flowing of soil is slowed down, foot settling of the robot is prevented effectively, and the walking capability of the robot in a soft soil environment is improved.
title: Robot sole structure with retractable fin

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot control method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the steps that in the process that a robot carries a load, foot trajectory planning is conducted on the robot, and a foot trajectory planning result of the robot is obtained; determining a zero moment point reference trajectory of the robot according to the foot trajectory planning result; determining an equivalent centroid trajectory according to the zero moment point reference trajectory; wherein the equivalent center of mass is the center of mass which takes the robot and the load as a whole; the mass center track of the robot is determined according to the equivalent mass center track; inverse kinematics solution is conducted according to the mass center track of the robot, and the leg joint poses of the robot are obtained; and controlling the robot to move according to the leg joint poses of the robot. According to the method, the influence generated by the load is fully considered, and the walking stability of the robot is effectively improved.
title: Robot control method and device, computer readable storage medium and robot

abstract: The invention discloses a completely passive both-foot walking machine with bionic ankle and subtalar joints, comprising a hip assembly, leg assemblies, ankle joint assemblies, subtalar joint assemblies, a left foot, a right foot and toe assemblies, wherein each leg assembly is arranged between the hip assembly and the ankle joint assembly, and a main body of the walking machine is constructed; each subtalar joint assembly is arranged between the ankle joint assembly and a foot, the toe assemblies are distributed at two sides of each foot. Foot joints disclosed by the invention comprise the ankle joint assemblies and the subtalar joint assemblies, the foot joints of the walking machine are designed by simulating the physiological angles of the ankle joints and the subtalar joints of a human in the space. Meanwhile, toes can realize an elastic start in the walking process under the effect of springs. According to the walking machine disclosed by the invention, the beneficial effects of the optimal walking energy efficiency, improvement of walking stability and naturality of the both-foot walking machine are achieved according to the passive walking principle and the introduction of the bionic ankle and subtalar joints.
title: Completely passive both-foot walking machine with bionic ankle and subtalar joints

abstract: The invention discloses a gait planning method and device for a robot walking on a slope, equipment and a medium. The method comprises steps of a beveloid material and an inclination angle of a targetslope being determined; collecting a skeleton point data set of legs of a human body in the walking process on the target slope, and constructing a slope walking track; constructing a leg model of the robot, and determining an association relationship between joint angles of the robot; establishing a nonlinear equation set according to the incidence relation and the slope walking track; constructing a control model according to the nonlinear equation set; wherein the control model is used for calculating a joint angle value when the robot walks on a target slope; and controlling the robot towalk on the slope according to the joint angle value. The method is advantaged in that walking stability of the robot is improved, and the robot can walk on a slope, is high in adaptability and can bewidely applied to the technical field of robots.
title: Gait planning method and device for robot walking on slope, equipment and medium

abstract: The invention relates to the field of bionic robots, and discloses a bionic robot and a bionic leg and a locking device thereof. The bionic robot body comprises a bionic robot body, the bionic robot body comprises a bionic robot trunk, a bionic robot head, a pair of bionic robot arms and a pair of bionic robot legs, the bionic robot head is installed at the upper end of the bionic robot trunk, thepair of bionic robot arms are arranged on the left side and the right side of the bionic robot trunk respectively, the bionic robot leg parts are installed at the lower end of the bionic robot trunkthrough a locking device, the bionic robot legs can be quickly stopped by the locking device, so that the probability of danger is reduced.
title: Bionic robot and bionic leg and locking device thereof

abstract: The invention relates to a foot structure of a biped robot and an all-terrain pavement adaptation method thereof. When the biped robot adopting the foot structure walks on a non-flat road surface, active adaptation can be conducted according to the actual terrain of the road surface, the corresponding posture is adjusted in time, the standing and walking stability of the biped robot is rapidly andeffectively improved, and the problems, for example, that when the biped robot walks on the uneven road surface, the foot ground contact area is small, and overall balance is difficult to maintain are solved. According to the all-terrain road surface adaptive foot structure, the foot bottom is divided into four areas, and the four areas are independently stressed and deformed, so the foot of therobot is kept in good contact with the ground on the uneven road surface; and meanwhile, the situation that the foot touches the ground is obtained through the force measuring sensors distributed in the four areas of the foot, the actual topographic distribution of the foot is speculated according to the situation, related joints of the robot are driven to be adjusted, and active adaptation of thefoot and the overall posture of the robot to the uneven road surface is completed.
title: Foot structure of biped robot and all-terrain pavement adaptation method thereof

abstract: The invention relates to a foot type robot and a motion control method of the foot type robot. The method comprises the following steps: responding to a reverse joint standing instruction, wherein the reverse joint standing instruction comprises switching from a positive joint standard standing state to a reverse joint standing state; determining a joint initial angle value of the positive joint in a standard standing state and a mechanical limiting angle value of the negative joint in a standing state; entering a positive joint standard standing state based on a whole body control algorithm; based on the joint initial angle value and the mechanical limiting angle value, determining a first discrete angle value for moving from a positive joint standard standing state to a negative joint standing state; and the first discrete angle value is converted into first joint torque based on joint proportional differential control, and a thigh motor and a shank motor are controlled to rotate based on the first joint torque, so that the foot type robot reaches reverse joint mechanical limiting in a reverse joint standing state. By adopting the method, stable switching of different states of the foot type robot can be improved.
title: Foot type robot and motion control method of foot type robot

abstract: The invention discloses a hydraulic biped robot lower limb mechanism with a buffering function. The hydraulic biped robot lower limb mechanism with the buffering function comprises a body support, hipjoint supporting frames arranged on the two sides of the body support, thighs hinged to the tail ends of the hip joint supporting frames, shanks hinged to the tail ends of the thighs and feet hingedto the tail ends of the shanks. Compared with the prior art, the hydraulic biped robot lower limb mechanism with the buffering function has 12 DoF (each hip joint has 3 DoF, each knee joint has 1 DoF,and each ankle has 2 DoF), so that the motion flexibility is greatly improved; hydraulic drive is adopted, so that high loading capacity and disturbance resisting capacity are achieved; damper devices are adopted, so that compliance of motion is greatly improved; the Z-shaped feet are adopted and have a certain elastic energy storage function, the front part of each foot is furcate, and then walking has a certain complex land adaptability.
title: Hydraulic biped robot lower limb mechanism with buffering function

abstract: The invention relates to a high-flexibility deformable wall-climbing robot which comprises a rack main body, the front portion of the rack main body is connected with a front swing arm in a swing mode, the rear portion of the rack main body is connected with a rear swing arm in a swing mode, the front swing arm and the rear swing arm are each rotatably connected with a torsion piece, the torsion pieces are each rotatably connected with a hinge base, and the hinge bases are hinged to the front swing arm and the rear swing arm. The hinge seats are connected with walking wheel sets, and the bottom of the machine frame body is also connected with walking wheel sets. The deformation capacity of the robot is effectively improved, so that the robot can adjust the corresponding walking posture according to different wall surface conditions, and the movement flexibility and the obstacle crossing capacity of the wall-climbing robot are improved.
title: High-flexibility deformable wall-climbing robot

abstract: According to the embodiment of the invention, the wheel-legged advancing device and the wheel-legged robot are provided. The wheel leg traveling device comprises a main body extending along the direction of the main body; the wheel type traveling mechanism is rotatably coupled to the first end of the main body in the direction of the main body and comprises at least one driving wheel for driving the wheel leg traveling device to move; the at least one pair of foot type advancing mechanisms is at least coupled to the second end, opposite to the first end, of the main body in the main body direction, and the at least one pair of foot type advancing mechanisms are arranged on the two sides of the main body direction correspondingly so as to be suitable for driving the wheel-leg advancing device to move in an alternating movement mode. Therefore, the wheel-leg advancing device not only can use the wheel type advancing mechanism to drive the device to advance, but also can simulate the walking posture of the human body through the foot type advancing mechanism under the complex road environment, so that better passing performance is obtained, the passing performance under the complex road condition can be improved, and the stability of passing through the complex road condition is improved.
title: Wheel-legged advancing device and wheel-legged robot

abstract: The invention relates to a lower-limb brain-like intelligent mechano-electronic exoskeleton and an integrated control system thereof. The lower-limb brain-like intelligent mechano-electronic exoskeleton is characterized by comprising a gravity center adjusting device, a plurality of mechano-electronic joints, a plurality of connecting rods, a plurality of exoskeleton bodies, foot fixing shoes and pelma sensors; the gravity center adjusting device is installed on the waist connecting rod, and the waist connecting rod, the hip mechano-electronic joint, the thigh exoskeleton bodies, the thigh connecting rods, the knee mechano-electronic joints, the shank exoskeleton bodies, the shank connecting rods and the ankle mechano-electronic joints are connected in sequence; the mechano-electronic joints are internally provided with joint angle and damping sensors respectively and driven by corresponding mechanical joint driving devices to generate actions. The lower-limb brain-like intelligent mechano-electronic exoskeleton is reasonable in design, various actions can be precisely sensed, and on this basis, the corresponding control functions are achieved. Meanwhile, the balance of the lower limbs is automatically adjusted through the gravity center adjusting device, the walking stability and reliability are ensured, and the problem that the rehabilitation effect of a patient who loses the lower limb functions is slow can be effectively solved.
title: Lower-limb brain-like intelligent mechano-electronic exoskeleton and integrated control system thereof

abstract: The invention relates to the field of robot control, in particular to a robot control method and device and a storage medium. The robot control method comprises the steps that a robot supporting leg knee joint angle and a swinging leg knee joint angle are obtained; determining a support leg knee joint angle and a swing leg knee joint angle; determining a target discrete support leg knee joint angle and a target discrete swing leg knee joint angle based on the support leg knee joint angle interval and the swing leg knee joint angle interval; based on the target kinetic parameters corresponding to the target discrete support leg knee joint angle and the target discrete swing leg knee joint angle, generating a joint torque control instruction for performing whole-body control on the robot; and performing whole-body control on the robot based on the joint torque control instruction. According to the invention, the dependence on the computing power of control hardware is reduced, and the response speed and the control precision of the joint are improved.
title: Robot control method and device and storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses a fall risk early assessment method based on multi-modal information fusion. The fall risk early assessment method comprises the steps that video data and sensor data of a tested person during walking are collected at the same time; obtaining a first evaluation result based on the video data; obtaining a second evaluation result based on the sensor data; and integrating the first evaluation result and the second evaluation result to obtain a final evaluation result. According to the fall risk early assessment method based on multi-modal information fusion, the walking posture information of the testee is comprehensively assessed by using the multi-modal information of two modes, and the advantages of the two modes are combined.
title: Fall risk early assessment method based on multi-modal information fusion

abstract: The invention discloses an X-ray security inspection machine imaging recognition method and system based on dynamic tracking, and the method comprises the steps: S1, collecting human face information, and obtaining identity information through big data analysis and comparison; s2, emitting an X-ray signal to a three-dimensional space in which the target moves; s3, displaying an image video of the target moving in the three-dimensional space in the virtual environment; s4, through an image analysis method, analyzing the limb movement change amplitude and change angle of the moving target to obtain limb movement data of the moving target; s5, comparing the walking limb movement data stored in the database corresponding to the identity information obtained in the step S1 with the limb movement data of the moving target collected in the step 4; and S6, judging whether the walking posture information is the walking posture information of the person collecting the identity information or not. According to the invention, the problem that whether a moving person is in a walking posture or not cannot be effectively recognized in an existing high-confidentiality person recognition scene is solved.
title: X-ray security inspection machine imaging identification method and system based on dynamic tracking

abstract: The embodiment of the invention belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and relates to a man-machine cooperation system and an operation control method and device.The system comprises a positioner, a robot, a self-adaptive cooperation module and a whole body control module; an end effector of the robot is provided with a force/touch sensor; the force/touch sensor is used for measuring force information applied by the end effector; the positioner is used for measuring motion data of a motion part of the operator; the self-adaptive cooperation module is used for solving the speed control quantity and the pose control quantity of the tail end of the robot based on the motion data and the force information; and the whole body control module is used for solving the joint speed control quantity of the robot based on the speed control quantity and the pose control quantity. According to the technical scheme, the operability of man-machine cooperation for the deformation target object can be improved.
title: Man-machine cooperation system, operation control method and device

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of foot type robots, and particularly relates to a six-degree-of-freedom series-parallel hydraulic drive foot type robot hip structure which is characterized in that a hip frame body comprises a plurality of annularly-distributed curved columns, the two ends of each curved column are connected with the same upper base and the same lower base correspondingly, and the upper portions of the curved columns are sleeved with the same first platform; the curved columns are divided into two sets, the lower portions of the same set of curved columns are sleeved with the same second platform, a subspace A is formed between the upper base and the first platforms, a subspace B is formed between the first platforms and the lower base, and subspaces C are formed between the first platforms and the second platforms. According to the technical scheme, structural distribution is reasonable and compact, space is saved, the size occupied by the hip structure is reduced, the application range of the foot type robot is enlarged, and the problem that in the prior art, a hydraulic drive system is large in overall size, and consequently a hydraulic drive foot type robot is difficult to deploy and use in some application scenes with limited space is solved.
title: Six-degree-of-freedom series-parallel connection type hydraulically-driven foot type robot hip structure

abstract: The present invention relates to a tendon apparatus for a clothing type wearable robot for assisting muscular strength, and is capable of supporting the muscular strength for both flexion/extension motion in order to enable strength support for various movements such as a flat walking, a stair walking, an inclined walking, and a sitting and standing. A mechanism of a drive module for the clothing type wearable robot which minimizes force transfer delay through a wire, minimizes influence of individual differences such as human body size and walking posture, and enables human-robot interaction force measurement by measuring tension of the wire. In addition, since the wearable robot has a form to be coupled with a human body, it is necessary to consider safety and non-uniformity of a wearer, and the wire of the drive module has elasticity by a spring.
title: Tendon device of suit type exoskeleton for human power assistance

abstract: The invention discloses a whole-body response planning control method for a mobile operation robot based on quadratic programming, and firstly provides a tail end track re-planning method combined with visual information. A tail end track is parameterized by using a B-spline curve, and a control point of the B-spline curve is corrected according to environment information, so that correction of a reference track in a certain time domain in the future is realized. Then, a reactivity optimization controller based on quadratic programming is provided for whole-body control, and safe and smooth collaborative movement of the mobile operation arm is achieved by combining safety constraint derived by a control barrier function and operability cost. Besides, by introducing a slack variable and punishing the slack variable, the instantaneous error of the reactive controller is allowed, the deviation target value is punished at the same time, the tracking adaptability and accuracy are improved, and the algorithm provided by the invention improves the potential of operation smoothness, safety and accuracy in an uncertain environment.
title: Moving operation robot whole body reaction planning control method based on quadratic programming

abstract: According to one embodiment, an electrostatic adsorption climbing robot can comprise an electrostatic adsorption pad formed in a continuous track shape, a robot lower body installed in the electrostatic adsorption pad to supply a rotational force to the electrostatic adsorption pad, and a robot upper body disposed on an upper part of the body to perform an operation according to a user′s command; the electrostatic adsorption pad generates an electrostatic force according to a supply of power such that the electrostatic adsorption pad can be electrostatically adsorbed on the wall of a structure; and climbing, moving, or being fixed to an operation area of the robot upper body can be achieved by the rotation and stopping of the electrostatic adsorption pad.
title: ELECTROSTATIC CLIMBING ROBOT

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of posture analysis, in particular to a 3D posture detection and analysis system and method. The system comprises an acquisition robot, a central controller, an input device and a display, and the central controller is in data connection with the acquisition robot and the display. The acquisition robot is used for acquiring walking posture data of a user. The central controller comprises a user walking route obtaining module used for obtaining a user walking route input by the input device. A robot control module is used for controlling the positionand direction of the acquisition robot according to the user walking route. A posture analysis module is used for analyzing the posture of the user according to the user walking posture data acquiredby the acquisition robot and generating a posture analysis result. According to the 3D posture detection and analysis system and method, by arranging the acquisition robot, multi-angle and all-aroundcollection can be flexibly carried out on the posture of the user, the flexibility of equipment deployment can be improved, the accuracy of the analysis result is improved, and the deployment cost isreduced.
title: 3D posture detection and analysis system and method

abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an Alzheimer's disease early screening method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a user facial expression; acquiring a user voice and a user input text; acquiring a walking gait of the user; inputting the facial expression of the user into a first prediction model to predict the emotional state of the user; inputting the user voice into a second prediction model to predict the emotional state of the user; inputting the user gait into a third prediction model for user gait recognition; performing text sentiment analysis on the text input by the user; integrating the results; and determining whether the user suffers from the early symptom of the Alzheimer's disease, and if so, sending an adjustment instruction to the accompanying robot and the relatives and friends. By implementing the method disclosed by the invention, the problems of individual difference, technical limitation, difficulty in capturing early pathological changes and the like in the existing early screening of the Alzheimer's disease can be solved, and meanwhile, a more convenient means for obtaining a more accurate result is provided.
title: Alzheimer's disease early screening method and device, computer equipment and storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses a depression mood gait recognition method and system based on a double-branch self-erasure graph convolutional network. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a model construction training module and a detection result output module. According to the method, psychological test data labels of a subject and walking gait data are collected to construct a data set, and features are extracted through a network, so that a depressive emotion detection model is obtained. An original gait video is processed into a scaling gait period video, a 3D-ResNet network is used for extracting shallow layer features, DSAM-GN is used for extracting deep layer features, and finally a result is obtained through a classifier. The method is high in precision and few in model parameters, and human body gait features can be better extracted; the method is high in real-time performance, low in cost and suitable for screening the mental health conditions of people, and effective auxiliary diagnosis suggestions are provided for psychological counseling doctors.
title: Depression mood gait recognition method and system based on double-branch self-erasure graph convolutional network

abstract: The invention discloses an ankle joint and a sole of a quadruped robot hind limb system, comprising an ankle joint and a sole which are rotatably connected; the ankle joint comprises a support plate,a support frame, a support support, a screw transmission unit and an ankle joint control unit; -The upper end of the screw rod transmission unit is fixed on the upper part of the support support, thetwo connecting ends of the lower end of the screw rod transmission unit are connected with the left and right ends of the support plate through two first connecting rods, and are hinged with the leftand right ends of the support frame through two second connecting rods, so as to realize the pitching motion and the turning motion of the support plate; The sole of the foot includes the heel, arch,sole control unit and toe. The invention can effectively improve the adaptability and anti-interference ability of the leg robot to complex terrain, It enhances the reliability of contact with the ground, improves the walking stability of robot in irregular terrain, expands the interaction ability of robot sole and environment, reduces the mechanical complexity of sole, and improves the control precision of ankle joint and sole.
title: An ankle joint and sole of a quadruped robot hind limb system

abstract: The invention discloses a quadruped robot control method applied to dynamic slope topography, and the method comprises the steps: enabling a quadruped robot to be equivalent to a virtual leg model through an overall motion planning layer, carrying out the online planning of the motion track and posture of a body according to a control instruction inputted by a user and the slope estimation fusing the data of each sensor, and carrying out the online planning of the motion track and posture of the body; the posture controller is used for controlling the posture of the body; the coordinated motion planning layer judges leg motion states, platform motion time-varying constraints are introduced into a robot dynamic model, and supporting leg joint torque and expected foot end counter-force are optimized and solved; introducing the concept of a balance point of the inverted pendulum model into planning of a swing leg, and optimizing a landing point of the robot on a dynamic slope; the single-leg control layer realizes force and position control of a single leg through kinematics and dynamics so as to execute control of a supporting phase and a swinging phase; the method adapts to a dynamic slope platform, can overcome complex road surfaces, and is good in adaptability; according to the foothold planning method, more appropriate points can be selected, and the walking stability of the quadruped robot is higher.
title: Quadruped robot control method applied to dynamic slope topography

abstract: The invention discloses a leg mechanism of a desktop robot, and the leg mechanism comprises a leg assembly which is internally provided with a rotary steering engine; the connecting rod structure is mounted at the upper part of the leg component and is used for supporting the robot trunk; the leg component can be driven to rotate relative to the connecting rod structure through the rotary steering engine; wherein the leg assembly is lifted up or put down by driving the connecting rod structure to rotate relative to the robot trunk, and the robot trunk is driven to do lateral movement by driving the leg assembly and the connecting rod structure to rotate relative to each other, so that the forward/backward movement of the leg mechanism is realized. The invention further discloses the desktop robot and a walking method thereof. According to the desktop robot, the structural complexity of the desktop robot is reduced, flexible movement and diversified action display can be achieved by simply coordinating and controlling the leg assemblies and the connecting rod structures, and the cost is reduced; in addition, by means of the design, the appearance of the desktop robot is optimized, and the use experience of the user is improved.
title: Leg mechanism of desktop robot, desktop robot and walking method of desktop robot

abstract: A Stewart platform includes six electromagnetic linear actuators, each provided with a cylindrical bering and positioned encoder. The actuators are surrounded by a crash ring made of cushioning material to absorb shocks in case of power loses of the platform. Such a motion platform may be included in an apparatus and method for testing footwear where a stationary shoe is truck by the platform in a manner simulating the running or walking gait.
title: Motion platform and method of use

abstract: The invention provides a method of a man-machine interaction system for human bone motion identification, relating to the technical field of human bone motion identification. The motion identification method is characterized in that wireless sensors and acceleration inductors are arranged at human joints and used for acquiring human bone motion information in a networking manner, the positions of a human body's arms and legs, shoulder and head in each frame of image are acquired by means of the combination of a human body skin color model and a background subtraction method based on a Gauss model, and a human body 3D model is established according to the position information, the 3D model is modified based on the motion direction position parameters in each area in a human body video image sequence, and various body motions are identified by means of HMM and the identification results are verified by experiments. The method of the man-machine interaction system for human bone motion identification is easy to realize, simple in principle, wide in application, and good in identification effect, and can achieve quick bone motion identification at a low cost.
title: Method of man-machine interaction system for human bone motion identification

abstract: The invention discloses a whole-body control method for an unmanned aerial vehicle in a strong wind disturbance environment, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle control, and the method comprises the steps: selecting corresponding target decision variables according to different wind disturbances; converting the nonlinear dynamic model of the unmanned aerial vehicle air operation system into a linear dynamic model; the unmanned aerial vehicle air operation system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle and a mechanical arm connected with the unmanned aerial vehicle. Online updating the estimated value of the air disturbance according to the online state data of the air operating system of the unmanned aerial vehicle; dynamically planning and solving a model prediction control optimization problem corresponding to the linear dynamic model according to the decision variable and the wind disturbance estimated value to obtain control input; and controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle air operation system according to the control input. According to the method, the target decision variable corresponding to the wind disturbance is selected, the estimated value of the wind disturbance is updated online, and then the appropriate control input is obtained through solving to control the system, so that the aerial operation system of the unmanned aerial vehicle adapts to various scenes under strong wind disturbance, and the robustness and the agility are improved.
title: Whole body control method for unmanned aerial vehicle in strong wind disturbance environment

abstract: The invention relates to a biped robot lower limb mechanism, in particular to a biped robot lower limb mechanism driven hydraulically. The problems that an existing electrically-driven robot is small in loading capacity, low in specific power and poor in anti-interference performance are solved. The biped robot lower limb mechanism comprises a body, an oil distributor, a left leg and a right leg, the oil distributor is arranged on the upper surface of the body, the left leg and the right leg are arranged on the lower surface of the body side by side, and are of the same structure, and the left leg comprises a foot, a shank, a thigh, a hip joint forward swing hydraulic cylinder servo unit, a hip joint twisting hydraulic cylinder servo unit, a hip joint, a knee joint forward swing hydraulic cylinder servo unit, an ankle joint, two ankle joint hydraulic cylinder servo units, a hip joint side swing hydraulic cylinder servo unit and a body upper end swing connecting piece. The biped robot lower limb mechanism belongs to the field of robots.
title: Biped robot lower limb mechanism driven hydraulically

abstract: The invention relates to an exoskeleton comprising at least one body worn on the body of the user, an exoskeleton which is movably and/or fixedly connected to said body and which provides support to at least one of the waist, shoulder, arm and leg regions of the user and which includes multiple support parts that reduce the physical load, and a tracking system that enables the tracking of this exoskeleton. Said exoskeleton comprises at least one GPS module for receiving instantaneous location information and at least one first communication module for wired or wireless communication in connection with said GPS module.
title: EXOSKELETON WITH GPS MODULE AND A TRACKING SYSTEM FOR THE SAME

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of fire rescue, and particularly discloses a fire rescue exoskeleton device which comprises a back frame, a first leg support and a second leg support, the back frame is fixed to the upper body of a worker, the first leg support is connected to the back frame, the second leg support is connected with the first leg support, and the second leg support is connected with the second leg support. The first leg support and the second leg support are used in cooperation and used for fixing thighs and shanks of a worker respectively, a supporting plate is connected to the back frame, the gravity center adjusting assembly is connected to the back frame and connected with the supporting plate, and the gravity center adjusting assembly adjusts the position of the supporting plate on the back frame by monitoring the weight of the supporting plate. The supporting plate is allowed to move in the vertical direction of the back frame, the gravity center adjusting assembly adjusts the position of the supporting plate according to the weight of a fire fighting tool on the supporting plate, the overall gravity center is kept close to the natural gravity center of a human body, back pressure is relieved, the body is prevented from inclining forwards or backwards due to uneven load bearing, and the falling risk caused by gravity center shifting is prevented. Therefore, the walking stability and comfort are improved.
title: Fire rescue exoskeleton device

abstract: The invention relates to a serial and parallel mixed connection arm/leg mechanism for a prosthetic robot fore limb mechanical system. The serial and parallel mixed connection arm/leg mechanism comprises mechanism bodies, hip joints and landing legs; and the two mechanism bodies are fixedly connected side by side to form mechanism main bodies, the two ends of each mechanism main body are provided with the hip joints, and the lower portion of each hip joint is connected with one landing leg. The serial and parallel mixed connection arm/leg mechanism comprises a mechanism body part, hip joint parts and landing leg parts, movement of six poles can obtain transverse motion, pitching and yawing of the hip joints in all directions, and the work space and the joint flexibility of the series leg parts are improved. The hip joint structure adopts double motors of big and small legs, the coaxial structure is achieved through thigh planet carriers, the rotation accuracy of swing rotation of the big and small legs can be improved when the leg part moves, and meanwhile the walking stability can be improved.
title: Serial and parallel mixed connection arm/leg mechanism for prosthetic robot fore limb mechanical system

abstract: The invention discloses a toy dog movement device capable of walking uprightly, which comprises a shell, a pair of front foot shells and a pair of rear foot shells, a driving component is arranged in the shell, and the front foot shells and the rear foot shells are respectively connected to the driving component through a front foot Hough link mechanism and a rear foot Hough link mechanism to realize four-foot walking. A rear foot posture switching assembly used for adjusting the relative position of a rod piece of a rear foot Hall connecting rod mechanism is arranged in the body, a foot adjusting shaft is driven to move by rotating a shifting rod, and then a rear foot sliding rod is driven to slide along a rear foot connecting rod through swinging of a rear foot rocker. And the rear foot Hough link mechanism is switched between a four-foot walking posture and a double-foot walking posture with the rear feet upright. According to the invention, a reliable mechanism can be utilized in the compact shell to realize convenient and stable switching between a four-foot walking posture and a rear-foot upright double-foot walking posture, so that the expressive force and the playing value of the toy are greatly improved.
title: Toy dog movement device capable of walking vertically

abstract: The invention discloses a mechanical foot type walking device. The mechanical foot type walking device comprises a bottom plate, a driving component and a walking component, wherein the driving component is installed in combination with the bottom plate, the walking component is installed in combination with the bottom plate, the driving component is connected with the walking component, the walking component is rotatably connected with the bottom plate through a supporting shaft, furthermore, the driving component is connected with the walking component through a crank structure, and the driving component drives the walking component to move in the direction parallel to the horizontal plane and in the direction perpendicular to the horizontal plane. The mechanical foot type walking deviceis steady in structure and can effectively support a robot serving as a leg structure of the robot, and the walking stability can be guaranteed, the good obstacle crossing performance is provided, and the mechanical foot type walking device can be widely adapted to different types of robots and has a wide use range.
title: Mechanical foot type walking device

abstract: The invention discloses a quadruped robot based on a single-degree-of-freedom closed chain connecting rod mechanism. The robot comprises a robot body and mechanical legs, each mechanical leg comprises a front leg mechanism, a rear leg mechanism and a connecting plate, and the front leg mechanisms and the rear leg mechanisms are installed on the robot body in a mirror image mode. The front leg mechanism comprises a right front leg mechanism and a left front leg mechanism, the rear leg mechanism comprises a right rear leg mechanism and a left rear leg mechanism, and the left leg mechanism and the right leg mechanism are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the machine body. The leg mechanism comprises a single-degree-of-freedom closed-chain connecting rod mechanism, a supporting plate and the like which are obtained through optimization of a closed-chain connecting rod mechanism synthesis and optimization method, the length of each rod piece of the single-degree-of-freedom closed-chain connecting rod mechanism has a fixed proportional relation, and under the condition that a motor is unidirectionally and uniformly arranged, the leg mechanism is fixed to the supporting plate. The foot end track of a single foot of the robot is an oval track, and the soaring phase and the grounding phase use the same time. The quadruped robot based on the single-degree-of-freedom connecting rod mechanism is good in walking stability and high in energy efficiency.
title: Quadruped robot based on single-degree-of-freedom closed chain connecting rod mechanism

abstract: A self-adaptive variable instantaneous center exoskeleton robot knee joint comprises a thigh rod, a shank rod, a driving line wheel, a joint shaft and a self-adaptive adjusting instantaneous center mechanism. The joint shaft is rotatably arranged on the lower portion of the thigh rod, the driving line wheel is fixed to one end of the joint shaft, a bionic fitting instantaneous center structure is adopted between the lower portion of the thigh rod and the upper portion of the shank rod, and a self-adaptive variable instantaneous center mechanism is arranged between the thigh rod and the shank rod and can move up and down relative to the thigh rod and the shank rod. The self-adaptive adjusting instantaneous center mechanism comprises a thigh telescopic liquid chamber, a shank telescopic liquid chamber and a liquid guide pipe; the thigh telescopic liquid chamber is connected with the shank telescopic liquid chamber through the liquid guide pipe, and the thigh telescopic liquid chamber is arranged on the thigh rod and can move up and down relative to the thigh rod. The defects that an existing power-assisted exoskeleton robot knee joint mechanism cannot adapt to the motion state of the human knee joint, and then normal movement of the human body is interfered are overcome.
title: Self-adaptive variable instantaneous center exoskeleton robot knee joint

abstract: The invention belongs to the field of robots, and particularly relate to a hydraulic-driven biped robot lower limb mechanism. The hydraulic-driven biped robot lower limb mechanism comprises a trunk, aleft leg and a right leg, the left leg comprises a foot part, an ankle joint assembly, a shank, a knee joint assembly, a thigh and a hip joint assembly; the thigh is connected with the truck and theshank, the shank is hinged to the foot part, the hip joint assembly comprises a cantilever, a hip joint pitching hydraulic driving unit and a hip joint side hydraulic driving unit, the hip joint sidehydraulic driving unit is connected with the cantilever and the trunk, and the hip joint pitching hydraulic driving unit is connected with the cantilever and the thigh; and a knee joint hydraulic driving unit in the knee joint assembly is connected with the thigh and the shank; and the ankle joint assembly comprises two ankle joint hydraulic driving units which are arranged side by side, one endsof the ankle joint hydraulic driving units are hinged to a main body of the shank, and the other ends of the ankle joint hydraulic driving units are hinged to the foot part. The hydraulic-driven bipedrobot lower limb mechanism solves the problems that in the prior art, a motor-driven robot is small in moving speed, lacking of explosive force and difficult to adapt to complicated terrains.
title: Hydraulic-driven biped robot lower limb mechanism

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a gait planning method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a first phase variable of gait planning of the robot, wherein the first phase variable is a function of two position components of a trunk of the robot on a horizontal plane; a second phase variable is constructed according to the first phase variable, the second phase variable is a function of the first phase variable, and the slope of the second phase variable is smaller than that of the first phase variable at the moment before the swing foot of the robot touches the ground; and performing gait planning on the swinging foot of the robot by using the second phase variable to obtain a planning track of the swinging foot of the robot. According to the method and the device, the phase variable constructed based on the state of the robot is improved, the slope of the improved phase variable at the moment before the swing foot touches the ground is smaller, the impact between the swing foot and the ground can be smaller, and thus the walking stability of the robot is enhanced.
title: Gait planning method and device, computer readable storage medium and robot

abstract: The invention provides a robot hip joint, a control method and device and a robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The mechanical hip joint comprises a supporting assembly, a driving assembly and an executing assembly. The driving assembly comprises a first driver, a second driver and a third driver, and the execution assembly comprises a first leg moving part, a second leg moving part and a waist moving part; the first leg moving part and the second leg moving part are rotationally connected with the supporting assembly, the first driver is in transmission connection with the first leg moving part, the first driver is used for driving the first leg moving part to rotate around a first axis, and the second driver is used for driving the second leg moving part to rotate around the first axis; the waist moving part is rotationally connected with the supporting assembly, the third driver is in transmission connection with the waist moving part, and the third driver is used for driving the waist moving part to rotate around a second axis; the first axis is parallel to the second axis. The stair climbing robot is compact in structure and suitable for scenes such as stair climbing.
title: Robot hip joint, control method and device and robot

abstract: The invention relates to a guest welcoming and cleaning robot device with an ultra-quiet walking characteristic. The device solves the problems that a walking device of a traditional guest welcoming robot generates a large noise in the welcoming process, and the traditional guest welcoming robot cannot perform other work in a non-welcoming state. The guest welcoming and cleaning robot device comprises a robot head, a robot torso, a wheeled chassis moving device and a control system, the robot head comprises a head casing, an RGB-LED 8*16 dot matrix expression board and a voice device, the robot torso is composed of a neck support bracket, a back support plate, a chest support plate, a touch sensor and an ultrasonic sensor, the wheeled chassis moving device is composed of a walking device and a cleaning device, and an STM32F103 chip is used as a main chip of a control system and is in controlling connection with the RGB-LED 8*16 dot matrix expression board, the voice device, the touch sensor, the ultrasonic sensor, a brushless direct current gear motor and a brushless direct current motor; the functions of ultra-quiet walking, self-service obstacle avoidance, voice broadcast and ground cleaning of the guest welcoming cleaning robot are achieved.
title: Guest welcoming and cleaning robot device with ultra-quiet walking characteristic

abstract: The invention discloses a luggage transport robot. The luggage transport robot comprises a first support, a second support, upper limbs, first rods, first gears, thigh connecting pieces, a steering engine and the like. The second support, a third support, a pair of fourth supports and a pair of fifth brackets are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the first support from inside to outside, andmeanwhile, the second support and the third support are fixedly connected with a sixth support through first inner hexagon screws. The first rods are arranged between the third support and the fourthsupports on the same side with the third support, and the first rods, the third support and the fourth supports form a rotating pair. By using a gear set, the hip of a semi-passive walking machine iskept to be on the angular bisector, on the sagittal plane, of the left and right legs all the time, and the walking stability can be improved.
title: Luggage transport robot

abstract: The invention discloses an active power-assisted armored vehicle rescue exoskeleton robot lower limb structure which comprises passive hip joint assisting modules, active boom power assisting modules,retractable base modules and a waist connecting module; the retractable base module are arranged in left-right symmetry and are provided with the passive hip joint assisting modules respectively; thepassive hip joint assisting modules are provided with the active boom assisting modules respectively; and the waist connecting module is arranged between the passive hip assisting modules. The activepower-assisted armored vehicle rescue exoskeleton robot lower limb structure enables rescue personnel to quickly wear the single-person rescue device for rescue and has the characteristics of simpleness, rapidness, time conservation and labor conservation.
title: Active power-assisted armored vehicle rescue exoskeleton robot lower limb structure

abstract: The invention discloses a sole control type lower limb energy storage power-assisted mechanism. The sole control type lower limb energy storage power-assisted mechanism comprises a thigh rod, a thigh bandage, a knee joint energy storage device, a shank rod, an air spring, a ball joint, a bottom plate and a spring. In the using process, the thigh rod is bound to a thigh through the bandage. Man-machine coupling and multi-degree-of-freedom passive walking assistance are achieved according to the human body walking gait principle, the energy storage requirement is met through bending of a coil spring, full utilization of energy is achieved through cooperative use of the air spring, and free and smooth switching between a working state and a non-working state is achieved through cooperative use of an electromagnet and meshing teeth.
