In the daily walking process, the sole control type lower limb energy storage power-assisted mechanism can help people to share loads of knee joints and achieve load bearing and energy storage in the supporting phase so as to assist stretching in the later period of the supporting middle period; and meanwhile, sufficient power is provided for lifting the legs in the pre-swinging period, and the legs can swing freely in the swinging period without interfering with normal movement of the human body.
title: Sole control type lower limb energy storage power-assisted mechanism

abstract: The invention discloses an omnibearing avoiding device based on artificial intelligence. The omnibearing avoiding device comprises a base, a motor, fan blades, a storage box and an obstacle avoidancedevice. Driving wheels are movably installed at the bottom of the base, an adjusting rod penetrates an inner bearing of a supporting plate, and movable blocks are connected with the base and a shell through guide rods. The motor is installed at one end of the interior of the shell through bolts, a motor shaft is rotationally connected to the bottom of the motor, a transmission shaft penetrates ina third gear and is connected with a movable shaft through a belt wheel mechanism, air conveying pipes are fixed to the positions, below the fan blades, of the shell, and the storage box is fixedly installed on the top of the shell. According to the omnibearing avoiding device based on artificial intelligence, surrounding obstacles can be perceived in an omnibearing manner, the safety distance canbe kept, the perceived height can be adjusted, meanwhile, sundries at the walking position of a robot can be removed, and therefore the walking stability is guaranteed.
title: Omnibearing avoiding device based on artificial intelligence

abstract: The invention discloses a high-stability education robot, and belongs to the field of education robots. The high-stability education robot comprises a robot body, the bottom of the robot body is fixedly connected with a control box, the bottom of the control box is provided with six sets of walking mechanisms, and the six sets of the walking mechanisms are annularly and uniformly distributed. The top of each set of the walking mechanism is provided with an automatic height adjusting assembly. According to the scheme, in the actual moving process of the robot body, a camera shoots the road surface condition in real time and transmits the shot image to a controller, and when the road surface is uneven or has an inclined plane, the controller controls the automatic height adjusting assembly to adjust the heights of the walking mechanisms, so that the whole device is in a stable state, and the walking stability is guaranteed. And when the robot body does not need to be moved, a telescopic auxiliary supporting assembly penetrates through a through hole to make contact with the ground, the whole device is supported in an auxiliary mode, and the whole device can be stably placed at a set position during moving.
title: High-stability education robot

abstract: The invention discloses a variable-stiffness self-adaptive toe joint which comprises a sole plate and toes and further comprises a driving mechanism and a driven mechanism, and the driven mechanism comprises a pressing wheel. One side of each toe is connected with the sole plate through the titanium steel plate spring, the pressing wheel is located above the titanium steel plate spring and presses the titanium steel plate spring, and the driving mechanism can drive the pressing wheel to move above the titanium steel plate spring so as to adjust the rotating radius of the toes. One side of the toe is connected with the sole plate through the titanium steel plate spring, the pressing wheel is located above the titanium steel plate spring and can press the titanium steel plate spring, the driving mechanism can drive the pressing wheel to move along the titanium steel plate spring, and the bending radius when the toe is stressed is changed through different contact positions of the pressing wheel and the titanium steel plate spring; the variable stiffness self-adaptive movement of the toes in the movement process is achieved, and the walking speed, the stride height and stride of the robot in the walking process and the walking stability of the robot are improved.
title: Variable-stiffness self-adaptive toe joint, toe joint operation method and application thereof

abstract: The invention discloses a form-changeable quadruped robot. The form-changeable quadruped robot comprises mechanical legs, a robot trunk and modular mechanical arms, the mechanical legs are connected with the robot trunk; and the modular mechanical arms are placed on the robot trunk and connected with the mechanical legs after being detached. The walking mode of the quadruped robot can be changed through leg shape reconstruction, the quadruped robot can quickly adapt to different environments, and the moving and cross-country ability is improved; a wheel type moving mode is added, so that the quadruped robot can quickly move on a flat road surface; and through the modular mechanical arm, the mechanical legs of the quadruped robot can be converted into the mechanical arms through the interfaces, and the operation capacity of the quadruped robot is improved under the condition that the mechanical arms are not additionally arranged.
title: Form-changeable quadruped robot

abstract: The invention relates to a brimless wheel mechanism capable of being used for traveling simulation and automatic testing of a biped robot. The brimless wheel mechanism is composed of a center shaft module, a sliding sleeve module, a leg module, a control circuit module, a center shaft connection module and an additional function module, and can move in various modes under cooperation of the modules. As for the spatial bilateral brimless wheel movement mode of the brimless wheel mechanism, through intermittent impact contact between the tail end of a spoke of the brimless wheel mechanism and the topographical slope, sole rhythmic movement of a steady foot walking gait is simulated, and testing is conducted. Compared with traditional brimless wheel mechanisms and application thereof, the brimless wheel mechanism has the advantages that the number of legs can be changed, the wheel tread and the leg length can be adjusted, an elastic damping element is additionally arranged, the plane unilateral brimless wheel system mode and the spatial bilateral brimless wheel system mode can be switched, and accordingly, biped passive movement testing and control research with more forms is achieved.
title: Brimless wheel mechanism used for traveling simulation and automatic testing of biped robot

abstract: The invention discloses a gait control method and a device for a dual-foot robot. The method comprises the steps of selecting gait control parameters for a starting period, a walking period and a stopping period; acquiring the motion trajectory of the mass center of the dual-foot robot during the walking period when the zero moment point of the dual-foot robot is within a stable area; obtaining the first value of each gait control parameter when the mass center is at the initial moment of the walking period and the second value of the gait control parameter when the mass center is at the ending moment of the walking period; setting a first constraint condition at the ending moment of the starting period by utilizing the first value, and setting a second constraint condition at the starting moment of the stopping period by utilizing the second value; based on the first constraint condition and the second constraint condition, calculating the motion trajectory of the mass center during the starting period and during the stopping period respectively; controlling the walking of the dual-foot robot to enable the motion trajectory of the mass center of the dual-foot robot during walking to meet the motion trajectory of the mass center during the starting period, the walking period and the stopping period respectively. According to the technical scheme of the invention, the stable cohesion of the dual-foot robot during the starting period, the walking period and the stopping period and the walking stability of the dual-foot robot can be ensured.
title: Gait control method and device for dual-foot robot

abstract: The invention discloses a multi-legged robot hydraulic drive unit capable of absorbing landing impact. The multi-legged robot hydraulic drive unit comprises a proportional servo valve, a servo cylinder, an energy accumulator, a valve plate, a damping part and a fuel tank. The proportional servo valve is installed on the valve plate, four work oil ports of the proportional servo valve are connected to other components through fuel pipes respectively, the main oil inlet is connected to the energy accumulator, and the two work oil ports are connected to two cavities of the servo cylinder. A damping hole is formed between a rod-less cavity of the servo cylinder and a rod cavity of the servo cylinder. The damping part installed in the valve plate is installed in a threaded hole and can be detached and replaced, and the diameter and the length of the damping part can be adjusted according to needs. Various oil ways for hydraulic oil to flow are formed in the valve plate. The hydraulic drive unit can lower the influence of the ground impulse at the landing moment of a multi-legged robot on the high-load and high-speed gait condition on the robot, can lower the influence of instant hydraulic impact of ground impact on the hydraulic drive robot, can improve the dynamic-gait walking stability of the robot and can be applied to any joint of the multi-legged robot.
title: Multi-legged robot hydraulic drive unit capable of absorbing landing impact

abstract: The invention provides a wearable tension integral type bionic lower limb device, and belongs to the technical field of robot manufacturing. Comprising a three-dimensional tensioning overall mechanism and a knee joint component, and the three-dimensional tensioning overall mechanism is used for simulating foot actions; the radial spherical plain bearing is arranged on the lower bottom surface of the top block assembly and is arranged on the bottom plate through the bearing connecting piece; the top block assembly is installed on the bottom plate through a top block connecting piece, and the top block connecting piece is used for simulating twisting and lifting of a foot ankle joint; a bionic arch is arranged on the bottom plate and is used for buffering the impact on the bottom plate; the knee joint part comprises a bionic thigh part and a bionic shank part, and a flexible knee joint tension piece is arranged at the hinged position of the bionic thigh part and the bionic shank part; the lower limb motion mode of a person is restored to the maximum extent, various equilibrium states can be achieved, the application range is wide, and the robot lower limb bionic structure can serve as a wearable bionic structure and can also be directly applied to robot lower limbs. The composite material has impact resistance and bearing capacity, is high in material utilization rate, light in weight and convenient to assemble.
title: Wearable tensioning integral type bionic lower limb device

abstract: The invention relates to a movement mechanism (A) comprising at least one torso worn on the body of the user; an exoskeleton which is movably and/or permanently connected to said torso and which provides support to at least one of the waist, shoulder, arm and leg regions of the user and which includes multiple support parts that provide support to at least one of the waist, shoulder, arm and leg regions of the user and reduce physical load, and which enables the user to move the elbow and/or wrist by connecting to at least one support part in the arm region.
title: A MOVEMENT MECHANISM FOR EXOSKELETONS

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and relates to an exoskeleton robot ankle joint with double flexible driving branches. The exoskeleton robot ankle joint comprises a shank fixing block, a constraint branch, a sole plate, a first driving branch and a second driving branch, wherein the sole plate is connected with the shank fixing block through the constraint branch, the first driving branch and the second driving branch are arranged on the shank fixing block, and the sole plate is driven by the first driving branch and the second driving branch to realize dorsiflexion/plantar flexion and introversion/ectropion rotation. The exoskeleton robot ankle joint with the double flexible driving branches has two active degrees of freedom of dorsiflexion/plantar flexion and inward turning/outward turning, the rotation centers of the two joints are highly superposed to the center of the ankle joint of a human body, the structural rigidity is high, the driving force is sufficient, the center of gravity is close to the upper part, and each driving unit is connected with an elastic element in series, so that flexible and safe power output of each joint can be realized.
title: Exoskeleton robot ankle joint with double flexible driving branches

abstract: The invention provides an active control method and system based on rehabilitation robot arm joint motor current feedback and relates to the field of upper limb joint active rehabilitation. The methodincludes the following process that step 1, a kinematic model and a dynamical model of rehabilitation robot arms are established; step 2, joint current change caused by external force is calculated;and step 3, a motor is actively controlled to move according to the current change. By means of the active control method and system based on rehabilitation robot arm joint motor current feedback, input force, which is input in the rehabilitation robot arms, of a patient can be detected without a force sensor, detection of the force sensor is replaced by motor current feedback, substituting into akinetic equation is performed through real-time feedback of an encoder, the interference influence on the current due to gravity load under different positions and poses during movement is reduced, amovement relation of the feedback current and the motor rotating speed is established, and thus active control over the rehabilitation robot arms is achieved.
title: Active control method and system based on rehabilitation robot arm joint motor current feedback

abstract: A safety control method of a mobile manipulator robot according to one embodiment of the present invention includes processes of recognizing an approaching worker through an AMR to determine whether the worker is approaching, determining whether there is a collision with the worker through a multi-joint robot, entering a safety mode in response to the collision with the worker, and analyzing the avoidance direction according to the collision to control at least one of the AMR and the multi-joint robot to operate. Thus, the present invention can provide an efficient safety control method for the operation of a mobile manipulator, which is an integrated system of an autonomous mobile robot (AMR) and a multi-joint robot.
title: Mobile manipulator robot and safety control method of mobile manipulator robot using same

abstract: An embodiment includes a robotic welding system for generating a motion program, having a programmable robot controller of a robot having a computer processor and a computer memory. The programmable robot controller is configured to digitally record, in the computer memory, a plurality of spatial points along an operator path in a 3D space taken by a calibrated tool center point (TCP) of the robot as an operator manually moves a robot arm of the robot along the operator path from a start point to a destination point within the 3D space. The programmable robot controller is also configured to identify and eliminate extraneous spatial points from the plurality of spatial points as digitally recorded, leaving a subset of the plurality of spatial points as digitally recorded, where the extraneous spatial points are a result of extraneous movements of the robot arm by the operator.
title: ROBOT WITH SMART TRAJECTORY RECORDING

abstract: The invention relates to a table tennis robot system based on embedded equipment and application. The system is used for automatically returning a table tennis ball, the system comprises a robot body,the robot body comprises a camera and a mechanical arm, and the system is characterized in that the system also comprises embedded processing equipment, wherein the camera and the mechanical arm areboth connected to the embedded processing equipment, the embedded processing equipment is integrated with a storage module and a processing module, and the storage module stores an offline trained trajectory prediction model and a computer program for controlling the action of a robot body; when the processing module executes the computer program, the following processes are executed: obtaining the current position coordinates of the table tennis ball based on an image shot by the camera, inputting the current position coordinates into the trajectory prediction model to predict the table tennis ball drop point coordinates, and controlling the robot arm to move to the table tennis ball drop point coordinates to return stroke. Compared with the prior art, the table tennis robot is good in mobility and high in return stroke accuracy.
title: Table tennis robot system based on embedded equipment and application

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mine inspection, and particularly relates to an inspection robot navigation and obstacle avoidance device for a coal mine environment, which comprises a mounting plate and I-shaped steel, side plates are vertically and fixedly connected to positions, close to two sides, of the top end of the mounting plate, driving assemblies are arranged on the side plates, and first guide assemblies are arranged on the inner side walls of the side plates; the bottom end of the mounting plate is fixedly connected with a hydraulic cylinder, an output point of the hydraulic cylinder is fixedly connected with an inspection robot body, the inspection robot body is provided with a video monitoring holder, the inspection robot body is provided with a safety edge contact sensor, and the safety edge contact sensor is tightly attached to the I-shaped steel through a first limiting wheel. The inspection robot can play a good guiding role in turning and climbing, and the problem that the inspection robot shakes left and right due to the external environment in the walking process is solved.
title: Inspection robot navigation and obstacle avoidance device for coal mine environment

abstract: The invention discloses a transmission device and an exoskeleton robot. The transmission device comprises a shaft rod, a driving rotating mechanism, driven rotating mechanisms and drive mechanisms. The driving rotating mechanism is arranged on the shaft rod in a sleeving mode and used for receiving the action of the external force so as to be rotated relative to the shaft rod. Each end of the driving rotating mechanism comprises a first engagement portion. Each driven rotating mechanism is arranged on the shaft rod in a sleeving mode and located on the corresponding side of the driving rotating mechanism. The end of each driven rotating mechanism comprises a second engagement portion. The second engagement portions and the first engagement portions are separated in a face-to-face mode. Thedrive mechanisms are connected with the driven rotating mechanisms and used for driving the driven rotating mechanisms to conduct reciprocating movement on the shaft rod so that the first engagementportions and the second engagement portions can engage with each other or can be separated. The transmission device is simple and stable in structure and simple in control process, the response of theclutching process of the transmission device can be more sensitive, and the transmission efficiency is improved.
title: Transmission device and exoskeleton robot

abstract: The robot hand according to one embodiment of the present technology is provided with a finger unit and a guide member. The finger unit is configured to be capable of holding a flexible linear member such that the linear member can slide in the long side direction of the linear member, said linear member having one end that is fixed. The guide member is attached to the finger unit, and has a guide section for guiding the linear member to a predetermined position.
title: ROBOT HAND, ROBOT DEVICE, AND METHOD FOR MANUFACTURING ELECTRONIC APPARATUS

abstract: The invention discloses a badminton basic movement auxiliary training system based on Kinect, belongs to the field of human-computer interaction, and aims to solve the problems of small application range and low accuracy of a badminton movement guidance system adopting a DTW algorithm. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a movement feature extraction and identification module and a movement standard degree analysis and guidance module. The data acquisition module is used for monitoring an athlete in real time by utilizing Kinect v2 somatosensory equipment and acquiring three-dimensional coordinate data of 25 articulation points of the whole body of the athlete; the movement feature extraction and recognition module is used for establishing a standard template and obtaining thesimilarity between a to-be-tested user and the standard template movement; and the movement standard degree analysis and guidance module is used for judging the category to which the current movementof the to-be-tested user belongs according to the similarity, and analyzing whether the current movement of the to-be-tested user meets the standard or not according to the skeleton included angle threshold range set by the category movement technology evaluation rule.
title: Badminton basic movement auxiliary training system based on Kinect

abstract: A precision instrumentation platform carrying a tool, such as a scanner or drill, on a computer-controlled robotic arm is controlled by a robotic type positioning system. The scanner of the platform makes a three dimensional tomographic type scan of the area being diagnosed and a computer image is formed. A drill, or other treatment modality of the instrumentation platform, is controlled to treat the affected area. In the preferred embodiment of the invention, computer-controlled hydraulic pumps control vertical movement and rotation of the robotic arm and the instrumentation platform. These pumps adjust fluid volummes in various chambers to position the platform either for the purpose of making the scan or performing the treatment. As fluid volummes change, pistons move, and the platform follows a computer-directed path. Positional sensors, along with connecting torque systems and control systems create a multi-loop servo-system that guides the platform.
title: Computerized instrument platform positioning system

abstract: The invention provides a control method and device for an intelligent robot with a body, a terminal and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot autonomous task planning and motion control. The method comprises the steps of collecting multi-mode prompt information of a to-be-controlled robot; based on a large-scale pre-training language model, multi-modal prompt information and an atomic skill library suitable for robot long-sequence whole-body linkage actions, generating a corresponding chain reasoning text when a to-be-controlled robot executes task description, and decomposing the task description into atomic skill calling sequences according to the chain reasoning text, the atomic skill calling sequence comprises a plurality of atomic skills according to a calling sequence; and after calling and activating the atomic skills one by one according to the calling sequence, controlling the to-be-controlled robot to execute the atomic skills according to the calling sequence. According to the invention, seamless connection of whole-body motion and local operation of the robot can be realized, so that the robot can efficiently complete a long-sequence task in a complex environment.
title: Control method and device for intelligent robot with body, terminal and storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses a hair washing robot arm of a hairdressing robot and belongs to the technical field of electromechanics. The technical problem to be solved is to provide a hair washing robot arm of a hairdressing robot, which can automatically spray shampoo, automatically spray water and automatically rub and wash hairs on the head. The invention provides a technical scheme of the hair washing robot arm of the hairdressing robot, and the technical scheme comprises the connection modes and functions of 19 main components, 6 technical characteristics, 5 implementation drawings and the like.
title: Hair washing robot arm of hairdressing robot

abstract: The invention discloses a multi-joint internal drive variable holding power delay self-adaptation robot finger device, and belongs to the technical field of robot hands. The device comprises a base, a first finger segment, a second finger segment, a third finger segment, a near joint shaft, a middle joint shaft, a far joint shaft, two motors, two speed reducers, 12 gears, six spring parts, four shifting rods and four convex blocks. According to the device, in-built drive variable holding power holding and holding composite self-adaptation grabbing functions can be achieved. According to the device, the motors are placed in the middles of the fingers, the space occupying of the base is reduced, during object grabbing, the self-adaptation grabbing effect of objects in different shapes and with different sizes can be achieved, the control is simple, a complex sensing and control system is not needed, the motion personification degree is high, small objects can be held, a heavy object and a large object also can be held, and the holding force can be variable.
title: Multi-joint internal drive variable holding power delay self-adaptation robot finger device

abstract: The CPG control system comprises four oscillator units for correspondingly controlling hip joints of the quadruped robot, the oscillator units are connected to form a one-way ring network structure, the connection mode is time-lag coupling, and the oscillator units are connected with the hip joints of the quadruped robot under the time-lag effect. Multiple stable phase differences are achieved on the basis of a spontaneous symmetry breaking mechanism, parameter setting of a CPG control system is carried out through nonlinear dynamics analysis, and therefore multiple gait modes of the quadruped robot and switching of the multiple gait modes are achieved, and the multiple gait modes comprise quadruped jumping, side sequence walking, double-foot jumping, diagonal sequence walking, pacing and diagonal small running. Compared with the prior art, the system is simple in structure and easy to implement in engineering; the parameter setting method is reliable, and the change of the gait mode can be realized by switching a single time delay parameter between rhythm regions; and in a given rhythm region, the gait mode does not change along with the change of parameters, so that the robustness is effectively ensured.
title: CPG control system of quadruped robot and parameter setting method of CPG control system

abstract: The invention provides a conveying unit and a substrate processing apparatus which can stably perform vacuum suction on a substrate and can be used for a long time. The transport unit includes a robot arm and an end effector connected to the robot arm, where the end effector includes: a main body; a vacuum hole formed in the main body; and a pad mounted on the main body so as to surround the vacuum hole, and including a first pad layer and a second pad layer stacked in this order, in which the first pad layer has greater elasticity than the second pad layer, and the second pad layer has greater hardness than the first pad layer.
title: Transfer unit and substrate processing apparatus including same

abstract: A robot arm assembly includes a first, a second, and a third hollow arm, a fourth arm, and a first, a second, and a third transmission. The second arm is rotatably connected to the first arm, the third arm is rotatably connected to the second arm, the fourth arm is rotatably connected to the third arm. The first transmission sub-assembly is rotatably received in the first arm. The second transmission sub-assembly is rotatably received in the first arm and the second arm. The third transmission sub-assembly is rotatably received in the first arm, the second arm, and the third arm, and fixedly connected to the fourth arm. The first arm, the second arm, the third arm, and the fourth arm are capable of rotating around a first axis, a second axis, a third axis, and a fourth axis respectively.
title: ROBOT ARM ASSEMBLY

abstract: The invention discloses a power generation device for a thigh lower area of a running and walking robot, and relates to various reciprocating motion rotating devices in the electromechanical field. A reciprocating motion rotating device is installed to drive a generator to achieve self-power-generation and self-charging of the lower thigh area power generation technology. According to the main technical scheme, one end of a connecting rod is sealed, a piston is installed at the other end of the connecting rod, a spring is installed in front of a closed leg pipe, and one-way air inlet, air outlet and liquid valves are installed outside the pipe and connected in a combined mode to be connected into an inlet and an outlet of a steam pump and a hydraulic pump to form closing. During walking, pressure generated by self-weight and tension of the springs and the shanks form reciprocating motion, gas and liquid enter the gas, and the hydraulic pump drives the gas and the liquid to rotate and then circularly reciprocate to drive the foot rear area generator to generate electricity. The robot is mainly used for realizing self power generation and charging by utilizing the gravity of the robot in the running and walking processes and driving the power generator through the reciprocating motion rotating device.
title: Power generation device for lower thigh area of running walking robot

abstract: Two or more robotic arms having end effectors rigidly attached to an object to be moved are disclosed. A hybrid position/force control system is provided for driving each of the robotic arms. The object to be moved is represented as having a total mass that consists of the actual mass of the object to be moved plus the mass of the moveable arms that are rigidly attached to the moveable object. The arms are driven in a positive way by the hybrid control system to assure that each arm shares in the position/force applied to the object. The burden of actuation is shared by each arm in a non-conflicting way as the arm independently control the position of, and force upon, a designated point on the object.
title: Method and apparatus for hybrid position/force control of multi-arm cooperating robots

abstract: The quadruped robot comprises a bearing disc, the bearing disc is movably fixed to a trunk of the quadruped robot through a movable assembly rod, a control motor for controlling the movable assembly rod to move is arranged on the movable assembly rod, and the unmanned aerial vehicle is driven by the control motor to rise and fall. The bearing disc can be located above the trunk or below the trunk and move between the upper portion of the trunk and the lower portion of the trunk. The unmanned aerial vehicle takes off and lands on the bearing disc, and a fixing mechanism used for fixing the unmanned aerial vehicle and the bearing disc is arranged between the bearing disc and the unmanned aerial vehicle. The unmanned aerial vehicle and the quadruped robot are used in cooperation through the bearing disc, can be separated from each other and work independently, do not affect the performance during work, and guarantee completion of a work task.
title: Quadruped robot with unmanned aerial vehicle capable of taking off and landing integrally

abstract: A controller (1) for work piece-conveying robot having: a coordinate system storage section (2) for storing one or more manual jog feed coordinate systems; a working area setting section (3) for setting to a machine tool (30) a working area to which the manual jog feed coordinate system is assigned; a hand position obtaining section (4) for obtaining a current position of the robot hand (12) at each specified sampling period; a determination section (5) for determining whether or not the current position of the robot hand (12) obtained by the hand position obtaining section (4) is within the working area set by the working area setting section (3); and a coordinate system switching section (6) for switching a present manual jog feed coordinate system to the manual jog feed coordinate system assigned to the working area if it is determined by the determination section (5) that the current position of the robot hand (12) is within the working area.
title: Controller of work piece-conveying robot

abstract: Embodiments disclosed herein include a method of centering a substrate in a chamber. In an embodiment, the method comprises inserting the substrate into the chamber with a robot arm, obtaining a delta time value for a second pyrometer relative to a first pyrometer, where the delta time value is a duration of time between when the first pyrometer is covered by the substrate and when the second pyrometer is covered by the substrate, calculating a time offset value of the delta time value relative to an ideal delta time value, where the ideal delta time value is the delta time value when the substrate is perfectly centered in a first direction perpendicular to the motion of the substrate, and comparing the time offset value to a graph or a lookup table that correlates the time offset value to a distance offset value.
title: Automated substrate placement to chamber center

abstract: The invention discloses a modular reconfigurable bionic wheel-legged robot which deeply integrates bionics, a dynamic ad hoc network and a multi-modal motion control technology and has all-terrain self-adaption and multi-modal motion capabilities. According to the technical scheme for solving the technical problems, the modular reconfigurable bionic wheel-leg type robot comprises a plurality of single modules which are connected with one another, and each single module comprises a trunk module, a front end connecting arm and a wheel-leg composite motion module; the trunk module comprises a frame, a main control unit, a battery bin and a sensor array are integrated in the frame, and a conical protrusion is arranged in the frame. A clamping jaw is arranged at the end part of the front-end connecting arm, and is matched with the conical bulge to realize rigid connection between the adjacent single modules; the wheel-leg composite motion modules comprise hip joint modules, thigh joint modules, shank joint modules and wheel-foot modules, the wheel-foot modules can advance in a wheel-type mode or a foot-type mode, and the two wheel-leg composite motion modules are arranged on the two sides of the trunk module respectively.
title: Modularized reconfigurable bionic wheel-legged robot

abstract: The invention relates to a robotic method for loading cases on a packaging line from cases contained in a closed parallelepiped container and wherein it is proceeded with the loading of the packaging line, after opening of the container (Ca) by:/d/ insertion of a first jaw (30) of the clamp between the first face (F1) of the container and the first case (Et1) of the row of cases and, insertion of a second jaw (31) of the clamp between the last case (Etd) of the row of cases and the second face (F2) of the container, and approach of the jaws until seizing up the row of cases,/e/ piloting of the robotic arm so as to extract the row of cases from the container grasped by the motor-driven clamp (3) and load the packaging line (Lg) with the row of cases.
title: ROBOTIZED CASE LOADING PROCESS

abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent robot for scientific management of a water layer of a rice field, and belongs to the technical field of robot application. The intelligent robot approaches a water gate on a ridge, and conducts management of the water layer of the rice field; images of the growth and development of rice plants in the rice field and images of the water layer of the rice field are recorded by a left vision sensor and a right vision sensor mounted on the head of the intelligent robot, and electric signals of the images are input into a computer for processing; changes of the water level and the water quality of the rice field are sensed by the intelligent robot using a water level sensor and a water quality sensor which are arranged on the downward surface of a water detecting information collector installed at the lower end of a detection rod of the water level of the rice field, and changes of physical quantities of the water level and the water quality are converted into changes of electric signals; the changes of the electric signals are input into the computer for processing, calculation is conducted by the computer, and a processed result is obtained; a flashboard connected with a rope is controlled through lifting or lowering of the rope by a right robot arm commanded by the intelligent robot, and therefore water flow can be introduced into the field or prevented from entering the field, so that the depth of the water layer and the water quality of the rice field meet requirements of growth and development of rice.
title: Intelligent robot for scientific management of water layer of rice field

abstract: The invention provides a lightweight integrated joint driving device for an exoskeleton robot. The lightweight integrated joint driving device comprises a fixed module, an output module and a joint driving module, the joint driving module is worn on a human body through the fixing module; the output end of the joint driving module is in transmission connection with the output module; a strain gauge is arranged on a stress acting surface between the joint driving module and the fixed module, the joint driving module outputs power through the output module, and the strain gauge feeds back a counter-acting force generated between the fixed module and the joint driving module when the power is output. The strain gauge is arranged on the stress acting surface between the joint driving module and the fixed module, so that the joint interaction force can be detected and fed back. As the strain gauges are very light, the strain gauge has a beneficial effect on the wearing comfort of the wearable equipment. And compared with the conventional joint force sensor, the size is smaller, and the cost is lower. In addition, the joint modular design in the exoskeleton design is enhanced.
title: Lightweight integrated joint driving device for exoskeleton robot

abstract: According to the present invention, a fruit growing device using a robot arm comprises: a vehicle part to be moved by a manned or unmanned operation; a working part formed on the top of the vehicle part to carry out work related to fruit growing; and a control box mounted on the vehicle part to control the movement of the vehicle part and the work of the working part. The fruit growing device using a robot arm is applied to labor-intensive and dangerous work related to fruit growing, thereby protecting workers from being damaged by hard work and danger. In addition to this, the fruit growing device using a robot arm rapidly carries out labor-intensive and dangerous work, thereby improving work efficiency and productivity.
title: FRUIT TREE CULTIVATION USING ROBOT ARM

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, in particular to a multi-mode wheel-leg separation type quadruped robot control system. The control system comprises a terrain recognition module, a mode conversion module, a mode conversion control module, a remote controller or a man-machine interaction system and an upboard controller. The control system relates to wheel mode, foot mode and foot-wheel mode switching control, and effectively solves the problem of how to perform coordinated control when a multi-mode robot faces a multi-scene task demand. According to the system, trajectory tracking control in a wheel mode, motion control in a foot mode and a conversion system between the trajectory tracking control and the motion control are combined, the functions of the multi-mode robot can be efficiently played, and the moving efficiency of the robot is improved.
title: Multi-mode wheel-leg separation type quadruped robot control system

abstract: An end effector for robotic arms to effect grip and manipulation of objects, such as in rehabilitation robotics or industries where direct contact between humans and objects is undesirable. Twin pairs of interlinked jaws close belts held in constant tension onto the object being grasped. The length of the belts within the jaws may be varied to improve grip. The belts may be both driven in the salve direction to brush or rotate an object, or contra-rotated to impart opposing turn on an object, for example to remove screw tops from containers. The belts may include angled notches which form claws as they pass end rollers, to enable small objects to be picked up. For heavier duty service, other materials such as chains and sprockets may be used instead of belts and pulleys. Sensors may be incorporated to enable proximity and/or slip sensing and automated control system response.
title: Robotic end effector

abstract: A robot arm assembly includes a support arm, a lower arm rotatably connected to the support arm, an upper arm rotatably connected to the lower arm, a first driver for driving the lower arm, a first transmission transferring power from the first driver to the lower arm, a second driver for driving the upper arm, and a second transmission transferring power from the second driver to the upper arm. The first and second drivers are mounted on the support arm. The second transmission includes a belt assembly, a beveled gear assembly driven by the belt assembly, and a speed reducer coupled to the upper arm.
title: Robot arm assembly

abstract: An interface module designed for installing a pneumatically actuated gripping device on a robot arm includes a first fastening interface for installation on the robot arm and a second fastening interface for installation of the gripping device. First pneumatic connections serve for the connection to a pressure source and a pressure sink, while second pneumatic connections serve for the fluidic connection to the gripping device. The interface module contains a control valve device, by way of which the gripping device is pneumatically actuatable and which is, in turn, controllable by means of valve control signals, which are provided by an internal electronic control unit, which communicates with an external electronic control device. A robot equipped with such an interface module is further proposed.
title: Interface module for a gripping device and a robot equipped therewith

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of wearable equipment, and particularly relates to an exoskeleton robot driven by an electric rope wheel. The robot is used for realizing the technical effects of replacing human muscles to do work and reducing metabolic consumption of a human body. The robot comprises a back frame mechanism, a power battery, a transmission mechanism, a main control unit, a Bowden cable, leg mechanisms, foot mechanisms and the like. The exoskeleton assist robot driven by the electric rope wheel has the characteristics of being flexible in structure, flexible in transmission and timely in assistance, can reduce physical consumption of the human body during weight-bearing walking, protects bones and the muscles from being damaged, and is good in man-machine work efficiency and high in adaptability.
title: Exoskeleton assist robot driven by electric rope wheel

abstract: The invention discloses a device for improving the hip joint extension assisting efficiency of a flexible exoskeleton robot. The device comprises a base, the cam-like pressing rod mechanisms, a rotating block, a telescopic rod outer sleeve, a telescopic rod inner rod, a telescopic rod limiting screw, a telescopic rod locking sleeve and a Bowden cable guide pipe. One end of the rotating block is installed in the base through one cam-like pressing rod mechanism, the other end of the rotating block is connected with one end of the telescopic rod outer sleeve, and the other end of the telescopic rod outer sleeve sleeves one end of the telescopic rod inner rod; the telescopic rod locking sleeve sleeves the joint of the telescopic rod outer sleeve and the telescopic rod inner rod, a radial through hole is formed at the tail end of the other end of the telescopic rod inner rod, and the Bowden cable guide pipe is mounted in the radial through hole through a positioning screw. According to thedevice, the angle between a Bowden cable and the thigh is increased, the power assisting efficiency is improved, and the safety is higher.
title: Device for improving hip joint extension assisting efficiency of flexible exoskeleton robot

abstract: This manufacturing system is provided with an industrial robot having a robot arm and a robot hand attached thereto, and a workstation having a device which is provided with a grip to be gripped by the robot hand.
title: MANUFACTURING SYSTEM, CONSTRUCTION METHOD OF MANUFACTURING SYSTEM, END EFFECTOR, ROBOT, AND ROBOT OPERATING METHOD

abstract: The invention discloses a hand exoskeleton robot which comprises a driving device and at least one hand exoskeleton, and each hand exoskeleton comprises a first joint mechanism, a first connecting mechanism, a second joint mechanism, a second connecting mechanism and a third joint mechanism. The first connecting mechanism comprises a first push rod and a second push rod; the second joint mechanism is bound at a first set position of the finger and is connected with the second push rod; the second connecting mechanism comprises a third push rod and a fourth push rod; the third joint mechanism is bound at a second set position of the finger and is connected with the fourth push rod; the driving device drives the first push rod to move through the tendon rope, so that the second push rod applies acting force to the second joint mechanism; and/or the driving device further drives the third push rod to move through the tendon rope, so that the fourth push rod applies acting force to the third joint mechanism. In this way, the hand exoskeleton robot can adapt to fingers of different lengths, and the practicability of the hand exoskeleton robot is improved.
title: Hand exoskeleton robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a robot hand capable of gripping and operated with a single motor, which includes: fingers which grip an object; two cranks spreading and folding the fingers; a disc-shaped disc rotating by mounting the two cranks; one motor rotating the disc-shaped disc; and a cover of the back of the hand covering a portion of the fingers, the cranks, the disc, and the motor. The fingers are made by combining three fingers in addition to the thumb and index finger.
title: 1 Robot hand capable of grasp having operation with single motor

abstract: In a robotic medical system comprising a staging kinematic chain coupled to a plurality of independently articulable robotic arms capable of motion with one or more degrees of freedom, a first configuration of robotic arms may be determined based on a first inverse kinematic model including the robotic arms and assuming a static staging kinematic chain. The first configuration may effectuate desired poses of instruments coupled to the robotic arms. A set of control parameter values associated with the robotic arms may be determined based on the first configuration, and, when a determined control parameter value falls outside a corresponding control parameter range, a staging kinematic chain pose and a second configuration of the robotic arms to effectuate the desired poses of the instruments may be determined. The second configuration is determined using a second inverse kinematic model that includes the robotic arms and assumes a mobile staging kinematic chain.
title: Apparatus, systems and methods for dynamic online kinematic adaptation of medical robots

abstract: A robot control device includes a processor that is configured to execute computer-executable instructions so as to control a robot including a robot arm, an end effector detachably attached to the robot arm and configured to hold an object, and a force detecting device. the processor is configured to: calculate, on the basis of position and posture information of a first point of the robot arm and relative position and posture information of a second point of the object with respect to the first point, position and posture information of the second point when the robot operates; and cause a memory to store the position and posture information of the second point.
title: ROBOT CONTROL DEVICE, ROBOT SYSTEM, AND SIMULATION DEVICE

abstract: A telerobotic system adapted for tracking and handling a moving object comprises a robot manipulator, a video monitor, an image processor, hand controls and a computer. The robot manipulator comprises a movable robotic arm having an effector for handling an object, a drive system for moving the arm in response to arm input signals, sensors for sensing the position of the arm and for generating arm output signals which characterize the dynamic motion behavior of the arm, and a vid=eo camera carried by the arm. The camera responds to motion of the moving object within the field of view of the camera. The video monitor receives an input video signal from the video camera, for displaying an image of the object to a human operator. The image processor is responsive to the output signal of the camera, and is capable of acquiring and pre-processing an image of the object on a frame by frame basis. The hand control is capable of generating a hand control output signal in response to input from a human operator. The computer generates arm input signals and is disposed between the hand control means, the robot manipulator, and image processor. The computer receives (i) output signals from the image processor and (ii) the arm output signals and (iii) the hand control output signal and generates arm input signals in response to the received signals whereby the arm tracks the motion of the object.
title: Telerobotic tracker

abstract: PURPOSE: A robot hand is provided to realize an instant palletizing of products having a producing cycle time of 3-5 seconds through loading 2-4 products in once or twice. CONSTITUTION: By hanging a hook adapter(44) to a hook base adapter(45) and elevating a hook locker(43), a finger assay unit is combined to a hook base plate(32) by a hook locker fixing bolt(47). The hook adapter is mounted while being hung to the hook base adapter for supporting rotation moment. Then, products are lifted and transferred by fingers(38) of the finger assay unit. In case of hitting a material in lowering a robot hand, a hook arm(42) is slid up by the hook locker. Then, the hook adapter is elevated for an approaching sensor(36) on a front surface of the hook base plate to detect a sensor detect plate(52) on the hook adapter. Herein, the detected signal is processed as a collision signal.
title: DEFORMABLE AND DEVIDED LOADING TYPE ROBOT HAND

abstract: The invention discloses a six-legged robot. The six-legged robot comprises a middle connecting part and six mechanical legs connected with the middle connecting part, wherein the mechanical legs comprise a first leg connected with the middle connecting part, the first leg is connected with a second leg through a first joint part, the second leg is connected with a third leg through a second joint part, and the third leg is in contact with the ground; the first leg comprises a first shell, and a first driving hole is formed in one side at the end, connected with the first joint part, of the first shell; a first drive shaft is arranged in the first shell, and is connected with a first driving mechanism through the first driving hole. The first joint part is driven by the first drive shaft and the first driving mechanism to control the six-legged robot to walk, and a clamping lug on the circular outer end face of the middle shaft part of the first drive shaft is clamped in a secondary opening of a first drive disc, so that the six-legged robot is simple in structure, convenient to control and good in control effect.
title: Six-legged robot

abstract: The present invention relates to an upper limb exoskeleton robot for a movement improvement and gravity compensation comprising: an upper arm support unit which receives and supports an upper arm when wearing the upper limb exoskeleton robot; an elbow rotation shaft allowing bending/flexing of an elbow when coupled to the upper arm support unit; an arm support unit with one end coupled to the elbow rotation shaft in a front direction to support an arm; a wrist rotation unit allowing a rotation of the wrist coupled to the other end of the arm support unit; a hand support unit formed in the front end of the wrist rotation unit to support a hand; and a rotation joint connected around the upper arm support unit and the elbow rotation shaft to allow inner rotation/outer rotation and bending/flexing of a shoulder to be more natural and in a wider range, thereby improving a limited movement and providing gravity compensation.
title: UPPER LIMB EXOSKELETON ROBOT FOR MOVEMENT IMPROVEMENT AND GRAVITY COMPENSATION

abstract: The invention relates to a series connection type hydraulic servo passive compliant joint. The series connection type hydraulic servo passive compliant joint comprises a cylinder body, a hydraulic servo driving joint and a passive flexible joint, wherein the hydraulic servo driving joint and the passive flexible joint are connected in series. The hydraulic servo driving joint comprises a valve element a, a valve body a, a valve sleeve a and a blade a. The passive compliant joint comprises a valve element b, a valve body b, a valve sleeve b and a blade b. The right end of the valve body a and the left end of the valve element b are connected into a whole body. A torque transmission mechanism comprises a tray, a supporting wheel, a torque transmission disc, a supporting sleeve and a positioning sleeve. Tray edge slopes are arranged at the two connected ends of the edge of the tray and used for allowing the supporting wheel to slide. In the passive compliance state of the joints, T in the rotation angle formula of the valve element b is external force converted from collision force to the supporting wheel, R is the radius of the torque transmission disc, k is the rigidity of a spring, and gamma is the slope angle of the tray edge slopes. According to the series connection type hydraulic servo passive compliant joint, control and driving are integrated, the response speed is high, the control precision is high, the output torque is large, and the reliability is high; and passive compliance is achieved, and collision damage caused during man-machine physical contact can be effectively reduced.
title: Series connection type hydraulic servo passive compliant joint

abstract: Provided is an underactuated robot hand and a robot. The robot hand is provided with a frame and a finger unit (22) which is provided on the frame and which grips a gripping object. The finger unit (22) is provided with the following: a Scott-Russell mechanism (SRM) comprising a swinging lever member (SL) and a conversion link member (41) rotatably connected to an end of the swinging lever member by means of a connecting part positioned at an intermediate part; a first parallel link mechanism comprising at least the swinging lever member (SL) and a common link member (CL) rotatably connected to the connecting part; and a second parallel link mechanism comprising the common link member (CL), the conversion link member (41), a tip part link member (42), and an opposing conversion link member (41f).
title: ROBOT HAND AND ROBOT

abstract: A multi-fingered robot hand having a minimum required number of joints in finger mechanisms and capable of stably holding a variety of articles. The multi-fingered robot hand has a first palm portion (8) to which three finger mechanisms (2, 3, 4) are connected by root joints (12), a second palm portion (9) to which a single finger mechanism (1) is connected by a root joint (13), and a palm joint (10) for connecting the first palm portion (8) and the second palm portion (9). The palm joint (10) is adapted to permit variation in the angle of connection of the second palm portion (9) to the first palm portion (8). The palm joint (10), a bending joint (5), bending joints (6) of the root joints (12), and the root joint (13) have rotation axes parallel to each other, and the finger mechanisms are bent when rotated about the rotation axes.
title: MULTI-FINGERED ROBOT HAND

abstract: The invention discloses a teleoperation control method and a system of robot arms and hands. The system comprises a large arm MYO module for extracting electromyographic signals of large arms, a small arm MYO module for extracting electromyographic signals of small arms, human gestures and IMU signals, a mechanical arm impedance matrix module for acquiring a mechanical arm impedance matrix according to the electromyographic signals of the large arms, a human hand posture module for acquiring a human hand posture according to the IMU signals of the small arms, a manipulator impedance factor module for acquiring a manipulator impedance factor according to the electromyographic signals of the small arms, a mechanical arm controller module utilizing variable stiffness impedance control, a manipulator control module utilizing a variable stiffness impedance and force hybrid controller, a manipulator fingertip touch sensor module for acquiring a manipulator fingertip contact force, and robot arms and hands. The method and the system overcome the problems of failure in force control of traditional teleoperation and a complicated and unstable man-machine interaction interface; at the same time, off-line motion trail programming is not required by the robot arms and hands; and a designated task is accomplished in real time.
title: Teleoperation control method and system of robot arms and hands

abstract: Provided is an authentication device, etc., with which it is possible to perform highly accurate biometric authentication within a prescribed time using a few hardware resources for a to-be-authenticated subject that is moving. This biometric authentication device 100 comprises: a detection unit 11 for detecting a to-be-authenticated subject that is moving in a prescribed direction; a first image input unit 12 for inputting a first image in which the whole body of the subject is imaged; a first storage unit 15 for storing feature information that pertains to the whole body of the to-be-authenticated subject; a first authentication unit 14 for comparing feature information calculated from the first image and the feature information stored in the first storage unit 15, and extracting candidate information from the first storage unit 15; a second image input unit 13 for inputting a second image in which the iris of at least one of left and right eyes of the moving subject is imaged; a second storage unit 17 for storing feature information that pertains to the irises of left and right eyes of the to-be-authenticated subject; and a second authentication unit 16 for comparing, for each subject included in the candidate information, feature information pertaining to the iris in the second image and the feature information stored in the second storage unit 17, and authenticating the subject of the second image.
title: AUTHENTICATION DEVICE, AUTHENTICATION METHOD, AND STORAGE MEDIUM

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of fitness equipment, in particular to a bionic intelligent massage armchair which comprises an adjustable seat, a multi-axis mechanical arm, a bionic robot arm and a controller, the adjustable seat comprises a seat frame, a multi-section adjustable cushion and a driving motor, the multi-section adjustable cushion and the driving motor are installed on the seat frame, and the multi-axis mechanical arm is installed on the multi-section adjustable cushion. The relative angles of the multiple sections of adjustable pads are adjusted through a driving motor, then a straight chair, a deck chair or a flat bed form is formed, multi-shaft mechanical arm connecting bases are designed on the left side and the right side of the middle of the chair frame, multi-shaft mechanical arms are connected to the left side and the right side of the middle of the chair frame through the multi-shaft mechanical arm connecting bases, and each multi-shaft mechanical arm is connected with a bionic robot hand; the multi-axis mechanical arm and the bionic manipulator are electrically connected with the controller; compared with the prior art, the problems of poor massage flexibility, small massage range, low comfort and the like in the existing massage chair technology can be solved, and personalized and diversified massage requirements of users with different heights and different figures can be met.
title: Bionic intelligent massage chair

abstract: The invention discloses a lower limb exoskeleton robot for relieving knee joint cartilage injury and a use method thereof, and relates to the technical field of manipulators, the lower limb exoskeleton robot comprises a control system assembly, a pressure sensing module and an execution mechanism, the control system assembly comprises a gas pumping assembly, and the execution mechanism comprises a bag body fixing assembly and a force application bag body; the force application bag body is fixed on the two plate bodies at the same time; the force application capsule body comprises a capsule body main body and an exhaust assembly; the bag body main body is a cylindrical bag, an exhaust port is positioned on the bag body main body, and the exhaust component opens the exhaust port to exhaust part of gas in the bag body main body when the gas pumping component is in a non-operation state; the technical effects that the lower limb exoskeleton robot is high in cruising ability, good in portability, small in burden on the human body when no power exists and convenient to put on and take off are achieved.
title: Lower limb exoskeleton robot for relieving knee joint cartilage injury and use method

abstract: The invention discloses a high-torque power inspection lower limb exoskeleton power joint, which relates to the technical field of exoskeleton robots, comprises a shell mechanism with a one-way opening at the front end, and solves the problems that a single motor and worm and gear transmission are adopted in a mainstream scheme of a driving mode of an existing exoskeleton power joint, the rated torque is only small, and the cost is low. According to the invention, the problems that the load of a user is large, the load of the user cannot be quickly switched and adjusted according to the load condition of the user, for example, when the load is large, the load of the user can be relieved by small torque output, and the auxiliary effect is poor are solved. By means of the torque amplification characteristic of planetary gear transmission, compared with an existing single-motor worm and gear transmission scheme, the rated torque is remarkably improved, the lower limb load of an inspector can be effectively relieved when the inspector passes through a complex terrain in a load-bearing mode, and the problem that in the prior art, the torque is insufficient, and consequently the auxiliary effect is poor is solved.
title: High-torque power inspection lower limb exoskeleton power joint

abstract: The invention provides a substation inspection robot navigation positioning method based on GNSS and RFID. The method comprises the specific steps: S1, planning and laying substation inspection hardware equipment, collecting and coding the geographic information and equipment information of a substation, and making a substation inspection navigation file; S2, starting inspection operation, and issuing a navigation path and a scheme according to the inspection navigation file; S3, in the walking process of an inspection robot, a GNSS mobile station (8) receives and transmits signals to obtain real-time position information; and S4, when the inspection robot walks, road sign matching and RFID real-time read-write positioning are carried out, cooperative positioning and navigation of the substation inspection robot through GNSS and RFID are achieved, inspection information is obtained in real time through an inspection robot platform camera unit, and geographic position information received through GNSS and RFID and image information collected by a camera are continuously sent to a remote monitoring platform. Based on the method, the positioning precision of the inspection robot can be greatly improved.
title: Substation inspection robot navigation positioning method based on GNSS and RFID

abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer-readable storage devices, for robot navigation using 2D and 3D path planning. In the disclosed method, a robot accesses map data indicating two-dimensional layout of objects in a space and evaluates candidate paths for the robot to traverse. In response to determining that the candidate paths do not include a collision-free path across the space for a two-dimensional profile of the robot, the robot evaluates a three-dimensional shape of the robot with respect to a three-dimensional shape of an object in the space. Based on the evaluation of the three-dimensional shapes, the robot determines a collision-free path to traverse through the space.
title: ROBOT NAVIGATION USING 2D AND 3D PATH PLANNING

abstract: A gripper system of a fabric robot according to the present invention comprises: a gripper which directly grips a fabric roll and releases the grip; a robot arm to which the gripper is coupled at a distal end, transmits power or a control signal to the gripper so as to grip fabric and release the grip, such that the fabric is moved to a set position and loaded through rotational and linear motions; and a central control device which is equipped with a program for controlling the rotational and linear motions of the robot arm and a program for the gripping and releasing operations of the gripper, and can directly control the robot arm or control the gripper. After remembering the weight and volume of the previously loaded fabric, the next loading can be performed to ensure balanced loading of the fabric, such that the loaded fabric is prevented from collapsing, thereby minimizing casualties by preventing safety accidents in advance.
title: GRIPPER SYSTEM AND GRIP CONTROL METHOD OF FABRIC ROBOT

abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on a computer storage medium, for selective human-robot interaction. In some implementations, sensor data describing an environment of a robot is received, and a person in the environment of the robot is detected based on the sensor data. Scores indicative of properties of the detected person are generated based on the sensor data and processed using a machine learning model. Processing the scores can produce one or more outputs indicative of a likelihood that the detected person will perform a predetermined action in response to communication from the robot. Based on the one or more outputs of the machine learning model, the robot initiates communication with the detected person.
title: Selective human-robot interaction

abstract: The present disclosure generally relates to the field of robotics and computer animation, more particularly, method and apparatus to solve the inverse kinematics problem to control a kinematic chain such as a robot arm or an animation character's skeleton to reach a target position. The new method simulates a kinematic chain whose links and joints are elastic and can be distorted. The method distorts the kinematic chain to move its end to the target position, calculates distortions, and iteratively adjusts link and joint configurations of the kinematic chain to reduce distortions while keeping its end at the target position until a solution with near zero distortions is found. The resulting link and joint configurations of the simulated kinematic chain then can be used for the actual kinematic chain to reach the same target position.
title: Method and apparatus for controlling robot arms using elastic distortion simulations

abstract: Provided in the present invention is a substrate transfer apparatus. The substrate transfer apparatus of the present invention comprises a robot arm part; and a hand part installed on the front end of the robot arm part, and having a substrate formed, wherein the hand part comprises a slider installed on the front end of the robot arm part; a blade installed to be slid back and forth along the slider and including installation surface in which the substrate is installed; a front guide installed on the front end of the blade; and a rear guide installed on the back end of the blade to be moved back and forth by magnetic force.
title: SUBSTRATE TRANSFER APPARATUS

abstract: The present invention relates to an automatic touch-up device performing touch-up of a hydrogen fuel cell which comprises: a vision inspection unit which inspects a painting state of a surface through vision processing on the surface of a hydrogen fuel cell to derive a touch-up requiring area; a touch-up performing unit which uses a robot arm gripping a touch-up pen to perform touch-up on the area requiring a touch-up; and a conveyor control unit which moves a hydrogen fuel cell depending on the work performing result of the vision inspection unit and the touch-up performing unit. The device performs touch-ups through detailed settings related to the identified areas requiring touch-ups to lower the defect rate of hydrogen fuel cell production while improving quality.
title: Automatic touch-up device performing touch-up of hydrogen fuel cell electrodes

abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a surgical robot system may include an end-effector element configured for controlled movement and positioning and tracking of surgical instruments and objects relative to an image of a patient's anatomical structure. In some embodiments the end-effector may be tracked by surgical robot system and displayed to a user. In some embodiments the end-effector element may be configured to restrict the movement of an instrument assembly in a guide tube. In some embodiments, the end-effector may contain structures to allow for magnetic coupling to a robot arm and/or wireless powering of the end-effector element. In some embodiments, tracking of a target anatomical structure and objects, both in a navigation space and an image space, may be provided by a dynamic reference base located at a position away from the target anatomical structure.
title: SURGICAL TOOL SYSTEMS

abstract: The invention discloses an exoskeleton robot gait control method based on pressure sensors. An exoskeleton robot is jointly controlled by data of the leg pressure sensors and data of the foot sole pressure sensors, the data of the leg pressure sensors realize the main control effect, and the data of the foot sole pressure sensors realize the auxiliary detection effect. The gait control method is simple and reliable, avoids misjudgment and prevents tumbling, the robot can follow wearers to execute different gaits and can adapt to various terrains, and control is more humanized.
title: Exoskeleton robot gait control method based on pressure sensors

abstract: The present disclosure generally relates to systems and methods for handling, inspecting, and orienting a mask to be placed into a disinfection system. The systems and methods include a computer vision system configured to detect the mask position and calculate an orientation angle of the mask, a first robotic arm configured to lift the mask and adjust the mask position based on the orientation angle, and a second robotic arm configured to hold open the mask for a visual inspection of an internal and an external surface of the mask.
title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR FACIAL MASK DETECTION AND DISINFECTION FOR REUSE

abstract: The invention discloses a scene intelligent sensing system building method for a lower limb exoskeleton robot. The scene intelligent sensing system building method comprises the steps that 1, a single-stage target detection algorithm Yolov5 is used for training a data set to conduct scene recognition; step 2, performing exoskeleton robot calibration by using a binocular stereoscopic vision technology; 3, performing three-dimensional reconstruction on the local scene based on binocular stereoscopic vision; 4, performing optimal foothold pre-judgment and footprint planning based on scene understanding of the exoskeleton robot; and 5, building an exoskeleton visual auxiliary system, and carrying out experimental test and optimization. On the premise that the current environment is accurately recognized and scene understanding is carried out, the optimal foothold of the robot is pre-judged, and trajectory planning is carried out according to the current state and the position of the foothold. For the dynamic change of the environment, the environment identification has good real-time performance, the practicability and applicability of the footprint planning system can be ensured, and the obtained track path has good stability.
title: Scene intelligent sensing system building method for lower limb exoskeleton robot

abstract: Described herein are solutions for inspecting and/or handling a component (20) via a robotic arm (10), wherein movement of the robotic arm (10) is managed via a controller (30). In particular, a computer (40a) is configured for showing a three-dimensional model (CM) of the component (20) in a virtual environment (42a), wherein the virtual environment (42a) makes it possible to specify one or more points of interest (CPOI). Next, the computer shows a graphic interface (42c; 42d) that makes it possible to specify a sequence of commands (CPRG) comprising a plurality of commands (CMD) for interacting with the robotic arm (10) and/or with one or more sensors (102, 12), wherein each command (CMD) comprises data that identify an action (AT) and one or more respective parameters (ARG), In particular, a command (MOVE) requests movement of the robotic arm (10) into a point of interest (CPOI1). The computer then acquires (2202) via the sensors (102, 12) one or more images (IMG) and/or a point cloud (PC) of the component (20), compares these data with the three- dimensional model (CM) of the component (20) to determine the position of the component (20) with respect to the robotic arm (10), and converts (2206) the coordinates of the point of interest (CPOI1 ) in the reference system (REF) of the virtual environment (42a) into coordinates of the reference system of the robotic arm (10) using for this purpose the position of the component (20) with respect to the robotic arm (10). Next, the computer generates (2208) a further virtual environment using the three- dimensional model (CM) of the component (20) and a model (RM) of the robotic arm, and processes each command (CMD). In the case where the command (CMD) corresponds to the command (MOVE) that requests movement of the robotic arm (10) into the point of interest (CPOI1 ), the computer selects (2210) a trajectory and evaluates the selected trajectory. In the case where the robotic arm (10) can follow the selected trajectory without colliding with the component (20), the computer generates one or more movement instructions (RPRG) for the selected trajectory and sends the one or more movement instructions (RPRG) to the controller (30).
title: METHOD FOR INSPECTING AND/OR HANDLING A COMPONENT VIA A ROBOTIC ARM, AND CORRESPONDING SYSTEM AND COMPUTER-PROGRAM PRODUCT

abstract: The invention discloses a five-foot type intelligent walking robot. The robot comprises a supporting system, a walking system, a power supply system, a control system, a sensing system and a display system. The robot is low in energy consumption, high in bearing capacity, safe and economical, and solves the problems of moving goods and people and going upstairs and downstairs. The robot adopts five legs to walk, a telescopic leg structure is used for replacing an existing popular joint rotation type leg structure, the potential of a mechanical structure is better excavated, a control system is simplified, the balance capacity and the bearing capacity of the walking robot are improved, and energy consumption is reduced.
title: Five-foot type intelligent walking robot

abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a robot hand capable of performing the complicated movement with a multi-degree-of-freedom even in a hand size of a person, while reducing the weight and size of a joint driving mechanism.

SOLUTION: A linear motion actuator is used for a driving element 13 for driving a joint part of a robot hand finger mechanism; output of the actuator 13b on the side for generating gripping force is set large; and output of the actuator 13b on the side unrelated to the gripping force is set small, so that weight and the size of the robot hand can be reduced.

COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI
title: JOINT DRIVING MECHANISM AND ROBOT HAND

abstract: The present invention relates to a robot-based image photographing system, comprising: a moving unit for moving an area to be photographed; a camera installed on the moving unit by a support unit and photographing the area to be photographed; and a control portion for controlling the moving unit or the support unit so that the camera moves along a preset photographing path in the area to be photographed. The robot-based image photographing system according to the present invention can photograph while moving the camera along a preset photographing path by the moving unit, a robot arm, and a gimbal, so that the operator does not need to manually operate the camera so as to more easily obtain a photographed image.
title: Robot-based imaging system

abstract: The robot (1) has a robot arm apparatus comprising a robot arm (6) mounted on a base. An electrical drive has a signal emitter for emitting a signal representing one of electrical currents and electrical voltages. A computerized control device (14) operates the robot arm by controlling the drive. The control device is supplied with the signal from the signal emitter and another signal from a position detector i.e. rotary encoder.
