The control device determines a position of one of axes (A1-A6) from the signals and controls the drive dependent on the position of the axis. An independent claim is also included for a method for operating an industrial robot.
title: Industrial robots and method for operating same

abstract: The invention provides a blue sheep-imitated mechanical foot. The mechanical foot comprises a hoof part, an ankle part and a mechanical interface part, the hoof part is of a split-toe hoof structure,the hoof part comprises a first hoof palm and a second hoof palm, the first hoof palm and the second hoof palm are symmetrical to each other, the first hoof palm and the second hoof palm are both in the shapes of sharp front ends and wide rear ends, and the first hoof palm is divided into a first upper hoof palm and a first lower hoof palm. According to the mechanical foot, a first rotating drum and a second rotating drum respectively rotate around a first fixed shaft and a second fixed shaft, so that the front end of the hoof part is higher than the rear end or the front end is lower than therear end, a robot can easily hooks rock protrusions when the robot climbs uphill to facilitate wrap clamping of the rock protrusions in the climbing or downhill to prevent slippage, the imitation ofblue sheep feet to move on the uneven ground of complex terrains such as rock surface, large slope and the like is achieved, and the walking performance of a legged robot on the uneven ground of the complex terrains such as the rock surface, the large slope and the like is greatly improved.
title: Blue sheep-imitated mechanical foot

abstract: The present invention relates to a multi-function automatic coupling device which selectively installs various types of work tools to couple mounting means such as a bolt and a nut. More specifically, the multi-function automatic coupling device comprises: an electric motor installed on a bracket connecting a plurality of multi-joint robot arms to tilt a prescribed angle relative to a horizontal surface according to operation of the multi-joint robot arms; a decelerator connected to a rotational shaft of the electric motor; a gear assembly connected to a rotational shaft of the decelerator to receive a rotational force of the rotational shaft of the decelerator; a first operation arm connected to one side of the gear assembly to rotate; a second operation arm connected to the other side of the gear assembly to rotate; and a first and a second work tool installed on the first and the second operation arm, respectively. Accordingly, the two work tools can be precisely controlled by a single electric motor to improve a work speed.
title: MULTI FUNCTION AUTOMATIC COUPLING DEVICE

abstract: The invention discloses a control method and device of an exoskeleton robot. The method comprises the steps that a first posture parameter of a first component, a second posture parameter of a second component and a target joint parameter of a target joint are obtained, and the first component and the second component are connected through the target joint; correcting the second attitude parameter according to the first attitude parameter and the target joint parameter to obtain a third attitude parameter of the second component; and motor control parameters of the exoskeleton robot are adjusted based on the third posture parameters. The technical problem that in the prior art, the power assisting state of the exoskeleton robot determined according to the directly-measured kinematics posture parameters is not accurate is solved.
title: Exoskeleton robot control method and device

abstract: The present invention provides a collaborative robot system capable of faster work operations or movement operations than in the past, and a control method therefor. The collaborative robot system, which is provided with a robot arm (1) and in which a worker can come close to said robot arm, is provided with multiple nearness sensors (2), which are installed on the robot arm and are for detecting when the worker comes close to the robot arm, and an arm control unit (5) for selecting the nearness sensor to be used for detecting the worker from among the multiple nearness sensors according to a work procedure of the robot arm.
title: COLLABORATIVE ROBOT SYSTEM AND CONTROL METHOD THEREFOR

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of exoskeleton robots, in particular to an exoskeleton robot binding device. Comprising a base assembly, a first binding assembly and a second binding assembly, the base assembly is provided with the first binding assembly, the first binding assembly and the second binding assembly are detachably connected, and the problems that an exoskeleton robot binding device is poor in adaptability, complex in structure, unreliable in connection, poor in air permeability, high in cost and the like are solved; the design of the exoskeleton robot binding device is flat and light.
title: Exoskeleton robot binding device

abstract: PURPOSE: A substrate horizontal transfer device is provided to transfer a thin glass substrate at high speed by including a substrate skid-proof unit capable of supporting the thin glass substrate at the side of a robot hand. CONSTITUTION: A robot hand combination unit(10) is combined with a robot arm and is horizontally moved. A plurality of robot hands(20) is separated at regular intervals and is installed at the robot hand combination unit. A plurality of pads(22) which directly contacts with a substrate(S) is separately installed at the plurality of robot hands. A substrate skid-proof unit(30) is installed at the side of the plurality of robot hands in the direction which is vertical to a longitudinal direction of the plurality of robot hands. The substrate skid-proof unit comprises a support stand and a substrate contact jig.
title: APPARATUS FOR TRANSFERING SUBSTRATE HORIZONTALLY

abstract: The flange has a fastening part (2) connected with a tool, and a base part (1) connected with a robot arm. The fastening part and the base part are pivotably supported to each other. Distance between the fastening part and the base part are bridged by controllable pneumatic positioning elements (4) i.e. bellow-type cylinders, at sides of a pivotal point of a bearing (3) of the fastening part. Rigid bridging parts (6) i.e. blockable telescopes, are attached at one of the fastening part and the base part, and the other of the fastening part or the base part is attached with the bridging parts.
title: Flange for controlled pivotable fastening of tool at robot arm, has rigid bridging parts attached at one of fastening part and base part, where other of fastening part or base part is attached with bridging parts

abstract: The invention provides a method for acquiring a virtual digital keynote speaker based on machine vision. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a video stream containing information of the whole body of the keynote speaker; obtaining human body information and face information of a keynote speaker based on the video stream; identifying mouth shape information of the keynote speaker based on the face information of the keynote speaker; and constructing a virtual digital keynote speaker, wherein the virtual digital keynote speaker comprises the step of acquiring face information and mouth shape information of the keynote speaker. According to the scheme of following the facial expression and the mouth shape of the virtual digital keynote speaker based on machine vision and synchronously answering the question, the virtual digital keynote speaker is more vivid in the use scene, and the interaction effect is better.
title: Method for acquiring virtual digital keynote speaker based on machine vision

abstract: The invention discloses gait optimization application of a multi-legged robot based on a ZMP stability theory, and relates to the field of multi-legged robots. The multi-legged robot comprises a mainbody and mechanical feet, the left side and the right side of the main body are connected with the three mechanical feet respectively, each mechanical foot is composed of a root joint, a hip joint anda knee joint, the root joints are fixedly connected to the root of the main body, and each root joint, each hip joint and each knee joint are driven by independent motors. After the technical schemeis adopted, the gait optimization method has the beneficial effect of solving the problem that the gait optimization of the robot cannot consider the swing leg track, the body movement track and the gait parameters at the same time.
title: Gait optimization application of multi-legged robot based on ZMP stability theory

abstract: The invention provides a robot controller and a robot system, which can restrain reduction of productivity of a robot. The robot controller controls a robot arm driven by a motor, and includes: a first processing unit including a first control unit, a first storage unit, and a first system bus connecting the first control unit and the first storage unit, and a second processing unit including a second control unit, a second storage unit, and a second system bus connecting the second control unit and the second storage unit; acquiring designated target position information in a program for operating the robot arm; the second processing unit includes a second control unit, a second storage unit, and a second system bus connecting the second control unit and the second storage unit, receives the target position information from the first processing unit, and generates a trajectory of the robot arm based on the target position information.
title: Robot controller and robot system

abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for generating a virtual human body image. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a human body posture image of a human body to be captured through at least one Kinect device; processing the human body posture image to obtain human body posture data; acquiring hand posture data through the motion capture glove; and combining the transformed hand posture data with the human body posture data to obtain complete human body posture data containing fine finger action information for presentation in a 3D engine. According to the method, the Kinect device and the motion capture glove are used at the same time to obtain the posture data, then the two arrays are combined to obtain the complete human body posture data for presentation, on one hand, use of an expensive whole body motion capture device is avoided, on the other hand, the motion capture glove is used to enhance the collection precision of the hand data, and the defect that the hand image restoration degree is poor due to the fact that only Kinect equipment is used is overcome. According to the method, the virtual human body image with low cost and high precision can be obtained.
title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR GENERATING VIRTUAL BODY IMAGES

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of exoskeleton robot power-assisted efficiency evaluation, and particularly relates to an exoskeleton robot power-assisted efficiency evaluation method based on a slope oxygen consumption test. According to the method, the subject can be helped to enter a test state better, so that the sport injury risk can be reduced, and the oxygen consumption test precision can be improved. According to the method, a calculation formula of the net oxygen consumption and the power assisting efficiency is provided, the power assisting efficiency can be evaluated, and the oxygen consumption index is promoted to form a unified standard in the aspect of power assisting efficiency evaluation of the exoskeleton robot. According to the method, the problem that the oxygen consumption test is easily interfered by the self-adaptability of a human body is solved, and the evaluation precision of the assistance efficiency of the exoskeleton robot is improved; the method has the advantages of being accurate, stable, simple and feasible.
title: Exoskeleton robot assistance efficiency evaluation method based on slope oxygen consumption test

abstract: An accurate high speed gripper assembly (12) for use in handling articles in an automated manu­facturing process. The gripper assembly (12) includes a pair of movable fingers (14, 15) which depend from movable carriages (18, 19) mounted in a housing (13) rotatably mounted on the end of a robot arm (11). A pair of stepper motors (31, 33) are mounted in the housing (13) and are connected to rotary actuators (26, 27) which displace the fingers (14, 15) in discrete incremental steps toward or away from one another when rotated. Compliant elements (51) provided on each finger cooperate with force/torque sensors (52, 53) for determining the proximity of the fingers to an article to be gripped and the gripping force applied by the fingers (14, 15). The sensors (52, 53) generate signals which are processed in a controller (35) that regulates operation of the stepper motors (31, 33) so as to achieve desired finger move­ments and gripper forces.
title: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR HANDLING ARTICLES IN AUTOMATED ASSEMBLY PROCESSES

abstract: Provided is a medical device mounting apparatus which can intuitively control the movement of the mounting apparatus to increase the convenience of use. The medical device mounting apparatus can control a position of a robot arm to be fixed according to the strength of externally applied pressure, or control the robot arm to rotate in a multi-axis direction.
title: Apparatus for mounting of medical device and method for moving control thereof

abstract: The invention discloses a robot simulating human arm intelligent system. The intelligent system comprises a bionics robot arm and further comprises a processor connected with the robot arm, and the processor is further connected with a human arm sensing module and a signal input module; and the robot arm is used for receiving a control signal sent through the processor and does action according tothe control signal, the processor is used for receiving a control signal input through the signal input module and sending the control signal to the robot arm after processing the control signal, andis used for receiving motion parameters sent through the human arm sensing module, generating a control signal after processing the motion parameters and then sending the control signal to the robotarm, the signal input module is used for receiving a control signal input from the outside and sending the control signal to the processor, and the human arm sensing module is used for acquiring the motion parameters of all the parts of a human arm and sending the motion parameters to the processor. The system has the advantages that work is done by simulating the actions of the human arm, and thebionic degree is high; and the simulation control is sequentially carried out starting from an elbow joint, and a control method is simple.
title: Robot simulating human arm intelligent system

abstract: The invention provides a charging method for multi-point inspection of a quadruped robot. The charging method comprises the following steps: acquiring positions of all inspection points of the quadruped robot; acquiring the position of a charging point of the quadruped robot; planning an inspection path when the quadruped robot moves according to the position of the inspection point; judging whether the quadruped robot meets a charging condition or not; when the quadruped robot meets the charging condition, planning a charging path for the quadruped robot to move to the nearest charging point; enabling the quadruped robot to move to the charging point along the charging path for charging; when the electric quantity of the quadruped robot located at the charging point is higher than a second preset electric quantity, the inspection path of the quadruped robot is re-planned, the quadruped robot advances according to the inspection path, and during inspection, according to the charging requirement, a charging instruction can be sent at any time, the inspection process can be cut off, the nearest charging point is started to be found, and charging is started.
title: Charging method, system and equipment for multi-point inspection of quadruped robot and medium

abstract: A feed mechanism for inserting and/or retracting a flexible robotic arm from an area, the feed mechanism comprising a housing, a passageway that extends about a central longitudinal axis through the length of the housing, a drive portion and a rotational portion, the drive portion not being fixedly connected within the housing and having at least a pair of drive wheels coupled to a drive motor, the drive wheels are connected to a mounting frame with the mounting frame being connected to pivotable linkages with at least one of the linkages being connected to a spring, such that the expansion or contraction of the spring allows the drive wheels to move relative to the longitudinal axis, and the rotational portion being coupled to a motor, the rotational motor having a gear system that connects to the drive portion and causes a rotation of the drive portion about the central longitudinal axis within the housing.
title: INSERTION TOOL

abstract: PURPOSE: A force sensor for a robot and an exoskeleton robot using the same are provided to save a production cost of the exoskeleton robot by simplifying structure of the force sensor required to manufacture the exoskeleton robot. CONSTITUTION: A force sensor(100) for a robot comprises a first sensor unit(130), a second sensor unit(140), first cases(110,120), and a second case. The first sensor unit includes a vertical penetration hole and a horizontal penetration hole in one part. One end of the second sensor unit is connected to the first sensor unit, includes a vertical penetration hole in one part, is arranged to the direction intersecting with the first sensor unit. The first case covers the upper surface of the first sensor unit and the second sensor unit. The second case covers the lower surface of the first sensor unit and the second sensor unit.
title: FORCE SENSOR FOR ROBOT AND EXOSKELETON ROBOT USING THE SAME

abstract: The invention provides a mechanical instruction control method and system based on sample learning. The method comprises the steps that an environment model of a mechanical arm is established; the states of the mechanical arm are observed, and the mechanical arm action in the current state in the states of the mechanical arm is selected to interact with the environment model to obtain a reward value; constructing a security evaluation network based on a neural network, generating a security threshold according to the security evaluation network, and bringing the security threshold into the reward value; the IQL is combined with an attention mechanism to output historical actions of the mechanical arm; an implicit strategy in a historical action extraction channel is combined with an attention mechanism to screen out an optimal action in historical actions, and fusion output of a final action is obtained through dynamic hybrid control; a candidate action is generated based on the reward value, and a fused output of the final action is combined to generate a safety action of the robotic arm. The problem that the performance of mechanical arm control is reduced under complex conditions can be avoided, and mechanical arm control can be flexibly and efficiently carried out.
title: Mechanical instruction control method and system based on sample learning

abstract: The invention provides a robot navigation method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the field of robot navigation.The method comprises the steps that the target distance between a robot and a final position and the obstacle distance between the robot and a nearest obstacle are obtained in real time; two algorithms are constructed to respectively control discrete actions and continuous actions of the robot; respectively determining an attraction potential field and a repulsion potential field, and constructing an artificial potential field based on the attraction potential field and the repulsion potential field; two algorithms are combined, and a unified navigation model is constructed based on an artificial potential field; potential energy variation of the robot is determined according to the artificial field potential, the potential energy variation of each step of the robot serves as a reward function, and the robot is guided to move in the potential energy reduction direction; and under the condition that the target distance is smaller than a preset threshold value, determining that the robot completes navigation. In this way, the discrete-continuous action hybrid control mode can adapt to the complex environment, and an accurate navigation path is provided for the robot.
title: Robot navigation method and device, computer equipment and storage medium

abstract: The present invention relates to a transfer system, which includes at least one horizontal transfer device in which a transfer rail having a plurality of transfer rollers spaced apart from each other is formed on an upper portion and which transfers an object to be processed by using the transfer rail. One aspect of the present invention prevents accidents of an operator in a dangerous operation process by using a robot arm and provides accuracy and speed of transfer so that productivity and efficiency are improved.
title: TRANSFERRING SYSTEM

abstract: An instrument drive unit for use in a robotic surgical system includes a carriage configured to be coupled to a robotic arm, a hub rotationally coupled to the carriage and configured to be non-rotatably coupled to an electromechanical surgical instrument, a plurality of electric motors disposed within the carriage, a plurality of drive shafts rotationally supported in the hub, and a plurality of drive gears. Each electric motor includes a stator and a rotor disposed within the stator. Each drive gear is fixed to a corresponding drive shaft and is configured for interfacing with a corresponding driven member of the electromechanical surgical instrument. Each rotor is configured to rotate a corresponding drive gear in response to an activation of a respective electric motor to actuate a function of the electromechanical surgical instrument.
title: SURGICAL ROBOTIC SYSTEMS

abstract: Embodiments generally relate to systems, apparatus and methods concerned with autonomous preparation of brewed beverages, such as coffee beverages. Some embodiments make use of at least one robotic arm in the brewed beverage preparation. Various embodiments use two robotic arms. Various embodiments have multiple separately controlled components with which the at least one robotic arm can interact as part of the coffee preparation process.
title: ROBOTIC BEVERAGE PREPARATION SYSTEM AND CONTROL SYSTEMS AND METHODS THEREFOR

abstract: Provided is an apparatus for measuring a weight of a molded product in advance by using a weight sensor when the molded product is absorbed by an absorption apparatus provided on a robot arm or before the molded product is transferred to a conveyer, so as to reduce operating processes, to reduce equipment costs, and improve productivity. Also, provided is an apparatus for measuring a surface temperature of the molded product or a mold by using a temperature measuring apparatus in the absorption apparatus in order to detect a defect according to a temperature difference, and thus, a separate apparatus for measuring temperature is not necessary, and the operating processes are reduced and the productivity is improved greatly.
title: APPARATUS FOR DETECTING DEFECT OF MOLDED PRODUCT IN MOLD-TAKEOUT ROBOT

abstract: The invention provides an exoskeleton robot capable of adapting to different heights and a wearing adjustment method of the exoskeleton robot. The exoskeleton robot comprises a back supporting mechanism; the top ends of the two thigh length adjusting mechanisms are connected with the back supporting mechanism in a rotatable mode. The top ends of the two shank length adjusting mechanisms are connected with the two thigh length adjusting mechanisms in a rotatable mode. Through the length adjustment of the two thigh length adjusting mechanisms, the length of the thigh rod piece of the human body is matched; according to the exoskeleton robot, the lengths of the two shank length adjusting mechanisms are adjusted to adapt to the lengths of the shank rod pieces of the human body, so that the exoskeleton robot can adapt to the human bodies of different heights, meanwhile, auxiliary operation of personnel is not needed, the adjusting operation is simplified, and the wearing adjusting time is greatly shortened; the problems that an existing exoskeleton robot is long in adjustment time for adapting to the human body height and tedious in wearing adjustment are solved.
title: Exoskeleton robot capable of adapting to different heights and wearing adjustment method of exoskeleton robot

abstract: This information processing device includes: a first interface for acquiring information indicating a position and attitude of a robot arm which grips and moves an object; a second interface for acquiring output information of a sensor for measuring a distance from the sensor to the object being gripped by the robot arm, at a sensor height at which the sensor is disposed; and a control unit which derives the height of the object being gripped by the robot arm. Upon detecting, on the basis of the output information acquired by the second interface, that the object has exceeded the sensor height by means of the robot arm, the control unit acquires the information indicating the position and attitude of the robot arm, by means of the first interface, and derives the height of the object on the basis of the acquired position and attitude, the sensor height, the time from when it is detected that the object has exceeded the sensor height until the position and attitude are acquired, and the speed of movement of the robot arm.
title: INFORMATION PROCESSING DEVICE, UNLOADING SYSTEM PROVIDED WITH INFORMATION PROCESSING DEVICE, AND COMPUTER-READABLE STORAGE MEDIUM

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot navigation and artificial intelligence, in particular to an autonomous navigation robot system based on multi-modal perception, which comprises a visual perception module, a laser radar module, a voice instruction module, a central processing unit and an execution control unit, the visual perception module is used for collecting an environment RGB-D image; the laser radar module is used for acquiring an environment distance point cloud; the voice instruction module is used for receiving and analyzing a user voice instruction; the central processing unit generates a navigation path and an obstacle avoidance strategy through a multi-modal data fusion algorithm and a path planning algorithm; the execution control unit drives the robot chassis to move according to the navigation path and the obstacle avoidance strategy.
title: Autonomous navigation robot system based on multi-modal perception

abstract: The invention relates to a robot arm control system based on image geometric matching and a control method of the robot arm control system. The system comprises a master controller, a robot arm controller, a robot arm, a camera control assembly and a plurality of cameras. The cameras are used for collecting operation images of the robot arm. The camera control assembly is used for conducting imagegeometric matching on the operation images, and accordingly a matching result is obtained. The master controller outputs corresponding control signals according to the matching result. The robot armcontroller outputs drive signals according to the control signals. The robot arm conducts container carrying work according to the drive signals. Through the arrangement of the camera control assemblyand the multiple cameras, a robot vision component is formed. The camera control assembly and the cameras are utilized for image recognition, the geometric matching manner is adopted in the camera control assembly for image recognition, the work process of the robot arm can be monitored in real time, an automatic monitoring module is additionally arranged, the operation state of the robot arm ismonitored in real time, and accordingly the operation efficiency and the accuracy rate of the robot arm are improved.
title: Robot arm control system based on image geometric matching and control method of robot arm control system

abstract: The invention discloses a two-wheeled quadruped robot, and belongs to the technical field of mechanism design. The two-wheeled quadruped robot comprises a chassis, walking wheels and a centroid adjusting mechanism, the pair of walking wheels are fixedly installed at one ends of walking motor shafts on the two sides of the chassis, and the centroid adjusting mechanism is installed below the chassis. When the robot is of a wheeled robot structure, the walking speed is high, movement is flexible, and the robot is suitable for walking on a flat road surface; and when the robot deforms into a leg type robot structure, walking of a quadruped can be simulated, foot type walking in a complex environment can be achieved, and the mass center adjusting mechanism is used for adjusting the gravity center position of the robot under the leg type structure. The two-wheeled quadruped robot is stable in structure, large in wheel diameter and high in obstacle crossing capacity.
title: Two-wheeled quadruped robot

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and discloses a robot navigation method and system, a storage medium and electronic equipment. The robot navigation method provided by the invention comprises the following steps: acquiring task assignment information acquired by terminal equipment; the task assignment information is input into a cloud server, so that the cloud server determines position information of a destination where the robot executes the task and semantic description information of the destination based on the task assignment information; and inputting the position information of the destination and the semantic description information of the destination into the robot, so that the robot navigates to the destination to execute the task according to the position information of the destination and the semantic description information of the destination. According to the invention, the robot can accurately navigate to the destination to execute the operation task, and the user can assign the robot to operate at the far end, so that the user experience can be improved.
title: Robot navigation method and system, storage medium and electronic equipment

abstract: The invention relates to an upper limb active power-assisted exoskeleton robot which comprises a back plate and two power-assisted mechanisms. The two power-assisted mechanisms are distributed at the left end and the right end of the back plate respectively. The power assisting mechanism comprises a shoulder sliding assembly, a driving assembly and an arm transmission assembly. The shoulder sliding assembly comprises a sliding rail, a sliding block and a connecting piece. And the sliding rail is arranged on the back plate. The sliding block is arranged on the sliding rail in a sliding mode and can slide in the left-right direction. The connecting piece is arranged on the sliding block. The driving assembly comprises a mounting part, a driving motor and an output part. The driving motor is arranged in the mounting component, and an output shaft of the driving motor is connected to the arm transmission assembly through the output component. The installation part is hinged to the connecting piece, and the hinged axis is vertical. The arm transmission assembly is connected to the output component and can be connected with the upper limbs of the user so as to assist the user in lifting under the driving of the driving motor. When the exoskeleton robot is used, the smoothness and comfort are high.
title: Upper limb active power-assisted exoskeleton robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a system for programming the motion of an articulated robot and, more particularly, to a programming system for performing a direct teaching function for an articulated robot including two or more joints having a contact sensing unit for detecting the joint contact of an operator and a joint driving unit for moving front and rear joints in accordance with operation driving programming. The programming system comprises: a joint motion detection unit for detecting the motion of the front and rear joints from information input from the joints; a direct teaching function detection unit for detecting driving information of each joint when the operator grabs and moves an arbitrary joint at the input of the direct teaching function to the articulated robot; a contact function determination unit for determining whether the joint contact of the operator is contact for setting the direct teaching function, based on the information input from the joints; and a teaching function setting unit for setting, as driving program information for the contact, the driving information of each joint detected by the direct teaching function detection unit if the joint contact of the operator is the contact for setting the direct teaching function. Therefore, the programming system can cooperate with a robot arm with joints and can also perform programming thereon.
title: Motion programming system and method of articulated robot

abstract: A robot may include (1) a body having a pivot member, (2) a mobility subsystem, coupled to the body of the robot, that provides omnidirectional displacement of the robot along a plane, (3) a robotic arm, coupled to the body of the robot, for manipulating an object, and (4) a linking extension. The linking extension may include (1) a proximal end that is rotatably coupled to the pivot member of the body of the robot, and (2) a distal end that is dimensioned to rotatably couple to a coupling member of an assistant robot such that the linking extension links the robot and the assistant robot. The robot may also include a control subsystem, communicatively coupled to the mobility subsystem, that coordinates displacement of the robot by the mobility subsystem with displacement of the assistant robot. Various other apparatuses, systems, and methods are also disclosed.
title: Robots linkable to perform tasks in coordinated teams

abstract: Disclosed is an exchange device for nut runner sockets, which allows a nut runner to be fixed at a normal position while stably positioning a replacing socket, thus improving replacement work efficiency. The exchange device for nut runner sockets comprises: a base part installed on a bottom surface; a socket jig including a jig body installed on an upper side of the base part, a cylinder member installed in the jig body and having a rod member installed in an upward direction, and a clamping member installed on an upper side of the cylinder member to clamp a replacing socket; the replacing socket including a socket body fixed by the clamping member and having a hollow hole, through which a rod member is introduced, formed therein, and a pair of locking members rotatably installed on an outer side of the socket body and having a first protrusion at one end protruding into the hollow hole to come in contact with the rod member, and a second protrusion at the other end protruding to the upper side of the socket body; and a nut runner installed on a lateral side of the base part, protruding from the end portion of a robot arm, and having an insertion groove on a lateral side engaged with a catching protrusion inserted into the hollow hole of the replaced socket.
title: EXCHANGE APPARATUS FOR NUT RUNNER SOCKET

abstract: The invention relates to a robot navigation control method, device and system, a robot and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps that in the process that a robot chassis moves according to a preset path, a real-time image of a reference object shot by a visual module attached to the chassis is obtained, the reference object comprises lines and characters, the lines extend in the direction of the preset path of the chassis, and the characters are arranged in the extending direction of the lines; the real-time image is identified to obtain target line information and target character information; the chassis is controlled to move in a first direction perpendicular to the preset path direction according to the target line information, so that the pose of the chassis meets a preset pose condition; and the chassis is controlled to move in the preset path direction according to the target character information, so that the chassis is positioned to each working station. By adopting the method, the influence of surrounding environment change can be reduced, and the navigation positioning precision is improved.
title: Robot navigation control method, device and system, robot and storage medium

abstract: A robot wrist with two articulation axes (6, 8) has a first body (1) which is carried at the distal end of the robot arm, a second body (7) which is supported by the first body (1) for rotation about a first axis (6) which intersects the longitudinal axis (3) of the robot arm at right angles, and a third body (9) which is supported by the second body (7) for rotation about a second axis (8) which intersects the first axis (6) at right angles. The two bodies (7, 9) are rotated by two electric motors (20, 10) which are mounted on the first body (1) and the second body (7) respectively, with the interposition of 'Harmonic Drive' reduction units of the type in which the output rotor is supported for rotation by a load-bearing element which forms part of the reduction unit. <IMAGE>
title: Wrist for an industrial robot.

abstract: The invention discloses a method for sucking a substrate and a suction device. The method for sucking a substrate comprises the steps: determining whether a robot arm sucks the substrate, and if the robot arm does not suck the substrate, the method for sucking the substrate comprises the steps: transmitting a motion signal to the robot arm by means of the controller so as to enable the robot arm to make an arc motion toward the substrate, and determining whether the robot arm sucks the substrate, if the robot does not suck the substrate, transmitting a forward signal to the robot arm to move the robot arm toward the substrate by means of the controller, and then determining whether the robot arm sucks the substrate. In addition, a suction device is also provided.
title: Method for sucking a substrate and a suction device

abstract: In a robot arm mechanism provided with air intake and discharge ports, the present invention addresses the problem of minimizing effects on workpieces and suitably avoiding situations in which the mechanism sucks the clothing, etc. of a nearby worker. In a robot arm mechanism: a post (2) is supported on a base (1) so as to rotate freely; a crane section (4) is mounted on the post (2) and an extendable arm (5) is supported on the crane section (4) so as to be raised and lowered freely; and the tip of the arm (5) is equipped with a wrist section (6) on which an end effector can be mounted. On the crane section (4), an air intake port (32A) is provided in front, apart from an air discharge port (32B) in the back. In the wrist section (6), an air intake port (34A) is provided on the end closer to the end effector, separated from an air discharge port (34B) on the end that is farther from same.
title: ROBOT ARM MECHANISM

abstract: A robotic arm 100 comprises first and second links 32, 34 relatively pivotable about a pivot axis 33 of a joint 30 and first and second bi-directional actuators 40a, 40b, each comprising a first resilient member or tendon 46a, 46b extending between a first anchor point 36a, 36b of the second link 34 and the first link 32 and a second resilient member or tendon 48a, 48b extending between a second anchor point 38a, 38b of the second link 34 and the first link 32, each bi-directional actuator 40a, 40b being controllable to increase tension in one resilient member 46a, 46b, 48a, 48b while decreasing tension in the other resilient member 46a, 46b, 48a, 48b. The resilient members or tendons 46a, 46b, 48a, 48b may comprise a composite material of a generally elastic portion 47 which may be a core and a relatively stiff portion 49 which may be an outer surrounding portion, giving a monotonically increasing non-linear relationship between applied force and resulting elongation. The actuators 40a, 40b may operate in a high torque mode in which both first resilient members 46a, 46b are tensioned. The actuators 40a, 40b may also be operated in an antagonist mode in which the first resilient member 46a, 46b of one actuator 40a, 40b and the second resilient member 48a, 48b of the other actuator 40a, 40b are tensioned.
title: Robotic Arm

abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for a mobile robotic frame system. In some implementations, a mobile robot includes a motorized frame that is configured to travel to a location. The mobile robot includes a positioning assembly coupled to the motorized frame, a robotic arm having a manipulator, and sensors coupled to the motorized frame. A control system is configured to process data from the sensors and, based on the data from the sensors, provide control data to (i) move the motorized frame, (ii) adjust one or more movable components of the positioning assembly, and (ii) move the robotic arm relative to the motorized frame. The one or more movable components and the robotic arm are operable to position the manipulator at any position in a three-dimensional work volume with 6 degrees of freedom while the motorized frame remains at the location.
title: Mobile robotics frame system

abstract: Techniques relate to determining a region associated with an object to assist in controlling a robotic arm. For example, a system can determine that the robotic arm is positioned adjacent to an object within an environment. The system can determine a region in the environment that is associated with the object based at least in part on a position of a distal end of the robotic arm. The system can control the robotic arm or another robotic arm to move in the environment based at least in part on the region.
title: ROBOTIC COLLISION BOUNDARY DETERMINATION

abstract: The invention discloses an editing system for robot secondary development. The editing system comprises a robot navigation development module, a motion control development module, a lighting control development module, an expression editing development module, a message customization module, a voice recognition development module and a WIFI service development module; the robot navigation development module, the motion control development module, the lighting control development module, the expression editing development module, the message customization module, the voice recognition development module and the WIFI service development module are connected with a robot body. The editing system for robot secondary development can provide a secondary development interface of multiple functions of the robot, so that a developer or a user can directly carry out secondary development on the robot, and the editing system for robot secondary development has the characteristics of being convenient to use and simple to operate.
title: Editing system for robot secondary development

abstract: A system for generating a model-free reinforcement learning policy for a robotic hand for grasping an object is provided, including a processor; a memory; and a simulator implemented via the processor and the memory, performing: sampling a plurality of stable grasps relevant to reorienting the grasped object about a desired axis of rotation and using stable grasps as initial states for collecting training trajectories; learning finger-gaiting and finger-grasping policies for each axis of rotation in the hand coordinate frame based on proprioceptive sensing in the robotic hand, wherein the finger-gaiting and finger-pivoting policy is implemented on the robotic hand.
title: ROBOTIC DEXTERITY WITH INTRINSIC SENSING AND REINFORCEMENT LEARNING

abstract: Disclosed are a welding robot device for detecting an installation height and a preparation posture adjusting method according to the installation height. the welding robot device comprises: a robot arm on which a welding torch is mounted; and a fastening unit seated on a seating part provided on a holder. the fastening unit includes: an insertion part formed to protrude by a predetermined length downward from a body part; a support protrusion part formed to protrude outward from an outer circumferential surface of an upper end of the insertion part; and a first limit switch and a second limit switch formed to be spaced apart from each other at a predetermined interval so as to be exposed to a lower portion of the insertion part.
title: Welding robot device for detecting installation height and method for adjusting preparation posture corresponding installation height

abstract: The invention provides an upper limb exoskeleton robot control method and device based on an LSTM neural network. A robot arm of an upper limb exoskeleton robot moves along with the upper limb of a human body, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the processing of the historical movement track data of the human body through a built LSTM neural network prediction model, and predicting to obtain future movement state data of the human body; according to the future movement state data of the human body and a pre-established kinetic model of the upper limb exoskeleton robot, obtaining compensation torque required for controlling the upper limb exoskeleton robot; obtaining human-computer interaction force of the upper limb exoskeleton robot; and processing the compensation torque and the human-computer interaction force, and controlling the upper limb exoskeleton robot according to the processing result. Under the condition that the human-computer interaction force is zero, the upper limb exoskeleton robot can follow the movement of the human body.
title: Upper limb exoskeleton robot control method and device based on LSTM neural network

abstract: The invention discloses a soft robot arm, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The soft robot arm comprises an internal flexible supporting piece, first external supporting pieces, second external supporting pieces and third external supporting pieces, the internal flexible supporting piece is sleeved with the multiple first external supporting pieces, the multiple first external supporting pieces are arranged at intervals in the length direction of the internal flexible supporting piece, every two adjacent first external supporting pieces are connected through at least three second external supporting pieces, each first external supporting piece is connected with the internal flexible supporting piece through at least two third external supporting pieces, and each second externalsupporting piece and each third external supporting piece are each provided with at least one telescopic piece made of a memory alloy material. The invention further discloses a control system of thesoft robot arm. The soft robot arm can generate infinite-degree-of-freedom motion, can be suitable for occasions such as geological exploration, underwater search and rescue or obstacle sweeping in the military field, and has a wide application prospect.
title: Soft robot arm and control system thereof

abstract: The invention discloses a robot arm for quickly taking a workpiece. The robot arm for quickly taking the workpiece comprises a working table, wherein a rotating rod is movably connected to the middleof the working table through a bearing, a first motor is fixedly connected to the top of the working table, a driving gear is fixedly connected to a power output shaft of the first motor, a driven gear is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the rotating rod, the driven gear meshes with the driving gear, a platform is fixedly connected to the top end of the rotating rod, a shaft arm is movably hinged to one side of the platform through a connecting piece, and a first hydraulic rod is movably hinged to the other side of the platform through a connecting piece. According to the robot arm for quickly taking the workpiece, the first motor, the first hydraulic rod, a second hydraulic rod and a third hydraulic rod are arranged, so that the robot arm rotates, the angle of a mounting plate can be adjusted, the movable degree of freedom is high, the movable requirement of different angles can be met, and the stored workpiece is conveniently clamped.
title: Robot arm for quickly taking workpiece

abstract: A bend sensor is used to determine force applied to a robotic arm. The force may be an external force applied to the arm, an internal actuation force, or both. In some aspects, a stiffening element is used to restore the arm to a minimum kinematic energy state. In other aspects, the stiffening element is eliminated, and the arm is fully actuated.
title: Arm with a combined shape and force sensor

abstract: The invention discloses a wheeled robot navigation method oriented to a complex indoor environment, solves the problem that obstacle avoidance actions of a DWA algorithm and a TEB algorithm are not natural and smooth enough in a limited scene with dense pedestrians, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The method comprises the steps that mapping is conducted through three-dimensional laser SLAM and binocular vision SLAM, a point cloud map and a vision pose map are obtained, and when machine positioning is conducted, positioning results of the point cloud map and the vision pose map are fused, and global positioning is completed; planning a global path of the wheeled robot; a local map with the wheeled robot as the center is obtained through three-dimensional laser SLAM, a next path point of the wheeled robot is generated according to the global path, and the local map with the wheeled robot as the center, tracking information of pedestrians needing to be bypassed and the next path point are input into an obstacle avoidance model; and the obstacle avoidance model outputs an obstacle avoidance action strategy of the wheeled robot.
title: Wheeled robot navigation method for complex indoor environment

abstract: A control system for controlling a surgical robot system, the surgical robot system comprising at least one surgical robot, each of the at least one surgical robot comprising a base, and an arm extending from the base to an attachment for an instrument, the arm comprising a plurality of joints whereby the configuration of the arm can be altered, the control system comprising: a main controller configured to: receive communications from one or more devices of an operator console identifying inputs from an operator of the at least one surgical robot; generate control signals for controlling the movement of the at least one surgical robot arm based on the inputs; and send communications to the at least one surgical robot identifying the control signals; and a safety monitor configured to analyse at least a portion of the communications to and/or from the main controller to determine whether the surgical robot system is in a fault state, and in response to determining that the surgical robot system is in a fault state, cause at least one of the one or more devices of the operator console and the at least one surgical robot to transition to a safe state.
title: CONTROL SYSTEM FOR SURGICAL ROBOT SYSTEM WITH SAFETY MONITOR

abstract: The invention relates to an omni-directional quadruped robot energy-saving motion planning method based on a kinetic model. The method comprises the following steps that S1, obstacle information of an actual scene is obtained; s2, acquiring a real-time pose of the quadruped robot; s3, if the radar of the robot detects obstacle information, constructing an obstacle avoidance item based on a parameterized curve, then executing S4, and otherwise, directly executing S4; s4, constructing a position feasible item, a direction angle smooth item and a ground touching force optimization item; s5, solving a safe track; s6, judging whether the safe trajectory is dynamically feasible or not, if so, ending motion planning, and otherwise, executing S7; and S7, re-planning to obtain a feasible track, judging whether the feasible track is dynamically feasible, if so, ending the motion planning, and otherwise, repeating the S7. Compared with the prior art, the quadruped robot has the advantages of reducing impact of the ground on the quadruped robot and the like.
title: Energy-saving motion planning method for omnidirectional quadruped robot based on kinetic model

abstract: A control apparatus (70) for a robot arm (5) that is provided with an operation information database (17) in which pieces of information relating to operations of the robot arm are stored; a force detection unit (53) that detects a force of a person (4); and an operation correction unit (20) that corrects the operation information of the operation information database in accordance with the force of the person.
title: CONTROL APPARATUS AND CONTROL METHOD FOR A ROBOT ARM, ROBOT, CONTROL PROGRAM FOR A ROBOT ARM, AND ELECTRONIC INTEGRATED CIRCUIT FOR CONTROLLING A ROBOT ARM

abstract: A four-legged walking robot comprises a main rack, a transmission mechanism and multiple leg connection-rod mechanisms, wherein the transmission mechanism comprises a step motor, a transmission shaft and a plurality of track drive devices distributed on two side surfaces of the main rack in a mirroring manner; the step motor, the transmission shaft and the track drive devices are matched in a linkage manner; each track drive device comprises four driving wheels and a drive track, and the four driving wheels and the drive track are matched in a linkage manner; each leg connection-rod mechanism comprises a main rod and a rail rod, a connection part and a limiting part are arranged on one side of the main rod, a leg part is connected with the tail end of the main rod, the connection part and the corresponding drive track are relatively fixed, and the limiting part and the corresponding rail rod are matched in a limiting manner. The step motor drives the track drive devices to operate through the transmission shaft, the track drive devices control the leg connection-rod mechanisms to operate, accordingly, the leg connection-rod mechanisms drive the main rack to slide in sludge, the structure is simple, and the work operation efficiency is remarkably improved.
title: Four-legged walking robot

abstract: The invention discloses a virtual reality technology-based intangible cultural heritage display system, and relates to the technical field of virtual reality. The system comprises a performance monitoring module, a monitoring classification module, a data following unit, a data mixing unit, a data analysis unit, a controller, an AR experience module, a display unit, a storage unit, a content control unit and an input unit. The monitoring classification module is arranged at the AR experience module and used for monitoring real-time whole body picture information of a person who watches the intangible cultural heritage in real time by means of the AR experience module, and the monitoring classification module is used for transmitting real-time portrait information to the data analysis unit;the AR experience module is a virtual display interaction device; according to the method, the crowd types can be autonomously classified, the non-material cultural heritage types which various crowds tend to understand are counted, and automatic recommendation is carried out; the method is simple, effective, easy and practical.
title: Virtual reality technology-based intangible cultural heritage display system

abstract: A method and device for determining a barycenter position, a legged robot (101), equipment, and a medium, related to the technical field of computers. The method comprises: creating first relation data, creating second relation data corresponding to at least one leg with which the legged robot (101) is configured, creating third relation data on the basis of the second relation data corresponding to at least one leg, determining the value of a first constant, C, when a target value, J, is at minimum (203), and acquiring the first relation data corresponding to the first constant, C, of which the value is determined (204). The employment of the method for determining the barycenter position obviates the need to detect the states of joints of the legged robot (101), determines the trajectory of the barycenter of the legged robot (101) via the second relation data corresponding to at least one leg of the legged robot (101), and allows the legged robot (101) to move according to the determined trajectory of the barycenter, thus ensuring the efficiency of movement of the legged robot (101). This is applicable in the legged robot (101) with any number of legs and is widely applicable.
title: METHOD AND DEVICE FOR DETERMINING BARYCENTER POSITION, LEGGED ROBOT, AND STORAGE MEDIUM

abstract: The invention provides a human body whole body posture key point prediction method based on a vision-language level alignment relation. The method comprises the following steps: performing multi-level feature extraction on a target image by using a pyramid vision Transform network to obtain a multi-level feature pyramid; extracting text feature vectors from the learned prompts and predefined category labels by using a multi-modal text encoder, and obtaining a text semantic feature space based on the text feature vectors; performing feature vector alignment operation on the same level of the feature pyramid and the text semantic feature space by using a predefined optimal transmission algorithm to obtain a vision-language potential space; and performing feature vector mapping operation on the visual language potential space by using the feature pyramid prediction network, generating a heat map of the human body whole body posture key points in the target image, and predicting position coordinate information of each human body whole body posture key point in the target image based on the heat map of the human body whole body posture key points.
title: Method for predicting whole-body posture key points of human body based on vision-language level alignment relationship

abstract: A telescoping robot arm with singularity-free three degrees of motion freedom spherical joints is disclosed. The telescoping section and spherical joints are hydraulically operated to achieve a high power-to-weight ratio and use conventional seals of the type normally used on hydraulic pistons. The spherical joints of the instant invention are comprised of a generally spherical cavity containing a tiltable member with integral a retractable arcuate vanes interdigitized with retractable arcuate vanes in a non-tiltable member. A plurality of cavities is formed within the spaces between the interdigitized arcuate vanes of the instant invention, with the volume of these intervane cavities being controlled with an equal plurality of hydraulic valves. A plurality of spherical joints of the present invention may be interconnected with double acting telescoping sections of the present invention to form a robotic arm assembly. The telescoping sections are double acting and contain splines or similar structures to prevent rotation while allowing controllable extension and retraction. A combination of two spherical joints and one telescoping section of the instant invention make a singularity free robot arm with seven degrees of motion freedom.
title: Telescoping robot arm with spherical joints

abstract: The disclosure relates to a robotic system for autonomously operating multiple electrical chargers for charging electrical vehicles in a car park comprising several adjacent parking spaces. The system comprises a first detection unit for detecting and identifying an electrical vehicle in one of several adjacent parking spaces, a rail positioned above the several adjacent parking spaces, a collaborative robot arm slidable on the rail, one or more adapter tools connected to the collaborative robot arm; wherein the system is configured for detecting and identifying the electrical vehicle, and controlling the collaborative robot arm and the adapter tool to engage with the charging cable connector of the charging infrastructure and to connect and disconnect the charging cable connector of the charging cable to an electrical inlet of the electrical vehicle for recharging the electrical vehicle.
title: A ROBOTIC SYSTEM FOR AUTOMATICALLY OPERATING MULTIPLE ELECTRICAL CHARGERS FOR CHARGING ELECTRICAL VEHICLES IN A CAR PARK

abstract: A method and a device for controlling the walking of a legged robot for stably controlling the attitude thereof, the method comprising the steps of controlling the attitude of the robot with different control characteristics in each coordinate axis direction by using, as a control coordinate system, a sole coordinate system at least having coordinate axes in a direction connecting the soles of both legs to each other and a direction orthogonal to that direction in a horizontal plane basically on a sole position basis: the device comprising a sole position sensor for detecting the sole position of a ground-contact leg, a ground-contact leg sensor for detecting the state of the ground-contact leg or an action generating device for generating the state of the ground-contact leg, a control device for controlling the walking by using, as the control coordinate system, a coordinate system with reference to a direction for connecting the soles of the ground-contact legs to each other according to the detected sole position and state of the ground-contact leg, and a leg part actuator controlled by the control device.
title: METHOD AND DEVICE FOR CONTROLLING WALKING OF LEGGED ROBOT

abstract: The invention provides a control system of a lower limb assistance exoskeleton robot. The control system comprises a processing module, an operation module, a sensing module and a power supply module,wherein the processing module comprises a detecting circuit, a system management unit, a first circuit, a second circuit and a driving unit. The software sudden stop operation is performed on the driving unit by the system management unit and the first circuit through first sudden stop signals output by a first safety module; and the hardware sudden stop operation is performed on the driving unitby the first circuit and the second circuit not by the system management unit through second sudden stop signals output by a second safety module, so that the problem of low safety caused by only dependence of effecting of a safety emergency system on detection and control of a software system in the prior art is prevented, and the safety of wearers is further guaranteed.
title: Control system of lower limb assistance exoskeleton robot

abstract: A processing system includes a robot arm with an end effector having a longitudinal axis, the robot arm having a reach of at least 45 inches, wherein the end effector includes: a first wafer pocket defined within the end effector at a first location along the longitudinal axis, wherein the first wafer pocket has the reach of at least 45 inches; and a second wafer pocket defined within the end effector at a second location along the longitudinal axis, wherein the second wafer pocket has a second reach that is less than 45 inches. The end effector is capable of concurrently carrying a first wafer in the first wafer pocket and a second wafer in the second wafer pocket.
title: Long reach vacuum robot with dual wafer pockets

abstract: The invention provides a video processing method, which is executed by a video processing system, the system comprises an end-side device and a cloud computing device, and the method comprises the following steps: the end-side device collects a first video, identifies key parts of a human body in the first video, recombines local images corresponding to the key parts and whole body images corresponding to the human body to obtain a second video, and sends the second video to the cloud computing device; and transmitting the second video to the cloud computing device, and performing video processing by the cloud computing device according to the second video to obtain a video processing result. According to the scheme, the video content is divided and recombined at the end side to retain key information and reduce the proportion of low-weight information, and then the recombined video replaces the original video to be transmitted to the cloud for processing, so that on the basis of ensuring the video processing effect, the bandwidth occupation is reduced, the requirement on the uplink quality of the network is reduced, and the user experience is improved. The network bandwidth expenditure is reduced, and the video processing cost is reduced.
title: Video processing method and related equipment

abstract: Described within are systems, methods and apparatus for a bone mounted robotic-assisted orthopedic surgery system for precise implant position, soft tissue balancing and guidance of tools during a surgical procedure, particularly partial or total knee replacement procedure. The system features a bone mounted robotic arm with end-effector for precise positioning of surgical tool, positioning of implants and balancing of soft tissues. The reconfigurable robotic system requires minimal training by surgeons, is intuitive to use similar to conventional instrumented surgery and has a small footprint. The system works with existing, conventional instruments, patient specific instruments, sensor-assisted systems and computer-assisted systems and does not require increased surgical time and safely provides the enhanced precision achievable by robotic-assisted systems and computer-assisted technologies.
title: Methods and systems for robotic-assisted surgery using customized bone registration guides

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of power-assisted robots, in particular to a leg rod device for a hip joint power-assisted exoskeleton robot, and the leg rod device comprises a leg rod body, a leg binding module and a convenient disassembly and assembly module; the module convenient to disassemble and assemble comprises a leg supporting plate, a clamping wheel and a clamping tooth assembly. The leg supporting plate is arranged at the position, opposite to the front side of the leg of the human body, of the leg binding module. The clamping wheel is rotationally arranged on the supporting plate around a first axis, a multi-tooth clamping groove is formed in the clamping wheel, and meshing teeth protruding towards the first axis are arranged in the multi-tooth clamping groove; the latch assembly is provided with a latch structure which can protrude from the peripheral surface of the latch assembly, the latch structure is meshed with the meshing teeth, and the latch structure is arranged to be a structure which can stretch out and draw back in the length direction of the legs of the human body relative to the supporting plate; the circumferential multiple teeth of the clamping tooth assembly are meshed with the clamping wheel, so that connection looseness is avoided, and axial displacement and compensation of the adduction/abduction angle of the clamping wheel can be conducted through the flexibility and the rotating structure of the clamping wheel.
title: Leg rod device for hip joint assisting exoskeleton robot

abstract: The invention discloses a robot feedback method. The method comprises the following steps: rotation information of a robot arm around a robot body is acquired; wherein the robot arm and the robot body are connected through a rotating mechanism with a position sensor; the position sensor converts the rotation information into position information; and feedback information is output according to the position information. The invention further discloses a robot and a storage medium. According to the method and the device, at least the technical problems of how to improve the accuracy of acquiring the interaction object information by the robot, linearly feed back the feedback information to the interaction object and improve the man-machine interaction effect are solved.
title: Robot feedback method and robot

abstract: The invention provides a leg mechanism of an exoskeleton robot. The leg mechanism comprises a first driving wheel and a second driving wheel which are respectively installed at the output end of a first gear motor assembly and the output end of a second gear motor assembly; a first driven wheel and a second driven wheel are rotationally mounted at knee joints of the legs through knee joint rotating shafts and are fixedly connected with shanks; when the first gear motor assembly and the second gear motor assembly have the same output direction and the same torque, the thigh swings around a hip joint rotating shaft, and when the first gear motor assembly and the second gear motor assembly have the opposite output directions and the same torque, the shank swings around the knee joint rotating shaft; and when the output directions of the first gear motor assembly and the second gear motor assembly are opposite/same and the torques are different, the thighs and the shanks swing at the same time. Load driving can be achieved by selecting the motor with small output torque and output power, the performance of the motor can be brought into full play, and the system has good overload capacity.
title: Leg mechanism of exoskeleton robot

abstract: A robotic link mechanism comprising a pair of base elements connected by a passive flexible joint, such that flexure of the joint changes the mutual orientation of the base elements. A pair of obliquely truncated cylinders are confined between the base elements such that the obliquely formed end surfaces of the cylinders can rotate in sliding contact with each other, and the other end of each cylinder can rotate in sliding contact with its associated base element. Driving motors are attached to the base elements, each one controlled to rotate the cylinder associated with that base element, such that rotation of at least one of the cylinders causes the base elements to undergo change in their mutual orientation. The mechanism thus has a backbone composed of the passive flexible joint, which is supported and actuated by the oblique truncated cylindrical structure that serves as an active exoskeleton.
title: ROBOTIC MECHANISM WITH TWO DEGREES OF FREEDOM

abstract: The invention discloses a hip joint direct drive and knee joint line drive coupled active load-bearing walking-aid exoskeleton. A waist and back assembly of the exoskeleton is worn on the back of a human body, and the top end of the waist and back assembly is used for hanging a load; the Bowden cable coil is fixedly connected with an output shaft of the knee joint motor; the two hip joint assemblies are connected to the two sides of the tail end of the waist and back assembly respectively, so that the hip joint assemblies are matched with human hip joints. The hip joint assembly comprises a hip joint motor and a thigh plate worn on the thigh of a human body; the hip joint motor provides assistance for the flexion and extension movement of the hip joint of the swinging leg; the knee joint assembly symmetrically comprises a shank plate worn on a shank of a human body; the Bowden cable is connected between the Bowden cable coil and the shank plate; the foot assembly is connected to the lower portion of the knee joint assembly. The exoskeleton can provide active assistance for a wearer at the hip joint and the knee joint and can provide larger pulling force for the knee joint, load gravity can be better transmitted to the ground by straightening the knee joint, and physical strength of a human body is saved.
title: Active load-bearing walking-aid exoskeleton coupled with hip joint direct drive and knee joint linear drive

abstract: The invention discloses a lip language learning auxiliary training system based on the universe and an application thereof, and the system comprises a lip reading training module which is used for storing a standard lip shape video, building a universe learning scene, enabling a user to carry out lip reading training through the standard lip shape video in the universe learning scene, and enabling the user to carry out lip reading training through the standard lip shape video; calculating the similarity between the text read by the lip of the user and the text of the standard lip-shaped video; the virtual human answer communication module is used for establishing a meta-universe social scene, so that the user can perform answer communication with the virtual human in the meta-universe social scene; and the user personal center module is used for recording and feeding back the lip reading training effect of the user and combining the audio and the face of the user to form a virtual image of the user, so that the user can answer and communicate with other users in the meta-universe social scene through the virtual image. According to the system, the lip language learning accuracy can be improved, the learning effect can be fed back in time, interactivity is high, learning assistance modes are diversified, and the communication ability of a user is enhanced through assistance of the system.
title: Element universe-based lip language learning auxiliary training system and application thereof

abstract: The invention provides a bionic mechanical dog, relates to the technical field of bionic robots, and aims to solve the problems that the bionic mechanical dog easily falls down due to loss of balance in the movement process, internal vulnerable electrical elements are damaged once the bionic mechanical dog falls down, the mechanical dog loses the information feedback control capability, and the safety of the bionic mechanical dog is influenced. The bionic mechanical dog comprises a mechanical dog main body, a bionic mechanical dog body and a control system, the upper end of the mechanical dog main body is covered with a top sealing protection plate through a bolt; a sensing detection box is arranged in the middle of the upper end of the top sealing protection plate; protective cover plates are rotationally mounted on the left side and the right side of the upper end of the sensing detection box respectively; an inner sliding frame is vertically installed in an inner cavity of the sensing detection box, the mechanical dog body can have higher walking capacity, walking can be more stable through the cohesion state of the lower ends of the four walking limbs, the four-wheel-drive independent walking capacity is achieved, the robot dog can adapt to complex terrains, and the robot dog is suitable for being used in various occasions. And more outdoor operation activities can be competent.
title: Bionic mechanical dog

abstract: The invention relates to robots, particularly to a bionic manipulator able to climb and operate. The manipulator is a serial symmetrical configuration robot of which both ends are provided with clamping joint modules and the middle has five degrees of freedom. The manipulator comprises a first clamping joint module, a first rotary joint module, a first pitch joint servo motor, a second pitch joint servo motor, a third pitch joint servo motor, a second rotary joint module and a second clamping joint module which are connected in series in turn; wherein the manipulator is driven to rotate by the first rotary joint module and the second rotary joint module respectively to provide two degrees of rotation freedom; the manipulator is driven to turn over by the first pitch joint servo motor, the second pitch joint servo motor and the third pitch joint servo motor separately or jointly to provide three degrees of turnover freedom; the first clamping joint module and the second clamping joint module are the end effectors of the manipulator. The bionic manipulator provided by the invention has the advantages of novel structure, multiple functions, flexible operation of each joint, high mobility and operability.
title: Bionic manipulator able to climb and operate

abstract: The invention discloses a rigid-flexible coupling bionic snakelike robot which comprises a head module, a rigid-flexible coupling bending joint and a tail module, the rigid-flexible coupling bending joint is formed by coupling a rigid part, a flexible part and a soft part, and a rope driving device is installed to achieve joint bending driving. Bionic snake scales are installed at the bottoms of the joints to provide friction force for movement of the snake-shaped robot, and the multiple joints are connected in series to form a snake-shaped robot body. Wherein the head module and the tail module respectively comprise a shell part and are respectively provided with a control module and a power supply module. According to the snakelike robot, the rigid part, the flexible part and the soft part are coupled together through the movement mechanism of the bionic snakelike, the snakelike robot which is flexible and reliable in movement, high in control precision and high in environment adaptability is provided, and gaits such as wave movement, lateral movement, linear movement and telescopic movement of the snakelike robot in multiple environments are achieved by controlling the steering engine of each joint.
title: Rigid-flexible coupling bionic snakelike robot

abstract: The invention discloses a limb rehabilitation exoskeleton. The limb rehabilitation exoskeleton comprises a first supporting rod, a second supporting rod, a binding structure, a first guide wheel assembly and a second guide wheel assembly, wherein the second supporting rod is rotatably connected with the first supporting rod, the binding structure is used for fixing part of limbs to the second supporting rod, the binding structure is arranged on one side of the second supporting rod, the first guide wheel assembly is arranged at the end, deviating from the second supporting rod, of the first supporting rod, the second guide wheel assembly is arranged at the end, deviating from the first supporting rod, of the second supporting rod, the second guide wheel assembly includes inner side wheelsand outer side wheels, the inner side wheels and the outer side wheels are correspondingly arranged on two sides of the second supporting rod, and the inner side wheels and the binding structure are located on the same side of the second supporting rod. According to the technical scheme, a guiding role can be played when the exoskeleton is used for assisting the human body in rehabilitation, the exoskeleton fits the movement track of limbs, and the rehabilitation effect is improved. Moreover, the adverse effect caused by the inclination of the limb rehabilitation exoskeleton is avoided when the limb rehabilitation exoskeleton is used by users.
title: Limb rehabilitation exoskeleton
