abstract: The invention relates to the structural field of a pseudo robot, in particular to a fully mimetic copying propulsion mechanism. The mechanism Comprises a flexible bio-profiling layer segment shell controlled by a driving motor, wherein a plurality of sets of profiling members are fixedly connected inside the shell, and each set comprises a plurality of profiling single members; The profiling single piece is composed of a trunk part, a link block connected with the shell at the top of the trunk part and a foot limb joint bar group distributed on both sides of the trunk part, and the trunk partis composed of a body joint suspension bar group and a middle joint coupling bar group at the bottom of the trunk part. The foot joint rod set can swing around the trunk. On the basis of behavioral protoplasm reproduction, the harmonic performance of self-climbing step can be increased, and the harmonic coupling between ridge joint and foot group can be fitted and optimized by bionic posture, which reduces the inertia of the operation, improves the ground adherence of the operation, and reduces the height in the vertical direction, so as to improve the concealment of the equipment.
title: A fully mimetic copying propulsion mechanism

abstract: The invention discloses a multi-degree-of-freedom single-damping quick release joint which comprises a cross shaft universal joint and a quick release part, the cross shaft universal joint is in quick release connection with the quick release part through at least one movable locking part, and a first damping springback mechanism coaxially and rotatably arranged with the quick release part is arranged in the cross shaft universal joint. According to the multi-degree-of-freedom exoskeleton, the quick release part is arranged in the cross shaft universal joint, and the cross shaft universal joint and the quick release part are connected in a quick release manner, so that quick release can be realized on the basis of realizing multiple degrees of freedom, each part of the exoskeleton can be modularized, and certain parts in the exoskeleton can be conveniently maintained or replaced; and moreover, a damping springback mechanism is arranged, certain buffering is provided, and the situation that joints are locked or damaged or other conditions cannot work normally due to the fact that the impact of the user is too large or movement is too violent is avoided.
title: Multi-degree-of-freedom single-damping springback quick-release joint and exoskeleton

abstract: The invention discloses an artificial muscle soft driver bionic control method based on a spiking neural network, and the method employs a feedforward controller based on a rough inverse model as coarse adjustment, employs a cerebellar-like controller based on the spiking neural network as fine adjustment, and compensates the modeling uncertainty and environment interaction uncertainty in real time through an online learning method. According to the invention, a representative'artificial muscle 'soft driver-pneumatic artificial muscle is used, a pulse neural network simulating a working mechanism of a cerebellar nerve of a mammal is realized, and efficient, robust and adaptive control of the highly nonlinear and time-varying'artificial muscle' soft driver is realized.
title: Artificial muscle soft driver bionic control method based on pulse neural network

abstract: The invention discloses an irregular human motion state recognition method, device and equipment and a medium. The method comprises the following steps: performing data preprocessing according to irregular motion data to obtain preprocessed irregular motion data; inputting the preprocessed irregular motion data into a motion state recognition model to obtain an irregular human motion state recognition type output by the motion state recognition model; wherein the motion state recognition model is a multi-classification SVM (Support Vector Machine) model which is trained on the basis of irregular motion data corresponding to a pre-collected irregular human motion state. Through a machine learning method, firstly, the collected irregular motion data is preprocessed and converted into the input vector of the motion state recognition model, the irregular human motion state is determined according to the pre-trained motion state recognition model, and the real-time performance and accuracy of irregular human motion state recognition are improved.
title: Irregular human motion state recognition method, device and equipment and medium

abstract: The invention provides a high-traction bionic walking wheel in a soft mud soil environment. The high-traction bionic walking wheel comprises a shell, a driving motor, a wheel train structure, a telescopic quantity control structure and walking wheel leg and foot single bodies. The walking wheels are of a double-row structure; two rows of wheel legs of the walking wheels are spaced by a certain distance, and six walking wheel leg single bodies are uniformly distributed in each row; the driving motor is installed outside the left side of the shell and transmits power through a gear train structure. The gear train structure ensures that the two rows of walking wheels control large gears of the lead screws to rotate to be the same in rotation angle through gear transmission ratio; the expansion amount control structure comprises a lead screw structure, a fixing structure and a pressure spring structure, the lead screw structure is connected with the gear train structure through a bevel gear, and a pressure spring is installed in the foot leg cavity and makes contact with the bottom face of the shell leg cavity. The walking wheel simulates the movement of birds, toes are bent to enhance traction when the walking wheel walks on the soft ground, the bending degree of the toes can be adjusted through driving of a motor on the hard ground, and the walking wheel has good adaptability and traction effect.
title: High-traction bionic walking wheel in soft mud soil environment

abstract: The invention provides an exoskeleton-type walking machine. The exoskeleton-type walking machine comprises a walking device and an upper body skeleton connected to the upper end of the walking device, wherein the walking device comprises a foot balancer, a lower leg part connected to the foot balancer, an upper leg part movably connected with the lower leg part, and a seat detachably connected with the upper leg part; the upper body skeleton comprises a back skeleton connected to the seat, arms movably connected with the back skeleton and manipulators connected to the end parts of the arms. The exoskeleton-type walking machine can be adapted to climbing a slope, going upstairs and other circumstances, can achieve walking and running processes, and can flexibly control the center of gravity in the using process through an elastic body and a balancing mechanism.
title: Exoskeleton-type walking machine

abstract: The invention provides a bionic machine foot device and a bionic machine, and relates to the technical field of bionic machinery. The design cost and the processing complexity are reduced. The foot device comprises a connecting part, a supporting part and a sole part which are connected in sequence, and the end, away from the supporting part, of the connecting part is connected with the leg device. A pressure sensor is arranged between the supporting part and the sole part, and a distance sensor is arranged on the surface, making contact with the ground, of the sole part. When the bionic machine moves, the distance sensor transmits a distance detection signal for indicating the distance between the sole part and the ground to a control device of the bionic machine, and the pressure sensortransmits a pressure detection signal for indicating the contact pressure between the sole part and the ground to the control device.
title: Bionic machine foot device and bionic machine

abstract: The invention relates to the field of kinematics of four-footed crawling robots, and discloses a four-footed crawling robot kinematics analysis and gait planning method based on foot end tracks. According to the method, firstly, modeling is conducted on the quadruped crawling robot, then the motion paths of the foot ends of the quadruped crawling robot are designed, inverse kinematics analysis is conducted on the quadruped crawling robot through an analytical method, the angle value of each joint is solved, and then each joint motor is controlled to reach the expected position. Then, the Walk gait and the Trot gait of the four-footed crawling robot are designed, and finally movement tracks of foot ends of the Walk gait and the Trot gait of the four-footed crawling robot are output. The method has the advantages that the analytical method is high in speed and precision, and the method is suitable for leg structure analysis of the four-footed crawling robot. Technical support is provided for autonomous decision making and path planning, and possibility is provided for application of the four-footed crawling robot in various tasks.
title: Foot end trajectory-based kinematics analysis and gait planning method for space four-footed crawling robot

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of power assisting equipment, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle operated upper limb power assisting exoskeleton which comprises an exoskeleton body, a main control device and a myoelectricity sensor. The exoskeleton body comprises a shoulder rest assembly matched with the shoulder and the back and arm assemblies matched with the arms, the two sides of the shoulder rest assembly are each provided with one arm assembly, and the two arm assemblies are connected through a first flexible connecting piece. The arm assembly is provided with a myoelectricity sensor, and signals of the myoelectricity sensor and rocker thrust signals of an unmanned aerial vehicle remote controller are transmitted to the master control device. The first fixing part and the second fixing part of the arm assembly are connected through the driving piece, the main control device can control the driving piece to drive the two to rotate relatively, and the rotating winding mechanism of the shoulder support assembly winds or releases the first connecting piece. The exoskeleton can accurately recognize operation intentions, cooperate with upper limb movement to provide targeted assistance, effectively relieve shoulder and elbow muscle loads, reduce arm shaking, delay fatigue and improve the control stability and operation durability of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and is suitable for long-time operation scenes such as electric power inspection and surveying and mapping.
title: Unmanned aerial vehicle operation upper limb assisting exoskeleton

abstract: An exoskeleton sensory feedback apparatus that senses position and force information from a user and applies forces and torques to a limb. The apparatus has the same number of degrees of freedom as the limb to which it is attached. This is achieved through the use of remote center mechanisms, compliant mechanical design elements and portable self contained electrical motor cooling systems.
title: Sensory feedback exoskeleton armmaster

abstract: A simple and portable lower limb exoskeleton power assisting device with an anti-falling function is characterized in that the simple and portable lower limb exoskeleton power assisting device comprises a strap unit (1), a waistband unit (2), a lower limb supporting unit (3), a power output unit (4), a signal receiving and outputting unit (5) and a main control unit (6), and an anti-falling unit (7) is further arranged on the inner side of the waistband unit (2); according to the whole lower limb exoskeleton power assisting device, the structure of the power assisting device is simplified, the intelligent level of the lower limb exoskeleton power assisting device is improved, meanwhile, a falling-down buffering mechanism is additionally arranged, and secondary injury generated when a user falls down can be effectively avoided.
title: Simple and portable lower limb exoskeleton power assisting device with anti-falling function

abstract: The invention provides a bionic walking mechanism and a battle robot. The bionic walking mechanism and the battle robot are used for solving the problem of the complex structure of a walking mechanismin the prior art. The bionic walking mechanism comprises a vertical plate, at least two driving gears, at least one transmission gear, vertical feet and a walking driving part. The driving gears andthe transmission gears are mounted on the vertical plate. Each driving gear and the corresponding transmission gear are sequentially arranged on the same group of straight line. The transmission gearsare located between the driving gears and are engaged with the driving gears. The vertical feet are matched with the driving gears in number. The upper end of one of the vertical feet is rotated through a pin shaft and is eccentrically connected to one of the driving gears. A strip-shaped through groove is formed in the middle of each vertical foot. Guide rods matched with the driving gears in number are vertically fixed to the vertical plate. The guide rods penetrate the strip-shaped through grooves and can move in a reciprocating manner in the length direction of the strip-shaped through grooves. The walking driving part can drive one of the driving gears or transmission gears.
title: Bionic walking mechanism and battle robot

abstract: The invention discloses a gas transmission snake-shaped robot, and belongs to the technical field of bionic robots. The gas transmission robot comprises a flexible material bag, a gas separation film, a gas separation device, a flexible bag retracting and releasing cylinder, a gas inflation and exhaust driving device and a belt driving device. The flexible material bag is made of a foldable flexible material, is cylindrical and has leakproofness, a certain amount of gas is filled in the flexible material bag, the flexible material bag is divided into eight closed spaces by the internal gas separation film and the gas separation device, the front closed space and the rear closed space form a group, and four groups are formed. The expansion and contraction speeds of the four groups of closed spaces are controlled by separately controlling the power of four gas inflation and exhaust devices, so that the movement speed and the movement direction of the snake-shaped robot are controlled, and the snake-shaped robot can further be controlled to move forwards or backwards. According to the gas transmission snake-shaped robot, the weight is greatly reduced by using the flexible material bag; when meeting a complex and narrow space environment, the robot can cross obstacles by changing the area of the cross section; and the robot can move forwards or backwards.
title: Gas transmission snake-shaped robot

abstract: A system for preventing discomfort to a user of a robotic exoskeleton (200) determines the existence of an exoskeleton operating condition which has the potential to cause at least one of a discomfort or an injury to a user (204) when the exoskeleton is being worn by the user. Responsive to the determining, an exoskeleton control system (224) selectively controls at least one viscous coupling (208, 210) disposed at an interface location (201, 203) of the exoskeleton where a physical interaction occurs between a portion of the user and a portion of the exoskeleton when the exoskeleton is in use. The control system selectively varies a viscosity of a fluid (216) comprising the viscous coupling to control the stiffness of the interface.
title: ROBOTIC EXOSKELETON WITH ADAPTIVE VISCOUS USER COUPLING

abstract: The invention relates to an exoskeleton (20) comprising: a base portion (1) for mounting on a torso (2) of a human body; a support portion (3) for supporting an arm (4) of the human body; an actuator device (5), in particular a pneumatic actuator device, which acts on the support section (3) in order to provide a supporting force for the arm (4); and a shoulder joint assembly (9) via which the support portion (3) is movably coupled to the base portion (1). The shoulder joint assembly (9) comprises a lifting pivot bearing (34) via which the support portion (3) is mounted on the shoulder joint assembly (9) so as to be pivotable about a horizontal lifting axis (36). The shoulder joint assembly (9) also comprises a link chain (201) which defines a curved path of movement (202) for the lifting pivot bearing (34) relative to the base portion (1), which path of movement lies in a plane, in particular a horizontal plane.
title: EXOSKELETON AND METHOD

abstract: The invention relates to an arm movement mechanism (B) suitable for use in an exoskeleton comprising at least one body (A) worn by the user, which distributes the weight of the load evenly by keeping the user's arms fixed during load carrying, and which enables the user's arms to be released in a practical way when the load is not carried, and which is located in the exoskeleton separately for each arm of the user. Said arm movement mechanism (B) comprises a motion transmission element (1) connected to the body (A); a first carrier arm (2); a second carrier arm (3) movably connected to said first carrier arm (2) at any point on said first carrier arm (2); a third carrier arm (4) movably connected to an end of said first carrier arm (2); a first connecting part (5) connecting said second carrier arm (3) and said third carrier arm (4); and a second connecting part (6) connecting said motion transmission element (1) and said third carrier arm (4), further comprising a second connecting part (6) connecting said connecting end (3.1) comprising a stopper part (7) arranged on said body (A) so as to prevent movement of said connecting end (3.1) in the Y direction (Y).
title: AN ARM MOVEMENT MECHANISM FOR EXOSKELETONS

abstract: The invention discloses rigidity-variable exoskeleton wearable equipment based on a telecentric point and a rigidity adjusting method of the rigidity-variable exoskeleton wearable equipment. An existing rigidity-variable exoskeleton wearable device is large in limitation of the movement range of a shoulder joint. The robot comprises a wearing body, a variable stiffness mechanism, a wheel train type shoulder joint, an upper arm part and a front arm part, the gear train type shoulder joint comprises a first connecting frame, a second connecting frame, a first driving gear, a second driving gear, a first intermediate gear, a second intermediate gear, a first output gear, a second output gear, a fixed gear, a third intermediate gear and a third output gear; the rotation center line of the first connecting frame relative to the wearing body, the rotation center line of the second connecting frame relative to the first connecting frame and the rotation center line of the third output gear relative to the second connecting frame intersect at one point in the space. In the rehabilitation training process, the body is prevented from being pulled; the elastic force of the elastic rope is changed by controlling the length of the elastic rope in the variable stiffness mechanism, so that the stiffness of the wheel train type shoulder joint is adjusted.
title: Variable-rigidity exoskeleton wearable device based on telecentric point and rigidity adjusting method thereof

abstract: Features for prosthetic digits are described. The digits mimic natural fingers by having multiple articulating segments, for example three, that can rotate varying amounts. Rotatable and/or linearly expandable mechanical links are configured to provide the digit segments with multiple degrees of rotational freedom. The digit may have an actuator that outputs linear actuation to cause rotation of the digit segments. The digit may have an expandable proximal link to allow for variable relative rotational positions of the segments. Middle and/or distal digit segments may fully rotate independent of rotation of a proximal digit segment. The rotated digit may thus fully surround and grasp small or large objects, objects with irregular outer contours, etc.
title: PROSTHETIC DIGIT WITH ARTICULATING LINKS

abstract: The bionic soft clamping jaw comprises a flexible mechanism and at least two soft pneumatic actuators, the flexible mechanism is provided with a notch, a cavity is formed in the flexible mechanism, and the at least two soft pneumatic actuators are arranged in the cavity of the flexible mechanism. The at least two soft pneumatic actuators are uniformly arranged along the circumferential direction of the wall of the notch; each soft pneumatic actuator is connected with a first air pipe, and after each soft pneumatic actuator is subjected to negative pressure pumping, the soft pneumatic actuator is bent towards the wall of the notch and extrudes the wall of the notch. The manipulator can effectively adapt to objects in different shapes in the grabbing process, and the grabbing stability can be improved.
title: Bionic soft clamping jaw based on trunk

abstract: The invention relates to the field of photo-thermal driven flexible robots, in particular to a photo-thermal driven one-way continuous crawling flexible robot with bionic bristles. The flexible robot is composed of three modules, namely a middle driving module composed of a photo-thermal response liquid crystal polymer and a polyimide base material and two bionic bristle modules (called a front foot and a rear foot) located at the front end and the rear end. According to the flexible robot, bending deformation and recovery of the driving module can be achieved only by judging whether the driving module is irradiated by the near-infrared light source or not, and meanwhile continuous crawling movement driven by light and heat is achieved by means of the principle that the bristle structure hinders the flexible robot from moving backwards. From the perspective of bionics, special environment or shape design is not needed, a specific 3D deformation program does not need to be provided for the flexible robot, and the flexible robot can achieve controllable continuous crawling movement only by having certain deformation capacity and a simple bionic bristle structure. The strategy has great research significance for promoting research and development of the photo-thermal driven flexible robot.
title: Photo-thermal driven one-way continuous crawling flexible robot with bionic bristles

abstract: The invention relates to a virtual hand grasping perception and exoskeleton force feedback mapping method based on virtual-real interaction, and belongs to the technical field of virtual reality, the method comprises the following steps: building a hand exoskeleton, and reading joint data in real time; calculating the pose of each joint coordinate system of the virtual hand relative to the virtual world; according to the calculated poses of all the joints of the virtual hand, the virtual hand is driven to synchronously move with the hand exoskeleton in real time; collision and contact events of the virtual hand and the digital object are monitored in real time, and virtual interaction force generated when the virtual hand interacts with the digital object is calculated; calculating feedback torque required to be output by each hand exoskeleton motor of the hand exoskeleton, and driving the motors to output corresponding feedback force through a motor controller of the hand exoskeleton, so as to realize force feedback of the hand. According to the method, the interaction reality sense in the virtual reality application can be enhanced, the user can interact with the virtual environment more naturally in an immersive mode, and the user experience is improved.
title: Virtual hand grasping perception and exoskeleton force feedback mapping method based on virtual-real interaction

abstract: The invention discloses a coupling self-adaptive under-actuated bionic dexterous manipulator finger, and relates to the technical field of manipulator fingers. The knuckle assembly comprises a far-end knuckle, a middle-end knuckle and a near-end knuckle which are mutually cooperated and matched and are connected in sequence; the driving assembly comprises a side swing-flexion and extension module and a grabbing driving module, and the side swing-flexion and extension module and the grabbing driving module each comprise a multi-stage connecting rod structure and are used for driving the knuckle assembly to complete specified actions; according to the manipulator finger, the passive adaptive capacity of the finger is effectively improved, more natural envelope grabbing is achieved, and the finger has a larger grabbing space while the structure is kept simple and compact.
title: Coupling self-adaptive under-actuated bionic dexterous manipulator finger

abstract: A multi-joint bionic scorpion tail with independent distributed power comprises a connecting frame and tail joints and is further provided with three-dimensional joints, two-dimensional joints, a tailspine device, power systems and an intelligent electric control device. The three-dimensional joints are fixed to the connecting frame and connected with the tail joints. The tail joints are sequentially connected through the two-dimensional joints in an end-to-end manner. The tail spine device is connected with the tail joints through the two-dimensional joints. The power systems are fixed in cavities of the tail joints and are connected with the three-dimensional joints, the two-dimensional joints and the tail spine device through electricity or pipelines. The intelligent electric control device is fixed in a cavity/cavities of the connecting frame or/and the tail joints or/and the tail spine device. The intelligent electric control device is electrically connected with the power systems, the three-dimensional joints, the two-dimensional joints and the tail spine device. The multi-joint bionic scorpion tail is simple in structure, convenient to mount and dismount, low in fault, highin reliability and wide in application.
title: Multi-joint bionic scorpion tail with independent distributed power

abstract: A Brain Machine Interface (BMI) agent (1 10) is provided, that when operatively coupled to a subject during a mental task by the subject to control a prosthetic device (130), monitors one or more states (125) of neural activity of the subject, receives feedback associated with a behavior of the prosthetic device responsive to the control, learns a functional mapping between the mental task and the behavior in view of the feedback, and applies at least one control action (1 15) to the prosthetic device in accordance with the learning to control the prosthetic device for a targeted behavior.
title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR BRAIN MACHINE INTERFACE (BMI) CONTROL USING REINFORCEMENT LEARNING

abstract: The invention discloses an exoskeleton driving device capable of automatically recovering a flexible force transmission component and a power-assisted exoskeleton. The exoskeleton driving device comprises a power source, the flexible force transmission component and a recovery mechanism for recovering the flexible force transmission component, the flexible force transmission device further comprises an elastic energy storage mechanism, the elastic energy storage mechanism stores force when the flexible force transmission component is pulled out, and when the power source stops providing the driving force, the elastic energy storage mechanism releases elastic potential energy to drive the recovery mechanism to recover the flexible force transmission component. One driving device drives a plurality of executing mechanisms, separation of the driving device and the executing mechanisms is achieved, the problems that a wearer feels heavy due to the fact that a driving motor is installed on the executing mechanisms, and even movement freedom of the wearer is limited are solved, and user experience is improved. Correspondingly, the invention further provides the exoskeleton.
title: Exoskeleton driving device capable of automatically recovering flexible force transmission component and exoskeleton

abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, device, equipment and storage medium for semantic understanding of dynamic human posture. The method for semantic understanding of dynamic human posture comprises the following steps: the target person is identified from the acquired video streaming image frame; a non-mandatory image frame sequence is determined between adjacent command image frames as a semantic image frame sequence according to a command image frame in the video streaming, wherein the said command image frame is an image frame of the target person with command postures; thecorresponding semantics are identified according to the postures in the semantic image frame sequence. The embodiment of the invention is capable to adapt human posture recognition under a richer scene to improve the accuracy of recognition.
title: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for semantic understanding of dynamic human posture

abstract: A device operable to supply a force feedback to a physiological unit, to be used as an advanced interface for machines and including an exoskeleton which includes kinematic elements (7, 25, 34, 42, 56, 57) articulated about articulation axes arranged coincident with or in close proximity to the physiological axes of the physiological unit such as, for example, the flexion-extension axes of the phalanges of the fingers of a hand of an operator. A series of electrical actuators (11) controls the degree of tension on traction cables (13) applying a force feedback to the kinematic elements and, consequently, to the physiological unit, so as to simulate an interaction between the operator and a virtual object. The device includes position sensor means for detecting the configuration of the physiological unit and force sensor means for measuring the strength of the force locally applied thereto by the actuators controlled by actuators processing system.
title: A device operable to supply a force feedback to a physiological unit to be used in particular as an advanced interface for machines and computers

abstract: The invention relates to a virtual human emotion generation method and system. The generation method comprises the following steps: recording a sound audio in a communication process between a user and a virtual person through an acquisition module, and extracting a plurality of features and feature values from the sound audio; further, a classification module is used for carrying out n-emotion-based classification on the multiple features and the feature values, and emotion energy of each of the n emotions is calculated; further, obtaining a real-time emotion index of the virtual human, obtaining a corresponding emotion response function according to the real-time emotion index, and calculating an emotion increment; the emotional response function is used for reflecting the influence effect of specific emotional energy on the emotion based on the current emotional condition; and further, after the emotion parameter is updated according to the emotion increment, the emotion of the virtual human is driven to change correspondingly.
title: Virtual human emotion generation method and system

abstract: The invention relates to the field of human sports equipment, in particular to a multi-terrain ankle joint and foot collaborative exoskeleton device. The device comprises an ankle joint assistance mechanism for providing assistance and auxiliary balance for ankle joint walking and a foot balance mechanism for providing overall balance. According to the device, dynamic compensation on the foot is achieved through the foot balance mechanism, it is ensured that the whole device is in a balance state all the time, and therefore the device can adapt to various complex terrains, and the application scene is remarkably expanded. The ankle joint assisting mechanism provides power compensation for movement of the ankle joint, damage possibly caused by excessive rotation of the ankle joint is effectively prevented, through cooperative work of the mechanisms, the assisting force accuracy is remarkably improved, the stability and supporting force of the whole device are enhanced, it is ensured that the foot of a wearer is always kept stable, and the comfort of the wearer is improved. According to the invention, accidents such as tumble or sprain are effectively prevented, the safety and the moving efficiency are greatly improved, and particularly, the safety has remarkable advantages in outdoor complex terrains with height difference.
title: Multi-terrain ankle joint and foot collaborative exoskeleton device and application thereof

abstract: The invention relates to a human motion feature extraction method for motion quality evaluation, and belongs to the field of image processing. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring nodes for human body action quality evaluation, and extracting preliminary features for each node; in a self-attention layer in the heterogeneous graph neural network model based on the double-layer attention mechanism, projecting the preliminarily extracted node features of different node types to the same space through matrix transformation; aggregating the feature information of neighbor nodes by adopting a self-attention aggregation method based on a meta-path learning node neighbor weight to obtain node embedding with specific semantic information; the importance of different meta-paths is distinguished by applying semantic-level attention, an optimal weighted combination of specific semantic node embedding for specific tasks is obtained, and final embedding of nodes is obtained. According to the method, the complexity of the heterogeneous graph can be effectively processed, and the structure and semantic information in the heterogeneous graph can be better captured.
title: Human motion feature extraction method for motion quality evaluation

abstract: The invention discloses a weight-bearing exoskeleton bearing device which comprises a back assembly, a waist assembly, a storage assembly and a strap and waist belt assembly. The upper end of the back assembly is connected with the strap and waist belt assembly and the position corresponding to the back of a human body; the lower end of the back assembly is connected with the waist assembly; the storage assembly is detachably connected onto the waist assembly or the back assembly; the waist assembly comprises a waist flitch plate and a waist adjusting and damping mechanism; the waist flitch plate is connected with the strap and waist belt assembly; the waist adjusting and damping mechanism comprises a rotary connecting piece and supporting rods symmetrically arranged on the two axial sides of the rotary connecting piece; one end of each supporting rod is rotationally connected onto the rotary connecting piece through a first longitudinal rotating piece; the other end of each supporting rod is detachably connected with an external lower limb exoskeleton; and a supporting spring is further arranged between the two supporting rods. According to the scheme, the bearing capacity of the exoskeleton can be improved, and meanwhile, independent use or matched use with the lower limb exoskeleton is facilitated through the modular design.
title: Weight-bearing exoskeleton bearing device

abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of mechanical arms, and discloses a universal freedom degree mechanical arm device method and related products. The mechanical arm devicecomprises a bionic muscle section type joint mechanism, a ball socket connecting mechanism and a sealing bendable outer shell, is used for simulating the movement mode of certain organisms such as elephants, the mechanical arm can be bent and rotated in any direction in a certain range in a certain range in a three-dimensional space, and therefore the mechanical arm has the universal freedom degree. Therefore, according to the embodiment of the invention, the mechanical arm with the universal freedom degree can be realized, so that the mechanical arm device can be applied to more flexible themechanical arms, a mechanical hand and the structure of a robot, is wider, the structure is simple, the cost is low, and the modularization is realized.
title: Universal freedom degree mechanical arm device

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of exoskeletons, and particularly relates to an action posture adjustable exoskeleton which comprises a human body exoskeleton, the human body exoskeleton comprises a back assembly, two upper limb assemblies are symmetrically installed on the upper portion of the back assembly, and two lower limb assemblies are symmetrically installed on the lower portion of the back assembly. The exoskeleton further comprises an auxiliary frame, a turnover mechanism is arranged on the upper portion of the auxiliary frame, the back assembly is connected with the turnover mechanism, and the turnover mechanism can control the human body exoskeleton to be turned over to the vertical walking position and can also control the human body exoskeleton to be turned over to the crawling walking position. The whole human body exoskeleton is connected to the turnover mechanism arranged on the auxiliary frame, after the human body exoskeleton is used and worn, the turnover mechanism can support the whole human body exoskeleton to keep a standing state, at the moment, a user can carry out stepping walking training, and the turnover mechanism can also enable the human body exoskeleton to be turned over to a crawling state; at the moment, the user can perform crawling training, so that the scheme can meet different training requirements of the user by changing the form.
title: Exoskeleton capable of adjusting action posture

abstract: According to an aspect of the present invention, an upper limb exoskeleton assist device comprises: a body part; a rotating part rotationally connected to the body part in a first direction or a second direction opposite to the first direction; a connection part connecting a gap between the body part and the rotating part, and applying an elastic force to the rotating part when the rotating part is rotated in the first direction; and a clutch part having a first clutch unit allowing rotation of any one direction of the first direction and the second direction of the rotating part and a second clutch unit allowing rotation of the other one direction. Therefore, the upper limb exoskeleton assist device is convenient as only an elastic force is used without an additional energy source.
title: Upper limb exoskeleton assist device

abstract: The invention relates to a manipulator, in particular to a bionic 3D printing manipulator based on brain wave control. The bionic 3D printing manipulator comprises a hand part and a wrist part which are rotationally connected, an arm part fixedly connected with the wrist part, and a steering engine set arranged in the manipulator, wherein the hand part comprises a palm piece and a plurality of finger pieces hinged to the palm piece, each finger piece is provided with a plurality of knuckles, and the adjacent knuckles are hinged; the steering engine set controls the independent rotation of the single knuckles, the finger pieces or the palm piece through connecting ropes; and the connecting ropes are led out by the steering engine set, bypass the knuckles, the palm piece or the wrist part and then return to the steering engine set. Compared with the prior art, fingers can be accurately and quickly controlled to rotate; each joint can be independently controlled and is more flexible; each joint is controlled by a rope, so that the operation is simple and convenient; and charging is carried out in a wireless charging mode, control is carried out through brain waves, and use is more convenient and simpler.
title: Bionic 3D printing manipulator based on brain wave control

abstract: The invention discloses a driving type bionic crawling robot based on a paper folding structure. The driving type bionic crawling robot comprises a body, leg units and tail grippers. The body is of an expandable box structure, panels on the left side and the right side are connected with the leg units, the leg units serve as moving limbs of the robot, each leg unit is composed of a flexible driving structure and a suction cup, and corrugated pipe models of the flexible driving structures can be bent, stretched and contracted under the action of a magnetic field. As a motion muscle, the robot provides crawling power for the robot; the tail gripper is of a spiral curved surface structure, serves as the tail of the robot and is fixed to the rear side face of the body, the spiral bending paper cutting unit can be contracted through magnetic field changes, and the object grabbing function is achieved. According to the bionic robot, the flexible driving structures of the leg units and the tail gripper are applied and expanded as paper folding structures, the bionic robot can achieve the functions of crawling, steering, retreating, object grabbing and object conveying, and the bionic robot has the advantages of being convenient to manufacture, fast in response and light in weight and is wide in application prospect.
title: Driving type bionic crawling robot based on paper folding structure

abstract: The invention discloses a quality detection device for medical glove production, which comprises a workbench and a controller for controlling all electrical components, and further comprises a simulation mechanism, the simulation mechanism is in a bionic hand shape and is used for sleeving and wearing the medical gloves to participate in a test and carrying out air tightness detection on the interiors of the medical gloves; the simulation mechanism carries out multi-axial degree-of-freedom driving through the adjusting mechanism so as to simulate a human hand to carry out wearing tests at different angles; an auxiliary testing assembly is installed on the upper portion of the workbench and used for detecting the thicknesses of the medical gloves at different angles and different positions. A detection assembly is installed on the upper portion of the workbench. According to the invention, through mechanical linkage and mutual cooperation between the simulation mechanism and the adjusting mechanism, stress detection can be carried out in a simulated hand operation environment in an actual use process, and at the same time, air tightness can be detected; any angle and position can be adjusted in the detection process, comprehensive process testing is achieved, and actual machining and detection requirements are met.
title: Quality detection device for medical glove production

abstract: The invention discloses a bionic ground gripping anti-slip foot. The bionic ground gripping anti-slip foot comprises a bracket, a shaft, a second tension spring, a first gear, a first gear carrier, afirst supporting piece, first tension springs, a first bionic hoof, first tension spring connecting rods, third tension springs, second tension spring connecting rods, third tension spring connectingrods, a bearing, a second gear, a second gear carrier, a second supporting piece and a second bionic hoof; the first bionic hoof and the second bionic hoof which rotate to be opened around the first supporting piece and the second supporting piece in a small-angle finely adjusted manner can self-adapt to uneven road conditions and generate frictions with the ground to realize an anti-slip effect;bionic concave structures which are distributed at the bottoms of the first bionic hoof and the second bionic hoof in a mirror symmetric manner can enhance locking actions between the two toes and theroad surface; and through opening motions of the first bionic toe and the second bionic toe, the reliability of the ground gripping contact between the hooves and the road surface is effectively guaranteed so that an anti-slip effect is realized.
title: Bionic ground gripping anti-slip foot

abstract: The invention provides a follow-up walking control method of an adsorption type walking device. The method comprises the following steps that a controller controls an adsorption mechanism on a left leg mechanism to release adsorption force on the surface of an adsorbed object, the left leg mechanism is in a free state, and at the moment, the controller controls the adsorption mechanism on a rightleg mechanism to keep adsorption force on the surface of the adsorbed object, a distance between the right leg mechanism and the adsorbed object is not changed, and the right leg mechanism keeps traction follow-up performance; and a control mechanism controls a traction mechanism to pull the left leg mechanism to separate the left leg mechanism from the surface of the adsorbed object, a sensor judges the heights of some protruding obstacles existing on the surface of the object and feeds the judged heights back to the controller, the controller controls the traction mechanism to pull the leftleg mechanism to be lifted upwards, and the left leg mechanism has the height condition of crossing the obstacles. Through perfect synchronization of traction and adsorption, the walking device walksstably; bionic walking design is adopted; the height of an obstacle is automatically recognized and spanned; the obstacle removing capacity is high; and the adaptive capacity is high.
title: Follow-up walking control method of adsorption type walking device

abstract: The invention discloses a system for dynamically calling artificial intelligence memory and emotion to perform large language model interaction. In the invention, the embedded hidden Markov model and the HMT algorithm are utilized to construct a virtual human emotion interaction system based on computer vision, so that the interaction mode between the user and the virtual human is simplified, the user does not need to operate any computer peripheral, and the user experience is improved. According to the method, emotional communication with the virtual person can be carried out only by making various expressions and head postures in front of the camera, meanwhile, rich emotional feedback of the virtual person can be obtained, so that the interestingness in the interaction process is increased, the head postures in a real person video are estimated in real time through a designed head tracking algorithm, and the user experience is improved. The virtual human face is driven to make the same posture in the three-dimensional space, so that the virtual human is more vivid and lively, people can conveniently judge the emotion of the virtual human in time in the communication and interaction process, and the overall use experience of the system is improved.
title: System for dynamically calling artificial intelligence memory and emotion to perform large language model interaction

abstract: The invention discloses an active rope-driven variable-stiffness parallel exoskeleton, and relates to the technical field of rehabilitation auxiliary equipment, the active rope-driven variable-stiffness parallel exoskeleton comprises a rack, a shoulder fixing device and an arm fixing device, and the shoulder fixing device is fixed below the rack; the arm fixing device is a variable-rigidity arm fixing device, the variable-rigidity arm fixing device comprises a three-degree-of-freedom deviation rectifying device, the three-degree-of-freedom deviation rectifying device comprises an upper shaft ring and a lower shaft ring, one of the upper shaft ring and the lower shaft ring is uniformly provided with a plurality of sliding grooves in the circumferential direction, and the other one of the upper shaft ring and the lower shaft ring is provided with a deviation rod which moves up and down in the sliding grooves; one of the upper shaft ring and the lower shaft ring is provided with an arm fixer, and the other one is provided with four groups of variable stiffness devices; driving devices and rotating bearings which are located above the shoulder fixing devices are arranged on the rack, the rotating bearings are connected with shaft rings connected with the variable-rigidity devices through curved connecting rod supporting devices, and the driving devices and the variable-rigidity devices are in one-to-one correspondence and are connected through driving ropes.
title: Active rope-driven variable-stiffness parallel exoskeleton

abstract: The invention provides a rigid-flexible mixed exoskeleton. The rigid-flexible mixed exoskeleton comprises a back supporting module, a suspension back frame module, a hip joint, a driving module, a legpart, a flexible knee joint and an ankle joint module, wherein the suspension back frame module is connected with the hip joint through the back supporting module; the driving module is connected with one end of the hip joint; the leg part comprises a thigh rod and a shank rod; one end of the thigh rod is connected with the other end of the hip joint; one end of the thigh rod is connected with one end of the shank rod through the flexible knee joint; and the other end of the shank rod is connected with the ankle joint module. The rigid-flexible mixed exoskeleton provided by the invention hasthe flexible knee joint and can be bent along with the movement of a human body, the rigid-flexible mixed exoskeleton can be worn on bodies of users with different body shapes in a fitting manner, andthe wearing comfort is increased. Meanwhile, the rigid-flexible mixed exoskeleton provided by the invention can provide reliable supporting and assisting force and has the advantages of simple structure and light weight.
title: Rigid-flexible mixed exoskeleton

abstract: The invention provides a hip joint exoskeleton device. The hip joint exoskeleton device comprises a waist fixing component and a leg fixing component, wherein the leg fixing component comprises a support member, a first fixed part and a rotating mechanism; the first fixed part is used for being fixed to the leg; the rotating mechanism is located between the support member and the first fixed part; the support member is provided with a first end and a second end which are oppositely arranged; the first end of the support member is rotationally connected to the waist fixing component; the support member can swing in the front-back direction relative to the waist fixing component; the second end of the support member is connected to the rotating mechanism; and the first fixed part can rotate in the horizontal direction relative to the support member through the rotating mechanism. By means of the technical scheme provided by the invention, the problem that in the prior art, after a hip joint exoskeleton structure is worn, movement is limited can be solved.
title: Hip joint exoskeleton device

abstract: The invention provides a multi-joint bionic mechanical chela with autonomously-distributed power. The multi-joint bionic mechanical chela comprises a chela section and a chela shield section. The multi-joint bionic mechanical chela is characterized in that the multi-joint bionic mechanical chela is further provided with a connecting frame, a power device, a pincer movement mechanism, a pincer section and an electric control device; the connecting frame, the chela section and the chela shield section are sequentially connected through joints; the power device is fixed to a cavity/cavities of the chela section or/and the chela shield section; the electric control device is fixed to a cavity/cavities of the quick-fitting connecting frame or/and the chela section or/and the chela shield section; the electric control device is correspondingly and electrically connected with the power device and the joints; and the pincer section is connected with the chela shield section through the pincermovement mechanism. The multi-joint bionic mechanical chela is simple in structure and convenient to mount and dismount; and the complete machine is high in working reliability.
title: Multi-joint bionic mechanical chela with autonomously-distributed power

abstract: The invention discloses a lower limb wearable power assisting device based on a tensegrity structure, which comprises an exoskeleton wearable connecting structure, a wearable knee joint structure, a wearable foot structure, a wearable ankle joint structure and a rope connection driving structure, and is characterized in that the wearable knee joint structure is mounted in the middle of the exoskeleton wearable connecting structure; the wearable foot structure is mounted at the bottom of the exoskeleton wearable connecting structure; the wearable ankle joint structure is mounted on the rear side of the wearable foot structure; the wearable knee joint structure and the wearable foot structure are connected through the rope connection driving structure. A wearable structure and a tensegrity structure are combined, so that the whole tensegrity has flexibility, stability and flexibility, low manufacturing cost is guaranteed, meanwhile, structure building is simpler and faster, and the tensegrity has wide application prospects.
title: Lower limb wearable assisting device based on tensegrity structure

abstract: The current invention proposes an advance form of exoskeleton for mobile devices formation of various new types of robots that allow solving problems of various classes using additional functional modules within the framework of the EMD concept. It further allows a significant expansion of the functionality of mobile devices, which—with the help of a specialized external frame can move in space and carry out various useful interactions with the outside world using removable working (instrumental) modules. This structure allows to reduce the cost of robotics by using standard mobile devices equipped with appropriate software as operators of various types of exoskeletons. The specified technical result is achieved by combining the functionality of the exoskeleton (a specialized external frame), which allows you to move in space and interact with the environment, and various mobile devices (smartphones, tablets, smartwatches).
title: EXOSKELETON FOR MOBILE DEVICES

abstract: The invention provides an upper limb rehabilitation exoskeleton control method based on lower limb gaits. The method comprises following steps: 1), data collection: electromyographic sensors and motion sensors located on lower limbs as well as pressure sensors located on soles of feet collect electromyographic signals, joint angles and sole contact force of different gait categories when a subject walks normally; 2), data pre-processing: the collected electromyographic signals, joint angles and sole contact force are pre-processed; 3), gait recognition; 4), upper limb swinging position matching: corresponding upper limb swinging positions are matched according to the recognized gait categories; 5), exoskeleton control: corresponding control commands are sent to an upper limb rehabilitation exoskeleton driver according to the obtained upper limb swinging positions for performing upper limb rehabilitation exoskeleton control, and the upper limbs are driven to perform rehabilitation training. According to the method, coordination of the upper limbs and the lower limbs is taken into consideration, and the rehabilitation effect is better.
title: Upper limb rehabilitation exoskeleton control method based on lower limb gaits

abstract: The invention discloses a ground gripping type bionic intelligent robot which comprises a body main board and leg mechanisms, main board frames are arranged on the two sides of the body main board, and the leg mechanisms adopting the eight-foot bionic spider leg mechanisms are arranged on the main board frames. The eight-leg bionic spider leg mechanism comprises eight mechanical legs, a crank connecting rod mechanism and a gear transmission mechanism, wherein the crank connecting rod mechanism and the gear transmission mechanism drive the eight mechanical legs. A four-foot bionic spider leg mechanism is arranged on each side of the main board frame, each foot bionic spider leg mechanism is driven by a set of gear transmission mechanism in a transmission mode, each set of gear transmission mechanism adopts three-stage transmission gears, the modulus of the middle-stage transmission gear in the three-stage transmission gears is smaller than that of the two adjacent transmission gears, and the modulus of the middle-stage transmission gear in the three-stage transmission gears is smaller than that of the two adjacent transmission gears. The four-footed bionic spider leg mechanism on each side is driven by the same driving motor on the corresponding side to be in transmission connection with a three-level transmission gear, and the three-level transmission gears are connected with the four-footed bionic spider legs through crank connecting rod mechanisms. The structure is simple and flexible, cost is low, stability is high, and adaptability to complex special terrains is improved.
title: Ground gripping type bionic intelligent robot

abstract: The invention relates to a soft robot, in particular to a bionic soft finger based on high-performance etherified bacterial cellulose. The bionic soft finger can simulate a finger of a person to conduct single-joint bending and multi-joint simultaneous bending, has a large degree of freedom and a large working space, can cooperate with a plurality of drivers to complete a target task, and is simple in structure, convenient to operate, light, convenient and safe. According to the technical scheme, the bionic soft finger based on the high-performance etherified bacterial cellulose comprises a finger body and a driving controller, and is characterized in that the finger body comprises a flexible supporting frame and a plurality of flexible drivers attached to the flexible supporting frame; the flexible drivers are arranged in series and keep a certain distance; the driving controller is electrically connected with all the flexible drivers through wires.
title: Bionic soft finger based on high-performance etherified bacterial cellulose

abstract: The invention discloses a soft body bionic robot based on pneumatic muscles. The soft body bionic robot based on the pneumatic muscles comprises at least three fixed plates and the pneumatic muscles rotationally connected among the fixed plates; at least three sets of pneumatic muscles connected in series are rotationally connected between the first fixed plate and the second fixed plate in parallel; each set of pneumatic muscles connected in series are composed of at least three layers of pneumatic muscles connected in parallel, each layer of pneumatic muscles connected in parallel and the corresponding next layer of pneumatic muscles are rotationally connected through the corresponding fixed plate, each layer of pneumatic muscles are composed of six pneumatic muscles connected in parallel, and the two ends of each pneumatic muscle are rotationally connected with the corresponding fixed plates; and six pneumatic muscles are rotationally connected between the second fixed plate and thethird fixed plate in parallel. According to the soft body bionic robot based on the pneumatic muscles, the pneumatic muscles serve as moving elements for execution, the function of completely simulating movement of soft body animals such as snakes, cuttlefish and elephant noses or soft body joints of animals, the structure is compact, clean and good in anti-explosion performance, and the soft body bionic robot based on the pneumatic muscles can be used in the fields of teaching demonstration, object carrying, obstacle crossing, mine clearance and the like.
title: Soft body bionic robot based on pneumatic muscles

abstract: A bionic variable-structure lunar wheel with high obstacle crossing performance belongs to the technical field of engineering bionics, and is characterized in that a bionic variable-structure wheel mechanism capable of crossing obstacles in a lunar surface environment is designed by taking sawtooth structures of ostrich toes, locust legs and the like as bionic elements; the wheel comprises a wheel mechanism composed of a wheel face, a fixed spoke, a movable deformation mechanism and a wheel piece connecting rod. When no difficulty exists, the bionic variable-structure wheel rolls and runs on the lunar surface in a wheel form; when the wheel encounters an obstacle, the actuator drives the crankshaft assembly of the movable deformation mechanism to operate and drives the three cannon pinion pieces of the wheel to be unfolded outwards, and under the assistance of rolling friction of the wheel, structure changing is completed; due to the fact that the wheel pieces are unfolded to increase the enveloping radius and claw finger structures are arranged on the outer edges of the wheel pieces, claw fingers upwards climb and attach to rock obstacles along with rotating motion of the wheels, the whole moving platform is driven to climb upwards, and the obstacle crossing function is achieved.
title: Bionic variable-structure lunar wheel with high obstacle crossing performance

abstract: The invention discloses a module based on a paper folding structure and a bionic soft motion robot, and relates to the field of soft robot structure design and automatic control. The soft robot aims to solve the problems that an existing soft robot is single in motion mode, and working media are limited. The module based on the paper folding structure comprises a bidirectional bending soft paper folding actuator, a torsion soft paper folding actuator and a tenon-and-mortise connecting piece, and the end of the bidirectional bending soft paper folding actuator is connected with the torsion paper folding actuator through the tenon-and-mortise connecting piece. The bionic soft body motion robot comprises a plurality of bidirectional bending soft paper folding actuators, a plurality of torsion soft paper folding actuators and a plurality of mortise and tenon connecting pieces. A plurality of bidirectional bending soft origami actuators are arranged in a line shape, a torsion soft origami actuator is arranged between every two adjacent bidirectional bending soft origami actuators, the two ends of each torsion soft origami actuator are connected with the end of the adjacent bidirectional bending soft origami actuator through a tenon-and-mortise connecting piece respectively, and the torsion soft origami actuator has the self-sensing capacity. And self complex deformation can be sensed in real time.
title: Module based on paper folding structure and bionic soft motion robot

abstract: The invention discloses a bionic hand device. The bionic hand device comprises a palm shell, a thumb part and at least one finger part. Each finger part comprises a first driving mechanism and a finger mechanism, wherein the first driving mechanism can drive the finger mechanism to act. The thumb part comprises a second driving mechanism and a thumb mechanism, wherein the second driving mechanismcan drive the thumb mechanism to act. According to the bionic hand device, the similarity between the bionic hand and a real hand during clenching and spreading can be improved, and the comfort of a user during use and the accuracy during work are improved.
title: Bionic hand device

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of control, and more specifically, provides a PER-DDQN-based exoskeleton assistance movable carrying system control method with a factory workpiece movable carrying scene with exoskeleton equipment assistance and an omni-directional moving platform used as a control background and the influence of two factors including the assistance magnitude of exoskeleton assistance equipment and the moving speed of the moving platform on the production line safety, the production efficiency and the production cost in the carrying process considered. In a conventional production environment, on the basis of the factory workpiece movable carrying scene with exoskeleton equipment assistance and the omni-directional moving platform, the influence of the two factors including the assistance magnitude of the exoskeleton assistance equipment and the moving speed of the moving platform on the production line carrying safety, the production efficiency and the production cost in the carrying process is considered, the optimal strategy of the system is solved by the aid of a DDQN learning network of a priority experience playback mechanism, and the control method of the optimal or better action strategy in each system state is obtained.
title: PER-DDQN-based exoskeleton assistance movable carrying system control method

abstract: The invention discloses a virtual human teaching auxiliary system based on facial expression recognition. Teaching courseware adopts a virtual human teaching mode to carry out asynchronous learning; according to the system, facial expressions of learners are captured in real time through a camera, a facial area is framed by using an SSD algorithm, and the expressions are classified and counted by using a RepVGG network model; meanwhile, the system stores statistical results of different expressions of the learner in the virtual teaching process in a database, provides visual display, and facilitates the teacher to observe the learning state of the learner in the virtual teaching process. According to the invention, real-time monitoring of learners in a virtual teaching process is realized by utilizing an expression recognition technology and combining with a visualization technology, so that teachers or managers can intuitively understand the state of students in the learning process after class, and network teaching can achieve the same effect as face-to-face teaching; the teaching quality is improved. The technology has a wide application prospect in the fields of wisdom education, man-machine interaction and the like.
title: Virtual human teaching auxiliary system based on facial expression recognition

abstract: The invention relates to an exoskeleton (100) comprising: - an arm (110) comprising a means for attaching an upper limb, - a load-bearing structure (140) comprising a support point (141), - a compensation member (130) secured to said arm by a first pivot (131), extending between said arm and said load-bearing structure and exerting a compensation force moment on said arm by deformation of an elastic element, - a force transmission element (150) extending between a lower point of the compensation member and a rear end of the arm, - the elastic element and said force transmission element being continuously loaded in tension when the exoskeleton is in use, being configured in such a way that the moment varies with the inclination of the arm, - said transmission element is secured to the arm by a second pivot (151), the first pivot being located between the second pivot and the front end of the arm.
title: EXOSKELETON COMPRISING AN ELASTIC ELEMENT

abstract: Exoskeleton (50) for overhead, forward leaning or lifting activities, comprising a shoulder exoskeleton (1) for imposing a force or torque on an upper arm of a user, the shoulder exoskeleton comprising a vest (2) arranged for being supported by an upper body of a user, preferably wherein the vest is adaptable to a width of the upper body, a first thigh cuff (52), and a first elastic back strap (53) extending from the first thigh cuff to the vest, wherein, in a state of use, the upper body of the user supports the vest and a thigh of the user supports the first thigh cuff, and a first angle is measured or defined between the upper body and the thigh, wherein the first elastic back strap is arranged a) to stretch when the first angle decreases in the state of use, and b) to relax when the first angle increases in the state of use, particularly when the user is lifting a load from the ground or lowering the load to the ground or when the user is leaning forward.
title: EXOSKELETON

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of space robots, and particularly relates to a bionic manipulator capable of flying freely in a space station cabin. The bionic manipulator capable of flying freely in the space station cabin comprises a manipulator, an aircraft and an air floating platform; the air floating platform is used for simulating a microgravity environment in a space cabin; the aircraft is arranged above the air floating platform, and the aircraft is used for carrying out six-degree-of-freedom flight and hovering in a simulated microgravity environment provided by the air floating platform; and the manipulator is arranged on the aircraft and used for completing a grabbing task. According to the bionic manipulator capable of flying freely in the space station cabin, the whole robot system is carried on the small air floating platform and can simulate the microgravity environment in a space cabin on the ground, so that the manipulator can complete a plane two-degree-of-freedom grabbing experiment; and therefore, operation is flexible, and the grabbing efficiency is high.
title: Bionic manipulator capable of freely flying in space station cabin

abstract: A lifting type upper limb power-assisted exoskeleton comprises a wearable back frame, a left arm power-assisted mechanism and a right arm power-assisted mechanism, and the left arm power-assisted mechanism and the right arm power-assisted mechanism are installed on the left side and the right side of the wearable back frame in a mirror symmetry mode; the wearable back frame is in wearable fit with the back body of a human body through the straps and the waist bandage; the left arm power-assisted mechanism is in wearable fit with the left arm of the human body through a wrist bandage and an arm bandage; the right arm power-assisted mechanism is in wearable fit with the right arm of the human body through a wrist bandage and an arm bandage; the wearable back frame comprises a left shoulder joint motion compensation mechanism, a right shoulder joint motion compensation mechanism and a body supporting and fixing mechanism; the left shoulder joint motion compensation mechanism and the right shoulder joint motion compensation mechanism are installed on the left side and the right side of the body supporting and fixing mechanism in a mirror symmetry mode. The exoskeleton can compensate for the position change of the rotation center of the shoulder joint of the human body, the labor intensity of workers is reduced, the working comfort of the workers is improved, the working effect is improved, and the assistance effect of the exoskeleton is improved.
title: Lifting type upper limb assisting exoskeleton

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field related to exoskeletons, and discloses a passive exoskeleton device based on energy cross-joint transfer. The exoskeleton device comprises a waist wearing assembly, hip joint energy storage assemblies, ankle joint assisting assemblies and clutch assemblies, the waist wearing assembly is worn on the waist, the hip joint energy storage assemblies are worn on the thighs, and the ankle joint assisting assemblies are worn on the ankle joints; the clutch assembly is used for enabling the exoskeleton device to be switched between an energy storage mode and a power assisting mode; when the exoskeleton is in an energy storage mode, the tension spring is stretched, and the elastic potential energy of the tension spring is stored; when the exoskeleton is in a power-assisted mode, the feet of a power-assisted object step on the ground, the thighs swing backwards, the trigger rope is straightened and drives the trigger block to move upwards, the tension spring retracts to drive the sliding block to move upwards, the pull force generated when the sliding block moves upwards is transmitted to the ankle joint power-assisted assembly, and then power assistance of the power-assisted object is achieved. According to the invention, the problem that electronic elements and circuit control are needed in the exoskeleton is solved.
title: Passive exoskeleton device based on energy cross-joint transfer

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of bionic robots, and particularly relates to a bionic robot for topographic survey. The robot comprises a detection head, a detection tail and a joint part. A plurality of trunk assemblies are arranged between the detection head and the detection tail, and each trunk assembly comprises a trunk shell and a surface bulge assembly. A telescopic surface protruding assembly is arranged in the trunk shell, when the device needs to climb vertically, a driving motor can be started, a driving gear is driven to rotate, a driven gear is driven to rotate under the transmission effect of the driving gear, and under the effect of threads in a connecting sleeve, the surface protruding assemblies in the trunk shell extend out of the trunk shell through the limiting through holes, so that a plurality of anti-skid protruding structures are formed on the outer surface of the trunk shell, the roughness degree of the surface of the trunk shell is increased, and the friction force between the trunk shell and the rock wall is increased; in this way, the problems that the device slips and falls off in the climbing process, and consequently the device is inconvenient to climb and hard to climb are effectively prevented.
title: Bionic robot for topographic survey

abstract: PURPOSE: A real time remote image collection and remote swing system utilizing human motion information is provided to increase the reality of a virtual reality image similar to the swing of a ball by utilizing actual swing information and/or the real-time image information of a remote place. CONSTITUTION: A sensor(120) and a video output device(121) are connected to a computation device(110) for processing information and performing communication. The computation device measures information for the swing for hitting a ball by a human through the sensor. The computation device selects one or more image collect device among two or more image collect devices(160-165) located in remote, uses image data received from past or/and present selected image collect device, and outputs the image for showing the flying of the ball through the image output device.
title: Real time remote image collection and remote swing system utilizing human motion information

abstract: The invention discloses a knee joint walking aid exoskeleton. The knee joint walking-assisting exoskeleton comprises an exoskeleton skeleton, wherein the exoskeleton skeleton comprises a thigh assembly and a shank assembly; the ankle joint subsystem is connected with the exoskeleton framework, and the ankle joint subsystem provides passive assistance for the ankle joint when the user walks; the thigh assembly and the shank assembly are connected through the knee joint rotation assisting subsystem; the load distribution optimization subsystem is connected with the exoskeleton framework through binding; the knee joint rotation assisting subsystem comprises a standing state and an active state, and when the knee joint rotation assisting subsystem is in the standing state, the driving subsystem locks the exoskeleton; when the knee joint rotation assisting subsystem is in the movable state, the shank assembly can rotate relative to the thigh assembly. Two working modes of a standing state and an active state are designed; the knee joints of the user can be helped to bend and stretch when the user walks in an active state; in the standing state, the situation that the user cannot keep the standing posture for a long time due to insufficient leg muscle strength can be prevented.
title: Knee joint walking aid exoskeleton

abstract: The invention relates to the related field of bionic robots, and particularly discloses an internet-based biomimetic robot device. According to the invention, the fish-shaped robot main body is adopted; usually, the toy is played by children. A language unit realizes information playing or music playing of each species, so that children can learn during playing; a tail hook matched with a drivingmotor is arranged and can be used as a fish hook, when in use, a tail hook adjusting module controlled by the control chip is used for adjusting the tail hook to a hook-shaped object; a sound simulation module and a heterosexual sound simulation module of the simulation unit are used for simulating the sound of the target fish and the heterosexual sound of the fish respectively; the robot body canbe attracted to the tail hook through the attraction device, the fishing function is achieved, baits are not needed, species infection caused by contact with the baits is avoided, in addition, the robot body can also play a role in underwater scenery shooting, shooting or research of a shooting enthusiast is facilitated, and children can more vividly know the scenery in water.
title: Bionic robot device based on Internet

abstract: The invention discloses a method for converting hand-captured 3D coordinate data into rotation data, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, carrying out the motion capture of a video, and obtaining human motion data and human hand 3D coordinate data; s2, converting the 3D coordinate data of the human hand into hand capture rotation data; s3, splicing the hand capture rotation data with the human body motion data; and S4, carrying out jitter optimization on the spliced data. The method has the beneficial effects that the human hand 3D coordinate data is converted into the hand capture rotation data, then the hand capture rotation data and the human motion data are spliced, and finally the spliced data is subjected to jitter optimization, so that the method is used for converting and optimizing the human hand 3D coordinate data, repairing the defects of the hand capture data, and improving the human motion quality. Therefore, the generated data better conforms to the physical law of human motion, and a large amount of manpower cost is avoided for later repair.
title: Method for converting hand-captured 3D coordinate data into rotation data
