abstract: The invention provides a multi-path cooperation method, device and equipment for a cluster quadruped inspection robot, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining gait dynamics data and topographic data, and recognizing a topographic adaptive rhythm based on the spectrum decomposition of a foot end contact force sequence; converting the topographic data into a potential energy gradient field to construct a dynamic potential energy diagram, and generating a natural path network; a cooperative trigger point is set based on the stable support moment, a path ripple field is formed, and a multi-machine cooperative potential well is constructed; decomposing the path network into a dominant task chain and an auxiliary task chain, and weaving to form an initial collaborative path; rigid nodes and flexible sections are identified through topological transformation, and random disturbance is injected to reconstruct a self-adaptive collaborative path; gait phase information is extracted to construct a synchronous network, a potential energy flow vector is used for phase alignment to generate a group resonance frequency, and a resonance cooperation path is formed; and finally, an execution instruction is generated based on the resonance cooperation path and the terrain adaptability rhythm, and multi-path cooperation of the cluster quadruped inspection robot in the complex terrain environment is achieved.
title: Multi-path cooperation method, device and equipment for cluster quadruped inspection robot

abstract: The invention discloses a human motion recognition method based on human skeleton distribution, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of man-machine cooperation and intelligent manufacturing. In order to solve the problem of accuracy of complex action recognition, the method comprises the steps that sensors are worn at main joints of a human body to collect human body action data, the sensor wearing positions are set as nodes according to a human body skeleton structure diagram, edges are added to multi-dimensional features collected by each node according to human morphology, and an adjacency list is constructed; mapping the multi-dimensional features collected by each node to a hidden layer, and updating the multi-dimensional features by using an attention mechanism to obtain an updated multi-dimensional feature sequence of each node; and constructing a sparse routing selection method of a time sequence data time step dimension attention mechanism, dividing the updated multi-dimensional feature sequence of each node into a plurality of windows, processing each window to obtain a neighbor window most related to each window, and performing sparse attention calculation to obtain a human action recognition result based on human skeleton distribution.
title: Human motion recognition method based on human skeleton distribution, electronic equipment and storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses an exoskeleton quick-release ankle assembly and a using method thereof. The exoskeleton quick-release ankle assembly comprises a leg connecting piece, and the leg connecting piece is rigidly connected with an exoskeleton shank rod; the C-shaped assembly is connected with the leg connecting piece; and the sole component is connected with the C-shaped component. Two degrees of freedom are achieved, the front force transmission structure can effectively play a role in effective supporting, and meanwhile supporting performance and flexibility are achieved. The quick release structure and the joint rotating shaft are integrally designed, the size is small, the weight is light, the light weight of the product is achieved, and the movement flexibility after wearing is guaranteed. Through the modular design of the quick-release sole components and the quick-release joints, individual customization of individual differences can be realized only by replacing sole components with different sizes conveniently according to different foot sizes, and the quick-release sole has the advantage of guaranteeing wearing fitness and flexibility.
title: Exoskeleton quick-release ankle assembly and use method thereof

abstract: The invention provides a variable-moment flexible knee joint structure for a wearable exoskeleton. The variable-moment flexible knee joint structure comprises at least two hinge structures which are connected in sequence; the hinge structure includes: a connecting sheet assembly, a steel rope pulley and a limiting sheet, wherein the connecting piece assembly comprises a left piece and a right piece, wherein the left piece and the right piece are oppositely arranged, and the bone piece is located between the left piece and the right piece. The bone piece is a rectangular piece; the upper edge of one end forms an upper contact surface; the lower edge forms a lower contact surface, the upper edges of one ends of the left piece and the right piece are arc-shaped faces protruding upwards, the lower edges of one ends of the left piece and the right piece are concave faces which are concave upwards and similar to the arc-shaped faces in shape, the steel rope pulley is connected to the other ends of the left piece and the right piece in a pivoted mode through the limiting piece, and the portions, protruding upwards, of the left piece and the right piece are connected through a positioningpin. The invention provides a variable-moment flexible knee joint structure, which enables the torque of a knee joint to be stable during rotation and reduces the energy loss. The length change of theBowden cable is in linear relation with the angle, and the knee joint angle can be judged according to the length change of the Bowden cable.
title: Variable-moment flexible knee joint structure for wearable exoskeleton

abstract: The invention discloses a bionic vision multi-source information intelligent perception unmanned platform, and belongs to the technical field of computer vision and deep learning. The unmanned platform carries a bionic polarization vision/inertia/laser radar integrated navigation module, a deep learning target detection module and an autonomous obstacle avoidance module. Wherein the bionic polarization vision/inertia/laser radar combined navigation module is used for positioning and orienting the unmanned platform in real time; the deep learning target detection module is used for sensing the surrounding environment of the unmanned platform by using the RGB image of the surrounding environment obtained by the bionic polarization vision/inertia/laser radar integrated navigation module; and the autonomous obstacle avoidance module is used for judging whether an obstacle exists around or not according to the object identified by the target in the driving process of the unmanned platform, and performing autonomous obstacle avoidance in combination with the obtained carrier navigation positioning information. According to the invention, the concealment and autonomous navigation capability of the unmanned platform in a complex environment and the target detection and autonomous obstacle avoidance capabilities of the unmanned platform are improved.
title: Bionic vision multi-source information intelligent sensing unmanned platform

abstract: The present invention provides a multiple-legged walking apparatus, which performs four-legged walking motion using closed multi-articulated link members. The multiple-legged walking apparatus of the present invention includes closed multi-articulated link members having a plurality of links in quadrilateral form, wherein each upper vertex of the link members is eccentrically connected to front or rear axis, and one vertical direction link is hinged on a plate, an end of said link, which reaches the ground as said front or rear axes rotates, draw an oval orbit, the driving force obtained by forming a pair of legs, positioned diagonally opposite each other, phase difference from another pair of legs. The present invention can prevent the leg joint from getting overload that is caused by a directly connected driving means, prohibit flowing over-currency, simplify overall structure, and reduce overall load as well.
title: Multiple-legged walking apparatus

abstract: The invention discloses a passive gravity compensation hip joint for a heavy-load lower limb power-assisted exoskeleton and a robot. The hip joint comprises a hip joint unit, a waist adapter and a thigh adapter; the first end of the waist adapter is fixedly connected with a waist assembly; the second end of the waist adapter is fixedly connected with the outer side of the hip joint unit; the output end of the hip joint unit can rotate and is in clasping connection with the first end of the thigh adapter; and the second end of the thigh adapter is connected with a thigh assembly through a pin shaft. According to the passive gravity compensation hip joint for the heavy-load lower limb power-assisted exoskeleton and the robot, the designed hip joint is a passive gravity compensation joint, adopts the hydraulic spring energy conversion principle, does not need electromechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic driving, does not contain an electronic control system component, and can work with high reliability and infinite endurance for a long time; and on the basis of the integrated design of a hydraulic spring and a cam, appropriate auxiliary torque can be output at any angle in the movement process, sudden change or impact is not generated, the flexible output capacity of super-large torque is achieved, and the advantages of miniaturization and light weight are achieved.
title: Passive gravity compensation hip joint for heavy-load lower limb power-assisted exoskeleton and robot

abstract: The invention discloses a robot dog control method, and aims to provide a control method for remote cooperative control of a robot dog, a control module and an imaging helmet, and the main points of the technical scheme are that the method comprises the following steps: S1, an information collection stage: collecting video data of a surrounding environment in real time through a camera arranged on the robot dog; s2, a video data transmitting and receiving stage: transmitting the video data to an imaging helmet through a robot dog communication unit, and imaging the video data to a user visual interface at the same time; s3, in the video picture adjusting stage of the user, a control chip in the robot dog can sense rotation of the head of the user, and the robot dog can synchronize the rotation angle of the head of the human body in real time; s4, in an action data acquisition stage, acquiring a human body action instruction through a control module, and transmitting the human body action instruction to the robot dog, so that the robot dog synchronously completes the human body action instruction; and S5, a data information conversion stage: converting the acquired action data, and transmitting the converted action data to a control chip of the robot dog through a communication unit arranged in the robot dog.
title: Robot dog, control module and control method for remote cooperative control of imaging helmet

abstract: The invention relates to a soft bionic paper folding robot which comprises a head function module, a wriggling module and a rotating module which are connected in sequence, and the wriggling module has stretching and bending functions and is used for moving and deforming the robot. The outer side of the wriggling module is provided with a paper-folding-shaped tail skin used for resetting after the robot deforms and protecting the internal structure of the robot, the head function module is used for obtaining environment information, detecting objects and picking up the objects, and the rotating module is used for driving the robot to roll in two directions. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of modular design, convenience in later maintenance, simple overall structure, convenience in installation, strong deformability, high safety, long service life and the like.
title: Soft bionic paper folding robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the field of mechanical structure design, and particularly relates to a three-stage elastic connection suspension device. The three-stage elastic connection suspension device comprises a first-stage suspension device body, a second-stage suspension device body and a third-stage suspension device body, wherein the first-stage suspension device body, the second-stage suspension device body and the third-stage suspension device body are detachably connected in sequence. According to the three-stage elastic connection suspension device, due to the structural connection mode that the three-stage suspension device is arranged between the left and right hip structures of the power-assisted exoskeleton and protective clothing, motions such as a rotational degree of freedom, a vertical displacement degree of freedom, a rotational degree of freedom in a horizontal plane, a lateral rolling degree of freedom in a frontal plane, a transverse displacement degree of freedom and the like of the protective clothing relative to the exoskeleton can be realized.
title: Three-stage elastic connection suspension device

abstract: The invention discloses a gait recognition method based on three-dimensional point cloud data enhancement. The method comprises the following steps: preprocessing a gait data set, generating three-dimensional human gait data, extracting a black and white binary image, inputting the black and white binary image into a gait recognition network, extracting a gait point cloud energy diagram, inputting the gait point cloud energy diagram into a PointNet classification network, splicing two-dimensional image gait features and three-dimensional point cloud gait features along channel dimensions, carrying out aggregation output, calculating feature similarity, and outputting a recognition result. According to the invention, a novel recognition method combining image features and point cloud energy diagram feature fusion is realized, and the method has insensitivity to visual angles, shielding and clothes, richness provided by multi-dimensional information and higher robustness. The multi-feature fusion recognition method can integrate various information, resist noise and changes, adapt to diversified data and improve generalization ability. The gait recognition method solves the problem that enough information is difficult to obtain for recognition when part of the body is shielded, and plays an important role in promoting the industrialization process of gait recognition.
title: Gait recognition method based on three-dimensional point cloud data enhancement

abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a motion real-time counting method and system based on a deep learning model. The method comprises the following steps: collecting human motion video data in real time through camera equipment; detecting a sporter at the central position of the video image through a human body detection algorithm, and calculating a motion posture vector of a target sporter in each frame of image of the motion video; arranging the motion attitude vectors obtained by each frame of image according to a time sequence to obtain a motion attitude matrix; analyzing the motion attitude matrix based on a pre-trained deep learning model to obtain a counting result of the target actions; wherein the deep learning model is obtained through training based on a training data set formed by motion attitude matrix samples, the motion attitude matrix samples are obtained through calculation of video data samples of various types of motion, and each video data sample only comprises one complete action of one target motion sample. The technical problem that the accuracy of action recognition and counting is poor is solved.
title: Real-time motion counting method and system based on deep learning model

abstract: The invention relates to a torque control method of a lower limb exoskeleton nonlinear elastic driver. Linear processing of an output torque hysteresis force curve is realized by introducing virtual displacement, a set of improved Maxwell-slip hysteresis force model based on virtual displacement and an inverse model thereof are designed, and the torque control method is designed on the basis of the hysteresis force model, so that accurate control over the output torque of the nonlinear elastic driver is realized. The torque control method not only can be used in the lower limb exoskeleton nonlinear elastic driver, but also can be used in other nonlinear elastic drivers.
title: Torque control method of lower limb exoskeleton nonlinear elastic driver

abstract: An embodiment includes an exoskeleton robotic system comprising a parallelogram-based remote center of motion (RCM) joint. The RCM mechanism includes a first link that is coupled to a second link, a third link, and a fourth link. A motor is coupled to the third link. A first of the first, second, third, or fourth links includes a first flexure. The first flexure includes a first degree of freedom in a first direction. A second of the first, second, third, or fourth links includes a second flexure, the second flexure including a second degree of freedom in a second direction. The first direction is not parallel to the second direction.
title: ROBOTIC JOINT INCLUDING A REMOTE CENTER OF MOTION MECHANISM

abstract: The invention discloses a light passive modular power-assisted exoskeleton which comprises a man-machine backpack system, a leg supporting system and an elastic power-assisted system. The man-machine backpack system is composed of a backpack support, straps and a waist seal and mainly achieves the function of being connected and matched with a wearer. The leg supporting system is connected with the man-machine bearing system through a Moore belt and mainly composed of a waist inserting plate, a flexible binding part, a leg telescopic pipe and a shoe cover, the functions of supporting legs and transmitting load gravity to the ground are achieved, and the elastic power assisting system is connected to the leg supporting system through a joint shaft. The light passive modular power-assisted exoskeleton is mainly composed of an elastic adjusting knob, a ratchet wheel, a pawl and a torsional spring, the telescopic state of the torsional spring is changed through the elastic adjusting knob to achieve elastic adjustment of joints, and then the elastic power-assisted function is achieved. The load bearing capacity and the walking durability of the wearer are greatly improved, and the device is an ideal device for assisting walking.
title: Light passive modular power-assisted exoskeleton

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of deep learning, in particular to a video-based virtual human model driving method, device and equipment and a storage medium, through the method, an automatic process from video driving to virtual human model driving is realized, a human body is identified from a hand, a face and a body, and the problem of fuzzy local identification is solved. According to the method, the hands and the face are combined with the body in a splicing mode, so that the output action sequence file also comprises the facial expression, and the human body posture in the video can be obtained more finely. In addition, after the postures are converted into the action sequence file, follow-up use is more convenient, the same set of actions can be imported into different virtual human models, resource reuse is achieved, and commercialization is more convenient. The driven virtual character model can be applied to virtual human animation generation and can be used as a character image in financial product sales animation.
title: Video-based virtual human model driving method and device, equipment and storage medium

abstract: A wearable exoskeleton comprising: a base; an articulable mechanical member configured to be secured to a portion of the human anatomy having a joint; a pulley motor secured to the base; a Bowden cable secured to the pulley motor and the articulable mechanical member; wherein the mechanical member is configured to articulate in response to the pulley motor imparting force to the Bowden cable.
title: LIGHTWEIGHT HIGH TORQUE EXOSKELETON

abstract: The invention relates to a virtual digital human driving method and device, equipment and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining user information which comprises voice information and image information; determining a user intention and a user emotion according to the user information; determining a reply text of the virtual digital person according to the user intention, and determining a reply emotion of the virtual digital person according to the user intention and the user emotion; and determining the limb movement of the virtual digital human according to the reply text, and determining the emotion expression mode of the virtual digital human according to the reply emotion, thereby realizing a natural personification virtual human interaction state, and improving the simulation and expression naturalness of the virtual digital human.
title: Virtual digital human driving method and device, equipment and medium

abstract: The invention discloses a bionic hexapod robot. The robot comprises a robot body component and six mechanical legs evenly arranged on the robot body component, the robot body component comprises a top plate, a bottom plate and a supporting rod arranged between the top plate and the bottom plate, six supporting shafts are evenly arranged on the top plate, and six bearings corresponding to the supporting shafts are uniformly arranged on the bottom plate. Each mechanical leg comprises: a fixed base; a leg base which rotates in a horizontal plane; a first driving part which is arranged on the fixed base and drives the leg base to rotate; a connecting rod assembly which is rotationally connected with the leg base; a leg part which is rotationally connected with the connecting rod assembly; a second driving piece which is arranged on the leg base and connected with the connecting rod assembly to drive the legs to move in the horizontal direction; and a third driving part which is connected with the connecting rod assembly to drive the legs to move in the vertical direction. The bionic hexapod robot is high in bearing capacity and stable in walking, and the working space of the mechanical legs is enlarged.
title: Bionic hexapod robot

abstract: The invention discloses a virtual human behavior generation method and device, equipment and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a multi-modal event related to a current dialogue environment, and extracting an emotional representation from the multi-modal event, the emotional representation comprising a factor combination influencing the emotion of a virtual human; reasoning the emotional state of the virtual human at the next moment based on the figure setting, the current emotional state and the emotional representation of the virtual human, and determining the emotional state at the next moment; and based on the emotional state of the next moment, determining a human behavior and a performance degree of the human behavior from a preset behavior library, and outputting a human behavior combination instruction to determine a behavior of the virtual human at the next moment. According to the method, character setting of the virtual human is combined, the emotion is quantified, what behavior should be generated is autonomously decided, emotional expression and human setting creation of thousands of people are realized, and the flexibility is high.
title: Virtual human behavior generation method and device, equipment and medium

abstract: The invention discloses an automatic human body motion posture automatic detection method based on a convolutional neural network. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a motion image and preprocessing the motion image; segmenting the human body image and the scene image; extracting human body key point information; generating a feature vector based on the key points; calculating a feature vector included angle; and calling a neural network diagnosis model to judge the motion posture. According to the invention, real-time diagnosis of human motion postures is carried out based ona convolutional neural network model; the design method is suitable for different motion scenes and various human body actions, solves the problem that the common crowd cannot judge whether the motion posture is wrong or not due to lack of professional training, and provides a feasible low-cost solution for improving the motion quality of the common crowd.
title: Human body motion posture automatic detection method based on convolutional neural network

abstract: The invention relates to an exoskeleton in which a foot structure (308) includes a supporting plane (310) on which the foot of a person wearing the exoskeleton can rest when the foot is flat. The supporting plane comprises a front platform (903) and a rear platform (904). A foot pivot link (905) connects the front platform to the rear platform.
title: EXOSKELETON COMPRISING A FOOT STRUCTURE

abstract: The invention relates to a hip replacement postoperative auxiliary medical rehabilitation exoskeleton system which comprises a series elastic driver and a wearable exoskeleton, the series elastic driver is fixedly connected to a driving control cabinet and connected with the wearable exoskeleton through a first line pipe and a second line pipe, a first steel wire rope penetrates through the first line pipe, and a second steel wire rope penetrates through the second line pipe. One end of the connecting rod is connected to a steel wire rope fixing seat of the series elastic driver, and the other end of the connecting rod is connected to a first annular bolt of the wearable exoskeleton; the second steel wire rope penetrates through the second wire pipe, one end of the second steel wire rope is connected to a steel wire rope fixing base of the series elastic driver, and the other end of the second steel wire rope is connected to a second annular bolt of the wearable exoskeleton. Controllable assistance in a full gait cycle can be provided for a hip replacement surgery patient, mechanical stress generated by a traditional hip replacement postoperative rehabilitation robot and parasitic force formed by direct traction of a rope are eliminated, assistance rehabilitation training of the patient under standing posture autonomous walking is achieved, and rehabilitation efficiency and safety are improved.
title: Auxiliary medical rehabilitation exoskeleton system after hip replacement operation

abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a human motion sequence completion method and device, equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an incomplete initial motion sequence of a target object; inputting the initial motion sequence into a pre-constructed motion sequence completion model, wherein the motion sequence completion model comprises a sequence repair sub-model and a context optimization sub-model; performing sequence repair on the initial motion sequence according to the sequence repair sub-model to obtain a repaired motion sequence; and performing sequence optimization on the repaired motion sequence according to the context optimization sub-model to obtain a target motion sequence in which the target object is complemented completely. According to the embodiment of the invention, the method can consider the deletion of the motion sequence from different dimensions, considers the internal relation between the joint points of the human skeleton, and can generate a human motion sequence completion result with a better effect.
title: Human motion sequence completion method and device, equipment and storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses a clutch device and method suitable for an under-actuated exoskeleton. The clutch device comprises a motor, a rotating shaft, a left sliding groove disc, a left driven ratchet wheel assembly, a driving ratchet wheel, a right driven ratchet wheel assembly, a right sliding groove disc and an end cover assembly. The rotating shaft is connected to a motor, and the left sliding groove disc and the left driven ratchet wheel assembly and the right sliding groove disc and the right driven ratchet wheel assembly are installed on the rotating shaft in a mirror symmetry mode relative to the driving ratchet wheel. The left sliding groove disc and the right sliding groove disc are each of a cylindrical cam structure. The underactuated exoskeleton has the advantages of being small in size, light in weight, high in reliability, low in manufacturing cost and the like, decoupling of the two rope discs is achieved through cooperation between the cam sliding groove structure and the end face ratchet wheel, and the problem that two rope discs of a traditional underactuated exoskeleton interfere with each other is solved.
title: Clutch device and method suitable for under-actuated exoskeleton

abstract: The invention belongs to the field of grabbing and clamping devices and discloses an intelligent bionic grabbing and clamping device based on 4D printing forming. The intelligent bionic grabbing and clamping device based on 4D printing forming comprises a grabbing and clamping body and a temperature adjusting mechanism. The grabbing and clamping body comprises a semi-circular back body, a crescentgrabbing surface and body edge bottoms. The semi-circular back body is transitionally connected to two ends of the crescent grabbing surface through the two body edge bottoms to further form a deformable cavity structure. The temperature adjusting mechanism is arranged in the cavity structure for adjusting the temperature of the grabbing and clamping body. The grabbing and clamping body has martensite phase transformation under the action of different temperatures to be curled or unfolded, so that a workpiece is grabbed and clamped or unfolded and released. The intelligent bionic grabbing andclamping device is obtained by means of a 4D printing forming technology. The temperature adjusting mechanism adjusts the temperature, so that the grabbing and clamping body has martensite phase transformation under the action of different temperatures to be curled or unfolded, and therefore, the workpiece is grabbed and clamped or unfolded and released
title: Intelligent bionic grabbing and clamping device based on 4D printing forming

abstract: The invention relates to an exoskeleton for assisting human movement, which can be fitted to the user in terms of dimensions, tension and ranges of joint motion, either manually or automatically. Said exoskeleton can be fitted to the user in the anteroposterior direction in the sagittal plane, with the user in a horizontal or sitting position, without requiring a functional transfer. The exoskeleton has a modular design which is compatible with human biomechanics and reproduces a natural and physiological movement in the user, with up to 7 actuated and controlled degrees of movement per limb, ensuring that the user maintains equilibrium during locomotion.
title: EXOSKELETON FOR ASSISTING HUMAN MOVEMENT

abstract: The invention discloses a shoulder power-assisted exoskeleton giving consideration to power-assisted stability and redundant degree of freedom, which is provided with a waistband, two shoulder straps and a back skeleton are symmetrically connected to the waistband, the two shoulder straps are connected through a first connecting strap, and the upper end of the back skeleton is connected with the first connecting strap or the shoulder strap close to the first connecting strap through a second connecting strap. The upper end of the back framework is further rotationally connected with a shoulder base through a vertical shaft, the shoulder base is rotationally connected with an arm base through a horizontal shaft, the front end of the arm base is connected with an arm framework, and the front end of the arm framework is connected with an arm connecting piece; a wire passing roller is rotatably supported on the shoulder base, a wire pulling end shaft is arranged on the arm base, the wire pulling end shaft is connected with one end of a first pulling rope, the first pulling rope bypasses the wire passing roller, is vertically downward and is coaxial with a vertical shaft, the other end of the first pulling rope is connected with a force applying element connected to the back framework, a pulling rope limiting block is fixed to the shoulder base, and the pulling rope limiting block is connected with the arm base. And the central line of the first pull rope is prevented from downwards penetrating through the axis of the horizontal shaft.
title: Shoulder power-assisted exoskeleton giving consideration to power-assisted stability and redundant degree of freedom

abstract: The invention discloses a bionic six-feet robot with a picking function, belongs to the technical field of machinery manufacturing, and aims at solving the problem that harvesting conditions of existing low crops are complicated, a current machine cannot adapt to a complicated vegetation environment, and therefore manual picking is needed. The robot comprises a six-feet robot body and a picking manipulator. The six-feet robot body is characterized in that the six-feet robot body is supported and moves by six independent mechanical feet, an all-degree-of-freedom manipulator body is installed onthe upper portion of the robot body, and a camera is installed at the rear end of the manipulator body. The robot has the advantages that the structure is simple, the designing is ingenious, the costis low, the robot can effectively adapt to the working environment where the crops are grown, and the picking capability is improved.
title: Bionic six-feet robot with picking function

abstract: The invention discloses a flying robot suitable for perching, climbing and grabbing. The flying robot comprises a robot body and mechanical arms arranged at the two sides of the robot body; the robotbody comprises a rack, a flight controller, a propeller, a brushless motor and a camera, wherein the flight controller, the propeller, the brushless motor and the camera are arranged on the rack, thebrushless motor is used for driving the propeller to rotate, and the camera is used for collecting robot surrounding images; and each mechanical arm comprises a steering engine I, a right-angle connecting rod, a steering engine II, an arm body and a bionic claw which are sequentially connected. The flying robot is provided with four three-degree-of-freedom arms, so that the postures of the arms can be adjusted according to the structural characteristics of an inhabiting object, and the flying robot can stably inhabit and be attached to a target object; and meanwhile, the flying robot can simulate sloth to climb, the position of the flying robot can be adjusted, and simple objects can be grabbed to be transported in the air. The invention further discloses a control method of the flying robot, and different perching manners such as horizontal downward perching, horizontal upward perching, vertical perching and oblique perching of the robot can be achieved.
title: Flying robot suitable for perching, climbing and grabbing and control method thereof

abstract: The invention discloses a bionic face expression control method and device, equipment and a medium, and relates to the technical field of computers, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a first normalized action value range of each first RIG control variable corresponding to a real face, and determining a second normalized action value range of each second RIG control variable corresponding to a bionic face; calculating a mapping relation between action value ranges corresponding to the corresponding first RIG control variable and the second RIG control variable in each face action area; determining a target action value of the current real facial expression image in the first normalized action value range of each first RIG control variable by using a target deep learning model; and determining a bionic action value of the target action value in a second normalized action value range of the corresponding second RIG control variable based on the mapping relationship, and controlling a face steering engine based on the bionic action value to control a bionic face expression. And real face expressions are accurately mapped to the bionic face in real time.
title: Bionic facial expression control method and device, equipment and medium

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of knee joint power-assisted exoskeleton manufacturing, in particular to a strain gauge arrangement method of a knee joint power-assisted exoskeleton. The knee joint assisting exoskeleton comprises a lower limb supporting assembly, a power driving assembly, a control assembly and a strain gauge. The lower limb supporting assembly comprises a thigh/shank supporting frame, a knee joint transmission assembly and a bandage fixing seat. The arrangement method comprises the steps that S1, an arrangement area is determined as a non-knee-joint core connecting piece area of the lower limb supporting assembly and comprises a section, away from a knee joint transmission assembly and close to a bandage fixing base, of the thigh/shank supporting frame and a weak area of the turning position of the thigh/shank supporting frame; and S2, after the strain gauge is fixed in the arrangement area, the strain gauge is connected with the control assembly to construct an electric signal transmission path. Non-human body correlation force interference is avoided from the source, and it is ensured that the strain gauge captures a pure strain signal; in addition, the structural characteristics of the lower limb supporting assembly are adapted, the signal acquisition stability is improved, and reliable data support is provided for follow-up precise assistance.
title: Arrangement method of strain gauges of knee joint power-assisted exoskeleton

abstract: The invention relates to a modular exoskeleton structure that provides force assistance to the user, comprising a base module (1) that includes: a lumbar belt (11) to be placed around the user's waist; a battery (12) and a control unit (13), both secured to the lumbar belt (11); a first securing part secured to the belt (11) and intended to engage with a complementary second securing part of a hip module (5) in order to attach the hip module (5) to the base module (1) by means of the snap-fitting of the second securing part in the first securing part; and a third securing part secured to the belt (11) and intended to engage with a complementary fourth securing part of a back module in order to attach the back module to the base module (1).
title: MODULAR EXOSKELETON STRUCTURE THAT PROVIDES FORCE ASSISTANCE TO THE USER

abstract: The invention discloses a bionic robot with convertible gaits. The bionic robot comprises a trunk, a tail balance mechanism, two adjusting devices and four limbs. The two adjusting devices are connected to a front box body and a rear box body of the trunk respectively and are composed of transmission shafts, cranks and ratchet wheels. The four limbs are connected to the adjusting device and are composed of a right front limb, a left front limb, a right rear limb and a left rear limb; the tail balance mechanism is perpendicular to the rear surface of the rear box body, connected with the trunk and composed of a rotating attitude steering engine, three swing attitude steering engines and a plurality of connecting rods. By means of the adjusting part, gait conversion of walking, running and jumping of the front limb and the rear limb can be achieved under the condition that only two servo motors are arranged front and back; adjustment of rotation and swing of the tail is achieved through control of the four steering engines at the tail, and the stability of the whole robot is improved.
title: Bionic robot with convertible gaits

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and discloses a multifunctional bionic finger and a dexterous bionic hand, the multifunctional bionic finger comprises a knuckle structure and two linear motors, and the knuckle structure is hinged to a palm support through a ball pin pair; one end of each linear motor is hinged to the palm support through a first spherical pair, and the other end of each linear motor is hinged to the corresponding knuckle structure through a second spherical pair. The two linear motors are used for driving the knuckle structures to achieve bending and stretching movement or swinging movement, when the two linear motors stretch out and draw back synchronously, the knuckle structures conduct bending and stretching movement, and when the two linear motors stretch out and draw back asynchronously, the knuckle structures conduct swinging movement.
title: Multifunctional bionic finger and dexterous bionic hand

abstract: The invention discloses an unpowered exoskeleton. The unpowered exoskeleton comprises an exoskeleton body, a telescopic component and a connecting rod. The exoskeleton body is provided with a first side face of the exoskeleton body. The telescopic component is arranged on the first side face of the exoskeleton body. The telescopic component is provided with a first end of the telescopic component and a second end of the telescopic component. The connecting rod is arranged on the first side face of the exoskeleton body and provided with a through groove. The connecting rod is provided with a first end of the connecting rod and a second end of the connecting rod. The first end of the telescopic component is fixedly connected to the first side face of the exoskeleton body, the second end of the telescopic component is fixedly connected with the first end of the connecting rod, and the connecting rod is slidably connected with the exoskeleton body through the matching of the through groove and a first fastening component. The unpowered exoskeleton can assist a user to do exercise, the stress on the knee joints can be relieved when the user walks, the protection function on the knee joint is played, and the acting force applied to the user by the unpowered exoskeleton can be adjusted by adjusting the relative position of the first fastening component and the through groove.
title: Unpowered exoskeleton

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of data recognition, in particular to a human body feature object recognition auxiliary system based on a computer vision technology, which comprises a capture layer, an analysis layer and a control layer, image data of an object is obtained through the capturing layer, image enhancement processing is executed in the capturing layer, the image data is sent to the analysis layer, the analysis layer analyzes a processing target in the image data based on the received image data after image enhancement processing, and the processing target is subjected to physical analysis. According to the method, a target to be grabbed by the mechanical exoskeleton can be analyzed through the collected image data, and the magnitude of assisting force needing to be provided by each skeleton position on the mechanical exoskeleton is further analyzed for the target object on the basis of the collected image data, so that each skeleton position on the mechanical exoskeleton can be accurately grabbed according to the actual situation of the grabbed target. Mutually-adaptive cooperative grabbing operation is carried out, so that the mechanical exoskeleton is more labor-saving and intelligent in the using process.
title: Human body feature object recognition auxiliary system based on computer vision technology

abstract: The invention discloses a rest auxiliary switching method and device, a terminal and a computer readable storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: firstly the recognition information of an exoskeleton is obtained, wherein the recognition information at least comprises one of kinematics information, mechanics information, biological information and image information, and the exoskeleton is wearable equipment of a user; state information of the user is recognized based on the recognition information, and the state information comprises a standing state and a sitting state; based on thestate information, the exercise intention of the user is obtained, and the exercise intention comprises standing and sitting; and finally, based on the motion intention, whether to switch the rest auxiliary state of the user or not is determined, wherein the rest assistance state comprises opening assistance and closing assistance, so that assistance required by the user is provided when the user has a rest, namely, when the user is in a standing state, supporting assistance is opened, and when the user is in a sitting state, the assistance is closed, so that the user can freely move at will.
title: Rest auxiliary switching method and device, terminal and storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses an automatic obstacle avoidance system for a robot. The automatic obstacle avoidance system is composed of an external detection module, a memory, a service manager, a display,a microwave antenna and an obstacle avoidance module. The obstacle avoidance module is provided with a power supply module, a built-in laser range finder, a built-in camera, an image recognition module, a master controller, a projector, a communication module and a driving module. According to the automatic obstacle avoidance system for the robot, the external detection module is mounted in a work place of the robot to detect positions of objects in the place quickly, so that the robot can customize the most proper advancing route conveniently, and therefore, the work efficiency of the robotis improved. The projector is mounted at the front end of the robot to display an advancing route of the robot in the next step, so that staff can know the advancing route of the robot timely. Meanwhile, the staff also can compare a projection line with the advancing route of the robot by observing the projection line, so that the robot can be corrected conveniently and timely.
title: Automatic obstacle avoidance system for robot

abstract: The invention provides a method for selecting a camera erection point position by a robot and the robot, the robot comprises a camera, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining three-dimensional images of different areas, and constructing a three-dimensional map based on the three-dimensional images; determining a target area used for shooting on the three-dimensional map, a people flow direction in the target area and the height of a target crowd; determining a first point location of a camera according to the target area, the people flow direction and the height of the target crowd, wherein the camera shoots an image of the target crowd at the first point location; analyzing the face shooting quality in the target crowd image, and adjusting the first point location in combination with a factor influencing the face shooting quality to obtain a second point location of a camera capable of capturing a face from the front side; and determining an erection point location of the camera according to the second point location. According to the method for selecting the camera erection point position by the robot, the point selection efficiency and precision of the face snapshot camera can be improved, and the labor cost of point selection is reduced.
title: Method for selecting camera erection point position by robot and robot

abstract: A method is disclosed. The method is implemented by a robot engine that is stored as program code on a memory of a system. The program code is executed by a processor of the system, which enables robotic process automations of the robot engine. The processor is communicatively coupled to the memory within the system. The method includes initiating a guided operation of a platform presented by the system and monitoring the guided operation to observe an interaction with the platform or to receive a direct input by the robot engine. The method also includes executing a backend operation with respect to the interaction or the direct input.
title: GUIDED OPERATION BY ROBOTIC PROCESSES

abstract: The invention discloses grabbing equipment of an industrial intelligent robot. The grabbing equipment comprises an installation base, a fixing seat, a supporting column, a grabbing arm support and a grabbing assembly; the installation base is fixedly installed with the industrial intelligent robot, the fixing seat is fixedly installed at the center position of the upper end of the installation base, the supporting column is fixedly connected to the center position of the upper end of the fixing seat, a rotating cover is rotatably installed on the supporting column, the grabbing arm support isfixedly installed on the rotating cover, and a second motor and a third motor are fixedly installed on the grabbing arm support. According to the grabbing equipment, a grabbing assembly and a clampingassembly are arranged to grab and clamp objects, thus the different functions of the industrial intelligent robot are achieved, the using range of the industrial intelligent robot is increased, the fast and stable operation of the object grabbing and clamping is achieved, the range of grabbing and clamping is wide, the position adjustment is large, and it is effectively guaranteed that the objects with different shapes are stably grabbed and clamped.
title: Grabbing equipment of industrial intelligent robot and grabbing method thereof

abstract: A method, apparatus and computer program product are present for performing a manufacturing procedure. A component may be positioned in a work area. A plurality of groups of robots may be operated in parallel and robots of each group of robots of the plurality of groups of robots may be operated in synchronism for performing a plurality of manufacturing operations at a plurality of locations on the component.
title: AGILE MANUFACTURING APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR HIGH THROUGHPUT

abstract: The present disclosure provides a robot and a control method thereof. A robot according to the present disclosure includes a rotatable wheel, a cutter configured to cut an external object while the robot is moved by the wheel, a motor configured to rotate the cutter, a transceiver configured to receive GPS information of an external device outside the robot from the electronic device, and a processor configured to rotate the motor, obtain a distance between the robot and an object outside the robot while rotating the motor, and stop the motor based on the distance between the robot and the object. Accordingly, it is possible to protect a user from a danger of a blade and to safely use the robot.
title: ROBOT AND CONTROL METHOD THEREOF

abstract: The invention relates to a space screwing operation task-oriented multi-arm robot coordination compliance control method, and belongs to the technical field of space robots. Comprising the following steps: constructing an assembly system after a multi-arm robot captures a target; each mechanical arm obtains the actual force through a six-dimensional force sensor at the tail end, and the actual contact internal force is calculated according to the actual force and load distribution; when the actual contact internal force is not equal to the expected contact internal force, the actual movement track of the robot is adjusted through the self-adaptive variable impedance controller, and dynamic balance between the actual contact internal force and the position is achieved; and meanwhile, according to the assembly system, coordination among multiple arms and smooth contact between the mechanical arm and a target in the screwing process are achieved. According to the method, under the conditions of time varying of screwing position information and time varying of screwing torque, force/position discordance caused by errors can be automatically compensated through the self-adaptive law, and multi-arm coordination and compliance control is achieved.
title: Space screwing operation task-oriented multi-arm robot coordination compliance control method

abstract: The cleaning robot comprises a shell, a boundary detection module and a cleaning robot, the boundary detection module comprises a first detection part, a second detection part, a trigger part and an inductor, and the first detection part is configured to move relative to the shell in the first direction when the first detection part collides with a frame of a plate in a squeezing mode; the second detection part is movably mounted on the first detection part and is configured to move along a second direction different from the first direction relative to the first detection part when the second detection part moves to the outer side of the edge of the plate, and the trigger part is arranged on the second detection part and is located at a first position; the inductor is configured to generate an induction signal when the first detection part moves in the first direction and drives the trigger part to move from the first position to the second position or the second detection part moves in the second direction and drives the trigger part to move from the first position to the third position. The boundary detection module can realize boundary detection only by adopting one inductor and one trigger part, and has the advantages of simple structure, stability and reliability.
title: Boundary detection module and cleaning robot

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent maintenance robots, in particular to an intelligent maintenance robot which is characterized in that image information of a to-be-maintained part is acquired through a visual module, a moving device drives a dismounting and mounting device to move to the damaged to-be-maintained part according to the image information, and a screw for fixing the to-be-maintained part is dismounted through a dismounting and mounting device. And after the disassembly and assembly device disassembles the screws, the screws are carried to the loading device. After all the screws for fixing the to-be-maintained part are removed, the moving device moves the taking and placing device to the installation position of the to-be-maintained part, the to-be-maintained part is taken out from the installation position of the to-be-maintained part through the taking and placing device, and a replacement part capable of working normally is installed. After the replacement part is installed in the installation position, the disassembly and assembly device takes the screw from the loading device, the screw is installed on the replacement part in the installation position, the replacement part is fixed through the screw, and then maintenance of the part to be maintained is completed. And the whole maintenance process is completed through the intelligent maintenance robot, so that the safety and convenience of the LED display screen maintenance process are improved.
title: Intelligent maintenance robot

abstract: A method (300) and system (100) for task execution in a dynamic heterogeneous robotic environment is disclosed. The method (300) includes extracting (302) data associated with a plurality of data categories and further deriving (304) a plurality of factors from the extracted data and determining (306) a plurality of correlations amongst the plurality of factors based on the deep learning network. The method (300) includes deriving (308) a plurality of parameters for a set of factors from the plurality of factors based on the plurality of correlations and simulating (310) execution of the at least one current task by employing a plurality of robots. The method (300) includes iteratively re-adjusting (312) at least one of the plurality of parameters based on reinforcement learning performed on a result of the simulating and executing (314) the at least one current task by employing the plurality of robots.
title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR TASK EXECUTION IN DYNAMIC HETEROGENEOUS ROBOTIC ENVIRONMENT

abstract: The invention discloses a remotely-controlled teaching robot. The robot comprises a first shell, a second shell, a movable seat and a head; the first shell is arranged at the outside of the second shell in a sleeving manner, and the movable seat is fixed at the bottom end of the first shell in a welding manner; and the head is arranged above the second shell; the second shell is driven to rise through the lifting module, thereby driving the head to rise to an appropriate location, and a user can conveniently touch a display screen; the student can touch screen through a touch pen to query thedocument and learn. The teaching robot can be suitable for population in different heights, and the applicability is strong. A projector angle is adjusted through a driving cylinder, the operation isautomatic, the adjusting is convenient and the adjusting precision is higher, thereby improving a projection effect; the teaching robot is connected with an external network through a wireless networkreceiver, so that the remote control can be directly performed, and the teaching is convenient; the movement is performed by arranging the movable seat under the first shell. The robot can move flexibly, thereby conveniently teaching at different sites.
title: Remotely-controlled teaching robot

abstract: The present disclosure provides a patient-side operation device, a surgical robot, and a surgical medical system. The patient-side operation device comprises a base, a position adjustment mechanism, a posture adjustment mechanism, and an end effector holding mechanism that are sequentially connected. The position adjustment mechanism is configured for moving the posture adjustment mechanism and the end effector holding mechanism. The end effector holding mechanism is configured for mounting a surgical end effector and is provided with a pitching joint rotatable around a pitching axis, and the pitching axis is perpendicular to the extending direction of the surgical end effector. The posture adjustment mechanism is provided with a first pivotable joint rotating around a first pivoting axis and a second pivotable joint rotating around a second pivoting axis, wherein the first pivoting axis is at an angle to the second pivoting axis, and at least one of the first pivoting axis and the second pivoting axis is at an angle to the pitching axis.
title: PATIENT-SIDE OPERATION DEVICE, SURGICAL ROBOT, AND SURGICAL MEDICAL SYSTEM

abstract: A robotic apparatus has eight actuators (M0-M7) and a linkage (LINK 0 - LINK 5) that actuates an end effector. Three serial macro freedoms have large ranges of motion and inertias. Four serial micro freedoms have small ranges of motion and inertias. Translation of the end effector in any direction is actuated by at least one micro joint and at least one macro joint. The apparatus can be part of a master and slave combination, providing force feedback without any explicit force sensors. The slave is controlled with an Inverse Jacobian controller, and the master with a Jacobian Transpose controller. A slave having more degrees-of-freedom (DOFs) than the master can be controlled. A removable effector unit actuates its DOFs with cables. Beating heart surgery can be accomplished by commanding the slave to move with a beating heart, and cancelling out any such motion in the motions perceived by the master.
title: SURGICAL ROBOTIC APPARATUS

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a remote control device for a force feedback robot, which comprises a controller, and a plurality of supporting pieces which are convenient to disassemble and can be adsorbed and fixed are further mounted at the bottom of the controller; a data collector capable of collecting data when the controller works is arranged at the rear end of the controller, and a memory for storing the data is inserted into the outer side of the data collector; and a fixing structure for limiting and fixing the memory is also arranged on one side of the data collector at the rear end of the controller. The controller can collect the working state of the robot by arranging the data collector, collect the data and transmit the data to the memory for storage, so that after the robot is operated, the operation process can be analyzed through the data collected in the memory, problems are found, and the operation efficiency is improved. Therefore, the operation force feedback robot can be better controlled by the controller to work.
title: Remote control device for force feedback robot

abstract: The invention discloses a universal robot processing module for voice instruction input analysis, relates to the field of voice recognition, solves the problem of high error rate of audio recognition, and comprises an audio feature extraction unit, an audio analysis unit, an instruction generation unit and a robot module, the audio feature extraction unit is used for analyzing audio data input by a user and extracting an audio feature vector, the audio feature vector corresponding to the audio data is obtained through analysis and extraction, and the audio analysis unit is used for identifying the content of the audio feature vector corresponding to the audio data and obtaining an audio sounding sequence or generating a prompt signal; the instruction generation unit is used for converting an audio sounding sequence corresponding to the audio data into a text instruction and sending the text instruction to the robot module, the robot module is used for extracting control keywords in the text instruction and sequentially executing the control keywords according to the sequence of the control keywords in the text instruction, and accurate recognition of the audio data is achieved.
title: Universal robot processing module for voice instruction input analysis

abstract: The present invention relates to an intelligent caddy robot which is provide to a golfer by being spaced form the golfer at a predetermined distance by transmitting and receiving signals to/from a transceiver which the golfer carries; to enable stable and smooth operation in complex topography; and to recognize and avoid obstacles in a moving direction by facilitating a direction change frequently reacting with a direction change by the golfer. The intelligent caddy robot includes a vehicle body composed of a rack formed on the top to stably support golf things and vehicle wheels formed on the underside for driving; distance measuring sensors which are formed front left and right sides inside the vehicle body to sense the direction change by the difference of the distance to the transceiver carried by the golfer; an RF module which measures the distance to the transceiver by tracing the transceiver carried by the golfer; and a gyro and tilt sensor capable of maintaining a stable posture of the vehicle body according to the topography of a moving region; a main controller on which a control algorithm for automatically maintaining the distance by signals of a CCD sensor and the RF signals for recognizing and avoiding the obstacles existing on the moving direction, performing the dangerous topography avoid determination using the image sensing of the CCD sensor, stabilizing the posture according to the angular speed and an acceleration speed by using the gyro sensor and a tilt sensor, and controlling a vehicle wheel driving motor.
title: Intelligent caddy robot

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of wearable outer limb robots, in particular to a human body motion compensation method and system for a wearable outer limb robot, which fuses multi-sensing information through Kalman filtering, observes the state of a human-outer limb system in real time to obtain the influence of human body motion on the outer limb robot, and on this basis, the human body motion compensation method and system for the wearable outer limb robot are provided. An outer limb artificial potential field is constructed, the tail end track of the outer limb robot is adjusted in real time, the influence of human body movement on the preset track of the outer limb robot is compensated, and therefore precise operation of the outer limb in the operation process is achieved. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of higher accuracy and stability, low manufacturing cost and high universality.
title: Human body motion compensation method and system for wearable outer limb robot

abstract: The robot control system according to one aspect of the present disclosure is provided with: a reception unit for receiving a frame image in which the imaging position is changed in accordance with operation of a robot operated on the basis of a command; a command generation unit that generates a command; and an operation image generation unit that generates an operation image by extracting, from the frame image, a partial region in accordance with the command such that a delay in operation of the robot with respect to the command is indicated.
title: ROBOT CONTROL SYSTEM, ROBOT CONTROL METHOD, AND ROBOT CONTROL PROGRAM

abstract: The invention discloses a task optimization scheduling method and system based on a welcome explanation robot, belongs to the technical field of robots, and aims to solve the technical problem of how to improve the welcome explanation task execution efficiency of the welcome explanation robot, guide a user to a destination while explaining contents for the user and improve the welcome explanation task execution efficiency of the welcome explanation robot. According to the technical scheme, the method specifically comprises the following steps that a welcome explanation robot receives a target instruction, identifies a to-be-processed target task, automatically obtains a target welcome user and determines a target welcome explanation mode; the welcome explanation robot determines a target welcome user through an ultra-high-definition camera, obtains information of the target welcome user according to the recognized target welcome user, and sends the information to the cloud for functional area association; and judging whether the determined target welcome explanation mode is consistent with the received instruction sent by the target welcome user or not.
title: Task optimization scheduling method and system based on welcome explanation robot

abstract: A device, system and method for plug-and-play integration of components in robotic systems is provided. According to the present invention, components such as sensors may be seamlessly incorporated to a robot ecosystem thanks to the employment of dedicated hardware devices providing all configuration abstractions needed to produce the integration. In some embodiments, information models of preferred robotic middlewares are employed to transform raw component data into robotic middleware data.
title: DEVICE, SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR PLUG-AND-PLAY INTEGRATION OF COMPONENTS IN ROBOTIC SYSTEMS

abstract: The invention belongs to the field of underwater operation tools, and particularly discloses an underwater cleaning robot. The robot comprises a body frame, a buoyancy module, a propelling module, a cleaning module and a control power distribution module, wherein the body frame is divided into a top layer, a middle layer and a bottom layer from top to bottom; the buoyancy module is fixed on the top layer of the body frame; the propelling module is fixed to the top layer and the middle layer of the body frame and used for driving the underwater cleaning robot to move and meanwhile adjusting theposture of the underwater cleaning robot; the cleaning module comprises a side face cleaning assembly and a bottom face cleaning assembly which are used for cleaning a net cage side net and a net cage bottom net correspondingly; and the control power distribution module is fixed to the middle layer of the body frame and used for providing a power source for the underwater cleaning robot so as tocontrol the working process of the underwater cleaning robot. According to the underwater cleaning robot, cleaning work of the net cage side net and the net cage bottom net can be considered, the gravity center of the robot does not need to be adjusted, and the cleaning speed, stability and adaptability of the underwater cleaning robot are effectively improved.
title: Underwater cleaning robot

abstract: The invention relates to an assembled module type decentralized control robot which is assembled by a plurality of modules of different functions, the modules are of multi-face three-dimensional structures, and each face of the modules are provided with electric connection pieces allowing the modules to be disassembled and assembled; a single module is internally provided with a central processing unit, the single module is internally provided with different functional assemblies according to different tasks, the functional assemblies are arranged on any face of the corresponding module, the other faces are provided with a plurality of power source or network signal electrodes, and the electrodes in the modules are electrically connected with the adjacent modules through the electric connection pieces.
title: Assembled module type decentralized control robot

abstract: A method for navigating a robotic mower (2) limited by a boundary (6), and a robotic mower (2) configured to perform the method. The robotic mower (2) repeatedly determines (S100) its position by means of a positioning unit (8), navigates (S102) based on the determined position, determines (S104) that a new position of the robotic mower (2) cannot be accurately obtained, determines (S106) a position uncertainty distance (R) based on the positions obtained by the positioning unit (8) and a dead reckoning sensor (10) provided in the robotic mower (2), calculates (S108) a distance (D) to the closest boundary, determines (S110) a navigation margin as the difference between the distance (D) to the closest boundary (6) and the position uncertainty distance (R), and executes (S112) a safety operation if the navigation margin equals a predetermined value.
title: A ROBOTIC MOWER AND A METHOD FOR NAVIGATING THE SAME

abstract: The invention discloses a metamaterial configuration line drive under-actuated hyper-redundant software robot for wafer processing. The mechanical arm of the super-redundant soft robot comprises a multi-section structure and a linear transmission assembly. The multi-section structure comprises a first supporting section, a swinging section and a second supporting section. The control unit is in control connection with the driving unit, the driving unit is fixedly connected with one end of the first supporting section, the other end of the first supporting section is movably connected with one end of the swing section, the other end of the swing section is movably connected with one end of the second supporting section, and the other end of the second supporting section is fixedly connected with the soft gripper. The linear transmission assembly is arranged on the multi-section structure, and power transmission of the multi-section structure is achieved. A distributed driving framework and a stay wire force transmission design are adopted, and a power source is arranged at the rear, so that the mechanical arm body is long, thin and light, and high flexibility can be achieved. Through the combination of the hyper-redundant joints and the stay wire force transmission structure, the mechanical arm can achieve self-adaptive movement under the condition of a limited driving source, and the operation capacity of the robot is remarkably improved.
title: Metamaterial configuration line-driven under-actuated hyper-redundant software robot for wafer processing

abstract: The system has standardized, mutually compatible and inter connectable, static and mobile, sea, air and space multiblock cells (1-28) and multiblock robots are produced with minimal expense on development and construction. The robots can be made using optional combinations of the entire spectrum of multiblock robot parts.
title: Modular robot system

abstract: A motor drive circuit for a robot includes a switching unit switching among a normal state in which regenerative power is supplied to a regenerative capacitor, a first state in which a voltage is applied to a first resistor, and a second state in which a voltage is applied to the first resistor and a second resistor based on a detection result of a detection unit, wherein the switching unit switches to the first state when the voltage applied to the regenerative capacitor detected in the detection unit is equal to or larger than a first threshold in the normal state, and switches to the second state when the voltage applied to the first resistor is equal to or larger than a second threshold larger than the first threshold in the first state.
title: Motor drive circuit for motor and robot system

abstract: The present invention relates to a mobile robot for providing a remote control service and a method for providing a remote control service for a mobile robot. The mobile robot can provide a remote control service for an electronic device, by comprising: a driving unit which moves a mobile robot by controlling the actuation of wheels; a device identifying unit which recognizes a heat radiating device using a heat sensor during movement, recognizes an image of the recognized heat radiating device, and identifies an electronic device having the same image as the recognized image; a device registering unit which searches for remote control information of the electronic device, and registers the searched remote control information and position information as information of the electronic device; and a remote control unit which remotely controls the electronic device using the remote control information and the position information. Therefore, the mobile robot allows a user to conveniently control an electronic device by automatically controlling the identified electronic device.
title: Mobile robot for providing remote control service and method thereof

abstract: Described herein are systems, apparatus, and methods for precise placement and guidance of tools during surgery, particularly spinal surgery, using minimally invasive surgical techniques. Several minimally invasive approaches to spinal surgeries were conceived, percutaneous technique being one of them. This procedures looks to establish a skin opening as small as possible by accessing inner organs via needle-puncture of the skin. The percutaneous technique is used in conjunction with a robotic surgical system to further enhance advantages of manual percutaneous techniques by improving precision, usability and/or shortening surgery time by removal of redundant steps.
title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR PERFORMING MINIMALLY INVASIVE SPINAL SURGERY WITH A ROBOTIC SURGICAL SYSTEM USING A PERCUTANEOUS TECHNIQUE

abstract: The invention discloses ceramic substrate transferring equipment. The transferring equipment comprises a first conveying line unit used for conveying a cleaning basket jig, a second conveying line unit used for conveying a sputtering jig, a taking-out four-axis robot used for taking out ceramic substrates from the cleaning basket jig and a transferring placing six-axis robot used for arranging theceramic substrates in the sputtering jig; and the first conveying line unit and the second conveying line unit are arranged side by side in parallel, the taking-out four-axis robot and the transferring placing six-axis robot are located between the two conveying line units, and the transferring placing six-axis robot is opposite to the taking-out four-axis robot. Transferring of the ceramic substrates is realized in a full-automatic mode, manual intervention is not needed, the transferring speed is high, the ceramic substrates are not prone to be damaged, and the ceramic substrates are protected against secondary pollution by human fingers.
title: Ceramic substrate transferring equipment

abstract: The invention relates to a wall-climbing robot for wind turbine blade operation, and realizes blade monitoring and cleaning operation. The wall-climbing robot can be sucked on a blade of a wind turbine and move forward along the surface of the blade by adjusting a plurality of pairs of climbing arms to adapt to complex curvature changes of the surfaces of the blade; a blade cleaning system is usedfor cleaning the surface of the blade; to-be-sucked positions of the climbing arms are cleaned through cleaning blocks of a cleaning arm; a blade monitoring system is arranged to monitor the state ofthe blade nearby the position where the wall-climbing robot is located; the wall-climbing robot is connected with corresponding equipment in a cabin through a mooring pipeline, under the control of acorresponding valve, a cleaning agent is conveyed to the blade cleaning system or the cleaning arm at a proper moment, and clean water is conveyed to the blade cleaning system or the climbing arms, so that the pipeline at the climbing arm is subjected to exhausting or vacuum pumping. According to the robot, smudges on the surfaces of the blades can be efficiently removed, the influence of the smudges on the pneumatic performance of the blades is avoided, the blades of the wind turbine can work normally, and the loss of power generation amount is reduced.
title: Wall-climbing robot for wind turbine blade operation

abstract: A robot cleaner and a control method thereof are disclosed. The present invention is configured to, when performing cleaning again after the cleaning is forcibly terminated for any reason during the cleaning, prevent repeated cleaning by recognizing a self-position through an absolute position recognition, improve a detection error of a position of a relative position recognition portion by using an image detection unit, and enhance the efficiency and stability of a system by performing cleaning using the similarity of an image between a cleaning area and an image detected through the image detection unit, thereby increasing user convenience.
title: ROBOT CLEANER AND CONTROLLING METHOD OF THE SAME

abstract: A method of controlling a robot manipulator (190) on the basis of a program (P1, P2, P3) containing a plurality of movement instructions. In the method, it is determined (216) whether any of the movement instructions relates to a non-verified location of the robot manipulator, wherein a location is a point, an orientation, a path and/or a modulated path. If this is true, the method applies (224) a policy which restricts execution of the program.
title: POLICY-RESTRICTED EXECUTION OF A ROBOT PROGRAM WITH MOVEMENT INSTRUCTIONS
