abstract: The invention provides a robot emergency disposal system and method, and the system comprises a sensing module which is used for monitoring the state of a robot and the environment state in real time, and transmitting a monitoring result to a processing module; the processing module is used for judging whether the robot is in an emergency according to the monitoring result sent by the sensing module and generating an emergency disposal instruction; and the execution module is used for executing a corresponding emergency disposal action according to the emergency disposal instruction generated by the processing module. According to the technical scheme, the robot can conduct effective emergency disposal when encountering an emergency, and therefore the safety and reliability of the robot are improved.
title: Robot emergency disposal system and method

abstract: The invention discloses a slider-pushed type robot finger structure. A finger body is composed of a base, a finger root, a finger middle knuckle and a fingertip. The base, the finger root and the fingertip are sequentially connected in series. The finger root is connected with the base and the fingertip. A stepping motor is arranged in the finger root to drive a lead screw to rotate, the lead screw rotates to drive a slider to conduct reciprocating linear motion in the direction of the finger root. The slider is connected with the fingertip through a connection rod, and the connection rod, namely the finger middle knuckle, also achieves the function of assisting in grabbing. The slider-pushed type robot finger structure is novel in design, the-difference between the slider-pushed type robot finger structure and a traditional slider-crank mechanism is that a motion driving piece is changed from a crank into the slider. By means of gears, rapid adjustment of the finger posture can be achieved, and fine adjustment of the finger posture can be achieved through a lead screw-slider structure.
title: Slider-pushed type robot finger structure

abstract: The invention discloses a shopping mall guiding method and system based on natural language processing and a robot, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining request information of a user, and the request information comprises a target shop of the user; determining path information from the current position of the user to a target shop according to the user request information; and guiding the user to reach the target shop through the path information. When a strange shop is found in a shopping mall, the route information can be obtained only by inputting the name of the shop which the user needs to arrive at, and the user can arrive at the target shop through the guidance of the route information. The path information is the guidance navigation path generated based on the actual environment in the shopping mall, so that the user can quickly find the target shop in the diversified and complicated shopping mall.
title: Market guiding method, system and robot based on natural language processing

abstract: The present invention relates to a method for controlling a robot vacuum which includes a pair of rotating plates having a mop that is coupled to the lower surface thereof and faces a floor surface, and which travels by rotating the pair of rotating plates, the method comprising: a first traveling step in which the robot vacuum starts from a predetermined starting point on a floor surface and travels a predetermined distance; a second traveling step in which the robot vacuum travels to the starting point after the first traveling step; and a direction changing step of rotating the robot vacuum at a predetermined direction-changing angle, and thus the robot vacuum can meticulously clean a circular cleaning area while repeatedly traveling within same.
title: ROBOT VACUUM AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING ROBOT VACUUM

abstract: The disclosure provides an intelligent shopping guide method and system, sharing server and intelligent shopping guide robot. The intelligent shopping guide method includes performing classification and modeling according to customer data to obtain a customer data model containing a plurality of customer types; performing classification and modeling according to shop data and clothing data to obtain a clothing data model containing a plurality of clothing types; and making a classification analysis of a purchase history, and performing matching in combination with the customer data model and the clothing data model, thereby obtaining a clothing recommendation scheme aiming at a certain customer type. The method is relatively intelligentized, and provides relatively individualized and humanized clothing recommendation schemes for customers.
title: Intelligent shopping guide method and system, sharing server and intelligent shopping guide robot

abstract: The invention discloses a photo-thermal effect-based light-driven sensing integrated flexible joint and a light path system thereof, the flexible joint comprises a multimode fiber and a photo-thermal conversion elastomer, the photo-thermal conversion elastomer is in an arc-shaped joint shape, the photo-thermal conversion elastomer contains a material for photo-thermal conversion, and the material for photo-thermal conversion is a material for photo-thermal conversion. The multimode optical fiber is eccentrically embedded in the photothermal conversion elastomer; a fiber bragg grating is engraved on a fiber core of the multimode fiber, and the midpoint of the fiber bragg grating is flush with the midpoint of the flexible joint; when the incident light power of the multimode optical fiber is increased, the photothermal conversion elastomer bends towards the curvature reduction direction, and the reflection spectrum signal of the fiber bragg grating reflects the change angle of the photothermal conversion elastomer. According to the invention, sensing and driving functions are integrated by using the fiber Bragg grating, and the device has the advantages of high integration, low energy loss, small size, light weight, interference resistance and the like, and is conveniently applied to soft robots, in-vivo operations, high radiation, flammable and explosive occasions and the like.
title: Photo-thermal effect-based light-driven sensing integrated flexible joint and light path system thereof

abstract: The present invention relates to a terrain sensing variable agricultural robot capable of changing the width, which can change the width according to the terrain and perform the necessary work in the field. According to the present invention, provided is the terrain sensing variable agricultural robot comprising: driving modules provided on both sides of a body of the robot so that the robot moves along a path of the field; a work module inserted between the driving modules, formed to be replaceable according to the work required for the field, and allowing the robot to travel through the driving module and perform the necessary work for the field; and a control module for detecting the topography of the field and controlling the width between the driving modules according to the detected topography of the field. Accordingly, the terrain sensing variable agricultural robot can change the manufactured width thereof.
title: TERRAIN SENSING VARIABLE AGRICULTURAL ROBOT WITH VARIABLE WIDTH

abstract: The invention provides a column-type joint robot, and relates to the technical field of automatic transfer. The column-type joint robot comprises a fixed base. An inner gear is arranged on the inner side of the fixed base. A rotary base is fixedly connected to the position, corresponding to the inner gear, of the top side of the fixed base. A supporting base is rotatably connected to the top sideof the rotary base. A first motor is arranged at the top side of the supporting base. The output end of the first motor is fixedly connected with a first speed reducer, and the first speed reducer isfixedly connected with the supporting base. A PLC controls two third motors and third speed reducers on the bottom sides of the third motors to rotate so as to drive a second joint arm and a second sliding rail on the bottom side of a first joint arm to rotate to adjust the position, then the PLC controls a manipulator to clamp goods, and afterwards, the PLC starts a second motor and the first motor again to enable the joint robot to clamp goods and then to move upwards and rotate to a placement position to stack the goods; and the column-type joint robot is very convenient to use, manual transfer is avoided, and the good stacking efficiency is improved.
title: Column-type joint robot

abstract: The invention discloses a robot operation device. The robot operating device includes: a moving vehicle; the guide rail is mounted on the moving vehicle; and a plurality of robots slidably mounted on the guide rail so as to be movable along the guide rail. A plurality of robots cooperate with each other and are used to manipulate a product manufacturing machine to manufacture a product by the product manufacturing machine. The plurality of robots are also configured to cooperate with the product manufacturing machine to complete manufacturing of the product with the product manufacturing machine. The movable trolley comprises a movable base, a movable trolley and a movable trolley, and the fixed support is installed on the movable base, and the guide rail is fixedly installed on the fixed support and linearly extends in the horizontal direction. In the embodiment of the invention, the robot operating device is used for replacing an operator to operate the product manufacturing machine, so that misoperation can be effectively avoided, and safety production accidents are avoided. In addition, the robot operating device is used for replacing operators, production efficiency can be improved, and cost can be reduced.
title: ROBOT OPERATING DEVICE AND PRODUCT MANUFACTURING SYSTEM

abstract: A robot apparatus (1) is capable of audibly expressing an emotion in a manner similar to that performed by a living animal. The robot apparatus (1) utters a sentence by means of voice synthesis by performing a process including the steps of: an emotional state discrimination step (S1) for discriminating an emotional state of an emotion model (73); a sentence output step (S2) for outputting a sentence representing a content to be uttered in the form of a voice; a parameter control step (S3) for controlling a parameter for use in voice synthesis, depending upon the emotional state discriminated in the emotional state discrimination step (S1); and a voice synthesis step (S4) for inputting, to a voice synthesis unit, the sentence output in the sentence output step (S2) and synthesizing a voice in accordance with the controlled parameter. <IMAGE>
title: Method and apparatus for voice synthesis and robot apparatus

abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent ordering and delivering robot for an unmanned restaurant. A customer orders by self through a self-service ordering module, an intelligent robot performs voice playing confirmation on an ordering menu of the customer, prints the ordering menu and generates a payment two-dimensional code, the customer completes payment through WeChat or Alipay code scanning according to the payment two-dimensional code displayed by the robot, the customer sends the printed ordering menu to a kitchen after payment, and sends dishes to a dining table from the kitchen after receiving calling information of the kitchen, and ordering or delivering work is completed. According to the intelligent ordering and delivering robot for the unmanned restaurant, ordering and delivering work of the restaurant is completely completed through the intelligent robot, unmanned management of the restaurant is achieved, the labor cost of the restaurant is greatly reduced, services more accurate and efficient than services can be provided, and the risk of conflicts between waiters and customers is reduced.
title: Intelligent ordering and delivering robot for unmanned restaurant

abstract: The invention relates to a cable tunnel inspection robot which comprises a walking mechanism, a supporting arm assembly, a measuring device, an early warning sensor, a fire extinguishing mechanism and a guiding device, the supporting arm assembly is arranged at one end of the walking mechanism, the guiding device is arranged at the other end of the walking mechanism, and the measuring device is arranged at the free end of the supporting arm assembly. An early warning sensor and a fire extinguishing mechanism are arranged on the upper side of the walking mechanism, the guiding device comprises a support, telescopic rods are arranged on the two sides of the support, transmission guide wheels are arranged at the outer ends of the telescopic rods, and distance measuring sensors are arranged on the upper sides of the transmission guide wheels. According to the cable tunnel inspection robot, the measurer can be quickly and accurately buckled on the outer surface of a cable to measure electrical data, the support arm assembly and the measuring device act flexibly and accurately, and the problems that an existing cable tunnel inspection robot is slow in response, poor in accuracy, complex in follow-up calibration mode and the like when measuring the electrical data of a wire are effectively solved; and fire disasters can be timely found and automatically extinguished in the inspection process.
title: Cable tunnel inspection robot

abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an outbound method and related equipment. The method is applied to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: when calling an outbound robot to execute an outbound service on a user in an outbound list based on an outbound strategy, determining a target TTS engine according to the called priority of each pre-configured TTS engine indicated by the calling information in the TTS engine configuration data, and calling a target TTS engine to perform text-to-voice conversion on the target verbal skill to obtainvoice data corresponding to the target verbal skill, thereby calling an outbound robot to communicate with the user based on the voice data. By adopting the invention, one outbound strategy can support various TTS engines, the target TTS engine can be determined according to the called priority of each TTS engine in the call process, and the outbound strategy is executed based on the target TTS engine, so that the outbound intelligence can be improved.
title: Outbound method and related equipment

abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a steering engine over-temperature protection method and device, an intelligent robot and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a steering engine resistance measurement value when a target steering engine rotates; obtaining a steering engine resistance estimation value when the target steering engine rotates; determining an actual steering engine resistance value of the target steering engine according to the steering engine resistance measurement value and the steering engine resistance estimation value; determining an actual steering engine temperature value of the target steering engine according to the actual steering engine resistance value and a pre-calibrated resistance temperature curve; and if the actual steering engine temperature value is greater than or equal to the preset temperature threshold value, performing over-temperature protection processing on the target steering engine. The actual steering engine temperature value in the target steering engine can be directly determined according to the actual steering engine electric resistance value under the condition of no temperature sensor, and the problems that the temperature sensor is inaccurate in temperature measurement and complex in installation are solved.
title: Steering engine over-temperature protection method and device, intelligent robot and storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses a multi-degree-of-freedom industrial robot with small size and high flexibility, belongs to the technical field of industrial robots, and aims to solve the problems that each mechanical part of the industrial robot is driven by an independent motor or hydraulic pressure, a plurality of mechanical arms are inconvenient to store, and the whole equipment is relatively huge. A first motor, a first push-pull type electromagnet and a second push-pull type electromagnet control a lead screw to rotate to drive a movable plug to compress hydraulic oil in a liquid storage cylinder, the hydraulic oil enters a sleeve, a piston plate enables a rack to drive a meshing gear to move under the hydraulic effect, and the hydraulic oil is separated from the liquid storage cylinder. The second mechanical arm, the third mechanical arm or the fourth mechanical arm is driven to rotate through the end face gear, the bevel gear and the rotating shaft, rotation of the second mechanical arm, the third mechanical arm or the fourth mechanical arm is controlled correspondingly, and the structure is compact; and the first mechanical arm, the second mechanical arm, the third mechanical arm and the fourth mechanical arm can be stored when not used, and the space is further compressed.
title: Small-size high-flexibility multi-degree-of-freedom industrial robot

abstract: The present invention may provide a method for controlling the movement of a robot based on the risk determination, wherein the robot transports an object. According to the present invention, the method comprises a risk determination step of determining the degree of risk related to robot operation, and a robot control step of controlling the movement of the robot based on the degree of risk. In addition, according to the present invention, the determination of the degree of risk related to robot operation may include an internal risk judgment step of judging internal risk based on properties of the object, and an external risk determination step of judging the external risk related to the environmental condition around the robot.
title: METHOD FOR CONTROLLING MOVEMENT OF ROBOT BASED ON DEGREE OF RISK AND APPRATUS USING THE SAME

abstract: The invention discloses a query method and device of a self-moving device, a storage medium and an electronic device.The query method of the self-moving device comprises the steps that under the condition that a voice query instruction sent by a target object is received, running of a current work task of the self-moving device is stopped; the to-be-queried content of the voice query instruction is determined, and the to-be-queried content comprises at least one of the following contents: the loss condition of all consumables of the self-moving equipment, the loss condition of target consumables of the self-moving equipment and the task progress of the current work task; the query result corresponding to the to-be-queried content is determined according to the to-be-queried content, that is, the self-moving device can analyze and execute the voice query instruction sent by the target object and feed back the voice query instruction to the target object, and by means of the technical scheme, the problem that in the prior art, a sweeping robot cannot respond to consumable query and task query sent by a user in time is solved.
title: Query method and device of self-moving equipment, storage medium and electronic device

abstract: The invention provides an inchworm-imitating mobile robot which comprises a clamping jaw joint, an autorotation joint, a first angle rotation joint, a second angle rotation joint and a carrier tape telescopic joint, the clamping jaw joint, the autorotation joint, the first angle rotation joint and the second angle rotation joint are symmetrically arranged based on the carrier tape telescopic joint, and the carrier tape telescopic joint is arranged on the carrier tape telescopic joint. The autorotation joint is used for enabling the robot to autorotate within the range of 360 degrees; the angle rotation joint is used for enabling the robot to complete an angle rotation range of-60 degrees to 60 degrees; the carrier tape telescopic joint can carry a camera, a sensor and the like. The inchworm-imitating mobile robot has the advantages of various movement modes, high adaptability, high movement flexibility, high carrying capacity and high modular replacement capacity.
title: Inchworm-imitating mobile robot

abstract: A method for controlling the operation of a robot (105) in an environment (110) is provided. The robot (105) is configured to exchange data with a remote server (150) by establishing a robot-remote server communication (RL0) through a communication network (155). The method comprises: - having the robot be required to perform a task in the environment (100); - generating (206) a robot procedure RP adapted to be performed by the robot (105) for carrying out said task, said robot procedure RP comprising a corresponding set of procedures Pj each one corresponding to one or more corresponding software applications SP comprising instructions for accordingly controlling the operation of the robot (105) for performing the corresponding procedure Pj; - selecting (206) a set of at least one device (Di), each device (Di) of the set having a processing unit suitable to execute at least one of said software applications SP, each device (Di) of the set being located in the environment (110); - having the remote server (150) cause (208) each device (Di) of the set of devices to download and install at least one of said software applications SP; - having the robot (105) perform (210) the robot procedure RP at least partially under the control of commands sent by at least one device (Di) of the set, said commands being generated by the at least one device (Di) of the set by having the processing unit of the at least a device (Di) of the set executing the instructions of the installed at least one software application SP.
title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR ENHANCING ROBOT CAPABILITIES

abstract: The invention provides a dish-collecting robot for restaurants, which comprises a head detection device, wherein the head detection device is fixed on a rotatable cavity; the rotatable cavity is provided with a left arm supporting column and a right arm supporting column; the left arm supporting column and the right arm supporting column are embedded in the rotatable cavity; the front ends of the left arm supporting column and the right arm supporting column are provided with a left gripper and a right gripper correspondingly; the front ends of the left gripper and the right gripper are embedded in the tail ends of the left arm supporting column and the right arm supporting column correspondingly; a control rotating motor is arranged at the bottom of the rotatable cavity; the rotatable cavity is connected with the control rotating motor through a transmission rod; a bottom plate is arranged on the lower part of the rotatable cavity; one end of the bottom plate is provided with a dish storage cavity; the bottom of the dish storage cavity is fixedly connected with the face end of the bottom plate; the other end of the bottom plate is provided with a box body; the bottom of the box body is fixedly connected with the face end of the bottom plate. The dish-collecting robot changes the traditional dish treatment mode into an automatic collecting, tidying and transporting mode, so that labor cost is greatly saved, and labor force is released.
title: Dish-collecting robot for restaurants

abstract: The invention provides an off-line programming spraying path generation method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and is applied to a terminal.The method comprises the steps that a spraying mechanism model, a spraying tool model and a target workpiece model are constructed, and spraying process parameters are obtained, the spraying model comprises a spraying robot model, a connecting column model and a guide rail model extending in the left-right direction; a target spraying mode is selected, the terminal displays a spraying track parameter setting interface corresponding to the target spraying mode, spraying track parameters input by a user in the spraying track parameter setting interface are obtained, and a target spraying track is generated; and based on the target spraying track, a spraying tool model is used for conducting spraying simulation on a target workpiece model. In the embodiment provided by the invention, the spraying robot model, the connecting column model and the guide rail model extending in the left-right direction are constructed, so that the spraying robot model can move left and right along the guide rail model and move up and down along the connecting column model, the thickness of a simulated paint film is more uniform, and the simulated spraying effect is more attractive.
title: Offline programming spraying path generation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium

abstract: The invention relates to a motion planning method for intelligent cooperation of robot travelling and operation. The motion planning method is used for a hedge trimming robot, and comprises the following steps of, firstly, acquiring working environment information, planning a global path which passes through all to-be-trimmed motion planning method hedges and has the shortest total motion travel, then determining a trimming operation area, and planning a local path of a mobile base plate; and conducting smoothing on the local path, and then planning the track of a robot mechanical arm. According to the motion planning method, full-automatic operation of the robot can be achieved, and the automation and intelligence level of the robot is improved.
title: Motion planning method for intelligent cooperation of robot travelling and operation

abstract: Robotic picking devices and methods for performing a picking operation. The disclosed methods may involve executing an imagery analysis procedure to identify a feature of interest of an item, wherein the feature of interest may affect a picking device's ability to perform a picking operation, and generating a grasping plan executable by the picking device, wherein the grasping plan accommodates the feature of interest so that the picking device is able to perform the picking operation.
title: ITEM FEATURE ACCOMMODATION

abstract: The invention discloses an exterior wall washing robot. The exterior wall washing robot comprises a washing machine body, wherein bearing plates are fixedly arranged on the two sides of the bottom ofthe washing machine body, a main sweeping stick and a secondary sweeping stick are connected between the two sets of bearing plates, rolling wheels are connected to the outer ends of the two sets of bearing plates, belts are connected on the rolling wheels in a sleeving mode, a first stepping motor and a second stepping motor are mounted at the two sides of the upper surface of the washing machinebody, a third stepping motor is fixedly mounted in the middle of the upper portion of the washing machine body, supporting rods are fixedly mounted at the four corners of the upper surface of the washing machine body, a fan plate is connected to the top ends of the supporting rods, and four sets of fans are mounted inside the fan plate. According to the exterior wall washing robot, wall glass issucked through the belts and suction discs, and the fans are mounted so that the washing machine body can be attached to the wall surface, and a conduit and nozzles are mounted at the front end of thewashing machine body, so that a washing liquid is sprayed, and washing is achieved through the sweeping sticks.
title: Exterior wall washing robot

abstract: The invention relates to a software pneumatic robot control method, device and equipment based on a Koopman operator and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the lagging characteristic data of a software pneumatic robot, and constructing a discrete time nonlinear dynamic model based on the lagging characteristic data; approaching the discrete time nonlinear dynamic model by using a Koopman operator, and constructing an SPAs model based on the Koopman operator; and a reference trajectory is given, a model prediction controller is designed through the SPAs model, and dynamic control is conducted on the soft pneumatic robot through the model prediction controller. The model prediction controller can still work well when processing physical constraints of SPAs, the hysteresis problem of the soft pneumatic robot is solved, and more accurate control is achieved.
title: Soft robot control method, device and equipment based on Koopman operator and medium

abstract: The invention provides a remote monitoring method and system for a mobile fire-fighting robot, and relates to the technical field of mobile fire-fighting robots, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a cloud point number and real-time image data through a real-time landform recognition sensor, and carrying out the construction and self-positioning of an environment map through a LOAM algorithm; carrying out field detection by using an environment sensor, transmitting detection data to a remote monitoring system, carrying out analysis, and obtaining coordinate points of fire signals according to an environment map; according to the coordinate point of the fire signal and self-positioning, planning a path to the fire signal position by using a path planning algorithm; and in the process that the mobile fire-fighting robot moves according to the planned path, the planned path is adjusted in real time according to an obstacle avoidance algorithm to obtain an optimal path. The invention provides a remote monitoring method and system for a mobile fire-fighting robot, and solves the technical problems that the control response is not timely, the operation state of the robot cannot be monitored, and environment sensing information cannot be transmitted back.
title: Remote monitoring method and system for mobile fire-fighting robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of banking business transaction, and particularly discloses a non-contact banking business service station. The service station comprises a service stationbody; a plurality of intelligent self-service robots are arranged in the service station body. A banking business zone, a self-service physical examination business zone, a buffet zone and an entertainment service zone are arranged in the service station body. The non-contact banking business service station can realize full coverage of non-cash businesses and can realize simulation or actual operation on stock, futures, convertible bonds and overseas stock market transactions. An operation screen is a hand-waving-controlled non-contact screen with voice recognition technology, so the risk ofcross virus infection caused by use by multiple users is avoided. At the same time, zero virus invasion is ensured in a functional zone with N95 grade protection plus a negative ion generator.
title: Non-contact banking business service station

abstract: The invention relates to the field of flexible robots, and discloses a flexible charging robot based on rope driving. The flexible charging robot comprises a plurality of control ropes, a rope driving device, a flexible mechanical arm and an end executor; the control ropes can be driven by the rope driving device to telescope to drive the flexible mechanical arm to bend, and then the end executor installed at the tail end of the flexible mechanical arm is driven to move. According to the flexible charging robot based on rope driving, the charging robot is formed by combining the flexible mechanical arm with a charging head, can adapt to a garage environment which has a narrow working space and many obstacles by combining free bending motion of the flexible mechanical arm and is small in size, low in weight, flexible to move and low in control cost; meanwhile, a motor and a control circuit are far away from the end executor, therefore, the flexible charging robot is not liable to be affected by an outside environment, and the service life of the robot can be guaranteed.
title: Flexible charging robot based on rope driving
